```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { createJobLane } from './lane';

function deferred<T = void>() {
  let resolve!: (value: T) => void;
  const promise = new Promise<T>((r) => {
    resolve = r;
  });
  return { promise, resolve };
}
/** Resolves when `signal` aborts (at once if it already has). */
const untilAborted = (signal: AbortSignal): Promise<void> =>
  new Promise((resolve) => (signal.aborted ? resolve() : signal.addEventListener('abort', () => resolve(), { once: true })));
const ticks = async (n = 3) => {
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) await Promise.resolve();
};

describe('the work line (spec 3.1)', () => {
  it('runs one job at a time, in the order asked', async () => {
    const lane = createJobLane();
    const log: string[] = [];
    const first = deferred();
    const a = lane.run('import', async () => {
      log.push('import start');
      await first.promise;
      log.push('import end');
      return 1;
    });
    const b = lane.run('backup', async () => {
      log.push('backup');
      return 2;
    });
    const c = lane.run('restore', async () => {
      log.push('restore');
      return 3;
    });
    await ticks();
    expect(log).toEqual(['import start']);
    first.resolve();
    expect(await Promise.all([a, b, c])).toEqual([1, 2, 3]);
    expect(log).toEqual(['import start', 'import end', 'backup', 'restore']);
  });

  it('busy() names the running job from the moment it is asked for, and is null when idle', async () => {
    const lane = createJobLane();
    expect(lane.busy()).toBe(null);
    const hold = deferred();
    const job = lane.run('backup', () => hold.promise);
    expect(lane.busy()).toBe('backup');
    hold.resolve();
    await job;
    expect(lane.busy()).toBe(null);
  });

  it('cancelCurrent aborts the running job only: the next one still runs, with a fresh signal', async () => {
    const lane = createJobLane();
    const a = lane.run('import', (signal) => untilAborted(signal).then(() => 'stopped'));
    const b = lane.run('backup', async (signal) => (signal.aborted ? 'aborted' : 'ran'));
    await ticks();
    lane.cancelCurrent();
    expect(await a).toBe('stopped');
    expect(await b).toBe('ran');
  });

  it('cancelAll stops the running job and drops the waiting ones with CANCELLED: their work never runs', async () => {
    const lane = createJobLane();
    const ran: string[] = [];
    const a = lane.run('import', (signal) => untilAborted(signal).then(() => 'stopped'));
    const b = lane.run('backup', async () => {
      ran.push('backup');
    });
    const c = lane.run('restore', async () => {
      ran.push('restore');
    });
    lane.cancelAll();
    expect(await a).toBe('stopped');
    await expect(b).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'CANCELLED' });
    await expect(c).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'CANCELLED' });
    expect(ran).toEqual([]);
    await lane.idle();
    expect(lane.busy()).toBe(null);
    // The line takes new work afterwards.
    expect(await lane.run('import', async () => 'again')).toBe('again');
  });

  it('idle() resolves at once when idle, else once nothing runs and nothing waits', async () => {
    const lane = createJobLane();
    await lane.idle();
    const hold = deferred();
    void lane.run('import', () => hold.promise);
    void lane.run('backup', async () => {});
    let idle = false;
    void lane.idle().then(() => {
      idle = true;
    });
    await ticks();
    expect(idle).toBe(false);
    hold.resolve();
    await lane.idle();
    expect(idle).toBe(true);
    expect(lane.busy()).toBe(null);
  });

  it('a job that fails, even before its first await, frees the line for the next', async () => {
    const lane = createJobLane();
    const a = lane.run('import', async () => {
      throw new Error('disk gone');
    });
    const b = lane.run('backup', () => {
      throw new Error('at once');
    });
    const c = lane.run('restore', async () => 'ran');
    await expect(a).rejects.toThrow('disk gone');
    await expect(b).rejects.toThrow('at once');
    expect(await c).toBe('ran');
  });
});
```

새 파일 `apps/desktop/src/main/jobs/lane.ts`:
```ts
import { LearnError } from '@learn/domain';
import { mainStrings } from '../strings';

/** What the work line runs (spec 3.1). */
export type JobKind = 'import' | 'backup' | 'restore';

export interface JobLane {
  /**
   * Runs `work` once every job asked for before it has ended, and settles as it does. Its signal aborts on
   * cancelCurrent or cancelAll: the work stops at its next checkpoint. A job cancelAll drops before it started rejects
   * with CANCELLED, and its work never runs.
   */
  run<T>(kind: JobKind, work: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>): Promise<T>;
  /** The running job's kind (from the moment it is asked for on an idle line); null when nothing runs. */
  busy(): JobKind | null;
  /** Aborts the running job's signal; the jobs waiting behind it still run. */
  cancelCurrent(): void;
  /** Quitting: aborts the running job and drops every waiting one. */
  cancelAll(): void;
  /** Resolves once nothing runs and nothing waits (at once when idle). */
  idle(): Promise<void>;
}

interface Waiting {
  start(): void;
  drop(reason: unknown): void;
}

/**
 * The main process's one work line (`library-jobs`): imports, backups and restores, one at a time, in the order asked —
 * one writer to the library and a predictable disk.
 */
export function createJobLane(): JobLane {
  const waiting: Waiting[] = [];
  let current: { kind: JobKind; abort: AbortController } | null = null;
  let idleWaiters: Array<() => void> = [];

  const next = (): void => {
    if (current !== null) return;
    const job = waiting.shift();
    if (job) {
      job.start();
      return;
    }
    const waiters = idleWaiters;
    idleWaiters = [];
    for (const resolve of waiters) resolve();
  };

  return {
    run<T>(kind: JobKind, work: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
      return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
        waiting.push({
          start: () => {
            const abort = new AbortController();
            current = { kind, abort };
            // On a later microtask: the caller's own bookkeeping after run() returns comes first, and a work that
            // throws at once is a rejection like any other.
            Promise.resolve()
              .then(() => work(abort.signal))
              .then(resolve, reject)
              .finally(() => {
                current = null;
                next();
              });
          },
          drop: reject,
        });
        next();
      });
    },
    busy: () => current?.kind ?? null,
    cancelCurrent: () => current?.abort.abort(),
    cancelAll() {
      for (const job of waiting.splice(0)) job.drop(new LearnError('CANCELLED', mainStrings.jobs.cancelled));
      current?.abort.abort();
      next(); // with nothing running, the idle waiters hear it now
    },
    idle: () => (current === null && waiting.length === 0 ? Promise.resolve() : new Promise<void>((resolve) => idleWaiters.push(resolve))),
  };
}
```

```ts
  });
```

새 파일 `apps/desktop/src/main/jobs/throttle.ts`:
```ts
/** A call made at most once per period: the first at once, then one at the end of the period for whatever came meanwhile. */
export interface Throttle {
  request(): void;
  /** A call that is waiting runs now (the end of a run); nothing when none waits. */
  flush(): void;
}

/** Progress notices and list announcements stay under their rate however fast the work reports (spec 3.3: ≤ 10 a second). */
export function createThrottle(fire: () => void, ms: number): Throttle {
  let last = Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
  const run = (): void => {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = undefined;
    last = Date.now();
    fire();
  };
  return {
    request() {
      if (timer !== undefined) return;
      const wait = last + ms - Date.now();
      if (wait <= 0) run();
      else timer = setTimeout(run, wait);
    },
    flush() {
      if (timer !== undefined) run();
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import {
  IDLE_IMPORT_STATE, LearnError,
  type DuplicateCard, type ErrorCode, type ImportOutcome, type ImportQueueState, type ImportReport, type LibraryItem,
} from '@learn/domain';
import type { ImportOptions } from '@learn/library';
import { createImportQueue, type DuplicateAnswer, type DuplicateQuestion, type ImportBatch, type ImportQueueDeps } from './import-queue';
import { createJobLane, type JobLane } from './lane';

afterEach(() => {
  vi.useRealTimers();
});

interface Deferred<T> {
  promise: Promise<T>;
  resolve(value: T): void;
}
function deferred<T = void>(): Deferred<T> {
  let resolve!: (value: T) => void;
  const promise = new Promise<T>((r) => {
    resolve = r;
  });
  return { promise, resolve };
}
const imported = (p: string, collectionId?: string | null): ImportOutcome => ({
  status: 'imported',
  path: p,
  item: { id: `item:${p}` } as LibraryItem,
  ...(collectionId ? { collectionId } : {}),
});
const duplicate = (p: string, existingItemId: string): ImportOutcome => ({ status: 'duplicate', path: p, existingItemId });
const failed = (p: string, code: ErrorCode, message: string): ImportOutcome => ({ status: 'failed', path: p, code, message });
const card = (id: string): DuplicateCard => ({ title: `자료 ${id}`, type: 'pdf', size: 1000, createdAt: '2026-10-31T00:00:00.000Z', storageMode: 'managed' });
const SKIP: DuplicateAnswer = { choice: 'skip', applyToRest: false, askedOn: null };
const until = (signal: AbortSignal | undefined): Promise<void> =>
  new Promise((resolve) => {
    if (!signal) return;
    if (signal.aborted) resolve();
    else signal.addEventListener('abort', () => resolve(), { once: true });
  });

/**
 * A fake importer: `outcome(path, opts)` answers each call. `hold(path, bytes)` keeps the next import of that path
 * running — after reporting `bytes` read — until released or its signal aborts; a stopped file answers CANCELLED, as
 * the real importer does.
 */
function fakeImporter(outcome: (p: string, opts: ImportOptions) => ImportOutcome = (p, o) => imported(p, o.collectionId)) {
  const calls: Array<{ path: string; opts: ImportOptions }> = [];
  const holds = new Map<string, { bytes: number; started: Deferred<void>; release: Deferred<void> }>();
  let running = 0;
  let mostAtOnce = 0;
  return {
    calls,
    mostAtOnce: () => mostAtOnce,
    hold(p: string, bytes = 0) {
      const h = { bytes, started: deferred(), release: deferred() };
      holds.set(p, h);
      return { started: h.started.promise, release: () => h.release.resolve() };
    },
    importer: {
      async importOne(p: string, opts: ImportOptions): Promise<ImportOutcome> {
        calls.push({ path: p, opts });
        running++;
        mostAtOnce = Math.max(mostAtOnce, running);
        try {
          const h = holds.get(p);
          if (h) {
            holds.delete(p);
            if (h.bytes > 0) opts.onBytes?.(h.bytes);
            h.started.resolve();
            await Promise.race([h.release.promise, until(opts.signal)]);
          } else await Promise.resolve();
          if (opts.signal?.aborted) return failed(p, 'CANCELLED', '가져오기를 취소했습니다.');
          return outcome(p, opts);
        } finally {
          running--;
        }
      },
    },
  };
}

function setup(over: {
  importer?: ReturnType<typeof fakeImporter>;
  answers?: DuplicateAnswer[];
  cards?: Record<string, DuplicateCard | null>;
  sizes?: Record<string, number>;
  lane?: JobLane;
  deps?: Partial<ImportQueueDeps>;
} = {}) {
  const fake = over.importer ?? fakeImporter();
  const lane = over.lane ?? createJobLane();
  const questions: Array<{ owner: number } & DuplicateQuestion> = [];
  const answers = [...(over.answers ?? [])];
  const filed: Array<[string, string[]]> = [];
  const announced: string[][] = [];
  const queue = createImportQueue({
    lane,
    importer: () => fake.importer,
    card: (id) => {
      const known = over.cards?.[id];
      return known === undefined ? card(id) : known;
    },
    ask: async (owner, q) => {
      questions.push({ owner, ...q });
      return answers.shift() ?? { choice: 'skip', applyToRest: false, askedOn: owner };
    },
    fileExisting: (collectionId, itemIds) => {
      filed.push([collectionId, [...itemIds]]);
      return itemIds.length;
    },
    announce: (itemIds) => announced.push(itemIds),
    stat: async (p) => over.sizes?.[p] ?? 10,
    warn: () => {},
    ...over.deps,
  });
  const reports: Array<{ report: ImportReport; openIn: number | null }> = [];
  queue.onFinished((report, openIn) => reports.push({ report, openIn }));
  const states: ImportQueueState[] = [];
  queue.onProgress((s) => states.push(s));
  /** The next run's report (ask before putting files in). */
  const nextReport = () =>
    new Promise<ImportReport>((resolve) => {
      const off = queue.onFinished((r) => {
        off();
        resolve(r);
      });
    });
  return { queue, fake, lane, questions, filed, announced, reports, states, nextReport };
}
const batch = (paths: string[], over: Partial<ImportBatch> = {}): ImportBatch => ({ paths, mode: 'managed', collectionId: null, owner: 1, ...over });
const report = (over: Partial<ImportReport>): ImportReport => ({
  imported: 0, filed: 0, filedExisting: 0, failed: [], openItemId: null, requested: 0, cancelled: false, mode: 'managed', collectionId: null, ...over,
});

describe('order and batches (spec 3.1)', () => {
  it('imports one file at a time, batch after batch, each with its own mode, collection and titles', async () => {
    const h = setup();
    const done = h.nextReport();
    h.queue.enqueue(batch(['/in/a1.pdf', '/in/a2.pdf']));
    h.queue.enqueue(batch(['/in/b1.mp4'], { mode: 'linked', collectionId: 'c-1', titles: { '/in/b1.mp4': '강의 4' } }));
    expect(await done).toEqual(report({ imported: 3, filed: 1, requested: 3, mode: null, collectionId: null }));
    expect(h.fake.calls.map((c) => [c.path, c.opts.mode, c.opts.collectionId, c.opts.title])).toEqual([
      ['/in/a1.pdf', 'managed', null, undefined],
      ['/in/a2.pdf', 'managed', null, undefined],
      ['/in/b1.mp4', 'linked', 'c-1', '강의 4'],
    ]);
    expect(h.fake.mostAtOnce()).toBe(1);
    expect(h.reports).toHaveLength(1); // one run, one report
    expect(h.queue.state()).toEqual(IDLE_IMPORT_STATE);
  });

  it('names the one mode and collection every batch of a run shared', async () => {
    const h = setup();
    const done = h.nextReport();
    h.queue.enqueue(batch(['/in/a.pdf'], { mode: 'linked', collectionId: 'c-1' }));
    h.queue.enqueue(batch(['/in/b.pdf'], { mode: 'linked', collectionId: 'c-1' }));
    expect(await done).toEqual(report({ imported: 2, filed: 2, requested: 2, mode: 'linked', collectionId: 'c-1' }));
  });

  it('files put in while it runs join the run: the total grows, and one report covers them all', async () => {
    const h = setup();

    const done = h.nextReport();
    expect(h.queue.enqueue(batch(['/in/a.pdf', '/in/b.pdf']))).toBe(2);
    await held.started;
    expect(h.queue.enqueue(batch(['/in/c.pdf', '/in/d.pdf', '/in/e.pdf']))).toBe(5);
    expect(h.queue.state()).toMatchObject({ state: 'running', done: 0, total: 5, current: 'a.pdf' });
    held.release();
    expect(await done).toEqual(report({ imported: 5, requested: 5 }));
    expect(h.fake.calls.map((c) => c.path)).toEqual(['/in/a.pdf', '/in/b.pdf', '/in/c.pdf', '/in/d.pdf', '/in/e.pdf']);
  });

  it('starts a new run once idle: a report of its own, counted from zero', async () => {
    const h = setup();
    const first = h.nextReport();
    h.queue.enqueue(batch(['/in/a.pdf']));
    await first;
    const second = h.nextReport();
    expect(h.queue.enqueue(batch(['/in/b.pdf']))).toBe(1);
    expect(await second).toEqual(report({ imported: 1, requested: 1 }));
    expect(h.reports).toHaveLength(2);
  });

  it('refuses a batch with a relative path and changes nothing; an empty batch is nothing', () => {
    const h = setup();
    expect(() => h.queue.enqueue(batch(['/in/a.pdf', 'b.pdf']))).toThrow(expect.objectContaining({ code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED' }));
    expect(h.queue.enqueue(batch([]))).toBe(0);
    expect(h.queue.state()).toEqual(IDLE_IMPORT_STATE);
    expect(h.fake.calls).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('progress (spec 3.3)', () => {
  it('bytes: the total is the sizes when put in; a file counts its hashed bytes, then all of its size; only the file name shows', async () => {

    expect(fake.calls[2]!.opts.signal?.aborted).toBe(true);
    expect(h.questions).toEqual([]);
    expect(h.queue.state()).toEqual(IDLE_IMPORT_STATE);
  });

  it('a file that committed before it saw the stop still counts', async () => {
    const started = deferred();
    const release = deferred();
    const importer = {
      async importOne(p: string): Promise<ImportOutcome> {
        if (p === '/in/b.pdf') {
          started.resolve();
          await release.promise;
        }
        return imported(p);
      },
    };
    const h = setup({ deps: { importer: () => importer } });
    const done = h.nextReport();
    h.queue.enqueue(batch(['/in/a.pdf', '/in/b.pdf', '/in/c.pdf']));
    await started.promise;
    h.queue.cancel();
    expect(h.queue.state()).toMatchObject({ state: 'running', current: 'b.pdf' }); // still stopping
    release.resolve();
    expect(await done).toEqual(report({ imported: 2, requested: 3, cancelled: true }));
  });

  it('files put in after 취소 make a new run, while the stopped file is still stopping', async () => {
    const h = setup();
    const held = h.fake.hold('/in/a.pdf');
    h.queue.enqueue(batch(['/in/a.pdf']));
    await held.started;
    h.queue.cancel();
    expect(h.queue.enqueue(batch(['/in/b.pdf']))).toBe(1);
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(h.reports).toHaveLength(2));
    expect(h.reports.map((r) => r.report)).toEqual([report({ requested: 1, cancelled: true }), report({ imported: 1, requested: 1 })]);
  });

  it('취소 during a question: the answer is not acted on and the rest are not asked', async () => {
    const answer = deferred<DuplicateAnswer>();
    const fake = fakeImporter((p, o) => (o.allowDuplicate ? imported(p) : duplicate(p, 'e-1')));
    const h = setup({
      importer: fake,
      deps: { ask: (_owner, _q, signal) => Promise.race([answer.promise, until(signal).then(() => SKIP)]) },
    });
    const done = h.nextReport();
    h.queue.enqueue(batch(['/in/d1.pdf', '/in/d2.pdf']));
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(h.queue.state().state).toBe('waiting-choice'));
    h.queue.cancel();
    expect(await done).toEqual(report({ requested: 2, cancelled: true }));
    answer.resolve({ choice: 'add', applyToRest: true, askedOn: 1 });
    await Promise.resolve();
    expect(fake.calls.some((c) => c.opts.allowDuplicate)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('취소 with nothing running does nothing', () => {
    const h = setup();
    h.queue.cancel();
    expect(h.reports).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('the work line (spec 3.1)', () => {
  it('waits behind a running backup as waiting-job, then runs', async () => {
    const lane = createJobLane();

  it("the line's stop (quitting) stops the queue as 취소 does", async () => {

    expect(h.fake.calls.map((c) => c.path)).toEqual(['/in/a.pdf']);
  });

  it('quitting while it waits behind a job drops it: the report says none of N', async () => {

    const h = setup({ lane });

  });
});
```

```ts
import fs from 'node:fs/promises';
import {
  IDLE_IMPORT_STATE, LearnError, absolutePathSchema, toLearnError,
  type DuplicateCard, type DuplicateChoice, type ImportOutcome, type ImportQueueState, type ImportReport, type StorageMode,
} from '@learn/domain';
import { displayFileName, type ImportOptions } from '@learn/library';
import { mainStrings } from '../strings';
import type { JobLane } from './lane';
import { createThrottle } from './throttle';

export type ImportedOutcome = Extract<ImportOutcome, { status: 'imported' }>;

/** One put-in: a drop, an open panel's files, an edited copy, a copy the library check brings back. */
export interface ImportBatch {
  /** Absolute paths, imported in this order. */
  paths: string[];
  mode: StorageMode;
  /** The collection each imported item goes into (이 컬렉션으로 가져오기), or null. */
  collectionId: string | null;
  /** The webContents id of the window that put the files in: its duplicate questions hang on it. */
  owner: number;
  /** A title for a path instead of its file name's. */
  titles?: Record<string, string>;
  /** After each file of this batch is committed (an edited copy goes only then, once its hash is checked again). */
  afterCommit?: (outcome: ImportedOutcome) => Promise<void>;
}

export interface DuplicateQuestion {
  fileName: string;
  existing: DuplicateCard;
  /** The other duplicates of this run still to settle: above 0 the question offers one answer for all. */
  remaining: number;
}

/** `askedOn`: the window the question was answered on, where 기존 자료 열기 opens the item (null without a window). */
export interface DuplicateAnswer {
  choice: DuplicateChoice;
  applyToRest: boolean;
  askedOn: number | null;
}

/** The importer as the queue uses it (Importer; a fake in unit tests). */
export interface QueueImporter {
  importOne(inputPath: string, opts: ImportOptions): Promise<ImportOutcome>;
}

export interface ImportQueueDeps {
  lane: JobLane;
  /** The library's importer. Throws when no library is open, which fails each file with that reason. */
  importer(): QueueImporter;
  /** The live item a duplicate matched, as the question shows it; null once it has left the library (the trash). */
  card(itemId: string): DuplicateCard | null;
  /** One duplicate question on the owner window; resolves 건너뛰기 when `signal` aborts first. */
  ask(owner: number, question: DuplicateQuestion, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<DuplicateAnswer>;
  /** Files existing items into a collection: how many it did not hold yet (announced by the caller). */
  fileExisting(collectionId: string, itemIds: readonly string[]): number;
  /** libraryChanged{import} for items the run added. */
  announce(itemIds: string[]): void;
  /** A file's size in bytes as it is put in; 0 when it cannot be read (it fails later, with the reason). */
  stat?(file: string): Promise<number>;
  progressMs?: number;
  announceMs?: number;
  /** A log line: error codes only, never a path or a title. */
  warn?(line: string): void;
}

export interface ImportQueue {
  /** Puts files at the back of the queue; answers the run's total so far. */
  enqueue(batch: ImportBatch): number;
  /** The file under way stops at its next checkpoint, files not started are dropped, gathered duplicates are not asked. */
  cancel(): void;
  state(): ImportQueueState;
  onProgress(cb: (state: ImportQueueState) => void): () => void;
  /** Once per run: its report, and the window 기존 자료 열기 was answered on (null when it was not). */
  onFinished(cb: (report: ImportReport, openIn: number | null) => void): () => void;
}

/** Progress notices at most once per 100 ms: never more than 10 a second (spec 3.3). */
export const PROGRESS_MS = 100;
/** Added items are announced at most once a second: each notice makes the renderer read the list again. */
export const ANNOUNCE_MS = 1000;
const STAT_CONCURRENCY = 16;

type RunReport = Pick<ImportReport, 'imported' | 'filed' | 'filedExisting' | 'failed' | 'openItemId'>;

/** What the queue does from idle to idle: one progress toast, one report. */
interface Run {
  total: number;
  done: number;
  bytesTotal: number;
  bytesFinished: number;
  report: RunReport;
  modes: Set<StorageMode>;
  collections: Set<string | null>;
  duplicates: PendingDuplicate[];
  /** 같은 선택 for this run's remaining duplicates; 기존 자료 열기 for the rest is 건너뛰기 (one item opens). */
  sticky: 'add' | 'skip' | null;
  /** Collection id → the existing items whose duplicate was answered 건너뛰기 in an import into it. */
  skipped: Map<string, string[]>;
  openIn: number | null;
  abort: AbortController;
  cancelled: boolean;
  finished: boolean;
}

interface Entry {
  path: string;
  name: string;
  size: number;
  read: number;
  sized: Promise<void>;
  batch: ImportBatch;
  run: Run;
  /** Imported again once because the item it matched had gone: a second time it is left out, not asked about. */
  retried: boolean;
}

interface PendingDuplicate {
  entry: Entry;
  existingItemId: string;
}

const SKIP: DuplicateAnswer = { choice: 'skip', applyToRest: false, askedOn: null };
const only = <T>(values: ReadonlySet<T>): T | null => (values.size === 1 ? (values.values().next().value as T) : null);
const statSize = (file: string): Promise<number> => fs.stat(file).then((s) => (s.isFile() ? s.size : 0), () => 0);
const newRun = (): Run => ({
  total: 0, done: 0, bytesTotal: 0, bytesFinished: 0,
  report: { imported: 0, filed: 0, filedExisting: 0, failed: [], openItemId: null },
  modes: new Set(), collections: new Set(), duplicates: [], sticky: null, skipped: new Map(), openIn: null,
  abort: new AbortController(), cancelled: false, finished: false,
});

/**
 * The import queue on the work line (spec 3): every window's files go into one queue and are imported one at a time.
 * Duplicates are gathered and asked at the end, in order; 취소 stops the file under way at its next checkpoint.
 */
export function createImportQueue(deps: ImportQueueDeps): ImportQueue {
  const stat = deps.stat ?? statSize;
  const warn = deps.warn ?? ((line: string) => console.warn(line));
  const progressListeners = new Set<(state: ImportQueueState) => void>();
  const finishedListeners = new Set<(report: ImportReport, openIn: number | null) => void>();
  /** Files not started yet: all of the active run's. */
  const pending: Entry[] = [];
  /** The run files join; null when idle, or right after 취소 while the stopped run's file is still stopping. */
  let active: Run | null = null;
  /** A stopped run whose file under way has not stopped yet: its report waits for that file. */
  let stopping: Run | null = null;
  let current: Entry | null = null;
  let phase: 'running' | 'waiting-choice' | 'waiting-job' = 'running';
  /** The lane job working through the queue; null when none is asked for. */
  let job: Promise<void> | null = null;

  function state(): ImportQueueState {
    const run = active ?? stopping;
    if (run === null) return { ...IDLE_IMPORT_STATE };
    const mine = current !== null && current.run === run ? current : null;
    return {
      state: run === active ? phase : 'running',
      done: run.done,
      total: run.total,
      bytesDone: Math.min(run.bytesTotal, run.bytesFinished + (mine?.read ?? 0)),
      bytesTotal: run.bytesTotal,
      current: mine?.name ?? null,
    };
  }

  const progress = createThrottle(() => {
    const s = state();
    for (const cb of [...progressListeners]) {
      try {
        cb(s);
      } catch (e) {
        warn(`[import] a progress listener failed: ${toLearnError(e).code}`);
      }
    }
  }, deps.progressMs ?? PROGRESS_MS);

  const added: string[] = [];
  const announcer = createThrottle(() => {
    if (added.length > 0) deps.announce(added.splice(0));
  }, deps.announceMs ?? ANNOUNCE_MS);

  /** Sizes for the bar, a few files at a time in the order put in; each file waits only for its own. */
  function sizeAll(entries: readonly Entry[], resolvers: ReadonlyArray<() => void>): void {
    let next = 0;
    const worker = async (): Promise<void> => {
      while (next < entries.length) {
        const i = next++;
        const entry = entries[i]!;
        entry.size = await stat(entry.path).catch(() => 0);
        if (!entry.run.finished) {
          entry.run.bytesTotal += entry.size;
          progress.request();
        }
        resolvers[i]!();
      }
    };
    for (let k = 0; k < Math.min(STAT_CONCURRENCY, entries.length); k++) void worker();
  }

  function enqueue(batch: ImportBatch): number {
    // The same rule as the import channel's input: a relative path would resolve against main's working folder.
    if (batch.paths.some((p) => !absolutePathSchema.safeParse(p).success)) throw new LearnError('VALIDATION_FAILED', mainStrings.badRequest);
    if (batch.paths.length === 0) return active?.total ?? 0;
    const run = (active ??= newRun());
    run.modes.add(batch.mode);
    run.collections.add(batch.collectionId);
    const resolvers: Array<() => void> = [];
    const entries = batch.paths.map(
      (p): Entry => ({
        path: p, name: displayFileName(p), size: 0, read: 0, batch, run, retried: false,
        sized: new Promise<void>((resolve) => resolvers.push(resolve)),
      }),
    );
    run.total += entries.length;
    pending.push(...entries);
    sizeAll(entries, resolvers);
    if (job === null) startJob();
    progress.request();
    return run.total;
  }

  function startJob(): void {
    phase = deps.lane.busy() === null ? 'running' : 'waiting-job';
    const started = deps.lane.run('import', work);
    job = started;
    started
      .catch((e: unknown) => {
        const code = toLearnError(e).code;
        if (code !== 'CANCELLED') warn(`[import] the queue stopped: ${code}`);
        // Dropped before it ran (quitting), or failed: the runs it was for end stopped.
        current = null;
        if (stopping !== null) finishRun(stopping);
        cancel();
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (job === started) job = null;
        if (job === null && pending.length > 0) startJob();
      });
  }

  async function work(laneSignal: AbortSignal): Promise<void> {
    // The line's own stop (quitting) is 취소 for the queue.
    const onAbort = (): void => cancel();
    laneSignal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    try {
      phase = 'running';
      progress.request();
      for (;;) {
        // Once the line is stopped, every run on this job ends stopped, files put in since included.
        if (laneSignal.aborted) cancel();
        const entry = pending.shift();
        if (entry !== undefined) {
          await importFile(entry, laneSignal);
          continue;
        }
        const run = active;
        if (run === null) return;
        const dup = run.duplicates.shift();
        if (dup !== undefined) await settleDuplicate(dup, laneSignal);
        else finishRun(run);
      }
    } finally {
      laneSignal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    }
  }

  const signalFor = (entry: Entry, laneSignal: AbortSignal): AbortSignal => AbortSignal.any([laneSignal, entry.run.abort.signal]);

  async function importOnce(entry: Entry, laneSignal: AbortSignal, extra: { allowDuplicate?: true; onBytes?: (bytes: number) => void }): Promise<ImportOutcome> {
    const { batch } = entry;
    const title = batch.titles?.[entry.path];
    const opts: ImportOptions = {
      mode: batch.mode,
      collectionId: batch.collectionId,
      signal: signalFor(entry, laneSignal),
      ...(title !== undefined ? { title } : {}),
      ...(extra.allowDuplicate ? { allowDuplicate: true } : {}),
      ...(extra.onBytes ? { onBytes: extra.onBytes } : {}),
    };
    try {
      return await deps.importer().importOne(entry.path, opts);
    } catch (e) {
      // importOne never throws; deps.importer() does when no library is open.
      const le = toLearnError(e);
      return { status: 'failed', path: entry.path, code: le.code, message: le.message };
    }
  }

  async function take(entry: Entry, outcome: ImportOutcome): Promise<void> {
    const report = entry.run.report;
    if (outcome.status === 'imported') {
      report.imported++;
      if (outcome.collectionId !== undefined) report.filed++;
      added.push(outcome.item.id);
      announcer.request();
      if (entry.batch.afterCommit) {
        try {
          await entry.batch.afterCommit(outcome);
        } catch (e) {
          warn(`[import] the step after a commit failed: ${toLearnError(e).code}`);
        }
      }
    } else if (outcome.status === 'failed' && outcome.code !== 'CANCELLED') {
      report.failed.push({ name: entry.name, message: outcome.message });
    }
  }

  /** A file's outcome into its run: a duplicate waits for the end, anything else is done. */
  async function settle(entry: Entry, outcome: ImportOutcome): Promise<void> {
    const { run } = entry;
    if (outcome.status === 'duplicate') {
      if (!run.cancelled) run.duplicates.push({ entry, existingItemId: outcome.existingItemId });
      return;
    }
    await take(entry, outcome);
    run.done++;
  }

  async function importFile(entry: Entry, laneSignal: AbortSignal): Promise<void> {
    const { run } = entry;
    current = entry;
    try {
      await entry.sized;
      if (!run.cancelled) {
        const outcome = await importOnce(entry, laneSignal, {
          onBytes: (bytes) => {
            entry.read = Math.min(entry.size, entry.read + bytes);
            progress.request();
          },
        });
        run.bytesFinished += entry.size;
        entry.read = 0;
        await settle(entry, outcome);
      }
    } finally {
      current = null;
    }
    if (run.cancelled) finishRun(run);
    progress.request();
  }

  async function ask(entry: Entry, existing: DuplicateCard, laneSignal: AbortSignal): Promise<DuplicateAnswer> {
    try {
      return await deps.ask(entry.batch.owner, { fileName: entry.name, existing, remaining: entry.run.duplicates.length }, signalFor(entry, laneSignal));
    } catch (e) {
      warn(`[import] the duplicate question failed: ${toLearnError(e).code}`);
      return SKIP;
    }
  }

  async function settleDuplicate(dup: PendingDuplicate, laneSignal: AbortSignal): Promise<void> {
    const { entry } = dup;
    const { run, batch } = entry;
    current = entry;
    try {
      const existing = deps.card(dup.existingItemId);
      if (existing === null) {
        // The item it matched left the library meanwhile (the trash): the file is no longer its duplicate.
        if (entry.retried) {
          run.done++;
          return;
        }
        entry.retried = true;
        await settle(entry, await importOnce(entry, laneSignal, {}));
        return;
      }
      let choice: DuplicateChoice;
      if (run.sticky !== null) choice = run.sticky;
      else {
        phase = 'waiting-choice';
        progress.request();
        const answer = await ask(entry, existing, laneSignal);
        phase = 'running';
        if (run.cancelled) return;
        choice = answer.choice;
        if (answer.applyToRest && run.duplicates.length > 0) run.sticky = choice === 'open' ? 'skip' : choice;
        if (choice === 'open') run.openIn = answer.askedOn;
      }
      if (choice === 'open') run.report.openItemId = dup.existingItemId;
      else if (choice === 'add') await take(entry, await importOnce(entry, laneSignal, { allowDuplicate: true }));
      else if (batch.collectionId !== null) {
        const ids = run.skipped.get(batch.collectionId) ?? [];
        ids.push(dup.existingItemId);
        run.skipped.set(batch.collectionId, ids);
      }
      run.done++;
    } finally {
      current = null;
      if (run.cancelled) finishRun(run);
      progress.request();
    }
  }

  function finishRun(run: Run): void {
    if (run.finished) return;
    run.finished = true;
    if (active === run) active = null;
    if (stopping === run) stopping = null;
    // 건너뛰기 in an import into a collection: the existing item goes there instead, once the questions are over.
    for (const [collectionId, itemIds] of run.skipped) {
      try {
        run.report.filedExisting += deps.fileExisting(collectionId, itemIds);
      } catch (e) {
        warn(`[import] filing the existing items failed: ${toLearnError(e).code}`);
      }
    }
    announcer.flush();
    const report: ImportReport = {
      ...run.report,
      failed: [...run.report.failed],
      requested: run.total,
      cancelled: run.cancelled,
      mode: only(run.modes),
      collectionId: only(run.collections),
    };
    for (const cb of [...finishedListeners]) {
      try {
        cb(report, run.openIn);
      } catch (e) {
        warn(`[import] a finished listener failed: ${toLearnError(e).code}`);
      }
    }
    progress.request();
  }

  function cancel(): void {
    const run = active;
    if (run === null) return;
    run.cancelled = true;
    active = null;
    pending.length = 0;
    run.duplicates.length = 0;
    run.abort.abort();
    // The file under way stops at its next checkpoint; the report waits for it (one it committed meanwhile still counts).
    if (current !== null && current.run === run) stopping = run;
    else finishRun(run);
    progress.request();
  }

  return {
    enqueue,
    cancel,
    state,
    onProgress(cb) {
      progressListeners.add(cb);
      return () => {
        progressListeners.delete(cb);
      };
    },
    onFinished(cb) {
      finishedListeners.add(cb);
      return () => {
        finishedListeners.delete(cb);
      };
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';

import { createDuplicateAsker } from './duplicate-asker';

const EXISTING: DuplicateCard = { title: '분자생물학 6장', type: 'pdf', size: 4200, createdAt: '2026-10-20T11:40:00.000Z', storageMode: 'managed' };

    }),
```

새 파일 `apps/desktop/src/main/jobs/duplicate-asker.ts`:
```ts
import type { MessageBoxOptions } from 'electron';
import type { SheetPayload, SheetResult } from '@learn/domain';
import { mainStrings } from '../strings';
import type { DuplicateAnswer, DuplicateQuestion } from './import-queue';

/** What the question needs of a window (a BrowserWindow fits). */
export interface AskWindow {
  readonly webContents: { readonly id: number };
  isFocused(): boolean;
  focus(): void;
}

export interface DuplicateAskerDeps<W extends AskWindow> {
  /** The window with this webContents id while it is a live main window; else null. */
  windowOf(webContentsId: number): W | null;
  /** The main window there is now, or null. */
  anyMainWindow(): W | null;
  /** The duplicate sheet over `parent` (SheetHost.open). */
  sheet(parent: W, payload: SheetPayload): Promise<SheetResult | null>;
  /** A native message box with no window (dialog.showMessageBox(options)). */
  messageBox(options: MessageBoxOptions): Promise<{ response: number; checkboxChecked: boolean }>;
}

const SKIP: DuplicateAnswer = { choice: 'skip', applyToRest: false, askedOn: null };

/**
 * One duplicate question: on the window that put the file in; that window gone, on the main window there is now; with
 * none, in a message box of its own, which offers 새 자료로 추가 and 건너뛰기 only — there is no window to open the
 * existing item in. A question that ends unanswered (the sheet closed, the import stopped) is 건너뛰기, for that file.
 */
export function createDuplicateAsker<W extends AskWindow>(deps: DuplicateAskerDeps<W>) {
  return async (owner: number, question: DuplicateQuestion, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<DuplicateAnswer> => {
    if (signal.aborted) return SKIP;
    // A sheet left open by a stopped import closes with the app; nothing else ends it but its own answer.
    const stopped = new Promise<null>((resolve) => signal.addEventListener('abort', () => resolve(null), { once: true }));
    const offer = question.remaining > 0;
    const parent = deps.windowOf(owner) ?? deps.anyMainWindow();
    if (parent !== null) {
      // Files dropped from Finder leave Finder the active app: the question must not wait unseen on a background window.
      if (!parent.isFocused()) parent.focus();
      const payload: SheetPayload = { kind: 'duplicate', fileName: question.fileName, existing: question.existing, remaining: question.remaining };
      const result = await Promise.race([deps.sheet(parent, payload), stopped]);
      if (result === null || result.kind !== 'duplicate') return SKIP;
      return { choice: result.choice, applyToRest: offer && result.applyToRest, askedOn: parent.webContents.id };
    }
    const words = mainStrings.duplicateQuestion;
    const options: MessageBoxOptions = {
      type: 'question',
      message: words.message,
      detail: words.detail(question.fileName, question.existing.title),
      buttons: [words.add, words.skip],
      defaultId: 1,
      cancelId: 1,
      noLink: true,
      // Ticked as it opens, like the sheet's box: one answer for every duplicate unless unticked.
      ...(offer ? { checkboxLabel: words.applyToRest(question.remaining), checkboxChecked: true } : {}),
    };
    const answer = await Promise.race([deps.messageBox(options), stopped]);
    if (answer === null) return SKIP;
    return { choice: answer.response === 0 ? 'add' : 'skip', applyToRest: offer && answer.checkboxChecked, askedOn: null };
  };
}
```

새 파일 `apps/desktop/src/main/jobs/quit-guard.test.ts`:
```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import type { JobKind } from './lane';
import { QUIT_STOP_MS, createQuitGuard, quitQuestion, type QuitGuardDeps, type QuitQuestion } from './quit-guard';

afterEach(() => {
  vi.useRealTimers();
});

function quitEvent() {
  const e = {
    prevented: false,
    preventDefault() {
      e.prevented = true;
    },
  };
  return e;
}
/** A lane running `kind` until stop(). */
function fakeLane(kind: JobKind | null) {
  let busy = kind;
  let stopped!: () => void;
  const idle = new Promise<void>((r) => {
    stopped = r;
  });
  return {
    busy: () => busy,
    cancelAll: vi.fn(),
    idle: () => (busy === null ? Promise.resolve() : idle),
    stop() {
      busy = null;
      stopped();
    },
  };
}
function guard(lane: ReturnType<typeof fakeLane>, over: Partial<QuitGuardDeps<'main'>> & { answer?: boolean | Promise<boolean> } = {}) {
  const asked: Array<{ owner: 'main' | null; question: QuitQuestion }> = [];
  const quit = vi.fn();
  const onStay = vi.fn();
  const { answer, ...deps } = over;
  const g = createQuitGuard<'main'>({
    lane,
    remaining: () => 3,
    owner: () => 'main',
    ask: async (owner, question) => {
      asked.push({ owner, question });
      return await (answer ?? true);
    },
    quit,
    onStay,
    ...deps,
  });
  return { g, asked, quit, onStay };
}
const flush = () => new Promise<void>((r) => setImmediate(r));

describe('quitting while the work line runs (spec 3.6, P-19)', () => {
  it('lets the quit through untouched when nothing runs: the edit-flush gate is next', () => {
    const h = guard(fakeLane(null));
    const e = quitEvent();
    expect(h.g.onBeforeQuit(e)).toBe(false);
    expect(e.prevented).toBe(false);
    expect(h.asked).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('asks first while it imports, naming the files that will not come in; 취소 keeps the app and the import', async () => {
    const lane = fakeLane('import');
    const h = guard(lane, { answer: false });
    const e = quitEvent();
    expect(h.g.onBeforeQuit(e)).toBe(true);
    expect(e.prevented).toBe(true);
    await flush();
    expect(h.asked).toEqual([{
      owner: 'main',
      question: { type: 'warning', message: '가져오는 중입니다', detail: '끝내면 남은 3개는 가져오지 않습니다.', buttons: ['끝내기', '취소'], defaultId: 0, cancelId: 1 },
    }]);
    expect(lane.cancelAll).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(h.quit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(h.onStay).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    // 취소 was for that quit only: the next one asks again.
    expect(h.g.onBeforeQuit(quitEvent())).toBe(true);
    await flush();
    expect(h.asked).toHaveLength(2);
  });

  it('끝내기 stops the work, waits for it to stop, then quits', async () => {
    const lane = fakeLane('import');
    const h = guard(lane);
    h.g.onBeforeQuit(quitEvent());
    await flush();
    expect(lane.cancelAll).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(h.quit).not.toHaveBeenCalled(); // still stopping
    lane.stop();
    await flush();
    expect(h.quit).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(h.onStay).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('waits at most 10 s for the work to stop, then quits anyway; that quit passes though the work still runs', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    const lane = fakeLane('import');
    const h = guard(lane);
    h.g.onBeforeQuit(quitEvent());
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(QUIT_STOP_MS - 1);
    expect(h.quit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1);
    expect(h.quit).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    const repeat = quitEvent();
    expect(h.g.onBeforeQuit(repeat)).toBe(false);
    expect(repeat.prevented).toBe(false);
    expect(h.asked).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('the pass ends: a quit the next gate called off does not wave a later one through', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    const lane = fakeLane('import');
    const h = guard(lane, { passMs: 5000 });
    h.g.onBeforeQuit(quitEvent());
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(QUIT_STOP_MS);
    expect(h.quit).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(5000);
    expect(h.g.onBeforeQuit(quitEvent())).toBe(true); // still running: asked again
  });

  it('a second quit while it asks or stops is held, never asked twice', async () => {
    const lane = fakeLane('import');
    let say!: (v: boolean) => void;
    const h = guard(lane, { answer: new Promise<boolean>((r) => { say = r; }) });
    h.g.onBeforeQuit(quitEvent());
    const second = quitEvent();
    expect(h.g.onBeforeQuit(second)).toBe(true);
    expect(second.prevented).toBe(true);
    await flush();
    expect(h.asked).toHaveLength(1);
    say(true);
    await flush();
    expect(h.g.onBeforeQuit(quitEvent())).toBe(true); // stopping now
    lane.stop();
    await flush();
    expect(h.quit).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(h.asked).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('an import with every file done is only finishing: waited for, not asked about, nothing cancelled', async () => {
    const lane = fakeLane('import');
    const h = guard(lane, { remaining: () => 0 });
    h.g.onBeforeQuit(quitEvent());
    await flush();
    expect(h.asked).toEqual([]);
    expect(lane.cancelAll).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    lane.stop();
    await flush();
    expect(h.quit).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('with no main window it asks without one', async () => {
    const h = guard(fakeLane('backup'), { owner: () => null, answer: false });
    h.g.onBeforeQuit(quitEvent());
    await flush();
    expect(h.asked[0]!.owner).toBe(null);
    expect(h.onStay).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('a question that cannot be shown does not keep the app: the work is stopped and it quits', async () => {
    const lane = fakeLane('import');
    const h = guard(lane, { ask: async () => { throw new Error('no dialog'); } });
    h.g.onBeforeQuit(quitEvent());
    await flush();
    expect(lane.cancelAll).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    lane.stop();
    await flush();
    expect(h.quit).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('names a backup and a restore in their own words, 끝내기 first and the default', () => {
    expect(quitQuestion('backup', 0)).toEqual({ type: 'warning', message: '백업을 만드는 중입니다', detail: '끝내면 만들던 백업은 남지 않습니다.', buttons: ['끝내기', '취소'], defaultId: 0, cancelId: 1 });
```

새 파일 `apps/desktop/src/main/jobs/quit-guard.ts`:
```ts
import type { PreventableEvent } from '../edit-flush';
import { mainStrings } from '../strings';
import type { JobKind, JobLane } from './lane';

/** How long a confirmed quit waits for the work to stop; past it the app quits anyway (the next check shows what was left). */
export const QUIT_STOP_MS = 10_000;
/**
 * How long the confirmed quit's own repeats pass unasked: the edit-flush gate after this one asks the page (up to its
 * 3 s) and quits again. A pass still set after this belongs to a quit that did not happen.
 */
export const QUIT_GUARD_PASS_MS = 5_000;

export interface QuitQuestion {
  type: 'warning';
  message: string;
  detail: string;
  buttons: [string, string];
  defaultId: 0;
  cancelId: 1;
}

/** 끝내기 first and the default (the user asked to quit); 취소 keeps the app. */
export function quitQuestion(kind: JobKind, remaining: number): QuitQuestion {
  const words = mainStrings.quitGuard;
  const what = kind === 'import' ? { message: words.import.message, detail: words.import.detail(remaining) } : words[kind];
  return { type: 'warning', message: what.message, detail: what.detail, buttons: [words.quit, mainStrings.confirmSheet.cancel], defaultId: 0, cancelId: 1 };
}

export interface QuitGuardDeps<W> {
  lane: Pick<JobLane, 'busy' | 'cancelAll' | 'idle'>;
  /** Files of the import run not finished yet, the one under way included. */
  remaining(): number;
  /** The main window, for the question to hang on; null when there is none. */
  owner(): W | null;
  /** Shows the question; true for 끝내기. */
  ask(owner: W | null, question: QuitQuestion): Promise<boolean>;
  /** app.quit(): the quit again, once the work has stopped. */
  quit(): void;
  /** 취소 was chosen and the app stays. */
  onStay?(): void;
  stopMs?: number;
  passMs?: number;
}

export interface QuitGuard {
  /** The app's before-quit, ahead of the edit-flush gate: true when it took this quit (called off for now). */
  onBeforeQuit(event: PreventableEvent): boolean;
}

/**
 * Quitting while an import, backup or restore runs (spec 3.6): a native question first; 끝내기 stops the work as 취소
 * does, waits for it (at most QUIT_STOP_MS) and quits again, which then goes through the edit-flush gate.
 */
export function createQuitGuard<W>(deps: QuitGuardDeps<W>): QuitGuard {
  let holding = false;
  let passing = false;
  let passTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;

  const quitNow = (): void => {
    passing = true;
    clearTimeout(passTimer);
    passTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      passing = false;
    }, deps.passMs ?? QUIT_GUARD_PASS_MS);
    passTimer.unref?.();
    deps.quit();
  };
  const stopped = (): Promise<void> =>
    new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      const timer = setTimeout(resolve, deps.stopMs ?? QUIT_STOP_MS);
      void deps.lane.idle().then(() => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        resolve();
      });
    });

  async function hold(kind: JobKind): Promise<void> {
    const remaining = kind === 'import' ? deps.remaining() : 0;
    // An import with every file done is only finishing (filing, its last notices): waited for, not asked about.
    if (kind !== 'import' || remaining > 0) {
      let leave: boolean;
      try {
        leave = await deps.ask(deps.owner(), quitQuestion(kind, remaining));
      } catch {
        leave = true; // no question could be shown: the quit the user asked for goes ahead, safely stopped
      }
      if (!leave) {
        deps.onStay?.();
        return;
      }
      deps.lane.cancelAll();
    }
    await stopped();
    quitNow();
  }

  return {
    onBeforeQuit(event) {
      if (passing) return false;
      if (holding) {
        event.preventDefault(); // a second ⌘Q while asking or stopping
        return true;
      }
      const kind = deps.lane.busy();
      if (kind === null) return false;
      event.preventDefault();
      holding = true;
      void hold(kind).finally(() => {
        holding = false;
      });
      return true;
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
export type ImportPausePoint = 'afterStage' | 'afterPlace' | 'beforeCommit';

export interface ImportPause {
  hooks: ImportHooks;
  /** The next file to reach `at` waits there until resume() — one file: the ones after it run on. null calls it off. */
  pause(at: ImportPausePoint | null): void;
  resume(): void;
  /** Where a file waits now, or null. */
  waiting(): ImportPausePoint | null;
}

/**
 * E2E only: the importer's fault points as places a file can be held (afterStage: its verified copy is in staging/;
 * afterPlace: its copy is in assets/, no row yet; beforeCommit). A test holds a file there, then kills the app.
 */
export function createImportPause(): ImportPause {
  let armed: ImportPausePoint | null = null;
  let waitingAt: ImportPausePoint | null = null;
  let release: (() => void) | null = null;
  const point = (at: ImportPausePoint) => async (): Promise<void> => {
    if (armed !== at) return;
    armed = null;
    waitingAt = at;
    await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      release = resolve;
    });
    waitingAt = null;
  };
  return {
    hooks: { afterStage: point('afterStage'), afterPlace: point('afterPlace'), beforeCommit: point('beforeCommit') },
    pause(at) {
      armed = at;
    },
    resume() {
      const go = release;
      release = null;
      go?.();
    },
    waiting: () => waitingAt,
  };
}
```

`R/sheets/DuplicateSheet.tsx` 전체:
```tsx
import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Checkbox } from 'react-aria-components';
import { Check, Clapperboard, Copy, FileText } from 'lucide-react';
import type { DuplicateChoice, SheetPayload } from '@learn/domain';
import { formatDate, formatSize } from '../format';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { Icon } from '../ui/Icon';
import { resolveSheet } from './SheetApp';
import { useScrollRegion } from './scrollRegion';
import { useSheetKeys } from './sheetKeys';

/**
 * dialogs.html?scene=duplicate. ↩ = 건너뛰기 (the safe default), esc = 건너뛰기, 기존 자료 열기 on the left. While more
 * duplicates of the import wait (`remaining`), a check box under the card answers them all at once; it opens ticked,
 * as drawn, and ↩ / esc keep what it says.
 */
export function DuplicateSheet({ payload }: { payload: Extract<SheetPayload, { kind: 'duplicate' }> }) {
  const offer = payload.remaining > 0;
  const [applyToRest, setApplyToRest] = useState(offer);
  const choose = (choice: DuplicateChoice) => resolveSheet({ kind: 'duplicate', choice, applyToRest: offer && applyToRest });
  const keys = useSheetKeys(() => choose('skip'), () => choose('skip'));
  const body = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const region = useScrollRegion(body, 'sheet-title');
  const e = payload.existing;
  return (
    <div
      className="sheet"
      role="alertdialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="sheet-title"
      aria-describedby="sheet-text"
      data-sheet-root=""
      data-kind="duplicate"
      data-testid="sheet-root"
      {...keys}
    >
      <div className="d-title">
        <span className="badge-icon">
          <Icon icon={Copy} />
        </span>
        <h2 id="sheet-title" className="ui-balance">
          {t.sheets.duplicateTitle}
        </h2>
      </div>
      <div className="d-body" ref={body} {...region}>
        <p className="d-text ui-prose" id="sheet-text">
          <b data-testid="dup-file">{payload.fileName}</b>
          {t.sheets.duplicateBody}
        </p>
        <div className="card item-card" data-testid="dup-card">
          <span className="thumb">
            <Icon icon={e.type === 'video' ? Clapperboard : FileText} />
          </span>
          <div className="card-text">
            <div className="t-headline ellipsis" title={e.title}>
              {e.title}
            </div>
            <div className="t-footnote c-secondary ellipsis">{t.sheets.cardMeta(t.library.type[e.type], formatSize(e.size), formatDate(e.createdAt))}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        {offer && (
          <Checkbox className="checkbox t-footnote" isSelected={applyToRest} onChange={setApplyToRest}>
            {({ isSelected }) => (
              <>
                <span className="box" aria-hidden="true">
                  {isSelected && <Icon icon={Check} size="xs" />}
                </span>
                {t.sheets.applyToRest(payload.remaining)}
              </>
            )}
          </Checkbox>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="d-foot">
        <Button variant="plain-accent" leading testId="dup-open" onPress={() => choose('open')}>
          {t.sheets.openExisting}
        </Button>
        <span className="spacer" />
        <Button testId="dup-add" onPress={() => choose('add')}>
          {t.sheets.addAnyway}
        </Button>
        <Button variant="primary" autoFocus testId="dup-skip" onPress={() => choose('skip')}>
          {t.sheets.skip}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
(`useSheetKeys`는 매번 그려질 때 최신 콜백을 ref에 둔다 — ↩·esc가 지금 체크 상태를 읽는다.)

```css
     as wide as its box and words, so a press beside it on the row does nothing. */
```

새 파일 `tests/e2e/import-queue-main.spec.ts`:
```ts
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { expect, test, type ElectronApplication } from '@playwright/test';
import type { ImportQueueState, ImportReport } from '../../packages/domain/src/library';
import { clickToCloseSheet, closeSheet, confirmCalls, distinctPdfs, expectWindow, importPaths, launch, stubConfirm } from './helpers';

// Main's import queue before any page can reach it (Task 4 connects the channels): the E2E hooks of main/test-hooks.ts
// put files in, hold one at a fault point and read the reports.
type PausePoint = 'afterStage' | 'afterPlace' | 'beforeCommit';
interface QueueHooks {
  importPause(input: { at: PausePoint | null }): void;
  importResume(): void;
  importWaiting(): PausePoint | null;
  enqueueImport(input: { paths: string[] }): number;
  importQueueState(): ImportQueueState;
  importReports(): ImportReport[];
}
type G = { __learnTest: QueueHooks };
const pauseAt = (app: ElectronApplication, at: PausePoint | null) => app.evaluate((_e, at) => (globalThis as unknown as G).__learnTest.importPause({ at }), at);
const resume = (app: ElectronApplication) => app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as unknown as G).__learnTest.importResume());
const waitingAt = (app: ElectronApplication) => app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as unknown as G).__learnTest.importWaiting());
const enqueue = (app: ElectronApplication, paths: string[]) => app.evaluate((_e, paths) => (globalThis as unknown as G).__learnTest.enqueueImport({ paths }), paths);
const queueState = (app: ElectronApplication) => app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as unknown as G).__learnTest.importQueueState());
const reports = (app: ElectronApplication) => app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as unknown as G).__learnTest.importReports());
const idle = (app: ElectronApplication) => expect.poll(async () => (await queueState(app)).state, { message: 'the queue went idle' }).toBe('idle');
const filesUnder = (dir: string): string[] =>
  fs.readdirSync(dir, { recursive: true, withFileTypes: true }).filter((e) => e.isFile()).map((e) => e.name);

test('the E2E pause holds a queued file once its staging copy is verified; resumed, the run imports both (P-6)', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const lib = testInfo.outputPath('library');
  const s = await launch(lib, testInfo.outputPath('userdata'));
  try {
    const files = distinctPdfs(testInfo.outputPath('src'), 2);
    await pauseAt(s.app, 'afterStage');
    expect(await enqueue(s.app, files)).toBe(2);
    await expect.poll(() => waitingAt(s.app)).toBe('afterStage');
    // Held with its verified copy in staging/, nothing in assets/ or in the list yet.
    expect(fs.readdirSync(path.join(lib, 'staging')).filter((n) => n.endsWith('.part'))).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(filesUnder(path.join(lib, 'assets'))).toEqual([]);
    expect(await queueState(s.app)).toMatchObject({
      state: 'running', done: 0, total: 2, current: 'distinct-01.pdf', bytesTotal: files.reduce((n, f) => n + fs.statSync(f).size, 0),
    });
    await resume(s.app);
    await idle(s.app);
    expect(await reports(s.app)).toEqual([
      { imported: 2, filed: 0, filedExisting: 0, failed: [], openItemId: null, requested: 2, cancelled: false, mode: 'managed', collectionId: null },
    ]);
    expect(fs.readdirSync(path.join(lib, 'staging'))).toEqual([]);
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(2);
  } finally {
    await s.app.close();
  }
});

test('queued duplicates are asked at the end in the sheet, with one answer for the rest (P-1)', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const s = await launch(testInfo.outputPath('library'), testInfo.outputPath('userdata'));
  const rows = s.page.getByTestId('item-row');
  try {
    const first = await importPaths(s.page, distinctPdfs(testInfo.outputPath('first'), 3));
    await expect(rows).toHaveCount(3);
    // The same bytes under the same names in another folder (three duplicates) and one new file, a duplicate first.
    const again = distinctPdfs(testInfo.outputPath('again'), 4);

    // 새 자료로 추가 with the box as it opens (ticked): one question for all three, after the new file came in.
    let sheet = await expectWindow(s.app, 'sheet', () => enqueue(s.app, [again[0]!, again[3]!, again[1]!, again[2]!]));
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('dup-file')).toHaveText('distinct-01.pdf');
    await expect(sheet.getByRole('checkbox', { name: '남은 중복 파일 2개에도 같은 선택 적용' })).toBeChecked();
    expect(await queueState(s.app)).toMatchObject({ state: 'waiting-choice', done: 1, total: 4, current: 'distinct-01.pdf' });
    await clickToCloseSheet(sheet, sheet.getByTestId('dup-add'));
    await idle(s.app);
    expect((await reports(s.app)).at(-1)).toMatchObject({ imported: 4, requested: 4, cancelled: false, openItemId: null });
    await expect(rows).toHaveCount(7);

    // Unticked from the keyboard (Space), ↩ skips this one only; the next asks again, and 기존 자료 열기 with its box
    // ticked opens that item and skips the last one unasked.
    sheet = await expectWindow(s.app, 'sheet', () => enqueue(s.app, again.slice(0, 3)));
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('dup-skip')).toBeFocused();
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) await sheet.keyboard.press('Shift+Tab');
    await expect(sheet.getByRole('checkbox')).toBeFocused();
    await sheet.keyboard.press('Space');
    await expect(sheet.getByRole('checkbox')).not.toBeChecked();
    const next = s.app.waitForEvent('window', { timeout: 15_000 });
    await closeSheet(sheet, 'Enter');
    sheet = await next;
    await sheet.locator('[data-sheet-root]').waitFor();
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('dup-file')).toHaveText('distinct-02.pdf');
    await expect(sheet.getByRole('checkbox', { name: '남은 중복 파일 1개에도 같은 선택 적용' })).toBeChecked();
    await clickToCloseSheet(sheet, sheet.getByTestId('dup-open'));
    await expect.poll(async () => (await reports(s.app)).length).toBe(2);
    expect((await reports(s.app)).at(-1)).toMatchObject({ imported: 0, requested: 3, openItemId: first[1]!.id });
    expect(s.app.windows().filter((p) => !p.isClosed() && p.url().includes('window=sheet'))).toEqual([]);
    await expect(rows).toHaveCount(7);
  } finally {
    await s.app.close();
  }
});

test('quitting while the queue imports asks first: 취소 keeps it going, 끝내기 stops the file before its rename and quits (P-19)', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const lib = testInfo.outputPath('library');
  const ud = testInfo.outputPath('userdata');
  let s = await launch(lib, ud);
  await pauseAt(s.app, 'afterStage');
  await enqueue(s.app, distinctPdfs(testInfo.outputPath('src'), 3));
  await expect.poll(() => waitingAt(s.app)).toBe('afterStage');

  await stubConfirm(s.app, 'cancel');
  await s.app.evaluate(({ app }) => app.quit());
  await expect.poll(() => confirmCalls(s.app)).toEqual([
    { type: 'warning', message: '가져오는 중입니다', detail: '끝내면 남은 3개는 가져오지 않습니다.', buttons: ['끝내기', '취소'], defaultId: 0, cancelId: 1 },
  ]);
  expect(await waitingAt(s.app)).toBe('afterStage'); // still held: the import goes on

  await stubConfirm(s.app, 'confirm');
  const exited = new Promise((resolve) => s.app.process().once('exit', resolve));
  await s.app.evaluate(({ app }) => app.quit());
  await expect.poll(async () => (await confirmCalls(s.app)).length).toBe(1);
  // Let go, the held file meets the stop at its checkpoint before the rename; the app then quits by itself.
  await resume(s.app).catch(() => {});
  await exited;

  expect(fs.readdirSync(path.join(lib, 'staging'))).toEqual([]);
  expect(filesUnder(path.join(lib, 'assets'))).toEqual([]);
  s = await launch(lib, ud);
  try {
    expect(await s.page.evaluate(() => window.learn.library.list())).toEqual({ ok: true, data: [] });
  } finally {
    await s.app.close();
  }
});
```

- 352–433행(`/** The ⌘/ sheet lists …` 부터 `installTestHooks` 블록의 닫는 `}`까지 — Task 2가 그 안에 `importCommits` 한 줄을 더해 한 줄 길다)을 아래로 바꾼다. 바뀌는 것: `getContext`·`sheets`·`asSheet`를 `deps` 밖의 상수로 꺼내고(큐와 종료 확인도 쓴다), 큐·질문·종료 확인을 만들고, `deps`에 `jobs`·`imports`를 더하고, 시험 훅에 `imports`를 넘긴다. `appInfo`·`uiContext`·`theme`·`prepareSettings`·`relaunch`의 몸은 지금 그대로다.
  ```ts
    /** The ⌘/ sheet lists the registry's shortcuts: its height is kept per what it is drawn from. */
    const shortcutsSheetDigest = shortcutsDigest(COMMANDS, process.platform);
    const getContext = (): LibraryContext => {
      if (!ctx) throw new LearnError('LIBRARY_UNAVAILABLE', libraryError?.message ?? mainStrings.library.unavailable);
      return ctx;
    };
    const sheets = createSheetHost({
      preload: path.join(here, '../preload/sheet.cjs'),
      url: () => windowUrl(rendererBase, 'sheet', urlOptions),
      platform: process.platform,
      onSheetShown,
      onSheetClosed,
      staticKey: (payload) =>
        payload.kind === 'shortcuts'
          ? sheetHeightKey({ platform: process.platform, fontSize: prefs.get().fontSize, density: prefs.get().density, digest: shortcutsSheetDigest })
          : null,
    });
    /** Every native dialog with a parent window goes through this (IpcDeps.windows.asSheet). */
    const asSheet = async <T>(owner: BrowserWindow, show: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> => {
      onSheetShown(owner, { native: true }); // the dialog takes the key: owner is not key under it (critique m2)
      try {
        return await show();
      } finally {
        if (!owner.isDestroyed()) onSheetClosed(owner, { native: true });
      }
    };
    const liveMainWindow = (): BrowserWindow | null => (mainWindow && !mainWindow.isDestroyed() ? mainWindow : null);
    // Every window's imports, one file at a time on the work line; a duplicate question hangs on the window that asked.
    const imports = createImportQueue({
      lane: jobs,
      importer: () => getContext().importer,
      card: (itemId) => {
        const item = ctx?.repo.getItem(itemId);
        return item ? { title: item.title, type: item.type, size: item.size, createdAt: item.createdAt, storageMode: item.storageMode } : null;
      },
      ask: createDuplicateAsker<BrowserWindow>({
        windowOf: (id) => {
          const win = liveMainWindow();
          return win && win.webContents.id === id ? win : null;
        },
        anyMainWindow: liveMainWindow,
        sheet: (parent, payload) => sheets.open(parent, payload),
        messageBox: (options) => dialog.showMessageBox(options),
      }),
      fileExisting: (collectionId, itemIds) => {
        const filed = getContext().collections.addItemsChanged(collectionId, itemIds);
        if (filed.length > 0) broadcast('libraryChanged', { reason: 'collections', itemIds: filed });
        return filed.length;
      },
      announce: (itemIds) => broadcast('libraryChanged', { reason: 'import', itemIds }),
    });
    const deps: IpcDeps = {
      getContext,
      appInfo: (): AppInfo => ({
        version: app.getVersion(),
        libraryRoot,
        schemaVersion: ctx?.schemaVersion ?? 0,
        platform: process.platform,
        libraryError,
        homeDir: app.getPath('home'),
        // Looked up when asked (the fatal screen asks once): a backup the user restores meanwhile is not cached.
        backupFile: libraryError ? findUpdateBackup(libraryRoot) : null,
      }),
      prefs,
      uiContext: {
        report(sender, ctx) {
          // Only the main window drives the menu (settings and sheet windows report nothing that counts).
          if (!isMainWindow(sender)) return;
          menuState.__learnMenuStateVersion = (menuState.__learnMenuStateVersion ?? 0) + 1; // received, even if unchanged
          menuState.__learnMenuContext = ctx;
          setUiContext(ctx);
        },
        current: () => uiContext,
      },
      isMainWindow,
      isSettingsWindow,
      sheets,
      jobs,
      imports,
      windows: { openSettings: () => void settingsWindow.open(), asSheet },
      theme: {
        changed: (theme) => themeFollower.pageChanged(theme),
        shown: (sender, shade) => themeFollower.shown(sender.id, shade),
      },
      prepareSettings: () => settingsWindow.prepare(),
      relaunch() {
        if (isE2E(app.isPackaged, process.env)) {
          // Playwright cannot follow a relaunched process: E2E only records the request.
          (globalThis as { __learnRelaunchRequested?: boolean }).__learnRelaunchRequested = true;
          return;
        }
        setImmediate(() => {
          app.relaunch();
          app.quit();
        });
      },
    };
    registerAllIpc(createHandle(devOrigin), deps);
    // A running import, backup or restore is asked about before the edit-flush gate on every quit.
    quitGuard = createQuitGuard<BrowserWindow>({
      lane: jobs,
      remaining: () => {
        const s = imports.state();
        return s.total - s.done;
      },
      owner: liveMainWindow,
      ask: async (owner, question) => {
        const options: MessageBoxOptions = { ...question, buttons: [...question.buttons], noLink: true };
        const { response } = owner ? await asSheet(owner, () => dialog.showMessageBox(owner, options)) : await dialog.showMessageBox(options);
        return response === 0;
      },
      quit: () => app.quit(),
      // Linux/Windows quit when the last window closes: staying on without one would leave no way back into the app.
      onStay: () => {
        if (process.platform === 'darwin' || liveMainWindow() !== null) return;
        mainWindow = openMainWindow();
        refreshFullScreenItem();
      },
    });
    // E2E only (LEARN_E2E=1, never packaged): the hooks tests call through app.evaluate (seeding, the import pause and queue).
    if (isE2E(app.isPackaged, process.env)) {
      installTestHooks({
        repo: () => deps.getContext().repo,
        importCommits: () => deps.getContext().repo,
        organize: () => {
          const ctx = deps.getContext();
          return { db: ctx.db, collections: ctx.collections, tags: ctx.tags };
        },
        broadcast,
        imports: { importer: () => getContext().importer, queue: imports, mainWindowId: () => liveMainWindow()?.webContents.id ?? null },
      });
    }
  ```
- 449–451행(`// Before anything closes: …` 주석과 `app.on('before-quit', (event) => editFlush.onBeforeQuit(event));`)을 바꾼다:
  ```ts
  // Before anything closes: a running import, backup or restore is asked about first (it stops, or the quit is off),
  // then an open 정보 편집 is saved, or keeps the app (marked fields). Any other before-quit cleanup registers after this
  // one and must skip a quit this called off (event.defaultPrevented).
  app.on('before-quit', (event) => {
    if (quitGuard?.onBeforeQuit(event)) return;
    editFlush.onBeforeQuit(event);
  });
  ```

## 작성자 제안 (Q-3x)

- **Q-3a `ImportReport += mode: StorageMode | null, collectionId: string | null`.** 계약의 `ImportReport`에는 결과 토스트가 고를 말("가져왔습니다"/"연결했습니다", "‘X’에 …")에 필요한 묶음의 방식·컬렉션이 없다. 한 실행은 여러 창·여러 생산자(드롭, ⌘O, 수정본, 점검의 되살리기)의 묶음을 합치므로 렌더러는 그것을 알 수 없다. main이 "모든 묶음이 같을 때만 그 값, 아니면 null"로 싣는다. 받지 않으면: Task 4의 렌더러가 자기가 넣은 묶음을 실행마다 기억해 추측해야 하고, main이 넣은 실행(Task 7·8)과 창을 다시 띄운 뒤의 실행에서 틀린다. 지우는 비용은 두 필드와 `only()` 두 줄.
- **Q-3b `JobLane += cancelAll(): void`.** 종료 확인이 줄의 지금 작업만 취소하면(`cancelCurrent`) 그 뒤에 기다리던 백업·복원이 10초 기다리는 동안 시작되고, 끝내면서 중간에 죽는다(`.partial-*` 폴더가 남아 점검이 보인다). `cancelAll`은 지금 작업을 멈추고 기다리는 작업을 `CANCELLED`로 버린다(그 일은 시작하지 않는다). 받지 않으면: 종료 확인이 `cancelCurrent`를 반복하며 기다리는 작업마다 시작 직후 멈추게 하는 고리를 돌린다(Task 9·10의 첫 확인 지점 의존).
- **Q-3c P-6 바깥의 E2E 훅 넷 — `importWaiting()`, `enqueueImport()`, `importQueueState()`, `importReports()`.** SIGKILL 시험(Task 11)은 파일이 정말 그 지점에 멈췄는지 알아야 죽인다(`.part`가 있는지 보는 것은 복사 도중에도 참이라 경쟁이다). 나머지 셋은 Task 4가 채널을 연결하기 전에 이 작업의 체크박스·끝에 묻기·종료 확인을 실제 앱에서 확인하게 한다. 받지 않으면: Task 11이 staging 폴링으로 경쟁을 안고, 이 작업의 렌더러 변경(체크박스)과 종료 확인은 Task 4 전까지 실제 앱에서 시험되지 않는다. Task 4는 `enqueueImport`를 진짜 채널로 바꾸고 지워도 된다.
- **Q-3d 주인 없는 중복 질문은 단추 둘(새 자료로 추가 · 건너뛰기).** 명세 3.4 "그것도 없으면 주인 없는 대화상자"는 macOS에서 가져오는 도중 메인 창을 닫은 경우뿐이다. 그때는 "기존 자료 열기"로 열 창이 없어(Dock으로 창을 다시 열기 전) 그 단추는 아무 일도 못 한다 — 가짜 금지. 받지 않으면: 열기를 고르면 창을 새로 열고 `item:openRequested`를 그 창의 첫 보고 뒤로 미루는 길(Task 4에 수십 줄)을 만든다.
- **Q-3e 체크박스는 켜진 채 열린다.** 목업이 켬으로 그렸고, 소유자 결정이 "여러 중복이 나오면 한 번만 묻고"다. ↩(건너뛰기)는 안전하다 — 켠 채 ↩면 남은 중복을 모두 건너뛴다. 받지 않으면: `useState(offer)` → `useState(false)`, 주인 없는 상자의 `checkboxChecked: false`, E2E 두 단언.
- **Q-3f 종료 확인의 기본 단추는 끝내기.** 사용자가 이미 끝내기를 골랐고(⌘Q), 잃는 것은 아직 가져오지 않은 파일뿐이다(원본은 그대로, 다시 넣으면 된다). esc는 취소. 받지 않으면: `defaultId: 1`과 테스트 두 줄. (영구 삭제처럼 되돌릴 수 없는 파괴가 아니라서 취소를 기본으로 두지 않았다.)
- **Q-3g `onFinished(cb: (report, openIn: number | null) => void)`.** 계약은 콜백의 모양을 정하지 않았다. 열기 요청은 "마지막 선택이 이긴다"라서 실행이 끝날 때 하나만 나오고, 보낼 창은 그 질문에 답한 창이다(넣은 창이 닫혔으면 다른 창). 보고서와 함께 그 창의 webContents id를 넘긴다. 받지 않으면: 큐에 `onOpenRequested(cb)`를 따로 두는 것으로 바꾼다(같은 정보, 메서드 하나 더).
- **Q-3h 옛 `library:import`·`pickAndImport` 처리기는 Task 4까지 줄 밖에 둔다.** 이 작업에서 운영 경로로 큐에 넣는 쪽이 없으니 동시에 쓰는 두 쓰기는 생기지 않는다. 옛 처리기를 줄 위로 올리면 종료 확인이 "남은 N개"를 셀 수 없는 일을 붙잡는다(옛 경로는 큐의 수를 모른다). 받지 않으면: 옛 처리기를 `jobs.run('import', (signal) => importMany(paths, { ...input, signal }))`로 감싸고, 그동안 종료 확인 문장의 N을 "0"이 아닌 다른 말로 바꿔야 한다.
- **Q-3i Linux/Windows에서 종료 확인에 취소하면 메인 창을 다시 연다.** 그 플랫폼의 종료는 마지막 창을 닫아서 온다(`window-all-closed`). 창 없이 앱만 남으면 Dock이 없어 돌아올 길이 없고 두 번째 실행도 `second-instance`에서 창이 없어 아무것도 하지 않는다. 받지 않으면: 취소를 고른 사용자에게 보이지 않는 앱이 남는다.
- **Q-3j 가져온 자료 알림(`libraryChanged{import}`)은 실행 중 1초에 한 번, 나머지는 실행 끝에.** 알림마다 렌더러가 목록 전체를 다시 읽는다(`invalidateAll`). 큰 폴더(1,000개)를 파일마다 알리면 1만 항목 목록을 1,000번 읽는다. 받지 않으면: `ANNOUNCE_MS = 0`(파일마다)이고 Task 11의 성능 측정이 그 비용을 잰다.
- **Q-3k `ImportQueueState`는 D/library.ts에 둔다.** 계약은 `M/jobs/import-queue.ts` 옆에 적었지만 Task 4의 `import:progress` 푸시가 이 형을 렌더러로 보낸다(`LearnEventMap`은 D에 있다). 받지 않으면: Task 4가 D로 옮긴다(import 경로만 바뀐다).

### Task 4: 가져오기 큐 연결 — IPC 바꿈(`{ queued }`·`library:cancelImport`·푸시 셋), 진행 토스트(세 상태)·결과 토스트·취소, `blocked`에서 `importing` 빼기, 빈 라이브러리 화면 N, `file.cancelImport`, 기존 E2E 옮기기, 팔레트 held 분기 E2E, `p1` suite

#### 이 작업이 하는 일

Task 3이 만든 main의 큐(`IpcDeps.imports`)를 창에 잇는다. 명세 3.2·3.3·3.7·12, P-1·P-2·P-3·P-22·P-23.

- **IPC**: `library:import`·`library:pickAndImport`는 큐에 넣고 바로 `{ queued }`(그 실행의 전체 수, 아무것도 넣지 않았으면 0)를 답한다. 새 `library:cancelImport`. 새 푸시 `import:progress`(`ImportQueueState`), `import:finished`(`{ report }`), `item:openRequested`(`{ itemId }` — "기존 자료 열기"를 답한 창에만). `ui:confirmDuplicate`는 없앤다(P-1: 큐가 시트를 직접 연다).
- **렌더러**: `settleImport`·`ImportFlowDeps`·렌더러의 `ImportReport`를 걷어 내고 `importToast`·`failureLines`는 D의 `ImportReport`로 먹인다. `useImport.ts`를 지우고 `importRunner.ts`(순수, 단위 시험) + `useImportQueue.ts`(훅)로. 드롭은 500개씩 나눠 넣는다(P-2). 진행 토스트(P-3, 아래 결정)·`R/ui/ProgressBar.tsx`·가운데 줄임 파일 이름. 취소된 실행의 결과 "12개 중 7개를 가져왔습니다".
- **창**: `blocked`에서 `importing`을 뺀다(명세 3.2). 창을 잡는 것은 시트(⌘/·중복 질문)와 패널(파일 가져오기…·다시 연결…·사본 내보내기…)뿐이다. 중복 질문은 main의 `waiting-choice` 알림 + `windowState.sheetOpen`으로 안다. 빈 라이브러리의 "자료 N개를 가져오는 중…"은 N = 큐 전체 수이고, N이 늘어도 화면이 처음부터 다시 시작하지 않는다.
- **명령**: `file.cancelImport` "가져오기 취소"(팔레트만, 큐가 돌 때).
- **E2E**: `importPaths`를 큐 위로(P-22), `waitImportIdle`, 큐 시험 훅 도우미, 새 `tests/e2e/import-queue.spec.ts`(진행 토스트·큐에 붙이기·취소 둘·같은 선택·팔레트 held 분기 + axe·500개 넘는 드롭·앞의 작업 기다림·빈 라이브러리 N), 기존 E2E 옮기기(아래 표), 투어 정거장 10장, `p1` Mac suite 골격(`V/p1.evidence.ts`, 워크플로 options, `scripts/evidence.sh`).

**P-3 결정(진행 토스트의 구현)** — `ui/toasts.tsx`를 읽고 정했다: **RAC 토스트 큐 안의 항목 하나**다. 큐에는 내용 대신 `{ kind: 'job', job: 'import' }`를 넣고(`showJobToast`), 그 항목은 렌더러 저장소(`jobs/jobProgress.ts` `useJobProgress`)의 실시간 상태를 그린다. 그래서 같은 영역·같은 Tab/F6(`data-pane="toasts"`)·같은 `maxVisibleToasts`를 쓰고, 상태가 바뀌어도 큐의 항목(DOM 노드)이 그대로라 깜빡이지 않는다. 실행이 끝나면 그 항목의 "보기"(`views[toastKey]`)를 마지막 상태로 얼린 뒤 결과(`ToastData`)로 바꾼다 — 같은 `<Toast>` 노드가 결과 토스트가 되고, 그때부터 성공·정보 토스트처럼 5초 뒤 닫힌다(`AutoClose`). 결과가 없으면 닫는다. 1초 안에 끝난 실행은 진행 토스트를 띄우지 않고 결과만 새 토스트로 보인다(`jobs/progressToast.ts`). 항목은 **작업마다 하나**(가져오기·백업·복원)이고 같은 기계를 쓴다 — 목업 `dialogs.html?scene=jobs`처럼 백업 진행 토스트와 그 뒤에서 기다리는 가져오기 토스트가 함께 보일 수 있다(Task 9가 `ProgressJob`에 `'backup' | 'restore'`를 더한다). 접근성: RAC의 `role="alert"`(`ToastContent`)에는 제목("가져오는 중"·"확인을 기다리는 중"…)만 넣는다 — 수·파일 이름·막대는 그 밖에 두어 초당 10번 다시 읽히지 않는다. 막대는 `role="progressbar"` + `aria-valuenow`·`aria-valuetext`("파일 12개 중 7개, 58%").

```ts
describe('holding the work line (Task 4: the progress toast that waits for the work before it, Q-4i)', () => {
  it('holdJob runs a job of that kind on the line until releaseJob; a second hold waits for the first to be let go', async () => {
    const runs: Array<{ kind: string; done: Promise<unknown> }> = [];
    const lane = {
      run: vi.fn((kind: string, work: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<unknown>) => {
        const done = work(new AbortController().signal);
        runs.push({ kind, done });
        return done;
      }),
    };
    installTestHooks({
      importCommits: () => ({}) as never,
      repo: () => ({}) as never,
      organize: () => {
        throw new Error('not used');
      },
      broadcast: vi.fn(),
      imports: {
        importer: () => ({ setHooks: vi.fn() }),
        queue: { enqueue: vi.fn(() => 0), state: () => ({ ...IDLE_IMPORT_STATE }), onFinished: () => () => {} },
        mainWindowId: () => 41,
        lane: lane as never,
      },
    });
    const hooks = (globalThis as { __learnTest?: LearnTestHooks }).__learnTest!;
    hooks.holdJob({ kind: 'backup' });
    expect(lane.run).toHaveBeenCalledWith('backup', expect.any(Function));
    expect(() => hooks.holdJob({ kind: 'restore' })).toThrow(/held already/);
    let ended = false;
    void runs[0]!.done.then(() => (ended = true));
    await Promise.resolve();
    expect(ended).toBe(false);
    hooks.releaseJob();
    await runs[0]!.done;
    expect(ended).toBe(true);
    hooks.holdJob({ kind: 'restore' }); // let go: free again
    expect(runs.map((r) => r.kind)).toEqual(['backup', 'restore']);
    hooks.releaseJob();
    delete (globalThis as { __learnTest?: unknown }).__learnTest;
  });
});
```

`__learnTest` 객체의 Task 3 `importReports: () => [...reports],` 다음에:
```ts
    holdJob({ kind }) {
      const lane = queue().lane;
      if (!lane) throw new Error('holdJob: no work line');
      if (heldJob) throw new Error('holdJob: a job is held already');
      let release = (): void => {};
      const held = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        release = resolve;
      });
      heldJob = release;
      void lane
        .run(kind, (signal) => {
          signal.addEventListener('abort', () => release(), { once: true });
          return held;
        })
        .catch(() => {})
        .finally(() => {
          if (heldJob === release) heldJob = null;
        });
    },
    releaseJob() {
      const go = heldJob;
      heldJob = null;
      go?.();
    },
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { middleParts } from './middleEllipsis';

describe('a file name cut in the middle (spec 3.3)', () => {
  it('keeps the extension and the few characters before it whole; only the head gives way', () => {
    expect(middleParts('강의 08 · 효소 조절.mp4')).toEqual({ head: '강의 08', tail: ' · 효소 조절.mp4' });
    expect(middleParts('molbio_ch06_signaling_pathway_review.pdf')).toEqual({ head: 'molbio_ch06_signaling_pathwa', tail: 'y_review.pdf' });
  });
  it('a short name, or one with no extension, is whole or keeps its last characters; the parts always make the name', () => {
    expect(middleParts('a.pdf')).toEqual({ head: 'a.pdf', tail: '' });
    expect(middleParts('README-그대로-두는-파일')).toEqual({ head: 'README-그', tail: '대로-두는-파일' });
    for (const name of ['x', '.hidden', '세포생물학 3장.pdf', 'archive.tar.gz', '🎬 강의 영상 녹화본 마지막.mov']) {
      const { head, tail } = middleParts(name);
      expect(head + tail).toBe(name);
    }
  });
});
```
