```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { IDLE_IMPORT_STATE, type ImportQueueState } from '@learn/domain';
import { describeJob, importBusy, importBusyTotal, useJobProgress } from './jobProgress';

const state = (over: Partial<ImportQueueState>): ImportQueueState => ({ ...IDLE_IMPORT_STATE, state: 'running', ...over });
afterEach(() => {

});

describe('the progress toast in words (spec 3.3, mockup importToast)', () => {
  it('running: 가져오는 중 · done / total, the file under way, the hashed bytes as the bar', () => {
    expect(describeJob('import', state({ done: 7, total: 12, bytesDone: 580, bytesTotal: 1000, current: '강의 08 · 효소 조절.mp4' }))).toEqual({
      state: 'running', waiting: false, title: '가져오는 중', count: ' · 7 / 12', file: '강의 08 · 효소 조절.mp4', note: null,
      percent: 58, valueText: '파일 12개 중 7개, 58%', testId: 'import-progress', cancelTestId: 'import-cancel',
    });
  });
  it('waiting for a choice: paused, 확인을 기다리는 중, the file asked about', () => {
    expect(describeJob('import', state({ state: 'waiting-choice', done: 7, total: 12, bytesDone: 1000, bytesTotal: 1000, current: 'molbio_ch06_signaling.pdf' }))).toMatchObject({
      waiting: true, title: '확인을 기다리는 중', count: ' · 7 / 12', file: 'molbio_ch06_signaling.pdf', note: null, percent: 100,
    });
  });
  it('waiting for the work before it: paused, 앞의 작업을 기다리는 중 and what comes next, no file', () => {
    expect(describeJob('import', state({ state: 'waiting-job', done: 0, total: 12, bytesTotal: 5000 }))).toMatchObject({
      waiting: true, title: '앞의 작업을 기다리는 중', count: ' · 0 / 12', file: null, note: '앞의 작업이 끝나면 가져오기를 시작합니다.', percent: 0,
    });
  });
  it('a bar is never ahead of the bytes: floored, 0 before the sizes are known, 100 at most', () => {
    expect(describeJob('import', state({ bytesDone: 999, bytesTotal: 1000 })).percent).toBe(99);
    expect(describeJob('import', state({ bytesDone: 0, bytesTotal: 0 })).percent).toBe(0);
    expect(describeJob('import', state({ bytesDone: 7, bytesTotal: 5 })).percent).toBe(100);
    expect(describeJob('import', state({ bytesDone: 4_200_000, bytesTotal: 7_200_000 })).percent).toBe(58);
  });
});

describe('the empty library\'s busy screen N (spec 3.2: the queue\'s total)', () => {
  const s = () => useJobProgress.getState();
  it('is what this window hands over before main has counted it, then the queue\'s total as it grows', () => {
    expect(importBusyTotal(s())).toBeNull();
    s().addSending(2);
    expect(importBusyTotal(s())).toBe(2);
    s().setImport(state({ total: 2 }));
    s().addSending(-2);
    expect(importBusyTotal(s())).toBe(2);
    s().setImport(state({ total: 5 }));
    expect(importBusyTotal(s())).toBe(5);
    expect(importBusy(s())).toBe(true);
  });
  it('stays while the run\'s end is shown (main is idle by then), and is gone after it', () => {
    s().setImport(state({ total: 3 }));
    s().addSettling(1);
    s().setImport({ ...IDLE_IMPORT_STATE });
    expect(importBusyTotal(s())).toBe(3);
    s().addSettling(-1);
    expect(importBusyTotal(s())).toBeNull();
    expect(importBusy(s())).toBe(false);
  });
  it('a quiet run (the E2E setup helper) shows no busy screen', () => {
    s().setQuiet(true);
    s().setImport(state({ total: 4 }));
    expect(importBusyTotal(s())).toBeNull();
    expect(importBusy(s())).toBe(true);
  });
  it('keeps a toast\'s view until it is cleared', () => {
    s().setView('k1', { kind: 'progress', state: state({ total: 1 }) });
    expect(Object.keys(s().views)).toEqual(['k1']);
    s().setView('k1', undefined);
    expect(s().views).toEqual({});
  });
});
```

```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { IDLE_IMPORT_STATE, type ImportQueueState } from '@learn/domain';
import type { ToastData } from '../ui/toasts';
import { JOB_TOAST_DELAY_MS, createProgressToast, type JobToastView } from './progressToast';

afterEach(() => {
  vi.useRealTimers();
});
const last = (over: Partial<ImportQueueState> = {}): ImportQueueState => ({ ...IDLE_IMPORT_STATE, state: 'running', done: 3, total: 3, ...over });
const DONE: ToastData = { kind: 'success', title: '자료 3개를 가져왔습니다', testId: 'import-done' };
function harness() {
  const added: string[] = [];
  const closed: string[] = [];
  const shown: ToastData[] = [];
  const views = new Map<string, JobToastView>();
  const toast = createProgressToast('import', {
    add: () => {
      const key = `k${added.length + 1}`;
      added.push(key);
      return key;
    },
    close: (key) => void closed.push(key),
    show: (data) => void shown.push(data),
    setView: (key, view) => void views.set(key, view),
  });
  return { toast, added, closed, shown, views };
}

describe('the job progress toast (spec 3.3, P-3)', () => {
  it('a run that ends within 1 s never shows it: its result is a toast of its own', () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    const h = harness();
    h.toast.begin(false);
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(JOB_TOAST_DELAY_MS - 1);
    const key = h.toast.end(last());
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(5000);
    expect(key).toBeNull();
    expect(h.added).toEqual([]);
    h.toast.settle(key, DONE);
    expect(h.shown).toEqual([DONE]);
  });

  it('past 1 s one toast comes and stays; the end freezes it at its last state, and the result takes it over in place', () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    const h = harness();
    h.toast.begin(false);
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(JOB_TOAST_DELAY_MS);
    expect(h.added).toEqual(['k1']);
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(60_000);
    expect(h.added).toEqual(['k1']); // one toast for the run: never closed and shown again
    const key = h.toast.end(last({ done: 3 }));
    expect(key).toBe('k1');
    expect(h.views.get('k1')).toEqual({ kind: 'progress', state: last({ done: 3 }) });
    h.toast.settle(key, DONE);
    expect(h.views.get('k1')).toEqual({ kind: 'result', data: DONE });
    expect([h.closed, h.shown]).toEqual([[], []]);
  });

  it('with nothing to say at the end, the toast that was up closes', () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    const h = harness();
    h.toast.begin(false);
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(JOB_TOAST_DELAY_MS);
    h.toast.settle(h.toast.end(last()), null);
    expect(h.closed).toEqual(['k1']);
    h.toast.settle(null, null); // a short run with nothing to say: nothing at all
    expect(h.shown).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('a quiet run never shows it; the next run waits its own second', () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    const h = harness();
    h.toast.begin(true);
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(10_000);
    expect(h.toast.end(last())).toBeNull();
    h.toast.begin(false);
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(JOB_TOAST_DELAY_MS - 1);
    expect(h.added).toEqual([]);
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(1);
    expect(h.added).toEqual(['k1']);
  });

  it('a run that begins while the last one\'s end is still being shown gets a toast of its own', () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    const h = harness();
    h.toast.begin(false);
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(JOB_TOAST_DELAY_MS);
    const first = h.toast.end(last());
    h.toast.begin(false);
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(JOB_TOAST_DELAY_MS);
    expect(h.added).toEqual(['k1', 'k2']);
    h.toast.settle(first, DONE);
    expect(h.views.get('k1')).toEqual({ kind: 'result', data: DONE });
    expect(h.views.has('k2')).toBe(false); // still following its own run
  });
});
```

**(a)** 새 파일 `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/ui/middleEllipsis.ts`:
```ts
/** Characters kept whole before the extension (or at the end of a name without one). */
const KEEP = 8;
/** An extension longer than this is not one (a name with a dot in it). */
const EXTENSION_MAX = 6;

/**
 * Where a file name gives way when it does not fit (spec 3.3 "넘치면 가운데 줄임"): the head is cut with an ellipsis,
 * the tail — the extension and the few characters before it — stays. By code points, so Hangul and emoji are never split.
 */
export function middleParts(name: string): { head: string; tail: string } {
  const chars = [...name];
  const dot = name.lastIndexOf('.');
  const ext = dot > 0 ? [...name.slice(dot)].length : 0;
  const tailLength = (ext > 0 && ext <= EXTENSION_MAX ? ext : 0) + KEEP;
  if (chars.length <= tailLength + 2) return { head: name, tail: '' };
  return { head: chars.slice(0, chars.length - tailLength).join(''), tail: chars.slice(chars.length - tailLength).join('') };
}
```
(시험의 기대값은 이 규칙의 계산이다: `강의 08 · 효소 조절.mp4`는 17자라 꼬리 4 + 8 = 12자, `molbio_…_review.pdf`는 40자라 꼬리 12자, 확장자 없는 `README-그대로-두는-파일`은 16자라 꼬리 8자.)

새 파일 `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/ui/MiddleEllipsis.tsx`:
```tsx
import { cx } from './cx';
import { middleParts } from './middleEllipsis';

/** A file name on one line, cut in the middle when it does not fit; the whole name is its tooltip. */
export function MiddleEllipsis({ text, className }: { text: string; className?: string }) {
  const { head, tail } = middleParts(text);
  return (
    <span className={cx('middle-ellipsis', className)} title={text}>
      <span className="me-head">{head}</span>
      {tail !== '' && <span className="me-tail">{tail}</span>}
    </span>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { cx } from './cx';

/**
 * design-spec 6 진행 막대 (mockup .progress, .t-progress): the --bg-track track and the --meter fill; only its width moves
 * (160 ms). `percent` is a whole number the caller floors, so the bar never reads 100 before the work has ended.
 */
export function ProgressBar({ percent, label, valueText, wide = false, testId }: { percent: number; label: string; valueText?: string; wide?: boolean; testId?: string }) {
  const value = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Math.round(percent)));
  return (
    <span className={cx('progress', wide && 'wide')} role="progressbar" aria-label={label} aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={100} aria-valuenow={value} aria-valuetext={valueText} data-testid={testId}>

    </span>
  );
}
```

**(c)** 새 파일 `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/jobs/progressToast.ts`:
```ts
import type { ImportQueueState } from '@learn/domain';
import type { ToastData } from '../ui/toasts';

/** design-spec 6 "1초를 넘는 작업은 진행 토스트", spec 3.3: a run that has not ended by then gets its toast. */
export const JOB_TOAST_DELAY_MS = 1000;

/** The jobs with a progress toast. Task 9 adds the backup's and the restore's (the same toast, P-3). */
export type ProgressJob = 'import';

/** What a job's toast shows once it no longer follows its job: its run's last state, then the result that took it over. */
export type JobToastView = { kind: 'progress'; state: ImportQueueState } | { kind: 'result'; data: ToastData };

export interface ProgressToastDeps {
  /** Puts the job's toast in the region (it draws the job's live state until it is given a view); answers its key. */
  add(job: ProgressJob): string;
  close(key: string): void;
  /** A toast of its own: the result of a run that had no progress toast. */
  show(data: ToastData): void;
  setView(key: string, view: JobToastView): void;
  delayMs?: number;
}

export interface ProgressToast {
  /** A run began. Its toast comes once it has run JOB_TOAST_DELAY_MS; a quiet run (the E2E setup helper) has none. */
  begin(quiet: boolean): void;
  /** The run's end reached this window: no toast comes for it now; the one up keeps `last` and is answered (null: none). */
  end(last: ImportQueueState | null): string | null;
  /** The run's result takes its toast over in place, or is a toast of its own; null closes the toast. */
  settle(key: string | null, result: ToastData | null): void;
}

/**
 * One progress toast per run of a job (P-3): never closed and shown again while the run goes, so it does not flicker; the
 * same toast becomes the result. A run that begins while the last one's end is still being shown gets its own.
 */
export function createProgressToast(job: ProgressJob, deps: ProgressToastDeps): ProgressToast {
  const delay = deps.delayMs ?? JOB_TOAST_DELAY_MS;
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
  let shown: string | null = null;
  const stop = (): void => {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = undefined;
  };
  return {
    begin(quiet) {
      stop();
      if (quiet) return;
      timer = setTimeout(() => {
        timer = undefined;
        shown ??= deps.add(job);
      }, delay);
    },
    end(last) {
      stop();
      const key = shown;
      shown = null;
      if (key !== null && last !== null) deps.setView(key, { kind: 'progress', state: last });
      return key;
    },
    settle(key, result) {
      if (key === null) {
        if (result !== null) deps.show(result);
        return;
      }
      if (result !== null) deps.setView(key, { kind: 'result', data: result });
      else deps.close(key);
    },
  };
}
```

**(d)** 새 파일 `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/jobs/jobProgress.ts`:
```ts
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { IDLE_IMPORT_STATE, type ImportQueueState } from '@learn/domain';
import { t } from '../strings';
import type { JobToastView, ProgressJob } from './progressToast';

/** Work main runs on its work line, as this window knows it (spec 3: the window is not held meanwhile). */
export interface JobProgressState {
  /** Main's import queue as last pushed (import:progress). */
  import: ImportQueueState;
  /** Files this window has handed to main and main has not answered for yet (a drop between its event and the reply). */
  sending: number;
  /** Runs whose end is being shown (the list read again, the result toast): the busy screen and waitImportIdle wait. */
  settling: number;
  /** The busy screen's N while a run's end is shown: main's state is idle by then. */
  shownTotal: number;
  /** The run going now is the E2E setup helper's quiet one: no busy screen (window.__learnQuietImports). */
  quiet: boolean;
  /** Job toasts that stopped following their job, by toast key: their run's last state, then their result. */
  views: Readonly<Record<string, JobToastView>>;
  setImport(state: ImportQueueState): void;
  addSending(delta: number): void;
  addSettling(delta: number): void;
  setQuiet(quiet: boolean): void;
  setView(key: string, view: JobToastView | undefined): void;
}

export const useJobProgress = create<JobProgressState>()((set) => ({
  import: { ...IDLE_IMPORT_STATE },
  sending: 0,
  settling: 0,
  shownTotal: 0,
  quiet: false,
  views: {},
  setImport: (state) => set((s) => ({ import: state, shownTotal: state.state !== 'idle' ? state.total : s.shownTotal })),
  addSending: (delta) =>
    set((s) => {
      const sending = Math.max(0, s.sending + delta);
      return { sending, shownTotal: s.import.state === 'idle' && sending > 0 ? sending : s.shownTotal };
    }),
  addSettling: (delta) => set((s) => ({ settling: Math.max(0, s.settling + delta) })),
  setQuiet: (quiet) => set({ quiet }),
  setView: (key, view) =>
    set((s) => {
      const views = { ...s.views };
      if (view) views[key] = view;
      else delete views[key];
      return { views };
    }),
}));

/** An import is going as this window sees it: main's queue works, files are still being handed over, or an end is shown. */
export const importBusy = (s: JobProgressState): boolean => s.import.state !== 'idle' || s.sending > 0 || s.settling > 0;

/** The empty library's "자료 N개를 가져오는 중…" N (spec 3.2: the queue's total); null when the screen does not show it. */
export function importBusyTotal(s: JobProgressState): number | null {
  if (s.quiet) return null;
  if (s.import.state !== 'idle') return s.import.total;
  if (s.sending > 0) return s.sending;
  return s.settling > 0 ? s.shownTotal : null;
}

/** The progress toast's words and numbers (spec 3.3, mockup importToast and jobToasts). */
export interface JobToastText {
  state: ImportQueueState['state'];
  /** The pause icon instead of the spinner: a question is open, or another job runs first. */
  waiting: boolean;
  title: string;
  /** " · 7 / 12" after the title. */
  count: string;
  /** The file under way or asked about (cut in the middle); null while nothing is. */
  file: string | null;
  /** A sentence instead of a file name (waiting for the work before it). */
  note: string | null;
  /** The hashed bytes of the files so far, floored: never 100 before the end. */
  percent: number;
  valueText: string;
  testId: string;
  cancelTestId: string;
}

export function describeJob(_job: ProgressJob, s: ImportQueueState): JobToastText {
  const percent = s.bytesTotal > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.floor((s.bytesDone * 100) / s.bytesTotal)) : 0;
  const waitingJob = s.state === 'waiting-job';
  return {
    state: s.state,
    waiting: s.state === 'waiting-choice' || waitingJob,
    title: s.state === 'waiting-choice' ? t.jobs.waitingChoice : waitingJob ? t.jobs.waitingJob : t.jobs.importing,
    count: t.jobs.count(s.done, s.total),
    file: waitingJob ? null : s.current,
    note: waitingJob ? t.jobs.waitingJobNote : null,
    percent,
    valueText: t.jobs.progressValue(s.done, s.total, percent),
    testId: 'import-progress',
    cancelTestId: 'import-cancel',
  };
}
```

`useBusyScreen`(77–95행의 첫 두 `useEffect`까지)을 바꾼다 — N이 바뀔 때 처음부터(조용한 300ms) 다시 시작하지 않는다:
```ts
/**
 * `count`: the files an import into the empty library brings in (the queue's total, spec 3.2) while the list is still
 * empty; null otherwise. A count that changes while the screen is up (more files joined) changes its words only.
 */
export function useBusyScreen(count: number | null): BusyScreen | null {
  const [s, dispatch] = useReducer(busyReducer, null);
  const active = count !== null;
  const latest = useRef(count);
  latest.current = count;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!active) {
      dispatch({ type: 'end' });
      return;
    }
    dispatch({ type: 'start', count: latest.current! });
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
    const cancel = afterPaintOr(BUSY_DELAY_MS, () => (timer = setTimeout(() => dispatch({ type: 'delayDone' }), BUSY_DELAY_MS)));
    return () => {
      cancel();
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [active]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (count !== null) dispatch({ type: 'count', count });
  }, [count]);
```
(이어지는 `const text = …` 아래는 그대로.) 1행 import를 `import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useReducer, useRef } from 'react';`로.

  ```ts
  /** One put-in for the import queue from a channel's input: its duplicate questions hang on the window that sent it. */
  function batchOf(paths: string[], input: { mode: StorageMode; allowDuplicate: boolean; collectionId?: string | null | undefined }, owner: number): ImportBatch {
    return { paths, mode: input.mode, collectionId: input.collectionId ?? null, owner, ...(input.allowDuplicate ? { allowDuplicate: true } : {}) };
  }
  ```
- 59–65행(두 가져오기 처리기)을 바꾼다:
  ```ts
    // Into main's import queue (spec 3.7): answered at once with the run's total once these files are in (0: nothing was
    // picked). What becomes of them comes as import:progress and import:finished.
    handle(Channels.library.pickAndImport, pickAndImportInput, async (input, event) => {
      deps.getContext(); // no library (the fatal screen): refused before any panel opens
      const paths = await showOpen(deps, event, { title: words.import, message: input.mode === 'linked' ? words.linkMessage : words.importMessage, buttonLabel: input.mode === 'linked' ? words.linkButton : words.importButton, properties: ['openFile', 'multiSelections'], filters: IMPORT_FILTERS });
      return { queued: paths.length === 0 ? 0 : deps.imports.enqueue(batchOf(paths, input, event.sender.id)) };
    });

    handle(Channels.library.import, importPathsInput, (input, event) => {
      deps.getContext();
      return { queued: deps.imports.enqueue(batchOf(input.paths, input, event.sender.id)) };
    });

    // 취소 on the progress toast and 가져오기 취소 in the palette (spec 3.5, 11.1).
    handle(Channels.library.cancelImport, emptyInput, () => {
      deps.imports.cancel();
    });
  ```

  ```ts
    // Every window hears the queue (the progress toast, the busy screen); 기존 자료 열기 opens in the window it was
    // answered on, which may not be the one that put the file in (spec 3.4).
    imports.onProgress((state) => broadcast('import:progress', state));
    imports.onFinished((report, openIn) => {
      broadcast('import:finished', { report });
      if (report.openItemId === null || openIn === null) return;
      const contents = webContents.fromId(openIn);
      if (contents && !contents.isDestroyed()) sendEvent(contents, 'item:openRequested', { itemId: report.openItemId });
    });
  ```

```ts
    expect(importToast(report({ imported: 2, filed: 1 }), into)?.title).toBe('자료 2개를 가져왔습니다');

    });
  });
});

describe('settledWithin (the list read at the end of a run)', () => {
  it('resolves with the work, whether it succeeds or fails', async () => {
    await expect(settledWithin(Promise.resolve(1), 1000)).resolves.toBeUndefined();
    await expect(settledWithin(Promise.reject(new Error('read failed')), 1000)).resolves.toBeUndefined();
  });
  it('resolves after the limit when the work never answers (3 s for the list)', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    try {
      let done = false;
      void settledWithin(new Promise(() => {}), LIST_REFRESH_WAIT_MS).then(() => (done = true));
      await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(LIST_REFRESH_WAIT_MS - 1);
      expect(done).toBe(false);
      await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1);
      expect(done).toBe(true);
    } finally {
      vi.useRealTimers();
    }
  });
});
```

```ts
import type { ProgressToast } from '../jobs/progressToast';

const ok = <T>(data: T): Result<T> => ({ ok: true, data });
const running = (over: Partial<ImportQueueState> = {}): ImportQueueState => ({ ...IDLE_IMPORT_STATE, state: 'running', total: 2, ...over });
const report = (over: Partial<ImportReport> = {}): ImportReport => ({
  imported: 0, filed: 0, filedExisting: 0, failed: [], openItemId: null, requested: 2, cancelled: false, mode: 'managed', collectionId: null, ...over,
});

function harness(over: Partial<ImportRunnerDeps> = {}) {
  const log: string[] = [];
  const toasts: ToastData[] = [];
  let sending = 0;
  let settling = 0;
  const toast: ProgressToast = {
    begin: vi.fn((quiet: boolean) => void log.push(`begin:${quiet}`)),
    end: vi.fn(() => {
      log.push('end');

  };

    importPaths: vi.fn(async (input) => ok({ queued: input.paths.length })),
    pickAndImport: vi.fn(async () => ok({ queued: 2 })),

    settling: (d) => void (settling += d),
    setQuiet: vi.fn(),
    setPanel: vi.fn((open: boolean) => void log.push(`panel:${open}`)),
    showToast: (data) => void toasts.push(data),
    refreshList: vi.fn(async () => void log.push('list')),
    screenSettled: vi.fn(async () => void log.push('screen')),
    collectionName: (id) => (id === 'c1' ? '학회 준비' : null),
    takeQuiet: () => false,
    toast,
    mark: (name) => void log.push(`mark:${name}`),
    clearMarks: vi.fn(),

  };
  return { runner: createImportRunner(deps), deps, log, toasts, toast, sending: () => sending, settling: () => settling };
}
```

**(a)** `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/library/import-flow.ts` 전체:
```ts
import type { ImportReport } from '@learn/domain';
import { t } from '../strings';
import type { ToastData } from '../ui/toasts';

/**
 * The result toast of an import run (spec 3.3, 3.7), from main's report: the plain sentence; when every imported item went
 * into the collection the run asked for, the sentence naming it, with the existing items 건너뛰기 filed there as a line; a
 * run stopped by 취소 says how many of the files put in came in. Null when there is nothing to say.
 */
export function importToast(report: ImportReport, into: { name: string } | null): ToastData | null {
  const linked = report.mode === 'linked';
  const existing = into !== null && report.filedExisting > 0 ? t.toast.filedExisting(into.name, report.filedExisting) : null;
  let title: string | null = null;
  if (report.cancelled) title = (linked ? t.toast.linkedOf : t.toast.importedOf)(report.requested, report.imported);
  else if (report.imported > 0) {
    const filedInto = into !== null && report.filed === report.imported ? into : null;
    title = filedInto ? (linked ? t.toast.linkedInto : t.toast.importedInto)(filedInto.name, report.imported) : (linked ? t.toast.linked : t.toast.imported)(report.imported);
  }
  if (title === null && existing === null) return null;
  // Stopped with nothing in: said plainly, not as a success (Q-4j).
  const kind = report.cancelled && report.imported === 0 ? 'info' : 'success';
  return { kind, title: title ?? existing!, ...(title !== null && existing !== null ? { lines: [existing] } : {}), testId: 'import-done' };
}

/** "원인. 다음 행동." → [cause, next step]; a message without a second sentence has no next step. */
const splitMessage = (m: string): [string, string] => {
  const i = m.indexOf('. ');
  return i < 0 ? [m, ''] : [m.slice(0, i + 1), m.slice(i + 2)];
};

/** A failure toast row: the file name (cut first when the row is too long) and its cause (kept visible). */
export interface FailureLine {
  name: string;
  cause: string;
}

/**
 * Failure toast body: one name + cause row per file (at most `max`, then the plain line "외 N개"), and the next steps
 * once each after the list, so five files with the same cause do not repeat the same advice five times.
 */
export function failureLines(failed: ImportReport['failed'], max = 3): { lines: Array<FailureLine | string>; hints: string[] } {
  const lines: Array<FailureLine | string> = failed.slice(0, max).map((f) => ({ name: f.name, cause: splitMessage(f.message)[0] }));
  if (failed.length > max) lines.push(t.toast.more(failed.length - max));
  const hints = [...new Set(failed.map((f) => splitMessage(f.message)[1]).filter(Boolean))];
  return { lines, hints };
}

/** How long a run's end waits for the list to show what it brought before its toast comes anyway (re-review minor 2). */
export const LIST_REFRESH_WAIT_MS = 3000;

/** Resolves when `work` settles (either way) or after `ms`, whichever is first: a list read that never answers holds nothing. */
export async function settledWithin(work: Promise<unknown>, ms: number): Promise<void> {
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
  const limit = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
    timer = setTimeout(resolve, ms);
  });
  try {
    const settled = work.then(
      () => undefined,
      () => undefined,
    );
    await Promise.race([settled, limit]);
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}
```

**(b)** 새 파일 `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/library/importRunner.ts`:
```ts
import type { ImportPathsInput, ImportQueueState, ImportReport, PickAndImportInput, Result, StorageMode } from '@learn/domain';
import { unwrap } from '../api';
import type { ProgressToast } from '../jobs/progressToast';
import type { ImportTarget } from '../sidebar/importTarget';
import { t } from '../strings';
import type { PerfMark } from '../ui/perfMarks';
import type { ToastData } from '../ui/toasts';
import { failureLines, importToast } from './import-flow';

/** importPathsInput's limit (P-2): a bigger drop goes in as several calls, one after another, into the one queue. */
export const IMPORT_CALL_PATHS = 500;

export function inImportCalls<T>(list: readonly T[], size = IMPORT_CALL_PATHS): T[][] {
  const out: T[][] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i += size) out.push(list.slice(i, i + size));
  return out;
}

export interface ImportRunnerDeps {
  importPaths(input: ImportPathsInput): Promise<Result<{ queued: number }>>;
  pickAndImport(input: PickAndImportInput): Promise<Result<{ queued: number }>>;
  /** Files this window is handing to main (the busy screen counts them before main has): +n, then −n as answered. */
  sending(delta: number): void;
  /** A run's end is being shown: the busy screen and waitImportIdle wait for it. */
  settling(delta: number): void;
  /** The run going now is a quiet one (no busy screen). */
  setQuiet(quiet: boolean): void;
  /** 파일 가져오기…'s open panel is up: it holds the window. */
  setPanel(open: boolean): void;
  showToast(data: ToastData): void;
  /** Reads the list again after a run added items, waited for at most LIST_REFRESH_WAIT_MS. */
  refreshList(): Promise<void>;
  /** One painted frame, then whatever the busy screen still holds (its text's minimum time). */
  screenSettled(): Promise<void>;
  /** A live collection's name, from the organize model; null once it is gone. */
  collectionName(id: string): string | null;
  /** E2E only: whether the run that begins now was asked to be quiet (window.__learnQuietImports, Q-4b). */
  takeQuiet(): boolean;
  toast: ProgressToast;
  mark(name: PerfMark): void;
  clearMarks(drop: boolean): void;
}

export interface ImportRunner {
  /** 파일 가져오기… / 외부 파일 연결… / 이 컬렉션으로 가져오기…: main's open panel, then the queue. */
  pick(mode: StorageMode, into: ImportTarget | null): Promise<void>;
  /** A drop (the window, a sidebar row): sent once `ready` (the overlay-less frame), 500 paths a call. */
  drop(paths: readonly string[], mode: StorageMode, into: ImportTarget | null, ready: Promise<void>): Promise<void>;
  /** import:progress. */
  progress(state: ImportQueueState): void;
  /** import:finished: the list read again, then the result in place of the progress toast, and the failures. */
  finished(report: ImportReport): Promise<void>;
}

/**
 * The window's side of main's import queue (spec 3): it puts files in and shows what main reports. Nothing here waits for
 * a run to end before the window can be used again — only the open panel holds it, while it is up.
 */
export function createImportRunner(d: ImportRunnerDeps): ImportRunner {
  /** A run is going as far as this window knows: from its first busy notice to its report. */
  let inRun = false;
  let quiet = false;
  let last: ImportQueueState | null = null;
  const refused = (e: unknown): void => d.showToast({ kind: 'error', title: t.toast.importFailed, body: (e as Error).message, testId: 'import-failures' });
  return {
    async pick(mode, into) {
      d.clearMarks(false);
      d.mark('import:start');
      d.setPanel(true);
      try {
        await unwrap(d.pickAndImport({ mode, ...(into ? { collectionId: into.id } : {}) }));
        d.mark('import:answered');
      } catch (e) {
        refused(e);
      } finally {
        d.setPanel(false);
      }
    },
    async drop(paths, mode, into, ready) {
      d.mark('import:start');
      d.sending(paths.length);
      let left = paths.length;
      try {
        await ready;
        d.mark('import:sent');
        for (const call of inImportCalls(paths)) {
          await unwrap(d.importPaths({ paths: call, mode, ...(into ? { collectionId: into.id } : {}) }));
          left -= call.length;
          d.sending(-call.length);
        }
        d.mark('import:answered');
      } catch (e) {
        refused(e);
      } finally {
        if (left > 0) d.sending(-left);
      }
    },
    progress(state) {
      if (state.state === 'idle') return;
      last = state;
      if (inRun) return;
      inRun = true;
      quiet = d.takeQuiet();
      d.setQuiet(quiet);
      d.toast.begin(quiet);
    },
    async finished(report) {
      const key = d.toast.end(last);
      const quietRun = quiet;
      inRun = false;
      quiet = false;
      last = null;
      d.settling(1);
      try {
        // The toast says "가져왔습니다" over the rows it brought, never over an empty list (critique T13R2-m1).
        if (report.imported > 0) await d.refreshList();
        d.mark('import:listed');
        if (quietRun) {
          d.toast.settle(key, null);
          return;
        }
        await d.screenSettled();
        const name = report.collectionId === null ? null : d.collectionName(report.collectionId);
        d.toast.settle(key, importToast(report, name === null ? null : { name }));
        if (report.failed.length > 0) {
          const { lines, hints } = failureLines(report.failed);
          d.showToast({ kind: 'error', title: t.toast.failedTitle(report.failed.length), lines, body: hints.join(' ') || undefined, testId: 'import-failures' });
        }
      } finally {
        d.mark('import:end');
        if (!inRun) d.setQuiet(false);
        d.settling(-1);
      }
    },
  };
}
```

**(c)** 새 파일 `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/library/useImportQueue.ts`:
```ts
import { useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { api } from '../api';
import { keys } from '../data/queries';
import { queryClient } from '../data/query-client';
import { useLearnEvent } from '../events';
import { afterEditing } from '../inspector/editGuard';
import { useJobProgress } from '../jobs/jobProgress';
import { createProgressToast } from '../jobs/progressToast';
import { useShell } from '../state/shell-store';
import { afterPaintOr } from '../ui/afterPaint';
import { clearImportMarks, perfMark } from '../ui/perfMarks';
import { closeToast, showJobToast, showToast } from '../ui/toasts';
import { BUSY_MIN_MS, busyScreenSettled } from './busyScreen';
import { LIST_REFRESH_WAIT_MS, settledWithin } from './import-flow';
import { createImportRunner, type ImportRunner } from './importRunner';

declare global {
  interface Window {
    /** E2E only: tests/e2e/helpers.ts importPaths counts here the runs it starts; each runs with no busy screen or toast (Q-4b). */
    __learnQuietImports?: number;
  }
}

/** Whether the run that begins now is one of importPaths' (a normal run never finds the counter). */
function takeQuietImport(): boolean {
  const n = window.__learnQuietImports ?? 0;
  if (n <= 0) return false;
  window.__learnQuietImports = n - 1;
  return true;
}

/** The import's progress toast in this window: one controller, as there is one toast queue. */
const importProgressToast = createProgressToast('import', {
  add: (job) => showJobToast(job),
  close: closeToast,
  show: (data) => void showToast(data),
  setView: (key, view) => useJobProgress.getState().setView(key, view),
});

/**
 * Main's import queue for the main window (spec 3): its notices into the job store and the runner, 기존 자료 열기 into
 * the reader. `panelOpen`: 파일 가져오기…'s open panel is up (it holds the window, as 다시 연결…'s does).
 */
export function useImportQueue(collectionName: (id: string) => string | null): { runner: ImportRunner; panelOpen: boolean } {
  const [panelOpen, setPanel] = useState(false);
  const names = useRef(collectionName);
  names.current = collectionName;
  const setView = useShell((s) => s.setView);
  const runner = useMemo(
    () =>
      createImportRunner({
        importPaths: (input) => api().library.import(input),
        pickAndImport: (input) => api().library.pickAndImport(input),
        sending: (delta) => useJobProgress.getState().addSending(delta),
        settling: (delta) => useJobProgress.getState().addSettling(delta),
        setQuiet: (quiet) => useJobProgress.getState().setQuiet(quiet),
        setPanel,
        showToast: (data) => void showToast(data),
        // The read libraryChanged{import} started is awaited, not cancelled for a second one (cancelRefetch: false).
        refreshList: () => settledWithin(queryClient.refetchQueries({ queryKey: keys.items, type: 'active' }, { cancelRefetch: false }), LIST_REFRESH_WAIT_MS),
        screenSettled: async () => {
          // The busy text may have just turned and not yet painted: one frame first, so the toast never comes before it.
          await new Promise<void>((resolve) => afterPaintOr(100, resolve));
          await settledWithin(busyScreenSettled(), BUSY_MIN_MS + 200);
        },
        collectionName: (id) => names.current(id),
        takeQuiet: takeQuietImport,
        toast: importProgressToast,
        mark: perfMark,
        clearMarks: clearImportMarks,
      }),
    [],
  );
  useLearnEvent('import:progress', (state) => {
    useJobProgress.getState().setImport(state);
    runner.progress(state);
  });
  useLearnEvent('import:finished', ({ report }) => void runner.finished(report));
  // Not item.open through the registry: the question's sheet may still hold this window when the request comes.
  useLearnEvent('item:openRequested', ({ itemId }) => afterEditing(() => setView({ kind: 'reader', itemId })));
  return { runner, panelOpen };
}
```

  ```tsx
   */
  function JobProgressBody({ text, onCancel }: { text: JobToastText; onCancel: () => void }) {

          {text.note !== null && <span className="t-file ui-prose">{text.note}</span>}
        </div>

        </span>

    return (
  ```

  ```ts
  declare global {
    interface Window {
      learn: LearnApi;
      /** The renderer's E2E switch (library/useImportQueue.ts): importPaths' runs show no busy screen and no toast. */
      __learnQuietImports?: number;
    }
  }
  ```

- 285–293행 `importPaths`를 바꾼다:
  ```ts
  /**
   * Imports files through `learn.library.import` and waits for the queue's run to end (P-22): every path must come in as a
   * new item; they come back in the order given. The run is quiet — no busy screen, no progress or result toast — as this
   * helper was before the queue. `allowDuplicate`: the same content as an item already there comes in as a new item (no
   * question). Call it while no other import runs: the run must be this call's alone.
   */
  export async function importPaths(page: Page, paths: string[], opts: { mode?: StorageMode; allowDuplicate?: true } = {}): Promise<LibraryItem[]> {
    const r = await page.evaluate(
      async ({ paths, mode, allowDuplicate }) => {
        const learn = window.learn;
        const ids: string[] = [];
        const offs: Array<() => void> = [];
        const ended = new Promise<{ report: ImportReport } | { asked: true }>((resolve) => {
          offs.push(learn.on('libraryChanged', (c) => void (c.reason === 'import' && ids.push(...(c.itemIds ?? [])))));
          offs.push(learn.on('import:progress', (s) => void (s.state === 'waiting-choice' && resolve({ asked: true }))));
          offs.push(learn.on('import:finished', ({ report }) => resolve({ report })));
        });
        window.__learnQuietImports = (window.__learnQuietImports ?? 0) + 1;
        try {
          const sent = await learn.library.import({ paths, mode, ...(allowDuplicate ? { allowDuplicate: true } : {}) });
          if (!sent.ok) {
            window.__learnQuietImports = Math.max(0, (window.__learnQuietImports ?? 1) - 1);
            return { error: `library.import failed: ${sent.code}` };
          }
          const end = await ended;
          if ('asked' in end) return { error: 'importPaths: a duplicate was asked (pass allowDuplicate, or answer the sheet in the test)' };
          const got = ids.length > 0 ? await learn.library.getItems({ ids }) : { ok: true as const, data: [] as LibraryItem[] };
          if (!got.ok) return { error: `library.getItems failed: ${got.code}` };
          return { report: end.report, items: got.data };
        } finally {
          for (const off of offs) off();
        }
      },
      { paths, mode: opts.mode ?? 'managed', allowDuplicate: opts.allowDuplicate === true },
    );
    if ('error' in r) throw new Error(r.error);
    if (r.report.requested !== paths.length) throw new Error(`importPaths: the run had ${r.report.requested} files, not ${paths.length} (another import was running)`);
    if (r.report.failed.length > 0 || r.items.length !== paths.length) {
      throw new Error(`importPaths: ${r.report.failed.map((f) => `${f.name}: ${f.message}`).join('; ') || `${r.items.length} of ${paths.length} came in`}`);
    }
    return r.items;
  }

  /**
   * Until the import has ended for this window: main's queue idle, nothing being handed over, no run's end being shown (its
   * toasts are up). Call it after something showed that the run began (a toast, a sheet, a row).
   */
  export async function waitImportIdle(page: Page): Promise<void> {
    const marker = page.getByTestId('import-queue');
    await expect.poll(() => marker.evaluate((e) => `${e.getAttribute('data-state')}|${e.getAttribute('data-sending')}|${e.getAttribute('data-settling') ?? ''}`), { message: 'the import ended' }).toBe('idle|0|');
  }

  /** Main's E2E import hooks (main/test-hooks.ts, P-6, Q-3c, Q-4i). */
  export type ImportPausePoint = 'afterStage' | 'afterPlace' | 'beforeCommit';
  interface QueueTestHooks {
    importPause(input: { at: ImportPausePoint | null }): void;
    importResume(): void;
    importWaiting(): ImportPausePoint | null;
    importQueueState(): ImportQueueState;
    holdJob(input: { kind: 'backup' | 'restore' }): void;
    releaseJob(): void;
  }
  type WithQueueHooks = { __learnTest: QueueTestHooks };
  /** The next file of an import waits at `at` until importResume; null calls it off. */
  export const importPause = (app: ElectronApplication, at: ImportPausePoint | null) => app.evaluate((_e, at) => (globalThis as unknown as WithQueueHooks).__learnTest.importPause({ at }), at);
  export const importResume = (app: ElectronApplication) => app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as unknown as WithQueueHooks).__learnTest.importResume());
  export const importWaiting = (app: ElectronApplication) => app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as unknown as WithQueueHooks).__learnTest.importWaiting());
  export const importQueueState = (app: ElectronApplication) => app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as unknown as WithQueueHooks).__learnTest.importQueueState());
  /** A job of another kind holds the work line until releaseJob: an import put in meanwhile waits behind it. */
  export const holdJob = (app: ElectronApplication, kind: 'backup' | 'restore' = 'backup') => app.evaluate((_e, kind) => (globalThis as unknown as WithQueueHooks).__learnTest.holdJob({ kind }), kind);
  export const releaseJob = (app: ElectronApplication) => app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as unknown as WithQueueHooks).__learnTest.releaseJob());
  ```

```ts
test('while an import runs the window stays in use: its controls stay enabled, more files join it, the list opens items; only its open panel holds the window (spec 3.2)', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const s = await launch(testInfo.outputPath('library'), testInfo.outputPath('userdata'));
  const src = testInfo.outputPath('src');
  try {
    await importPaths(s.page, [fakePdf(src, 'kept.pdf', 'kept')]);
    await expect(rowByTitle(s.page, 'kept')).toBeVisible();
    // A drop whose first file is held in main before its commit (the E2E pause): nothing in the window waits for it.
    await importPause(s.app, 'beforeCommit');
    await dropSource(s.page, [fakePdf(src, 'held.pdf', 'held')]);
    await drag(s.page, 'dragenter', 'source');
    await drag(s.page, 'drop', 'source', { repeat: false });
    await expect.poll(() => importWaiting(s.app)).toBe('beforeCommit');
    await expectDisabledReason(s.page.getByTestId('import-menu'), null);
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('search-field').locator('input')).not.toHaveAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
    await expect.poll(() => menuItemEnabled(s.app, 'file.importManaged')).toBe(true);
    // Past 1 s the progress toast; more files join the same run and its total grows in that same toast.
    const toast = s.page.getByTestId('import-progress');
    await expect(toast).toContainText('가져오는 중 · 0 / 1');
    const node = await toast.elementHandle();
    await dropSource(s.page, [fakePdf(src, 'more.pdf', 'more')]);
    await drag(s.page, 'dragenter', 'source');
    await drag(s.page, 'drop', 'source', { repeat: false });
    await expect(toast).toContainText('가져오는 중 · 0 / 2');
    expect(await node!.evaluate((e) => e.isConnected)).toBe(true);
    // The list opens an item meanwhile: the registry's item.open is not refused.
    await rowByTitle(s.page, 'kept').dblclick();
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('viewer-title')).toHaveText('kept');
    await s.page.getByTestId('viewer-back').click();
    await importResume(s.app);
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('import-done')).toHaveText('자료 2개를 가져왔습니다');
    expect(await node!.evaluate((e) => (e.isConnected ? e.getAttribute('data-testid') : null))).toBe('import-done'); // the same toast, now the result
    await waitImportIdle(s.page);
    await s.page.mouse.move(700, 880);

    // 파일 가져오기…'s open panel is a sheet on the window (follow-up D): that still holds it, with the reason, and no
    // tooltip shows on hover (the window is not key under the panel).
    const managed = s.page.getByTestId('import-menu');
    await holdOpenDialog(s.app, [fakePdf(src, 'picked.pdf', 'picked')]);
    await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'file.importManaged');
    await expectDisabledReason(managed, BUSY);
    await expect(s.page.locator('html')).toHaveAttribute('data-window-inactive', '');
    await managed.hover();
    await s.page.waitForTimeout(900); // past the 600 ms hover delay
    await expect(s.page.getByRole('tooltip')).toHaveCount(0);
    // The quick search is held like the other toolbar controls while the panel is up, and the list opens nothing.
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('search-field').locator('input')).toHaveAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
    const row = rowByTitle(s.page, 'held');
    const opensNothing = async (how: () => Promise<void>) => {
      await how();
      await frames(s);
      await expect(s.page.getByTestId('viewer-title')).toHaveCount(0);
      await expect(s.page.getByTestId('library-table')).toBeVisible();
    };
    await opensNothing(() => row.dblclick());
    await opensNothing(async () => {
      await row.click(); // selecting stays allowed; opening is the registry's item.open, refused while held
      await s.page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    });
    await releaseOpenDialog(s.app);
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('import-done').filter({ hasText: '자료 1개를 가져왔습니다' })).toHaveCount(1);
    await expectDisabledReason(managed, null);
    await waitImportIdle(s.page);
    await row.dblclick();
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('viewer-title')).toHaveText('held');
  } finally {
    await s.app.close();
  }
});
```

**(f)** 새 파일 `tests/e2e/import-queue.spec.ts`(Step 9에서 먼저 쓴 그 파일):
```ts
// The import queue through the window (spec 3, Task 4): the progress toast in place, files joining a run, 취소 from the toast
// and from the palette, one answer for the remaining duplicates, the palette held under the question (next-session M6), a
// drop of more than 500 files (P-2), waiting for the work before it, and the empty library's busy screen counting the queue.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import { expectNoSeriousA11y } from './a11y';
import {
  clickToCloseSheet, closeSheet, distinctPdfs, drag, dropSource, expectWindow, holdJob, importFiles, importPause, importPaths, importResume, importWaiting, launch,
  mainWindow, menuItemEnabled, releaseJob, rowByTitle, runMenuCommand, runPalette, waitImportIdle,
} from './helpers';

/** A file that imports as a PDF (sniffed by its header), `bytes` long, with content of its own. */
function fakePdf(dir: string, name: string, bytes = 0): string {
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  const file = path.join(dir, name);
  fs.writeFileSync(file, `%PDF-1.4\n% ${name}\n%%EOF\n`);
  if (bytes > 0) fs.truncateSync(file, bytes);
  return file;
}
const filesUnder = (dir: string): string[] => (fs.existsSync(dir) ? fs.readdirSync(dir, { recursive: true, withFileTypes: true }).filter((e) => e.isFile()).map((e) => e.name) : []);
const toast = (page: import('@playwright/test').Page) => page.getByTestId('import-progress');

test('the progress toast: none for a short run; past 1 s one toast, in place, its bar on the hashed bytes, that becomes the result (spec 3.3, P-3)', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const s = await launch(testInfo.outputPath('library'), testInfo.outputPath('userdata'));
  const src = testInfo.outputPath('src');
  try {
    await s.page.evaluate(() => {
      const w = window as unknown as { __progressSeen?: boolean; __toastNodes: number };
      w.__toastNodes = 0;
      new MutationObserver((records) => {
        if (document.querySelector('[data-testid="import-progress"]')) w.__progressSeen = true;
        for (const r of records) for (const n of r.addedNodes) if (n instanceof Element && n.matches('.toast')) w.__toastNodes++;
      }).observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true, attributes: true });
    });
    await importFiles(s, [fakePdf(src, 'quick.pdf')]);
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('import-done')).toHaveText('자료 1개를 가져왔습니다');
    await waitImportIdle(s.page);
    expect(await s.page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { __progressSeen?: boolean }).__progressSeen ?? false)).toBe(false);

    await s.page.evaluate(() => void ((window as unknown as { __toastNodes: number }).__toastNodes = 0));
    await importPause(s.app, 'beforeCommit');
    await importFiles(s, [fakePdf(src, 'big-1.pdf', 300_000), fakePdf(src, 'big-2.pdf', 100_000), fakePdf(src, 'big-3.pdf', 100_000)]);
    await expect.poll(() => importWaiting(s.app)).toBe('beforeCommit');
    await expect(toast(s.page)).toHaveAttribute('data-state', 'running');
    await expect(toast(s.page)).toContainText('가져오는 중 · 0 / 3');
    await expect(toast(s.page).locator('.t-file')).toHaveText('big-1.pdf');
    const bar = toast(s.page).getByRole('progressbar', { name: '가져오는 중' });
    await expect(bar).toHaveAttribute('aria-valuenow', '60'); // 300 KB of 500 KB hashed
    await expect(bar).toHaveAttribute('aria-valuetext', '파일 3개 중 0개, 60%');
    await expect(toast(s.page).locator('.pct')).toHaveText('60%');
    // Only the title is the announced part (RAC's role=alert): the count and the bar change ten times a second.
    await expect(toast(s.page).getByRole('alert')).toHaveText('가져오는 중');
    await importResume(s.app);
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('import-done')).toHaveText('자료 3개를 가져왔습니다');
    expect(await s.page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { __toastNodes: number }).__toastNodes)).toBe(1); // one toast, progress to result
    await waitImportIdle(s.page);
  } finally {
    await s.app.close();
  }
});

test('a drop of 600 files goes in 500 at a time: one run, one toast; main sends at most 10 progress notices a second (P-2, spec 3.3)', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  test.setTimeout(240_000);
  const s = await launch(testInfo.outputPath('library'), testInfo.outputPath('userdata'));
  try {
    const files = distinctPdfs(testInfo.outputPath('src'), 600);
    await (await mainWindow(s.app)).evaluate((w) => {
      const g = globalThis as { __sentProgress?: number[]; __importCalls?: number };
      g.__sentProgress = [];
      const send = w.webContents.send.bind(w.webContents);
      w.webContents.send = (channel: string, ...args: unknown[]) => {
        if (channel === 'evt:import-progress') g.__sentProgress!.push(performance.now());
        send(channel, ...args);
      };
    });
    const before = (await s.app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as { __learnIpcCalls?: Record<string, number> }).__learnIpcCalls?.['library:import'])) ?? 0;
    await dropSource(s.page, files);
    await drag(s.page, 'dragenter', 'source');
    await drag(s.page, 'drop', 'source', { repeat: false });
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('import-done')).toHaveText('자료 600개를 가져왔습니다', { timeout: 180_000 });
    await waitImportIdle(s.page);
    const calls = (await s.app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as { __learnIpcCalls?: Record<string, number> }).__learnIpcCalls?.['library:import'])) ?? 0;
    expect(calls - before).toBe(2);
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('import-done')).toHaveCount(1);
    const sent = await s.app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as { __sentProgress?: number[] }).__sentProgress ?? []);
    const busiest = Math.max(...sent.map((t) => sent.filter((x) => x >= t && x < t + 1000).length));
    expect(sent.length).toBeGreaterThan(10);
    expect(busiest).toBeLessThanOrEqual(10);
    await expect(rowByTitle(s.page, 'distinct-600')).toHaveCount(1);
  } finally {
    await s.app.close();
  }
});
```

`tests/e2e/visual/tour.spec.ts` 9–12행 import에 `holdJob, importPause, importResume, importWaiting, releaseJob, waitImportIdle`를 더한다. `const library = …`(37–42행) 다음에:
```ts
/** A file named `name` in `dir`: `src`'s bytes and a line of its own (new content every time), zero-extended to `bytes`. */
function sizedCopy(src: string, dir: string, name: string, bytes: number): string {
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  const out = path.join(dir, name);
  fs.writeFileSync(out, Buffer.concat([fs.readFileSync(src), Buffer.from(`\n% ${name}\n`)]));
  if (fs.statSync(out).size > bytes) throw new Error(`${name} outgrew its tour size (${bytes} B)`);
  fs.truncateSync(out, bytes);
  return out;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 15: Mac suite `p1` 골격(P-23)**

새 파일 `tests/evidence/p1.evidence.ts`:
```ts
// @p1 — M6 on macOS (the Mac suite `p1`; Linux runs the file too, the macOS-only captures recorded as skipped).
//
// One shared session in serial mode, as organize.evidence.ts: no check stops the run, each is recorded in m6-p1.json
// (`checks`) as it is measured, and the last test asserts them all with expect.soft. Task 4: the import queue's progress
// toast and the duplicate sheet's box. Tasks 6–10 add their tests above the verdict and their measurements to `results`.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { FIXTURES, expectWindow, holdJob, importFiles, importPause, importPaths, importResume, launch, mainWindow, releaseJob, tokenColor, waitImportIdle, closeSheet, type Session } from '../e2e/helpers';
import { IS_MAC, allShots, focusApp, fullScreenShot, writeJson } from './capture';

const TAG = { tag: '@p1' };
const PDF = path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf');
const KO_PDF = path.join(FIXTURES, '한글 경로 (테스트) #1.pdf');
const MP4 = path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample-h264-aac.mp4');
const results: Record<string, unknown> = {};
const shotFailures: Array<{ name: string; kind: string; description: string; error: string }> = [];
results['shotFailures'] = shotFailures;
/** Every check's verdict and the value it was judged on, in the order measured. `ok: null`: could not be read. */
const checks: Record<string, { ok: boolean | null; value: unknown }> = {};
const tally = () => {
  const oks = Object.values(checks).map((c) => c.ok);
  return { total: oks.length, ok: oks.filter((o) => o === true).length, unread: oks.filter((o) => o === null).length, failed: oks.filter((o) => o === false).length };
};
const save = () => writeJson('m6-p1.json', { ...results, checks, tally: tally(), platform: `${process.platform}-${process.arch}`, at: new Date().toISOString() }, 'M6 P1 measurements');
function check(name: string, ok: boolean | null, value: unknown): void {
  checks[name] = { ok, value };
}
const errorText = (e: unknown) => (e instanceof Error ? `${e.name}: ${e.message.split('\n')[0]}` : String(e));
async function guard(name: string, run: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await run();
  } catch (e) {
    check(name, false, { error: errorText(e) });
  }
}
let s: Session;
let tmp = '';
const shots = async (page: Page, name: string, description: string): Promise<void> => {
  for (const e of await allShots(s.app, page, name, description)) if (e.file === null && e.error) shotFailures.push({ name, kind: e.kind, description: e.description, error: e.error });
};
const setTheme = async (theme: 'light' | 'dark') => {
  await s.page.evaluate((t) => window.learn.prefs.set({ theme: t }), theme);
  await expect(s.page.locator('html')).toHaveAttribute('data-theme', theme);
};
/** A file named `name`: `src`'s bytes and a line of its own, zero-extended to `bytes`. */
function sized(src: string, name: string, bytes: number): string {
  const dir = path.join(tmp, 'incoming');
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  const out = path.join(dir, name);
  fs.writeFileSync(out, Buffer.concat([fs.readFileSync(src), Buffer.from(`\n% ${name}\n`)]));
  fs.truncateSync(out, bytes);
  return out;
}

test.describe.configure({ mode: 'serial' });

test.beforeAll(async () => {
  tmp = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'learn-m6-p1-'));
  s = await launch(path.join(tmp, 'library'), path.join(tmp, 'userdata'), { colorScheme: null });
  await importPaths(s.page, [PDF, KO_PDF]);
});

test.afterAll(async () => {
  save();
  await s?.app.close().catch(() => {});
  if (tmp) fs.rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true });
});

test('M6 import: the progress toast runs in place — one toast, a 4 px bar on --meter, at most 10 notices a second (light and dark)', TAG, async () => {
  await (await mainWindow(s.app)).evaluate((w) => {
    const g = globalThis as { __sentProgress?: number[] };
    g.__sentProgress = [];
    const send = w.webContents.send.bind(w.webContents);
    w.webContents.send = (channel: string, ...args: unknown[]) => {
      if (channel === 'evt:import-progress') g.__sentProgress!.push(performance.now());
      send(channel, ...args);
    };
  });
  await s.page.evaluate(() => {
    const w = window as unknown as { __toastNodes: number };
    w.__toastNodes = 0;
    new MutationObserver((records) => {
      for (const r of records) for (const n of r.addedNodes) if (n instanceof Element && n.matches('.toast')) w.__toastNodes++;
    }).observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  });
  await importPause(s.app, 'beforeCommit');
  await importFiles(s, [sized(MP4, '강의 08 · 효소 조절.mp4', 4_200_000), sized(PDF, '세포생물학 3장.pdf', 1_500_000), sized(PDF, '세포생물학 4장.pdf', 1_500_000)]);
  const toast = s.page.getByTestId('import-progress');
  await expect(toast.locator('.pct')).toHaveText('58%');
  await guard('progress toast: 360 wide, a 4 px bar with the --meter fill over --bg-track, the count in tabular figures', async () => {
    const v = await toast.evaluate((t) => {
      const bar = t.querySelector('.progress')!;
      return {
        width: Math.round(t.getBoundingClientRect().width),
        barHeight: bar.getBoundingClientRect().height,
        fill: getComputedStyle(bar.querySelector('i')!).backgroundColor,
        track: getComputedStyle(bar).backgroundColor,
        numeric: getComputedStyle(t.querySelector('.t-count')!).fontVariantNumeric,
        file: t.querySelector('.t-file')?.textContent ?? null,
      };
    });
    const meter = await tokenColor(s.page, '--meter');
    const track = await tokenColor(s.page, '--bg-track');
    results['progressToast'] = { ...v, meter, track };
    check('progress toast: 360 wide, a 4 px bar with the --meter fill over --bg-track, the count in tabular figures', v.width === 360 && v.barHeight === 4 && v.fill === meter && v.track === track && v.numeric.includes('tabular-nums') && v.file === '강의 08 · 효소 조절.mp4', results['progressToast']);
  });
  for (const theme of ['light', 'dark'] as const) {
    await setTheme(theme);
    if (IS_MAC) await focusApp(s.app);
    await shots(s.page, `m6-01-import-running-${theme}`, `the progress toast at 58%: 가져오는 중 · 0 / 3 (${theme})`);
  }
  await setTheme('light');
  await importResume(s.app);
  await expect(s.page.getByTestId('import-done')).toHaveText('자료 3개를 가져왔습니다');
  await guard('one toast from the first progress to the result (P-3: never closed and shown again)', async () => {
    const nodes = await s.page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { __toastNodes: number }).__toastNodes);
    check('one toast from the first progress to the result (P-3: never closed and shown again)', nodes === 1, { nodes });
  });
  await guard('progress notices: at most 10 in any second, as main sends them (spec 3.3, 14)', async () => {
    const sent = await s.app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as { __sentProgress?: number[] }).__sentProgress ?? []);
    const busiest = sent.length === 0 ? 0 : Math.max(...sent.map((t) => sent.filter((x) => x >= t && x < t + 1000).length));
    results['progressNotices'] = { sent: sent.length, busiest };
    check('progress notices: at most 10 in any second, as main sends them (spec 3.3, 14)', sent.length > 0 && busiest <= 10, results['progressNotices']);
  });
  await waitImportIdle(s.page);
  save();
});

test('M6 import: duplicates asked at the end — the sheet\'s box for the rest, the toast waiting under it (macOS: the real sheet)', TAG, async () => {
  const twice = ['molbio_ch06_signaling.pdf', 'molbio_ch07_receptors.pdf', 'molbio_ch08_kinases.pdf'].map((n) => sized(PDF, n, 1_000_000));
  await importPaths(s.page, twice);
  const sheet = await expectWindow(s.app, 'sheet', () => importFiles(s, twice));
  await guard('duplicate sheet: the box "남은 중복 파일 2개에도 같은 선택 적용" opens ticked; ↩ stays on 건너뛰기', async () => {
    const box = sheet.getByRole('checkbox');
    // RAC's Checkbox is a <label class="checkbox"> around a visually hidden input: the label's text is the name.
    const v = { label: (await sheet.locator('label.checkbox').textContent())?.trim() ?? null, checked: await box.isChecked(), focused: await sheet.getByTestId('dup-skip').evaluate((e) => e === document.activeElement) };
    results['duplicateBox'] = v;
    check('duplicate sheet: the box "남은 중복 파일 2개에도 같은 선택 적용" opens ticked; ↩ stays on 건너뛰기', v.label === '남은 중복 파일 2개에도 같은 선택 적용' && v.checked && v.focused, v);
  });
  await expect(s.page.getByTestId('import-progress')).toHaveAttribute('data-state', 'waiting-choice');
  await s.page.waitForTimeout(600);
  await fullScreenShot('m6-02-duplicate-rest', 'the duplicate sheet with its box, the toast 확인을 기다리는 중 under it');
  await shots(s.page, 'm6-02-import-waiting-choice', 'the toast under the duplicate question: 확인을 기다리는 중 · 0 / 3');
  await closeSheet(sheet, 'Escape');
  await waitImportIdle(s.page);
  save();
});

test('M6 import: waiting behind the work before it, then 취소 — the result in its place', TAG, async () => {
  await holdJob(s.app, 'backup');
  await importFiles(s, [sized(PDF, 'molbio_ch10_mitosis.pdf', 1_000_000), sized(PDF, 'molbio_ch11_meiosis.pdf', 1_000_000)]);
  const toast = s.page.getByTestId('import-progress');
  await expect(toast).toHaveAttribute('data-state', 'waiting-job');
  await shots(s.page, 'm6-03-import-waiting-job', 'the toast behind another job: 앞의 작업을 기다리는 중 · 0 / 2');
  await toast.getByTestId('import-cancel').click();
  await expect(s.page.getByTestId('import-done')).toHaveText('2개 중 0개를 가져왔습니다');
  await guard('취소 while waiting: "2개 중 0개를 가져왔습니다", an info toast in the progress toast\'s place', async () => {
    const kind = await s.page.getByTestId('import-done').getAttribute('data-kind');
    check('취소 while waiting: "2개 중 0개를 가져왔습니다", an info toast in the progress toast\'s place', kind === 'info', { kind });
  });
  await shots(s.page, 'm6-04-import-cancelled', 'the result after 취소: 2개 중 0개를 가져왔습니다');
  await releaseJob(s.app);
  await waitImportIdle(s.page);
  save();
});

test('M6 P1: verdict of every check above (m6-p1.json checks)', TAG, async () => {
  save();
  for (const [name, c] of Object.entries(checks)) expect.soft(c.ok, `${name}: ${JSON.stringify(c.value)}`).not.toBe(false);
});
```

## 작성자 제안 (Q-4x)

- **Q-4a `ImportBatch.allowDuplicate?: boolean`.** 계약의 `ImportBatch`에 없다. 채널 입력은 `allowDuplicate`를 이미 받지만(기본 false) 큐가 몰라 버려진다. 렌더러 코드는 이제 쓰지 않고(`settleImport`의 `importAgain`이 유일했다), E2E 열세 곳(투어 넷 포함)이 "같은 내용을 새 자료로" 준비에 쓴다(중복 묶음·외부 연결 사본). 받지 않으면: 열세 곳이 중복 시트를 띄워 "새 자료로 추가"를 누르게 바꿔야 하고(창 하나씩 더, 투어 정거장에 시트 창이 끼어든다), 채널의 `allowDuplicate`는 지운다(죽은 입력). 비용은 필드 하나와 `importOnce`의 한 조건.
- **Q-4b E2E만의 조용한 실행 `window.__learnQuietImports`.** 큐 전에는 `importPaths`(페이지가 채널을 직접 부름)가 토스트를 띄우지 않았다 — 결과는 `useImport`만 만들었다. 이제 렌더러는 모든 실행의 `import:finished`를 듣고 토스트를 띄우므로, 그대로면 `importPaths` 뒤의 모든 투어 기준 PNG(수십 장)에 "자료 N개를 가져왔습니다"가 찍히고 `library.spec`의 토스트 세기 시험이 깨진다. 렌더러의 기존 E2E 전역(`__learnRenders`, `__learnProbes`)과 같은 방식으로, 도우미가 센 실행 하나는 바쁨 화면·진행·결과·실패 토스트를 띄우지 않는다(목록은 다시 읽는다). 보통 실행에서는 그 값이 없다(속성 읽기 한 번). 받지 않으면: 투어 기준 PNG 전부를 다시 만들고(토스트가 5초 동안 움직여 결정적이지 않다 — 정거장마다 토스트가 닫히길 기다리는 5초가 더 든다) 토스트 세기 시험들을 고친다.
- **Q-4c `CommandContextState.importRunning?: boolean`(선택 필드).** `file.cancelImport`의 가용성은 "큐가 돌 때"(명세 11.1)인데 지금 맥락에 그 사실이 없다. 레지스트리 규칙은 맥락 위의 순수 함수라 렌더러가 보고해야 한다. 선택 필드(`sidebar`·`inspector`처럼, 참일 때만 보고)로 두어 기존 맥락 리터럴(테스트 수십 곳, `NO_LIBRARY_VIEW`, main의 `BEFORE_FIRST_REPORT`)이 그대로 맞는다. main은 메뉴 줄이 없어 쓰지 않는다. 받지 않으면: 필수 필드로 두고 그 리터럴들을 모두 고친다(또는 `NO_LIBRARY_VIEW`에 넣는다 — 보기 필드가 아니라 어색하다).
- **Q-4d P-3의 구현 기록: 작업마다 토스트 하나.** 계약은 "가져오기·백업·복원이 같은 자리를 쓰는 제자리 갱신 토스트 하나"인데, Task 1의 목업 `dialogs.html?scene=jobs`는 백업 진행 토스트와 그 뒤에서 기다리는 가져오기 토스트를 함께 그린다(작업 줄은 하나씩 돌지만 기다리는 쪽도 보여야 한다 — 명세 3.1 "기다리는 쪽 토스트는 '앞의 작업을 기다리는 중'"). 그래서 "같은 기계(큐 안 항목 + 저장소 + 보기), 작업마다 항목 하나"로 정했다. 받지 않으면(정말 하나만): 백업이 도는 동안 기다리는 가져오기를 토스트에 보일 자리가 없어 명세 3.1의 문장이 사라진다 — Task 9가 한 토스트에 두 작업을 섞어 그려야 한다.
- **Q-4e "앞의 작업을 기다리는 중" 아래 줄은 지금 일반 문장.** 목업은 "백업이 끝나면 가져오기를 시작합니다."라고 앞의 작업을 이름으로 부르지만, Task 4에는 백업·복원이 없고 `ImportQueueState`는 기다리는 대상을 싣지 않는다. 이 작업은 "앞의 작업이 끝나면 가져오기를 시작합니다."를 쓰고, Task 9가 `job:progress`(P-20, `kind`)로 "백업이 끝나면…"/"복원이 끝나면…"을 고른다(`describeJob`의 가지 하나, 문구 둘). 받지 않으면: `ImportQueueState`에 `waitingFor: JobKind | null`을 더하도록 Task 3의 계약을 바꾼다.
- **Q-4f 취소 결과의 둘째 줄("취소해서 남은 5개는 가져오지 않았습니다.")은 넣지 않는다.** 명세 3.3은 제목 "12개 중 7개를 가져왔습니다"만 정했고, 둘째 줄은 Task 1의 목업(승인 대기)에만 있다. 그 수를 정직하게 셀 수 없다: 보고서는 실패 수는 있지만 끝에 묻다가 건너뛴 중복 수, 시작하지 않아 버린 수를 싣지 않는다(12 − 7 = 5는 실패·건너뛰기가 없을 때만 맞다). 소유자가 그 줄을 승인하면 Task 3의 `ImportReport`에 `dropped: number`(시작하지 않은 파일 + 묻지 않은 중복 + 멈춘 파일)를 더하고 `importToast`가 `lines`로 붙인다(문구 하나, 시험 둘). 받지 않으면(줄을 넣으라면 수 없이): "취소해서 나머지는 가져오지 않았습니다." — 수 없는 문장.
- **Q-4g 빈 라이브러리의 바쁨 화면은 열기 패널로 가져올 때도 뜬다.** 지금은 드롭에만 떴다(패널 가져오기는 수를 몰랐다). 명세 3.2 "N은 큐 전체 수"와, 가져오기가 창을 막지 않게 된 지금 패널 가져오기 동안 빈 라이브러리의 "아직 자료가 없습니다"와 켜진 가져오기 단추가 보이는 문제(T13R2-m1과 같은 결함) 때문에 큐가 돌면 언제나 띄운다. 받지 않으면: 바쁨 화면 조건에 "드롭으로 시작한 실행"을 더해(`sending`이 있었는지 기억) 패널 가져오기 동안은 빈 화면을 둔다.
- **Q-4h 숨은 DOM 표식 `data-testid="import-queue"`(`data-state`·`data-sending`·`data-settling`).** P-22의 `waitImportIdle(page)`는 페이지만 받는데 페이지에는 큐 상태를 묻는 채널이 없다(새 채널은 계약 밖). `app-ready`와 같은 숨은 표식으로, 렌더러가 끝을 다 보인 뒤(토스트까지)를 기다린다. 받지 않으면: `waitImportIdle(app)`로 서명을 바꿔 main의 `importQueueState()` 훅을 묻고(렌더러의 정착은 못 본다 — 토스트 단언이 경쟁한다).
- **Q-4i E2E 훅 `__learnTest.holdJob/releaseJob`.** "앞의 작업을 기다리는 중"(진행 토스트 셋째 상태, 명세 15 투어 "세 상태")은 백업·복원이 있어야 생기는데 그것은 Task 9·10이다. 줄에 다른 종류의 작업을 올려 두는 시험 훅으로 지금 그 상태를 그리고 시험한다(종료 확인도 그 작업을 백업처럼 묻는다). 받지 않으면: 셋째 상태의 투어 정거장·E2E를 Task 9로 미루고, 이 작업의 비평은 두 상태만 본다.
- **Q-4j 아무것도 들어오지 않은 취소 결과는 정보 토스트.** "2개 중 0개를 가져왔습니다"에 성공 아이콘(초록 체크)은 맞지 않는다. 같은 문장, `kind: 'info'`(정보 아이콘, 5초 뒤 닫힘). 받지 않으면: 한 줄을 지워 늘 성공.

### Task 5: 휴지통 데이터 — `library:trashView`, `library:purge`, `library:emptyTrash`(참조 계산·DB 먼저·파일 나중), 중복 정리 `library:keepOneOfDuplicates`·`keepOneOfAllDuplicates`·`undoKeepOne`, 알림 이유 `purge`, ADR-0006 (화면 없음)

#### 이 작업이 하는 일

명세 4.3–4.5·4.7·4.8·5·12의 데이터와 IPC만 만든다. 화면·명령·메뉴는 바뀌지 않는다(Task 6이 휴지통 보기와 명령을, Task 7이 중복 정리 화면을 그린다). 투어 기준 PNG도 그대로다.

- **휴지통 보기 데이터(P-8)**: `LibraryRepository.trashView(): TrashView` — 지운 자료(`TrashedItem` = `LibraryItem` + `deletedAt`)와 컬렉션 행(`TrashedCollection`), 둘 다 최근에 지운 순. 컬렉션 행 규칙(명세 4.3): 휴지통의 컬렉션 가운데 부모가 없거나 살아 있거나 부모와 `deleted_at`이 다른 것. 같이 지운 하위는 그 행에 든다(`childCount`). `library:listTrash`(부르는 곳 없음)는 `library:trashView`로 바뀌고 `listTrash()`도 없앤다.
- **사이드바 개수(P-7)**: `OrganizeSnapshot.trashCount` = 휴지통 자료 + 컬렉션 행. `readOrganizeSnapshot`이 같은 트랜잭션에서 센다. 이 필드 때문에 테스트 고정값 31곳에 `trashCount: 0`이 붙는다(Step 4의 스크립트 — 손으로 고치지 않는다).
- **영구 삭제(P-12)**: `LibraryRepository.purge({ itemIds, collectionIds })`·`emptyTrash()` → `PurgeResult`. 한 트랜잭션: 컬렉션 행(행에 든 하위와 함께, 따로 지운 하위는 맨 위로 옮겨 남김) → 자료(소속·태그·위치 cascade) → **남은 어떤 자료도(휴지통 포함) 쓰지 않는** 자산의 필기·앵커(리비전을 거쳐) → 리비전 → 자산 행 → 그 sha의 자산이 하나도 남지 않으면 그 sha의 작업 행. 살아 있는 id·모르는 id는 조용히 뺀다. 같은 상대 경로를 다른 행이 쥐고 있으면 그 사본은 남긴다(`relativePath: null`).
- **커밋 뒤 파일**: `L/purge.ts` `removePurgedFiles(layout, assets, opts?)` — 관리 사본(`assets/` 안의 것만), `derived/<assetId>/` 캐시, `derived/open/<assetId>/`의 이름 붙은 읽기 전용 복사본(`L/openable.ts` `clearNamedCopies`). 외부 연결 원본은 어떤 경우에도 건드리지 않고, 수정본(`isAside`)과 수정을 담았을 수 있는 복사본(`mayHoldEdits` — 지금 수정본 이름으로 비켜 둔다)과 그것을 담은 폴더는 남긴다. 파일을 지우기 바로 전에 그 경로를 쥔 행이 생겼는지 다시 묻는다(`LibraryRepository.managedPathInUse`, 명세 18 "지우기 전에 같은 경로를 쓰는 행 재확인").
- **가져오기와 겹칠 때(Q-5b)**: `L/asset-lock.ts` `withManagedPath(rel, work)` — 관리 경로 하나에는 한 번에 하나. 가져오기는 그 파일의 자산을 찾는 순간부터 커밋까지(`Importer.run()`을 `settle()`로 나눈다), 영구 삭제는 그 사본을 지우는 동안 쥔다. 영구 삭제가 커밋된 뒤 큐가 같은 파일을 가져오면서 남은 사본을 다시 쓰기로 했다면, 파일 단계는 그 커밋을 기다렸다가 다시 묻고 사본을 남긴다.
- **중복 정리(P-14)**: `keepOneOfDuplicates(itemIds)`·`keepOneOfAllDuplicates()`·`undoKeepOne(undo)`. 남는 자료 = 묶음에서 `created_at`이 가장 이른 것(같으면 id). 나머지의 소속·태그를 남는 자료에 더하고(이미 있으면 그대로) 나머지를 `nextDeletionStamp`(Task 2) 한 표시로 휴지통에. 실행 취소는 그 표시로 아직 휴지통에 있는 자료만 되살리고 이번에 더한 소속·태그만 뺀다. 되살아난 것이 없으면 아무것도 바꾸지 않는다(Q-5c).
- **IPC(명세 12)**: 새 모듈 `M/ipc/trash.ts` — `library:trashView`, `library:purge`, `library:emptyTrash`, `library:keepOneOfDuplicates`, `library:keepOneOfAllDuplicates`, `library:undoKeepOne`(모두 MAIN). 알림: 영구 삭제 `libraryChanged{reason:'purge', itemIds}`(컬렉션만이면 ids 없이), 중복 정리 `trash`(옮긴 자료 + 남는 자료), 실행 취소 `restore`. 파일 단계는 답을 기다리게 하지 않고 뒤에서 차례로 돈다. 로그에는 남긴 파일 수만.
- **렌더러 데이터**: `LibraryChangeReason` += `'purge'`(이미 "목록 전체"로 떨어진다 — 시험으로 고정), 쿼리 키 `keys.trash = ['library','trash']`와 `useTrashView(enabled)`, `collections` 알림이 휴지통 보기도 무효화(Q-5f: 컬렉션을 휴지통으로 옮기거나 되살리면 보기의 행이 바뀌지만 그 알림은 지금 스냅샷만 다시 읽는다).
- **E2E**: `tests/e2e/trash-data.spec.ts`(실제 앱에서 보기·개수·영구 삭제 뒤 관리 사본이 사라지고 외부 연결 원본은 같은 바이트, 휴지통 비우기, 중복 정리와 실행 취소), 도우미 `trashItems(page, ids)`, `specialRow`의 `'trash'`(P-22).
- **ADR-0006**: `docs/decisions/0006-trash.md`(명세 4.8의 목록 + 이 작업이 정한 순서·잠금·실행 취소 규칙).

이 작업이 바꾸지 않는 것: `library:trash`·`library:restore`(이미 있다 — Task 6의 렌더러가 처음 부른다), `LibraryScope`의 `trash`·명령 맥락(Task 6, P-7·P-10), 수정본 목록·가져오기(Task 7, P-15), 점검의 참조 없는 사본·주인 없는 수정본(Task 8 — 이 작업의 `withManagedPath`와 `managedPathInUse`를 "정리…"가 그대로 쓴다), 백업 manifest의 휴지통 포함/제외 개수(Task 9), ADR-0003의 `derived/open/` 문단(Task 12가 ADR-0006을 가리키는 한 줄을 더한다).

  ```ts
  export type TrashedItem = LibraryItem & { deletedAt: string };

  export interface TrashView { collections: TrashedCollection[]; items: TrashedItem[] }        // 둘 다 최근에 지운 순

  export interface KeepOneResult { kept: string[]; trashed: string[]; undo: KeepOneUndo }
  ```
  `TrashedCollection.childCount` = 그 행에 든 하위 컬렉션 수(같이 지운 것, 깊이 상관없이), `itemCount` = 그 행의 컬렉션들에 직접 든 휴지통 밖 자료 수(중복 없이).

Task 7 — `library.keepOneOfDuplicates`·`keepOneOfAllDuplicates`·`undoKeepOne`(실행 취소 토스트는 `KeepOneResult.undo`를 그대로 돌려준다), 영구 삭제가 수정본을 지우지 않는다는 것(ADR-0006 6절). Task 8 — 참조 없는 사본 "정리…"는 `withManagedPath` + `managedPathInUse`로 같은 재확인을 하고, `clearNamedCopies`가 남긴 수정본은 "주인 없는 수정본"으로 보인다. Task 9 — 휴지통의 자료·컬렉션·사본이 백업에 든다(ADR-0006 8절). Task 11 — 영구 삭제 1,000개 트랜잭션 측정은 `LibraryRepository.purge`(이 작업의 원형에서 1만 항목 라이브러리 69 ms, `trashView` 19 ms).

테스트 명령은 저장소 루트(`/home/baejs/projects/tutor/.worktrees/m6`)에서 `pnpm exec vitest run <경로…>`, 형 검사는 `pnpm typecheck`(전체) 또는 `pnpm --filter @learn/<패키지> typecheck`다. 이 작업의 커밋은 언제나 파일을 하나씩 `git add`한다(`git add -A` 금지 — Task 1의 목업 작업 파일과 `.superpowers/`가 섞인다).
