- [ ] **Step 1: domain — 실패하는 테스트**

새 파일 `packages/domain/test/trash-commands.test.ts`:
```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import {
  CONTEXT_MENU_KINDS, LIBRARY_COLUMNS, LIBRARY_COLUMN_IDS, NO_LIBRARY_VIEW, SETTINGS, TRASH_COLUMNS, TRASH_TARGET,
  availableMenuCommands, commandById, commandContextInput, commandLabel, confirmPurgeInput, isCommandAvailable, libraryScopeSchema,
  paletteLabel, parseSetting, selectionTargets, sheetResultInput, showContextMenuInput,
  type CommandContextState, type CommandTargetInfo,
} from '../src/index';

const ID = '7d3f3c3e-8a51-4f7e-9d7c-2b1f0f6f8f10';
const COL = '0f1e2d3c-4b5a-4968-8776-a5b4c3d2e1f0';
const base: CommandContextState = { view: 'library', blocked: false, textSize: 13, libraryCount: 9, selectionCount: 0, selectionAvailable: 0, selectionRelinkable: 0, ...NO_LIBRARY_VIEW };
const LIVE: CommandTargetInfo = { kind: 'item', storageMode: 'managed', availability: 'available' };
const inTrash = (over: Partial<CommandContextState> = {}): CommandContextState => ({ ...base, scope: 'trash', trashCount: 3, ...over });

describe('the trash commands (spec 11.1, P-10, P-11)', () => {
  it('item.trash: ⌘⌫, 파일\'s last group after 휴지통 비우기…, last in the item and trash menus, in the palette', () => {
    expect(commandById('item.trash')).toMatchObject({
      label: '휴지통으로 이동', accelerator: 'CmdOrCtrl+Backspace', contexts: ['item', 'trash'], palette: true,
      menu: { menu: 'file', group: 4, order: 2 }, contextMenu: { kinds: ['item', 'trash'], group: 4, order: 1 },
      stateLabels: { scope: { trash: '영구 삭제…' } },
    });
    expect(commandById('trash.empty')).toMatchObject({ label: '휴지통 비우기…', accelerator: 'Shift+CmdOrCtrl+Backspace', contexts: ['library'], menu: { menu: 'file', group: 4, order: 1 } });
    expect(commandById('item.restore')).toMatchObject({ label: '복원', contexts: ['trash'], palette: true, contextMenu: { kinds: ['trash'], group: 1, order: 1 } });
    expect(commandById('item.restore').accelerator).toBeUndefined();
    expect(commandById('item.restore').menu).toBeUndefined();
    expect(CONTEXT_MENU_KINDS).toContain('trash');
  });

  it('collection.delete is 휴지통으로 이동 now (spec 4.2), told apart from the items\' in the palette', () => {
    const c = commandById('collection.delete');
    expect(c.label).toBe('휴지통으로 이동');
    expect(paletteLabel(c, 'darwin')).toBe('컬렉션을 휴지통으로 이동');
  });

  it('⌘⌫ is one line named by the view: 영구 삭제… in the trash, 휴지통으로 이동 elsewhere and where no view is known (P-11)', () => {
    const c = commandById('item.trash');
    for (const platform of ['darwin', 'linux']) {
      expect(commandLabel(c, platform, { scope: 'trash' })).toBe('영구 삭제…');
      for (const scope of ['all', 'recent', 'unfiled', 'duplicates', 'collection'] as const) expect(commandLabel(c, platform, { scope })).toBe('휴지통으로 이동');
      expect(commandLabel(c, platform)).toBe('휴지통으로 이동');
    }
    // No other command's name follows the view.
    expect(commandLabel(commandById('item.open'), 'darwin', { scope: 'trash' })).toBe('열기');
    expect(commandLabel(commandById('view.toggleSidebar'), 'darwin', { scope: 'trash', sidebar: 'shown' })).toBe('사이드바 가리기');
  });

  it('outside the trash ⌘⌫ needs live items in the library view; in the trash it takes trash rows and nothing else', () => {
    expect(isCommandAvailable('item.trash', base, [LIVE])).toBe(true);
    expect(isCommandAvailable('item.trash', base, [])).toBe(false);
    expect(isCommandAvailable('item.trash', { ...base, view: 'viewer' }, [LIVE])).toBe(false);
    expect(isCommandAvailable('item.trash', base, [TRASH_TARGET])).toBe(false);
    expect(isCommandAvailable('item.trash', inTrash(), [TRASH_TARGET])).toBe(true);
    expect(isCommandAvailable('item.trash', inTrash(), [LIVE])).toBe(false);
    expect(isCommandAvailable('item.trash', inTrash({ blocked: true }), [TRASH_TARGET])).toBe(false);
  });

  it('복원 needs trash rows in the trash view; the item commands get no target there (opening is off, spec 4.3)', () => {
    expect(isCommandAvailable('item.restore', inTrash(), [TRASH_TARGET, TRASH_TARGET])).toBe(true);
    expect(isCommandAvailable('item.restore', inTrash(), [])).toBe(false);
    expect(isCommandAvailable('item.restore', base, [TRASH_TARGET])).toBe(false);
    for (const id of ['item.open', 'item.showInFolder', 'item.exportCopy', 'item.editInfo', 'collection.addItems', 'tag.color1'] as const) {
      expect(isCommandAvailable(id, inTrash(), [TRASH_TARGET]), id).toBe(false);
    }
    // The sidebar's collection commands still work while the trash view shows.
    expect(isCommandAvailable('collection.rename', inTrash(), [{ kind: 'collection', id: COL }])).toBe(true);
  });

  it('휴지통 비우기… while the trash has something, in the library view (trashCount, P-10)', () => {
    expect(isCommandAvailable('trash.empty', { ...base, trashCount: 1 })).toBe(true);
    expect(isCommandAvailable('trash.empty', { ...base, trashCount: 0 })).toBe(false);
    expect(isCommandAvailable('trash.empty', { ...base, trashCount: 4, view: 'viewer' })).toBe(false);
    expect(NO_LIBRARY_VIEW.trashCount).toBe(0);
  });

  it('the menu bar judges the reported selection in the trash as trash rows (selectionTargets)', () => {
    const ctx = inTrash({ selectionCount: 2 });
    expect(selectionTargets(ctx)).toEqual([TRASH_TARGET, TRASH_TARGET]);
    const menu = availableMenuCommands(ctx);
    expect(menu).toContain('item.trash');
    expect(menu).toContain('trash.empty');
    expect(menu).not.toContain('item.showInFolder');
    expect(availableMenuCommands(inTrash({ selectionCount: 0 }))).not.toContain('item.trash');
    expect(availableMenuCommands({ ...base, selectionCount: 1, selectionAvailable: 1 })).toContain('item.trash');
  });
});

describe('the trash view in the domain (P-7, spec 4.3)', () => {
  it('a stored view may be the trash', () => {
    expect(libraryScopeSchema.parse({ kind: 'trash' })).toEqual({ kind: 'trash' });
    expect(libraryScopeSchema.safeParse({ kind: 'trash', id: ID }).success).toBe(false);
  });
  it('삭제한 날짜: the last catalogue column, sortable, drawn only by the trash view, with a sort of its own', () => {
    expect(LIBRARY_COLUMN_IDS.at(-1)).toBe('deletedAt');
    expect(LIBRARY_COLUMNS.find((c) => c.id === 'deletedAt')).toEqual({ id: 'deletedAt', label: '삭제한 날짜', defaultVisible: false, defaultWidth: 132, minWidth: 112, align: 'start', trashOnly: true });
    expect(LIBRARY_COLUMNS.filter((c) => c.trashOnly).map((c) => c.id)).toEqual(['deletedAt']);
    expect(TRASH_COLUMNS).toEqual(['deletedAt']);
    expect(Object.hasOwn(SETTINGS, 'library.sort.trash')).toBe(true);
    expect(parseSetting('library.sort.trash', { column: 'deletedAt', direction: 'desc' })).toEqual({ column: 'deletedAt', direction: 'desc' });
  });
});

describe('the trash over IPC (P-10, P-25)', () => {
  it('the reported context takes the trash scope and its count; the count is required', () => {
    const ctx = inTrash({ selectionCount: 1 });
    expect(commandContextInput.parse(ctx)).toEqual(ctx);
    for (const bad of [-1, 1.5, '3']) expect(commandContextInput.safeParse({ ...ctx, trashCount: bad }).success, String(bad)).toBe(false);
    const { trashCount: _dropped, ...without } = ctx;
    expect(commandContextInput.safeParse(without).success).toBe(false);
  });
  it('the trash rows\' menu: items and collections, either list may be empty', () => {
    expect(showContextMenuInput.parse({ kind: 'trash', itemIds: [ID], collectionIds: [], x: 1, y: 2 })).toEqual({ kind: 'trash', itemIds: [ID], collectionIds: [], x: 1, y: 2 });
    expect(showContextMenuInput.safeParse({ kind: 'trash', itemIds: [], collectionIds: [COL], x: 1, y: 2 }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(showContextMenuInput.safeParse({ kind: 'trash', itemIds: ['x'], collectionIds: [], x: 1, y: 2 }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(showContextMenuInput.safeParse({ kind: 'trash', itemIds: [ID], x: 1, y: 2 }).success).toBe(false);
  });
  it('the purge sheet\'s question and its answer (P-25)', () => {
    expect(confirmPurgeInput.parse({ variant: 'mixed', items: 3, collections: 1 })).toEqual({ variant: 'mixed', items: 3, collections: 1 });
    for (const bad of [{ variant: 'all', items: 1, collections: 0 }, { variant: 'items', items: -1, collections: 0 }, { variant: 'items', items: 1, collections: 0, extra: true }, { variant: 'items', items: 1 }]) {
      expect(confirmPurgeInput.safeParse(bad).success, JSON.stringify(bad)).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(sheetResultInput.parse({ kind: 'purge', confirmed: true })).toEqual({ kind: 'purge', confirmed: true });
    expect(sheetResultInput.safeParse({ kind: 'purge' }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

**(a)** `packages/domain/src/organize.ts` — `LibraryScope`와 스키마:
```ts
export type LibraryScope =
  | { kind: 'all' }
  | { kind: 'recent' }
  | { kind: 'unfiled' }
  | { kind: 'duplicates' }
  /** 휴지통 (M6 spec 4.3): the trashed collection rows and items; shown only while the trash has something. */
  | { kind: 'trash' }
  | { kind: 'collection'; id: string };

/** library.view as stored. Strict: a value with keys this build does not know reads as unusable and the view opens at `all`. */
export const libraryScopeSchema: z.ZodType<LibraryScope> = z.discriminatedUnion('kind', [
  z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal('all') }),
  z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal('recent') }),
  z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal('unfiled') }),
  z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal('duplicates') }),
  z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal('trash') }),
  z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal('collection'), id: z.uuid() }),
]);
```

**(e)** `packages/domain/src/sheets.ts` 전체:
```ts
import type { ItemType, StorageMode } from './library';

/** Modal sheet windows (design-spec 6 시트). Types only (no zod): the preload never needs the schemas. */
export type DuplicateChoice = 'open' | 'add' | 'skip';

export interface DuplicateCard {
  title: string;
  type: ItemType;
  size: number;
  createdAt: string;
  storageMode: StorageMode;
}

/** What 영구 삭제… or 휴지통 비우기… asks about (P-25): its title and text follow. */
export type PurgeVariant = 'items' | 'collections' | 'mixed' | 'empty';

export type SheetPayload =
  | { kind: 'duplicate'; fileName: string; existing: DuplicateCard; remaining: number }
  | { kind: 'shortcuts' }
  | { kind: 'purge'; variant: PurgeVariant; items: number; collections: number };
export type SheetResult =
  | { kind: 'duplicate'; choice: DuplicateChoice; applyToRest: boolean }
  | { kind: 'shortcuts' }
  | { kind: 'purge'; confirmed: boolean };
```
(duplicate의 `remaining`·`applyToRest`는 Task 3이 넣은 그대로다 — 파일을 열어 그 두 줄이 위와 같은지 확인하고, 다르면 Task 3의 모양을 따른다.)

**(i)** `packages/domain/src/commands.ts`:

`CommandId` 합집합의 `| 'item.exportCopy'` 다음에 `| 'item.trash' | 'item.restore'`, `| 'view.textReset'` 다음에 `| 'trash.empty'`.

`CommandContext`와 그 주석:
```ts
/**
 * `app`: anywhere in the main window; `library` / `viewer`: the current view; `item` / `collection` / `tag` / `trash`: needs a
 * target of that kind (judged on the targets handed in). `trash` is the trash view's rows (P-10): a command that lists it
 * takes trash rows in the trash view, and its other kind elsewhere (⌘⌫).
 */
export type CommandContext = 'app' | 'library' | 'viewer' | 'item' | 'collection' | 'tag' | 'trash';
```
`CONTEXT_MENU_KINDS`:
```ts
export const CONTEXT_MENU_KINDS = ['item', 'collection', 'tag', 'column', 'trash'] as const;
```

```ts
    sidebar?: Readonly<Record<PaneShown, string>>;
    inspector?: Readonly<Record<PaneShown, string>>;
    /** By the view shown (P-11): ⌘⌫ is 영구 삭제… in the trash; a view without an entry keeps `label`. */
    scope?: Readonly<Partial<Record<LibraryScope['kind'], string>>>;
  };
```

```ts
  // (P-11): one key, one id, named by the view — the registry allows no second ⌘⌫ in one context. 파일's last group, the
```

```ts
const needsTargets = (c: CommandSpec): boolean => c.contexts.some((x) => x === 'item' || x === 'collection' || x === 'tag' || x === 'trash');
```
`commandLabel`·`paletteLabel`·`commandMention`을 바꾼다(`LabelState` 형은 `commandLabel` 위에):
```ts
/** What a state label follows: the pane states and the view's scope, as reported (absent ones name nothing). */
export type LabelState = Partial<Pick<CommandContextState, 'sidebar' | 'inspector' | 'scope'>>;

/**
 * The label a menu, tooltip or palette shows: the state label when the command has one and the state is known (`state`
 * is the reported context), else the platform label.
 */
export function commandLabel(c: CommandSpec, platform: string, state: LabelState = {}): string {
  const labels = c.stateLabels;
  if (labels?.sidebar && state.sidebar) return labels.sidebar[state.sidebar];
  if (labels?.inspector && state.inspector) return labels.inspector[state.inspector];
  const scoped = labels?.scope && state.scope ? labels.scope[state.scope] : undefined;
  if (scoped !== undefined) return scoped;
  return platform !== 'darwin' && c.labelOff ? c.labelOff : c.label;
}

/** The name the palette shows: `paletteLabel` where the command has one, else what the menus call it. */
export function paletteLabel(c: CommandSpec, platform: string, state: LabelState = {}): string {
  return c.paletteLabel ?? commandLabel(c, platform, state);
}
```
`commandMention`의 인자 형도 `state: LabelState = {}`.


대상 형 — `TagTargetInfo` 다음에:
```ts
/** A row of the trash view (P-10): what 복원 and 영구 삭제… act on. Its kind (item or collection) is the handler's, not availability's. */
export interface TrashTargetInfo {
  kind: 'trash';
}
export const TRASH_TARGET: TrashTargetInfo = Object.freeze({ kind: 'trash' });
/** What a command acts on, by kind: the item rules read the item ones only. */
export type CommandTargetInfo = ItemTargetInfo | CollectionTargetInfo | TagTargetInfo | TrashTargetInfo;
```
(옛 `CommandTargetInfo` 줄과 그 주석을 이것으로 바꾼다.) `Targets`·`NO_TARGETS`·`targetsByKind`:
```ts
export interface Targets {
  items: readonly ItemTargetInfo[];
  collections: readonly CollectionTargetInfo[];
  tags: readonly TagTargetInfo[];
  trash: readonly TrashTargetInfo[];
}
const NO_TARGETS: Targets = Object.freeze({ items: [], collections: [], tags: [], trash: [] });
```

`selectionTargets`:
```ts
/**
 * Synthetic targets for the menu bar: `selectionAvailable` available, then `selectionRelinkable` linked+missing, the
 * rest managed+missing. In the trash view the selection is trash rows (P-10). Main has only the reported counts; no rule
 * reads the storage mode of an available target. Counts that do not add up are clamped to `selectionCount`.
 */
export function selectionTargets(ctx: CommandContextState): CommandTargetInfo[] {
  if (ctx.scope === 'trash') {
    const rows = Array.from({ length: ctx.selectionCount }, (): TrashTargetInfo => TRASH_TARGET);
    split.set(rows, { items: [], collections: [], tags: [], trash: rows });
    return rows;
  }
  const available = Math.min(ctx.selectionAvailable, ctx.selectionCount);
  const relinkable = Math.min(ctx.selectionRelinkable, ctx.selectionCount - available);
  const targets = Array.from({ length: ctx.selectionCount }, (_, i) => (i < available ? AVAILABLE : i < available + relinkable ? RELINKABLE : MISSING));
  split.set(targets, { items: targets, collections: [], tags: [], trash: [] }); // items only: no pass over a selection of the whole library
  return targets;
}
```
`RULES`의 `'collection.removeItems'` 줄 다음에:
```ts
  // ⌘⌫ (P-11): the library view's selection — live items, or the trash view's rows there (neededTargets).
  'item.trash': (c) => c.view === 'library',
  // 복원: the trash view's rows only.
  'item.restore': (c) => c.view === 'library' && c.scope === 'trash',
  // 휴지통 비우기…: while the trash has something.
  'trash.empty': (c) => c.trashCount > 0,
```
`commandAvailable` 위에 함수 하나, 그리고 `commandAvailable`의 `needed` 줄을 그것으로:
```ts
/**
 * The targets a command needs, by the first kind it lists — except that a command of the trash rows takes those in the trash
 * view (⌘⌫ is 영구 삭제… there, P-11) and its other kind elsewhere. Null: it needs none (app or view context).
 */
function neededTargets(spec: CommandSpec, ctx: CommandContextState, t: Targets): readonly CommandTargetInfo[] | null {
  const c = spec.contexts;
  if (c.includes('trash') && ctx.scope === 'trash') return t.trash;
  if (c.includes('item')) return t.items;
  if (c.includes('collection')) return t.collections;
  if (c.includes('tag')) return t.tags;
  if (c.includes('trash')) return t.trash;
  return null;
}
```

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { CollectionsRepository, LibraryRepository, TagsRepository, type Db } from '../src/index';
import { freshDb, seedItem } from './fixtures';

let db: Db;
let repo: LibraryRepository;
beforeEach(() => {

  repo = new LibraryRepository(db);
});

describe('the trash view carries its items\' places and tags (Task 6, Q-6a: the read-only panel and the tag selector)', () => {
  it('members: live collection → trashed items directly in it; tagged: tag → trashed items; live items are in neither', () => {
    const a = seedItem(db, { title: 'A' }).itemId;
    const b = seedItem(db, { title: 'B' }).itemId;
    const live = seedItem(db, { title: 'live' }).itemId;
    const cols = new CollectionsRepository(db);
    const bio = cols.create({ name: '분자생물학' });
    const gone = cols.create({ name: '옛것' });
    cols.addItems(bio.id, [a, live]);
    cols.addItems(gone.id, [b]);
    const tags = new TagsRepository(db);
    const exam = tags.create('시험 범위');
    const finals = tags.create('기말');
    tags.assign(exam.id, [a, b, live]);
    tags.assign(finals.id, [live]);
    repo.trash([a, b]);
    cols.softDelete(gone.id);

    const view = repo.trashView();
    // 옛것 is in the trash itself: B's place there shows again when it is restored.
    expect(view.members).toEqual({ [bio.id]: [a] });
    expect(Object.keys(view.tagged)).toEqual([exam.id]);
    expect([...view.tagged[exam.id]!].sort()).toEqual([a, b].sort());
  });

  it('an empty trash has empty maps', () => {
    seedItem(db, { title: 'live' });
    expect(repo.trashView()).toEqual({ collections: [], items: [], members: {}, tagged: {} });
  });

  it('library.detail reads a trashed item too (the read-only panel, Q-6b); editing it is still refused', () => {
    const { itemId } = seedItem(db, { title: '휴지통 자료' });
    repo.trash([itemId]);
    const detail = repo.getItemDetail(itemId);
    expect(detail.item).toMatchObject({ id: itemId, title: '휴지통 자료' });
    expect(detail.file.sha256).toHaveLength(64);
    expect(() => repo.updateMetadata(itemId, { title: '바꿈' })).toThrow();
  });
});
```

`packages/db/src/trash.ts` 끝에:
```ts
/**
 * Where the trashed items are and what tags they have (Task 6, Q-6a): live collection → the trashed items directly in it, and
 * tag → the trashed items that have it, non-empty keys only (as the organize snapshot keeps them for live items). A trashed
 * collection's places are left out: they show again when it is restored.
 */
export function trashPlaces(db: Db): { members: Record<string, string[]>; tagged: Record<string, string[]> } {
  const group = (rows: Array<[string, string]>): Record<string, string[]> => {
    const out: Record<string, string[]> = {};
    for (const [key, id] of rows) (out[key] ??= []).push(id);
    return out;
  };
  const members = db
    .prepare(`SELECT ci.collection_id, ci.item_id FROM collection_items ci
              JOIN collections c ON c.id = ci.collection_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
              JOIN items i ON i.id = ci.item_id AND i.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
              ORDER BY ci.collection_id, i.deleted_at DESC, i.rowid DESC`)
    .raw()
    .all() as Array<[string, string]>;
  const tagged = db
    .prepare(`SELECT it.tag_id, it.item_id FROM item_tags it
              JOIN items i ON i.id = it.item_id AND i.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
              ORDER BY it.tag_id, i.deleted_at DESC, i.rowid DESC`)
    .raw()
    .all() as Array<[string, string]>;
  return { members: group(members), tagged: group(tagged) };
}
```

```ts
/** The reported state that state labels follow (design-spec 7.4): the pane states, and the view for ⌘⌫ (P-11). */
export type MenuLabelState = LabelState;

/** The label state of a reported context, without the absent parts (the fatal screen reports no pane). */
export function menuLabelState(ctx: LabelState): MenuLabelState {
  return { ...(ctx.sidebar ? { sidebar: ctx.sidebar } : {}), ...(ctx.inspector ? { inspector: ctx.inspector } : {}), ...(ctx.scope ? { scope: ctx.scope } : {}) };
}

/** Whether a new report renames a menu item: a pane state or the view that a state label follows has changed. */
export function menuLabelsChanged(before: MenuLabelState, after: MenuLabelState): boolean {
  return before.sidebar !== after.sidebar || before.inspector !== after.inspector || before.scope !== after.scope;
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { TRASH_TARGET, type CommandTargetInfo, type OrganizeSnapshot, type TrashView, type TrashedCollection } from '@learn/domain';
import { item } from '../organize/testing';
import { collectionMatch, splitTrashSelection, trashCollectionRows, trashModelFor, trashSelectionCount, withTrashTargets } from './trashRows';

const col = (id: string, name: string, deletedAt: string): TrashedCollection => ({ id, name, parentId: null, deletedAt, childCount: 0, itemCount: 1 });
const ROWS = [col('c1', '학회 준비', '2026-10-31T00:05:00.000Z'), col('c2', '통계', '2026-10-30T00:05:00.000Z'), col('c3', '세포 신호', '2026-10-31T00:09:00.000Z')];
const ids = (rows: readonly TrashedCollection[]) => rows.map((c) => c.id);
const plain = { query: '', tagFiltered: false };
const LIVE: CommandTargetInfo = { kind: 'item', storageMode: 'managed', availability: 'available' };
const VIEW: TrashView = { items: [{ ...item('t1'), deletedAt: '2026-10-31T00:01:00.000Z' }], collections: [ROWS[0]!], members: {}, tagged: {} };

describe('the trash view\'s collection rows (spec 4.3)', () => {
  it('newest first by default and under the columns they have no value in; by name or by date when that column sorts', () => {
    expect(ids(trashCollectionRows(ROWS, { ...plain, sort: { column: 'deletedAt', direction: 'desc' } }))).toEqual(['c3', 'c1', 'c2']);
    expect(ids(trashCollectionRows(ROWS, { ...plain, sort: { column: 'deletedAt', direction: 'asc' } }))).toEqual(['c2', 'c1', 'c3']);
    expect(ids(trashCollectionRows(ROWS, { ...plain, sort: { column: 'title', direction: 'asc' } }))).toEqual(['c3', 'c2', 'c1']); // 세포 · 통계 · 학회
    expect(ids(trashCollectionRows(ROWS, { ...plain, sort: { column: 'title', direction: 'desc' } }))).toEqual(['c1', 'c2', 'c3']);
    expect(ids(trashCollectionRows(ROWS, { ...plain, sort: { column: 'year', direction: 'asc' } }))).toEqual(['c3', 'c1', 'c2']);
    expect(trashCollectionRows(ROWS, { ...plain, sort: { column: 'title', direction: 'asc' } })).not.toBe(ROWS);
  });
  it('the quick search keeps the rows whose name has every word (초성 too, as the palette reads it); a tag filter keeps none', () => {
    const sort = { column: 'deletedAt', direction: 'desc' } as const;
    expect(ids(trashCollectionRows(ROWS, { sort, query: 'ㅎㅎ', tagFiltered: false }))).toEqual(['c1']);
    expect(ids(trashCollectionRows(ROWS, { sort, query: '세포  신호', tagFiltered: false }))).toEqual(['c3']);
    expect(ids(trashCollectionRows(ROWS, { sort, query: '신호 통계', tagFiltered: false }))).toEqual([]);
    expect(trashCollectionRows(ROWS, { sort, query: '', tagFiltered: true })).toEqual([]);
    expect(collectionMatch('학회 준비', '학회')).toMatchObject({ start: 0, end: 2 });
    expect(collectionMatch('학회 준비', '  ')).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('trash rows as command targets and selection (P-10)', () => {
  const live = (target: { itemIds?: readonly string[] }) => (target.itemIds ?? []).map(() => LIVE);
  it('an id the trash holds is a trash row; the others are judged as they are elsewhere', () => {
    expect(withTrashTargets(VIEW, { itemIds: ['t1', 'x'], collectionIds: ['c1'] }, live)).toEqual([LIVE, TRASH_TARGET, TRASH_TARGET]);
    expect(withTrashTargets(undefined, { itemIds: ['t1'] }, live)).toEqual([LIVE]);
  });
  it('splits a selection into the trash\'s items and collections, leaving out what it does not hold', () => {
    const selected = new Set(['c1', 't1', 'gone']);
    expect(splitTrashSelection(VIEW, selected)).toEqual({ itemIds: ['t1'], collectionIds: ['c1'] });
    expect(trashSelectionCount(VIEW, selected)).toBe(2);
    expect(splitTrashSelection(undefined, selected)).toEqual({ itemIds: [], collectionIds: [] });
    expect(trashSelectionCount(undefined, selected)).toBe(0);
  });
});

describe('the organize model over the trash (Q-6a)', () => {
  it('has the trashed items\' tags and live places, the live tree and tags, and the count; one model per snapshot and view', () => {
    const snapshot: OrganizeSnapshot = {
      collections: [{ id: 'bio', name: '분자생물학', parentId: null, createdAt: '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z' }],
      tags: [{ id: 'g', name: '기말', color: null, position: null }],
      members: { bio: ['live'] }, tagged: { g: ['live'] }, duplicates: [], trashCount: 2,
    };
    const view: TrashView = { ...VIEW, members: { bio: ['t1'] }, tagged: { g: ['t1'] } };
    const model = trashModelFor(snapshot, view);
    expect(model.tagsOfItem('t1').map((x) => x.id)).toEqual(['g']);
    expect(model.directCollectionsOf('t1')).toEqual(['bio']);
    expect(model.tagItems('g')).toEqual(new Set(['t1']));
    expect(model.node('bio')?.name).toBe('분자생물학');
    expect(model.trashCount).toBe(2);
    expect(trashModelFor(snapshot, view)).toBe(model);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import type { TrashView } from '@learn/domain';
import { item } from '../organize/testing';
import { createTrashActions, purgeVariant, type TrashDeps } from './trashActions';

const view = (items: number, collections: number): TrashView => ({
  items: Array.from({ length: items }, (_, k) => ({ ...item(`t${k}`), deletedAt: '2026-10-31T00:00:00.000Z' })),
  collections: Array.from({ length: collections }, (_, k) => ({ id: `c${k}`, name: `c${k}`, parentId: null, deletedAt: '2026-10-31T00:00:00.000Z', childCount: 0, itemCount: 0 })),
  members: {},
  tagged: {},
});
function setup(over: Partial<TrashDeps> = {}) {
  const deps: TrashDeps = {
    trash: vi.fn(async (ids: string[]) => ids.length),
    restoreItems: vi.fn(async (ids: string[]) => ids.length),
    restoreCollection: vi.fn(async () => {}),
    purge: vi.fn(async (rows: { itemIds: string[]; collectionIds: string[] }) => ({ itemIds: rows.itemIds, collectionIds: rows.collectionIds })),
    emptyTrash: vi.fn(async () => ({ itemIds: ['t0', 't1'], collectionIds: ['c0'] })),
    readTrash: vi.fn(async () => view(2, 1)),
    confirmPurge: vi.fn(async () => true),
    titleOf: vi.fn((id: string) => (id === 'a' ? '분자생물학 6장' : undefined)),
    dropFromList: vi.fn(),
    toast: vi.fn(),
    undoToast: vi.fn(),
    failed: vi.fn(),
    ...over,
  };
  return { deps, actions: createTrashActions(deps) };
}

describe('휴지통으로 이동 (spec 4.1)', () => {
  it('moves at once, says how many with 실행 취소 (one is named), and the undo brings back exactly those', async () => {
    const { deps, actions } = setup();
    await actions.trashItems(['a', 'b', 'a']);
    expect(deps.trash).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith(['a', 'b']);
    expect(deps.dropFromList).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith(['a', 'b']);
    const [title, undo] = vi.mocked(deps.undoToast).mock.calls[0]!;
    expect(title).toBe('자료 2개를 휴지통으로 옮겼습니다');
    await undo();
    expect(deps.restoreItems).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith(['a', 'b']);
    await actions.trashItems(['a']);
    expect(vi.mocked(deps.undoToast).mock.calls[1]![0]).toBe('‘분자생물학 6장’⁠을 휴지통으로 옮겼습니다');
  });
  it('nothing moved (gone meanwhile) says nothing; a refusal is told and moves nothing on screen', async () => {
    const none = setup({ trash: vi.fn(async () => 0) });
    await none.actions.trashItems(['a']);
    expect(none.deps.undoToast).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(none.deps.dropFromList).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    const boom = new Error('x');
    const refused = setup({ trash: vi.fn(async () => Promise.reject(boom)) });
    await refused.actions.trashItems(['a']);
    expect(refused.deps.failed).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith(boom);
    expect(refused.deps.dropFromList).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    await refused.actions.trashItems([]);
    expect(refused.deps.trash).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
});

describe('복원 (spec 4.4)', () => {
  it('restores the items and each collection, counted together, with no undo; quiet from the reader', async () => {
    const { deps, actions } = setup();
    await actions.restore({ itemIds: ['t0', 't1'], collectionIds: ['c0'] });
    expect(deps.restoreItems).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith(['t0', 't1']);
    expect(deps.restoreCollection).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith('c0');
    expect(deps.toast).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith('3개를 복원했습니다', 'restore-done');
    expect(deps.undoToast).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    await actions.restore({ itemIds: ['t0'], collectionIds: [] }, { quiet: true });
    expect(deps.toast).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
  it('a refusal is told; what came back before it is still said', async () => {
    const boom = new Error('x');
    const { deps, actions } = setup({ restoreCollection: vi.fn(async () => Promise.reject(boom)) });
    await actions.restore({ itemIds: ['t0'], collectionIds: ['c0'] });
    expect(deps.failed).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith(boom);
    expect(deps.toast).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith('1개를 복원했습니다', 'restore-done');
  });
});

describe('영구 삭제… and 휴지통 비우기… (spec 4.5, P-25)', () => {
  it('asks in the sheet first with its variant; 취소 deletes nothing; the toast counts what went', async () => {
    const no = setup({ confirmPurge: vi.fn(async () => false) });
    await no.actions.purge({ itemIds: ['t0'], collectionIds: [] });
    expect(no.deps.confirmPurge).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith({ variant: 'items', items: 1, collections: 0 });
    expect(no.deps.purge).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    const yes = setup();
    await yes.actions.purge({ itemIds: ['t0', 't1'], collectionIds: ['c0'] });
    expect(yes.deps.confirmPurge).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith({ variant: 'mixed', items: 2, collections: 1 });
    expect(yes.deps.purge).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith({ itemIds: ['t0', 't1'], collectionIds: ['c0'] });
    expect(yes.deps.toast).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith('자료 2개와 컬렉션 1개를 영구히 삭제했습니다', 'purge-done');
    expect([purgeVariant(0, 2), purgeVariant(3, 0), purgeVariant(1, 1)]).toEqual(['collections', 'items', 'mixed']);
  });
  it('휴지통 비우기… counts the trash as it is now; an empty trash asks nothing', async () => {
    const { deps, actions } = setup();
    await actions.emptyTrash();
    expect(deps.confirmPurge).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith({ variant: 'empty', items: 2, collections: 1 });
    expect(deps.emptyTrash).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(deps.toast).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith('휴지통을 비웠습니다', 'purge-done');
    const none = setup({ readTrash: vi.fn(async () => view(0, 0)) });
    await none.actions.emptyTrash();
    expect(none.deps.confirmPurge).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('a sheet that fails, or a refused delete, is told and nothing more happens', async () => {
    const boom = new Error('x');
    const sheet = setup({ confirmPurge: vi.fn(async () => Promise.reject(boom)) });
    await sheet.actions.purge({ itemIds: ['t0'], collectionIds: [] });
    expect(sheet.deps.failed).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith(boom);
    expect(sheet.deps.purge).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    const refused = setup({ emptyTrash: vi.fn(async () => Promise.reject(boom)) });
    await refused.actions.emptyTrash();
    expect(refused.deps.failed).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith(boom);
    expect(refused.deps.toast).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
```

```ts
    await actions.collectionOnTrash('gone');
    await actions.itemsOnTrash([]);
    expect(deps.trashCollection).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(deps.trashItems).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { ApiError } from '../api';
import { readerLost, trashedAfter } from './readerState';

describe('the reader and the trash (spec 4.6)', () => {
  it('a notice about its item: trashed shows the notice, restored keeps it until the item reads again, purged gives way', () => {
    expect(trashedAfter('no', { reason: 'trash', itemIds: ['x', 'me'] }, 'me')).toBe('yes');
    expect(trashedAfter('yes', { reason: 'restore', itemIds: ['me'] }, 'me')).toBe('back');
    expect(trashedAfter('no', { reason: 'restore', itemIds: ['me'] }, 'me')).toBe('no');
    expect(trashedAfter('yes', { reason: 'purge', itemIds: ['me'] }, 'me')).toBe('no');
    expect(trashedAfter('no', { reason: 'trash', itemIds: ['other'] }, 'me')).toBe('no');
    expect(trashedAfter('yes', { reason: 'metadata', itemIds: ['me'] }, 'me')).toBe('yes');
    expect(trashedAfter('no', { reason: 'trash' }, 'me')).toBe('no');
  });
  it('the reader gives way only when its item cannot be read at all or is gone; another failed re-read keeps it (spec 4.6)', () => {
    expect(readerLost({ isError: false, data: {}, error: null })).toBe(false);
    expect(readerLost({ isError: true, data: undefined, error: new ApiError('INTERNAL', 'x', false) })).toBe(true);
    expect(readerLost({ isError: true, data: {}, error: new ApiError('NOT_FOUND', 'x', false) })).toBe(true);
    expect(readerLost({ isError: true, data: {}, error: new ApiError('LIBRARY_UNAVAILABLE', 'x', false) })).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

```ts
describe('the trash view\'s 삭제한 날짜 (M6 spec 4.3)', () => {
  const forced = ['deletedAt'] as const;
  it('is drawn last only where a view forces it, whatever the stored columns say', () => {
    const stored = { ...defaultColumns(), visible: [...defaultColumns().visible, 'deletedAt' as const] };
    expect(visibleColumns(stored).map((c) => c.id)).not.toContain('deletedAt');
    expect(visibleColumns(defaultColumns(), forced).map((c) => c.id)).toEqual(['title', 'creators', 'year', 'type', 'createdAt', 'deletedAt']);
  });
  it('stays last: it is not moved, nothing goes after it, and the others still move before it', () => {
    const cfg = defaultColumns();
    const shown = ['title', 'creators', 'deletedAt'] as const;
    expect(pinnedCount(shown, forced)).toBe(1);
    expect(trailingCount(shown, forced)).toBe(1);
    expect(moveColumn(cfg, forced, 'deletedAt', 1)).toBe(cfg);
    expect(moveColumn(cfg, forced, 'creators', 6)).toBe(cfg);
    expect(visibleColumns(moveColumn(cfg, forced, 'creators', 5), forced).map((c) => c.id)).toEqual(['title', 'year', 'type', 'createdAt', 'creators', 'deletedAt']);
  });
});
```

```ts
describe('the trash commands (P-10, P-11)', () => {
  const TRASH: CommandTargetInfo = { kind: 'trash' };
  const asTrash = (target: CommandTarget): CommandTargetInfo[] => [...(target.itemIds ?? []), ...(target.collectionIds ?? [])].map(() => TRASH);
  it('⌘⌫ moves the live selection to the trash; in the trash view it asks to purge the trash rows; 복원 restores them', () => {
    const e = env({ libraryCount: 3, selectionCount: 2, targetsOf: available, selection: () => [ID, OTHER] });
    expect(runCommand('item.trash', e, menuTarget('item.trash', e))).toBe(true);
    expect(e.trashItems).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith([ID, OTHER]);
    expect(runCommand('item.restore', e, menuTarget('item.restore', e))).toBe(false);
    const rows = { itemIds: [ID], collectionIds: [OTHER] };
    const t = env({ libraryCount: 3, scope: 'trash', trashCount: 2, selectionCount: 2, targetsOf: asTrash, trashSelection: () => rows });
    expect(menuTarget('item.trash', t)).toEqual(rows);
    expect(runCommand('item.trash', t, menuTarget('item.trash', t))).toBe(true);
    expect(t.purge).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith(rows);
    expect(t.trashItems).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(runCommand('item.restore', t, menuTarget('item.restore', t))).toBe(true);
    expect(t.restore).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith(rows);
    // A trash row's menu pick runs on the rows the menu was opened for.
    expect(runPicked({ commandId: 'item.restore' }, t, { itemIds: [OTHER], collectionIds: [] })).toBe(true);
    expect(t.restore).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith({ itemIds: [OTHER], collectionIds: [] });
    // The reader: no ⌘⌫ (spec 4.1: the item commands are off there).
    const reader = env({ view: 'viewer', selectionCount: 1, targetsOf: available, selection: () => [ID] });
    expect(runCommand('item.trash', reader, menuTarget('item.trash', reader))).toBe(false);
  });
  it('휴지통 비우기… runs while the trash has something; the reported context carries the count', () => {
    expect(runCommand('trash.empty', env({ trashCount: 0 }))).toBe(false);
    const full = env({ trashCount: 5 });
    expect(runCommand('trash.empty', full)).toBe(true);
    expect(full.emptyTrash).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(contextOf(full).trashCount).toBe(5);
  });
  it('⌘⌫ and ⇧⌘⌫ are the keys a text field keeps (Q-6e)', () => {
    expect(yieldsToText('item.trash')).toBe(true);
    expect(yieldsToText('trash.empty')).toBe(true);
    expect(yieldsToText('library.find')).toBe(false);
    expect(yieldsToText('item.restore')).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

```ts
// The trash's copy (M6 spec 4; the owner-approved mockups library.html?state=trash and reader-pdf.html?state=trashed). 합니다체;
// "이 자료", "이 자리" bound with U+00A0.
import { eulReul } from './josa';

export const trash = {
  /** ⌘⌫ (spec 4.1): the toast with 실행 취소 — several counted, one named. */
  moved: (n: number) => `자료 ${n}개를 휴지통으로 옮겼습니다`,
  movedOne: (title: string) => `‘${title}’⁠${eulReul(title)} 휴지통으로 옮겼습니다`,
  /** A collection's 휴지통으로 이동 (spec 4.2), with 실행 취소. */
  collectionMoved: (name: string) => `‘${name}’ 컬렉션을 휴지통으로 옮겼습니다`,
  /** 복원 (spec 4.4): no 실행 취소 (⌘⌫ again); items and collections counted together. */
  restored: (n: number) => `${n}개를 복원했습니다`,
  /** After 영구 삭제… (Q-6f; spec 4.5: told as done even when a file could not be removed — the check shows it). */
  purged: (items: number, collections: number) =>
    items > 0 && collections > 0
      ? `자료 ${items}개와 컬렉션 ${collections}개를 영구히 삭제했습니다`
      : collections > 0
        ? `컬렉션 ${collections}개를 영구히 삭제했습니다`
        : `자료 ${items}개를 영구히 삭제했습니다`,
  emptied: '휴지통을 비웠습니다',
  /** A trashed collection row, where the author goes: the items it still has in the library. */
  collectionItems: (n: number) => `자료 ${n}개`,
  panel: {
    /** Under 복원 in the item panel: where the item is and since when ("오늘 오전 9:12"). */
    note: (when: string) => `휴지통에 있습니다 · ${when}에 옮김`,
    /** The same line for rows trashed at different times. */
    noteMixed: '휴지통에 있습니다',
    /** One trashed collection chosen: its kind line. */
    collectionKind: (items: number) => `컬렉션 · 자료 ${items}개`,
    /** The kind line's part for the collections among several rows. */
    collections: (n: number) => `컬렉션 ${n}개`,
    /** Several trash rows chosen: the panel's title. */
    selected: (items: number, collections: number) =>
      items > 0 && collections > 0 ? `자료 ${items}개와 컬렉션 ${collections}개 선택` : collections > 0 ? `컬렉션 ${collections}개 선택` : `자료 ${items}개 선택`,
  },
  /** The reader when its item went to the trash (spec 4.6). */
  reader: {
    title: '이 자료는 휴지통에 있습니다',
    body: '복원하면 이 자리에서 다시 엽니다.',
  },
} as const;
```

```ts
import type { SheetPayload } from '@learn/domain';
import { t } from '../strings';

export type PurgePayload = Extract<SheetPayload, { kind: 'purge' }>;

/** The purge sheet's words for a payload (P-25, spec 4.5 as the owner approved it): what goes, what stays, the verb. */
export function purgeText(p: PurgePayload): { title: string; body: string; verb: string } {
  const s = t.sheets.purge;
  switch (p.variant) {
    case 'items':
      return { title: s.titleItems(p.items), body: s.bodyItems, verb: s.purge };
    case 'collections':
      return { title: s.titleCollections(p.collections), body: s.bodyCollections, verb: s.purge };
    case 'mixed':
      return { title: s.titleMixed(p.items, p.collections), body: s.bodyMixed, verb: s.purge };
    case 'empty':
      return { title: s.titleEmpty, body: s.bodyEmpty(s.what(p.items, p.collections)), verb: s.empty };
  }
}
```

**(d)** `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/library/columns.ts` — `visibleColumns`·`pinnedCount`를 바꾸고 `trailingCount`를 더하고, `moveColumn`의 거절 조건을 넓힌다:
```ts
/** A column one view draws last and keeps there (the trash's 삭제한 날짜, M6 spec 4.3). */
const trailing = (id: LibraryColumnId): boolean => columnSpec(id).trashOnly === true;

/**
 * The shown columns in the stored order. `forced` columns are shown whatever the config says: right after the title (the
 * recent view's 마지막으로 연 날, spec 3.2), or last for a column only one view draws (the trash's 삭제한 날짜), which no other
 * view shows whatever library.columns says. The rest keep their order.
 */
export function visibleColumns(cfg: ColumnConfig, forced: readonly LibraryColumnId[] = []): LibraryColumnSpec[] {
  const rank = (id: LibraryColumnId) => (id === 'title' ? 0 : forced.includes(id) ? (trailing(id) ? 3 : 1) : 2);
  return completeOrder(cfg.order)
    .filter((id) => forced.includes(id) || (cfg.visible.includes(id) && !trailing(id)))
    .sort((a, b) => rank(a) - rank(b)) // stable: a rank keeps the stored order inside it
    .map(columnSpec);
}

/** How many leading columns are fixed: the title and the forced columns shown after it. They take no drag and nothing goes before them. */
export const pinnedCount = (shown: readonly LibraryColumnId[], forced: readonly LibraryColumnId[]): number =>
  shown.filter((id) => id === 'title' || (forced.includes(id) && !trailing(id))).length;

/** How many columns are fixed at the end (the trash's 삭제한 날짜): they take no drag and nothing goes after them. */
export const trailingCount = (shown: readonly LibraryColumnId[], forced: readonly LibraryColumnId[]): number =>
  shown.filter((id) => forced.includes(id) && trailing(id)).length;
```

```ts
/**
 * An action refused part-way (m-6): an error toast that names what was done, gives main's cause, and offers 실행 취소 for
 * that part. It stays until closed, as errors do; a refused undo is told like showUndoToast's.
 */
export function showUndoableError(e: unknown, title: string, undo: () => Promise<void>): string {
  return showToast({
    kind: 'error',
    title,
    body: e instanceof Error ? e.message : undefined,
    testId: 'partial-failure',
    action: {
      label: t.toast.undo,
      testId: 'undo-action',
      onAction: () =>
        void undo().catch((err: unknown) => showToast({ kind: 'error', title: t.toast.undoFailed, body: err instanceof Error ? err.message : undefined, testId: 'undo-failed' })),
    },
  });
}
```

```ts
import { useShell } from '../state/shell-store';

/**
 * A question main asks in one of our sheets (the purge sheet, P-25): from the request to the answer the window counts as
 * held — every command refused at once, nothing greyed until the sheet is on screen (MainWindow's `held` and `sheetOpen`,
 * as for ⌘/).
 */
export async function askInSheet<T>(ask: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  useShell.getState().countSheetAsk(1);
  try {
    return await ask();
  } finally {
    useShell.getState().countSheetAsk(-1);
  }
}
```

**(m)** 새 파일 `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/viewers/readerState.ts`:
```ts
import type { LearnEventMap } from '@learn/domain';
import { ApiError } from '../api';

/** The reader and the trash (spec 4.6): `yes` the notice shows; `back` restored, the notice stays until the item reads again. */
export type TrashedState = 'no' | 'yes' | 'back';

/** The state after a library notice: only one about this item counts — trashed, restored, or purged (then the not-found notice). */
export function trashedAfter(state: TrashedState, change: Pick<LearnEventMap['libraryChanged'], 'reason' | 'itemIds'>, itemId: string): TrashedState {
  if (!change.itemIds?.includes(itemId)) return state;
  if (change.reason === 'trash') return 'yes';
  if (change.reason === 'restore') return state === 'no' ? 'no' : 'back';
  if (change.reason === 'purge') return 'no';
  return state;
}

/** The reader gives way to its open-failed notice only when the item could not be read at all, or is gone (NOT_FOUND). */
export function readerLost(read: { isError: boolean; data: unknown; error: unknown }): boolean {
  if (!read.isError) return false;
  return read.data === undefined || (read.error instanceof ApiError && read.error.code === 'NOT_FOUND');
}
```

```ts
 * view's selected rows there (P-10); an item command the table's selection, which only the library view shows (spec 6: off
 * in the reader, as main's availableMenuCommands judges it).

export function menuTarget(id: CommandId, env: CommandEnv): CommandTarget {
  const contexts = COMMANDS.find((c) => c.id === id)?.contexts ?? [];
  if (contexts.includes('trash') && env.scope === 'trash' && env.view === 'library') return env.trashSelection();
  if (!contexts.includes('item')) return {};
```

**(o)** 새 파일 `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/trash/trashRows.ts`:
```ts
import { TRASH_TARGET, type CommandTargetInfo, type OrganizeSnapshot, type TrashView, type TrashedCollection } from '@learn/domain';
import type { CommandTarget, TrashRows } from '../commands/registry';
import type { LibrarySort } from '../library/sort';
import { buildOrganizeModel, type OrganizeModel } from '../organize/model';
import { matchKorean, type Match } from '../palette/hangul';

const collator = new Intl.Collator('ko', { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' });
const time = (iso: string): number => {
  const t = Date.parse(iso);
  return Number.isNaN(t) ? 0 : t;
};
const newestFirst = (a: TrashedCollection, b: TrashedCollection): number => time(b.deletedAt) - time(a.deletedAt);

/**
 * The trash view's collection rows as the table draws them (spec 4.3): always above the items, in the sort's own order when
 * it is the name (제목) or 삭제한 날짜, else most recently trashed first. A tag filter keeps none (a collection has no tags); a
 * query keeps the rows whose name has every word, read as the palette reads a collection's name (초성 too). A new array.
 */
export function trashCollectionRows(collections: readonly TrashedCollection[], opts: { sort: LibrarySort; query: string; tagFiltered: boolean }): TrashedCollection[] {
  if (opts.tagFiltered) return [];
  const words = opts.query.trim().split(/\s+/).filter((w) => w !== '');
  const kept = words.length === 0 ? [...collections] : collections.filter((c) => words.every((w) => matchKorean(w, c.name) !== null));
  const dir = opts.sort.direction === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
  if (opts.sort.column === 'title') return kept.sort((a, b) => collator.compare(a.name, b.name) * dir || newestFirst(a, b));
  if (opts.sort.column === 'deletedAt') return kept.sort((a, b) => (time(a.deletedAt) - time(b.deletedAt)) * dir || collator.compare(a.name, b.name));
  return kept.sort(newestFirst);
}

/** The part of a collection row's name the quick search matched (the query read as one word), for the title's <mark>. */
export function collectionMatch(name: string, query: string): Match | null {
  const q = query.trim();
  return q === '' ? null : matchKorean(q, name);
}

/** One id index per trash view read (it is replaced, never changed). */
const indexes = new WeakMap<TrashView, { items: ReadonlySet<string>; collections: ReadonlySet<string> }>();
function idsOf(view: TrashView): { items: ReadonlySet<string>; collections: ReadonlySet<string> } {
  let found = indexes.get(view);
  if (!found) {
    found = { items: new Set(view.items.map((i) => i.id)), collections: new Set(view.collections.map((c) => c.id)) };
    indexes.set(view, found);
  }
  return found;
}

/** The selected rows the trash holds, items and collections apart, in the view's order (most recently trashed first). */
export function splitTrashSelection(view: TrashView | undefined, selected: ReadonlySet<string>): TrashRows {
  if (!view || selected.size === 0) return { itemIds: [], collectionIds: [] };
  return { itemIds: view.items.filter((i) => selected.has(i.id)).map((i) => i.id), collectionIds: view.collections.filter((c) => selected.has(c.id)).map((c) => c.id) };
}

/** How many selected rows the trash holds: the command context's selection count in the trash view. */
export function trashSelectionCount(view: TrashView | undefined, selected: ReadonlySet<string>): number {
  if (!view || selected.size === 0) return 0;
  const ids = idsOf(view);
  let n = 0;
  for (const id of selected) if (ids.items.has(id) || ids.collections.has(id)) n += 1;
  return n;
}

/**
 * Command targets with the trash view's rows among them (P-10): an id the trash holds is a trash row; the rest are judged
 * as anywhere else by `live` (live items from the list, sidebar collections, tags). No view: everything is `live`'s.
 */
export function withTrashTargets(view: TrashView | undefined, target: CommandTarget, live: (rest: CommandTarget) => CommandTargetInfo[]): CommandTargetInfo[] {
  if (!view) return live(target);
  const ids = idsOf(view);
  const itemIds = target.itemIds ?? [];
  const collectionIds = target.collectionIds ?? [];
  const rows = itemIds.filter((id) => ids.items.has(id)).length + collectionIds.filter((id) => ids.collections.has(id)).length;
  const rest: CommandTarget = { ...target, itemIds: itemIds.filter((id) => !ids.items.has(id)), collectionIds: collectionIds.filter((id) => !ids.collections.has(id)) };
  return [...live(rest), ...Array.from({ length: rows }, (): CommandTargetInfo => TRASH_TARGET)];
}

let last: { snapshot: OrganizeSnapshot; view: TrashView; model: OrganizeModel } | null = null;
/**
 * The organize model of the trash view (Q-6a): the live tree and tags, with the trashed items' places and tags — what the
 * read-only item panel, the table's colour dots and the tag selector and filter read there. One model per snapshot and read.
 */
export function trashModelFor(snapshot: OrganizeSnapshot, view: TrashView): OrganizeModel {
  if (last && last.snapshot === snapshot && last.view === view) return last.model;
  const model = buildOrganizeModel({ ...snapshot, members: view.members, tagged: view.tagged, duplicates: [] }, view.items);
  last = { snapshot, view, model };
  return model;
}
```

**(p)** 새 파일 `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/trash/trashActions.ts`:
```ts
import type { ConfirmPurgeInput, PurgeVariant, PurgedRows, TrashView } from '@learn/domain';
import type { TrashRows } from '../commands/registry';
import { t } from '../strings';

/** Everything the trash's actions touch outside themselves, so they run in a test without a window (trash/actions.ts wires it). */
export interface TrashDeps {
  /** library.trash: how many items went (one deletion stamp per call). */
  trash(itemIds: string[]): Promise<number>;
  /** library.restore: how many items came back. */
  restoreItems(itemIds: string[]): Promise<number>;
  restoreCollection(collectionId: string): Promise<void>;
  purge(rows: TrashRows): Promise<PurgedRows>;
  emptyTrash(): Promise<PurgedRows>;
  /** The trash as it is now: 휴지통 비우기… from another view has no read of it yet. */
  readTrash(): Promise<TrashView>;
  /** The purge sheet (P-25): true when its destructive button was pressed. */
  confirmPurge(input: ConfirmPurgeInput): Promise<boolean>;
  /** A live item's title, for the toast that names one item. */
  titleOf(itemId: string): string | undefined;
  /** Takes the trashed items out of the cached list at once (spec 14: ⌘⌫ → the redrawn table ≤ 300 ms); the notice's read follows. */
  dropFromList(itemIds: readonly string[]): void;
  toast(title: string, testId: string): void;
  undoToast(title: string, undo: () => Promise<void>): void;
  failed(e: unknown): void;
}

export interface TrashActions {
  /** 휴지통으로 이동 (spec 4.1). */
  trashItems(itemIds: readonly string[]): Promise<void>;
  /** 복원 (spec 4.4); `quiet` from the reader, which reopens the item instead of a toast. */
  restore(rows: TrashRows, opts?: { quiet?: boolean }): Promise<void>;
  /** 영구 삭제… (spec 4.5). */
  purge(rows: TrashRows): Promise<void>;
  /** 휴지통 비우기… (spec 4.5). */
  emptyTrash(): Promise<void>;
}

/** What a purge sheet asks about. */
export const purgeVariant = (items: number, collections: number): PurgeVariant => (items > 0 && collections > 0 ? 'mixed' : collections > 0 ? 'collections' : 'items');

export function createTrashActions(deps: TrashDeps): TrashActions {
  /** The sheet's answer; a sheet that could not open is told and is a no. */
  const ask = async (input: ConfirmPurgeInput): Promise<boolean> => {
    try {
      return await deps.confirmPurge(input);
    } catch (e) {
      deps.failed(e);
      return false;
    }
  };
  return {
    async trashItems(itemIds) {
      const ids = [...new Set(itemIds)];
      if (ids.length === 0) return;
      const one = ids.length === 1 ? deps.titleOf(ids[0]!) : undefined;
      let moved: number;
      try {
        moved = await deps.trash(ids);
      } catch (e) {
        deps.failed(e);
        return;
      }
      if (moved === 0) return;
      deps.dropFromList(ids);
      deps.undoToast(one !== undefined ? t.trash.movedOne(one) : t.trash.moved(moved), async () => {
        await deps.restoreItems(ids);
      });
    },

    async restore({ itemIds, collectionIds }, opts = {}) {
      let restored = 0;
      try {
        if (itemIds.length > 0) restored += await deps.restoreItems([...itemIds]);
        for (const id of collectionIds) {
          await deps.restoreCollection(id);
          restored += 1;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        deps.failed(e);
      }
      if (restored > 0 && !opts.quiet) deps.toast(t.trash.restored(restored), 'restore-done');
    },

    async purge({ itemIds, collectionIds }) {
      const items = itemIds.length;
      const collections = collectionIds.length;
      if (items + collections === 0) return;
      if (!(await ask({ variant: purgeVariant(items, collections), items, collections }))) return;
      let done: PurgedRows;
      try {
        done = await deps.purge({ itemIds: [...itemIds], collectionIds: [...collectionIds] });
      } catch (e) {
        deps.failed(e);
        return;
      }
      if (done.itemIds.length + done.collectionIds.length > 0) deps.toast(t.trash.purged(done.itemIds.length, done.collectionIds.length), 'purge-done');
    },

    async emptyTrash() {
      let view: TrashView;
      try {
        view = await deps.readTrash();
      } catch (e) {
        deps.failed(e);
        return;
      }
      if (view.items.length + view.collections.length === 0) return;
      if (!(await ask({ variant: 'empty', items: view.items.length, collections: view.collections.length }))) return;
      try {
        await deps.emptyTrash();
      } catch (e) {
        deps.failed(e);
        return;
      }
      deps.toast(t.trash.emptied, 'purge-done');
    },
  };
}
```

**(q)** 새 파일 `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/trash/actions.ts`:
```ts
import type { LibraryItem } from '@learn/domain';
import { api, unwrap } from '../api';
import { keys, putItems } from '../data/queries';
import { queryClient } from '../data/query-client';
import { inChunks } from '../organize/membership';
import { askInSheet } from '../ui/sheetAsk';
import { showActionFailed, showToast, showUndoToast } from '../ui/toasts';
import { createTrashActions } from './trashActions';

/** library.trash and library.restore take 5,000 ids a call (itemIdsInput): a larger selection goes in parts. */
async function inParts(ids: readonly string[], call: (part: string[]) => Promise<number>): Promise<number> {
  let n = 0;
  for (const part of inChunks(ids)) n += await call(part);
  return n;
}

/** The window's trash actions: the registry env, the sidebar's drop target and the reader's notice share them. */
export const trashActions = createTrashActions({
  trash: (itemIds) => inParts(itemIds, (part) => unwrap(api().library.trash({ itemIds: part }))),
  restoreItems: (itemIds) => inParts(itemIds, (part) => unwrap(api().library.restore({ itemIds: part }))),
  restoreCollection: async (collectionId) => void (await unwrap(api().collections.restore({ collectionId }))),
  purge: (rows) => unwrap(api().library.purge(rows)),
  emptyTrash: () => unwrap(api().library.emptyTrash()),
  readTrash: () => queryClient.fetchQuery({ queryKey: keys.trash, queryFn: () => unwrap(api().library.trashView()), staleTime: 0 }),
  confirmPurge: (input) => askInSheet(() => unwrap(api().ui.confirmPurge(input))),
  titleOf: (itemId) => queryClient.getQueryData<LibraryItem[]>(keys.items)?.find((i) => i.id === itemId)?.title,
  dropFromList: (itemIds) => {
    const prev = queryClient.getQueryData<LibraryItem[]>(keys.items);
    if (!prev) return;
    const gone = new Set(itemIds);
    putItems(queryClient, prev, prev.filter((i) => !gone.has(i.id)));
  },
  toast: (title, testId) => void showToast({ kind: 'success', title, testId }),
  undoToast: (title, undo) => void showUndoToast(title, undo, { testId: 'trash-undo' }),
  failed: showActionFailed,
});
```

**(a)** 새 파일 `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/trash/useTrashSource.ts`:
```ts
import { useDeferredValue, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import type { LibraryItem, TrashedCollection } from '@learn/domain';
import { useItems, useTrashView } from '../data/queries';
import type { LibrarySort } from '../library/sort';
import type { OrganizeModel } from '../organize/model';
import { SCOPE_ALL } from '../organize/scope';
import { useOrganize } from '../organize/useOrganize';
import { useLibrary } from '../state/library-store';
import { trashCollectionRows, trashModelFor } from './trashRows';

const NONE: readonly TrashedCollection[] = Object.freeze([]);

/** The trash view shows (spec 4.3): it was chosen, and the trash has something — an empty trash has no view (resolveScope). */
export function useInTrash(): boolean {
  const chosen = useLibrary((s) => s.scope.kind === 'trash');
  const count = useOrganize().model?.trashCount ?? 0;
  return chosen && count > 0;
}

/** The trash view's read (P-8, library:trashView), only while it shows. */
export function useTrash() {
  return useTrashView(useInTrash());
}

/** The list the library view shows: the trashed items in the trash view, else the library's live items. */
export function useViewItems(): readonly LibraryItem[] | undefined {
  const inTrash = useInTrash();
  const live = useItems().data;
  const trash = useTrashView(inTrash).data;
  return inTrash ? trash?.items : live;
}

/** The organize model of the view shown: the trash's (its items' places and tags, Q-6a) in the trash view, else the library's. */
export function useViewModel(): OrganizeModel | undefined {
  const inTrash = useInTrash();
  const { snapshot, model } = useOrganize();
  const trash = useTrashView(inTrash).data;
  return useMemo(() => (!inTrash ? model : snapshot && trash ? trashModelFor(snapshot, trash) : undefined), [inTrash, model, snapshot, trash]);
}

/**
 * The trash view's collection rows (spec 4.3): all of them (the count), and those the quick search and the tag filter leave,
 * in `sort` (the table and the toolbar). None in any other view. `query` is the deferred one the table's rows use.
 */
export function useTrashCollectionRows(sort: LibrarySort): { all: readonly TrashedCollection[]; shown: readonly TrashedCollection[]; query: string } {
  const inTrash = useInTrash();
  const view = useTrashView(inTrash).data;
  const query = useDeferredValue(useLibrary((s) => s.query));
  const tagFiltered = useLibrary((s) => s.tagFilter.size > 0);
  const all = inTrash ? (view?.collections ?? NONE) : NONE;
  const shown = useMemo(() => (all.length === 0 ? NONE : trashCollectionRows(all, { sort, query, tagFiltered })), [all, sort, query, tagFiltered]);
  return { all, shown, query };
}

/** An emptied trash closes its view for good (spec 4.3: no empty state — the last row restored or purged goes to 내 라이브러리). */
export function useLeaveEmptyTrash(): void {
  const chosen = useLibrary((s) => s.scope.kind === 'trash');
  const { model } = useOrganize();
  const emptied = model !== undefined && model.trashCount === 0;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (chosen && emptied) useLibrary.getState().setScope(SCOPE_ALL);
  }, [chosen, emptied]);
}

/** An import asked for in the trash view shows the library it lands in (the approved mockup: the trash has no 가져오기, Q-6i). */
export function leaveTrashView(): void {
  const s = useLibrary.getState();
  if (s.scope.kind === 'trash') s.setScope(SCOPE_ALL);
}
```

```tsx
import { purgeText, type PurgePayload } from './purgeText';

/**
 * 영구 삭제… / 휴지통 비우기… (P-25; dialogs.html?scene=purge, ?scene=empty-trash): an app sheet, as a native message box can
 * neither draw a destructive button nor keep 취소 the default. ↩ and esc are 취소; the destructive verb, in danger text on the
 * left, takes a press (or Tab, then Space).

export function PurgeSheet({ payload }: { payload: PurgePayload }) {
  const answer = (confirmed: boolean) => resolveSheet({ kind: 'purge', confirmed });

        <span className="spacer" />

}
```

**(f)** `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/library/LibraryView.tsx` 전체:
```tsx
import { useLayoutEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import type { LibraryItem } from '@learn/domain';
import { resolveScope } from '../organize/scope';
import { ScopeEmpty } from '../sidebar/ScopeEmpty';
import { useLibrary } from '../state/library-store';
import { TagFilterEmpty } from '../tags/TagFilterEmpty';
import { useTrashCollectionRows, useViewModel } from '../trash/useTrashSource';
import { perfMarkLatest } from '../ui/perfMarks';
import { countRender } from '../ui/renderCount';
import { LibraryTable } from './LibraryTable';
import { SearchEmpty } from './SearchEmpty';
import { useLibraryRows } from './useLibraryRows';
import { useLibrarySettings } from './useLibrarySettings';
import { usePaintMark } from './usePaintMark';

/** The trash view opens nothing (spec 4.3): ↩ and a double-click on its rows do nothing. */
const OPENS_NOTHING = (): void => {};

/** The library view's content area: the table in the stored columns and sort, in the scope shown, filtered by the tags and the quick search. */
export function LibraryView({ items, onOpen, onItemMenu }: { items: readonly LibraryItem[]; onOpen(itemId: string): void; onItemMenu(ids: readonly string[], x: number, y: number): void }) {
  // Where a long frame's script time goes (the drop stall profile): this view's render began here.
  perfMarkLatest('table:render');
  countRender('LibraryView');
  const settings = useLibrarySettings();
  const scopeReady = useLibrary((s) => s.scopeReady);
  const { rows, titleMatches, view } = useLibraryRows(items);
  // The trash view's collection rows (spec 4.3, P-9): above its items in the same table; none in any other view.
  const collections = useTrashCollectionRows(settings.sort);
  // The frame that paints these rows (spec 9: input → paint, sort → paint, list → first rows). Before the stored columns
  // and sort are read the view draws nothing, so nothing is marked.
  usePaintMark('table:painted', settings.ready ? rows : null, 'table:first-paint');
  // Rows that left the list (and, from the search, the ones it hides) leave the selection before the frame is
  // painted: no command then acts on a row that is not on screen (spec 3.3).
  const pruneSelected = useLibrary((s) => s.pruneSelected);
  useLayoutEffect(() => pruneSelected(new Set([...collections.shown.map((c) => c.id), ...rows.map((r) => r.id)])), [rows, collections.shown, pruneSelected]);
  // A query typed and no row left (the deferred result): the no-results state in the body's place, under the header.
  const query = useLibrary((s) => s.query).trim();
  const shownRows = rows.length + collections.shown.length;
  const noResults = titleMatches !== null && shownRows === 0 && query !== '';
  const revealId = useLibrary((s) => s.lastOpenedId);
  const chosen = useLibrary((s) => s.scope);
  const tagFilterSize = useLibrary((s) => s.tagFilter.size);
  const model = useViewModel();
  const scope = useMemo(() => resolveScope(model, chosen), [model, chosen]);
  const trash = scope.kind === 'trash';
  // A view with nothing in it and nothing that would explain it (spec 3.6). The trash has none: emptied, it closes.
  const scopeEmpty = rows.length === 0 && query === '' && tagFilterSize === 0 && scope.kind !== 'all' && !trash;
  // The chosen tags leave no item and the search says nothing else: the filter's own empty state (spec 3.6).
  const tagEmpty = shownRows === 0 && query === '' && tagFilterSize > 0;
  const scopeName = scope.kind === 'collection' ? (model?.node(scope.id)?.name ?? '') : '';
  if (!settings.ready || !scopeReady) return null; // the stored columns, sort and view: one IPC round trip each, already in flight while the list loaded (LibraryLoading)
  return (
    <LibraryTable
      rows={rows}
      collectionRows={collections.shown}
      collectionQuery={collections.query}
      draggable={!trash}
      columns={settings.columns}
      forced={settings.forced}
      sort={settings.sort}
      onSortChange={settings.setSort}
      onColumnsChange={settings.setColumns}
      onOpen={trash ? OPENS_NOTHING : onOpen}
      onContextMenu={onItemMenu}
      revealId={revealId}
      titleMatches={titleMatches}
      tagsOf={model?.tagsOfItem}
      empty={noResults ? <SearchEmpty query={query} view={view.scope.kind === 'all' ? null : view.label} tagCount={tagFilterSize} /> : scopeEmpty ? <ScopeEmpty scope={scope} name={scopeName} /> : tagEmpty ? <TagFilterEmpty /> : undefined}
    />
  );
}
```

**(i)** `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/library/useLibrarySettings.ts` 전체:
```ts
import { useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { TRASH_COLUMNS, type ColumnConfig, type LibraryColumnId } from '@learn/domain';
import { api, unwrap } from '../api';
import { keys } from '../data/queries';
import { saveSetting } from '../data/saveSetting';
import { useLibrary } from '../state/library-store';
import { useInTrash } from '../trash/useTrashSource';
import { parseColumnConfig } from './columns';
import { DEFAULT_SORT, DEFAULT_SORT_RECENT, DEFAULT_SORT_TRASH, parseSort, type LibrarySort } from './sort';

const NO_COLUMNS: readonly LibraryColumnId[] = [];
/** The recent view always shows when each item was opened (spec 3.2). */
const RECENT_COLUMNS: readonly LibraryColumnId[] = ['openedAt'];
/** 삭제한 날짜 is the trash view's only (M6 spec 4.3): a sort by it stored for another view reads as that view's default. */
const outsideTrash = (sort: LibrarySort, fallback: LibrarySort): LibrarySort => (sort.column === 'deletedAt' ? fallback : sort);

/**
 * The table's columns and sort (library settings, ADR-0007 (b)): parsed values, defaults when unset or unreadable.
 * `sort` and `setSort` are those of the scope shown: the recent view has a sort of its own (`library.sort.recent`), the trash
 * view too (`library.sort.trash`, read the first time it shows), every other view shares `library.sort`. `forced` are the
 * columns the scope shows whatever the stored columns say. `ready` once the reads it needs have settled, so the table never
 * paints the default columns for a frame before the stored ones.
 */
export function useLibrarySettings(): {
  columns: ColumnConfig;
  sort: LibrarySort;
  forced: readonly LibraryColumnId[];
  setColumns(next: ColumnConfig): void;
  setSort(next: LibrarySort): void;
  ready: boolean;
} {
  const recent = useLibrary((s) => s.scope.kind === 'recent');
  const trash = useInTrash();
  const columnsRead = useQuery({ queryKey: keys.columns, queryFn: () => unwrap(api().settings.get({ key: 'library.columns' })) });
  const sortRead = useQuery({ queryKey: keys.sort, queryFn: () => unwrap(api().settings.get({ key: 'library.sort' })) });
  const recentRead = useQuery({ queryKey: keys.sortRecent, queryFn: () => unwrap(api().settings.get({ key: 'library.sort.recent' })) });
  const trashRead = useQuery({ queryKey: keys.sortTrash, queryFn: () => unwrap(api().settings.get({ key: 'library.sort.trash' })), enabled: trash });
  const columns = useMemo(() => parseColumnConfig(columnsRead.data ?? null), [columnsRead.data]);
  const sortAll = useMemo(() => outsideTrash(parseSort(sortRead.data ?? null), DEFAULT_SORT), [sortRead.data]);
  const sortRecent = useMemo(() => outsideTrash(parseSort(recentRead.data ?? null, DEFAULT_SORT_RECENT), DEFAULT_SORT_RECENT), [recentRead.data]);
  const sortTrash = useMemo(() => parseSort(trashRead.data ?? null, DEFAULT_SORT_TRASH), [trashRead.data]);
  const setColumns = useCallback((next: ColumnConfig) => saveSetting('library.columns', next), []);
  const setSort = useCallback((next: LibrarySort) => saveSetting(trash ? 'library.sort.trash' : recent ? 'library.sort.recent' : 'library.sort', next), [recent, trash]);
  return {
    columns,
    sort: trash ? sortTrash : recent ? sortRecent : sortAll,
    forced: trash ? TRASH_COLUMNS : recent ? RECENT_COLUMNS : NO_COLUMNS,
    setColumns,
    setSort,
    ready: !columnsRead.isPending && !sortRead.isPending && !recentRead.isPending && (!trash || !trashRead.isPending),
  };
}
```

```tsx
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { Clapperboard, FileText, Files, Folder, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { commandById, type TrashedCollection, type TrashedItem } from '@learn/domain';
import { useCommands } from '../commands/CommandProvider';
import type { CommandTarget } from '../commands/registry';
import { formatDate } from '../format';
import { sortItems } from '../library/sort';
import { useLibrarySettings } from '../library/useLibrarySettings';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { Icon } from '../ui/Icon';
import { useNow } from '../useNow';
import { multiSummary } from './summary';

/** Titles a multiple selection lists before "외 N개" (as InfoPane's). */
const MULTI_TITLES = 8;

/** 복원 in the panel head (the approved mockup: the default button, in 열기's place). */
export function RestoreButton({ target }: { target: CommandTarget }) {
  const { run, isEnabled } = useCommands();
  return (
    <Button variant="primary" testId="inspector-restore" isDisabled={!isEnabled('item.restore', target)} disabledReason={t.common.busy} onPress={() => run('item.restore', target)}>
      {commandById('item.restore').label}
    </Button>
  );
}

/** Under 복원: where the row is and since when; rows trashed at different times say only where. */
export function TrashNote({ at }: { at: string | null }) {
  const now = useNow();
  const text = at === null ? t.trash.panel.noteMixed : t.trash.panel.note(formatDate(at, now));
  return (
    <div className="trash-note" data-testid="trash-note">
      <Icon icon={Trash2} size="sm" />
      <span className="ellipsis" title={text}>
        {text}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Several trash rows, or one trashed collection (spec 4.3, dialogs.html?scene=purge's panel): read-only — the kinds and the
 * count, the titles, 복원 and the trash line; no tag or collection sections.
 */
export function TrashSelection({ items, collections }: { items: readonly TrashedItem[]; collections: readonly TrashedCollection[] }) {
  const { sort } = useLibrarySettings();
  const one = items.length === 0 && collections.length === 1 ? collections[0]! : undefined;
  const target = useMemo<CommandTarget>(() => ({ itemIds: items.map((i) => i.id), collectionIds: collections.map((c) => c.id) }), [items, collections]);
  const titles = useMemo(
    () => [
      ...collections.map((c) => ({ id: c.id, title: c.name, icon: Folder })),
      ...sortItems(items, sort).map((i) => ({ id: i.id, title: i.title, icon: i.type === 'video' ? Clapperboard : FileText })),
    ],
    [items, collections, sort],
  );
  const times = new Set([...items.map((i) => i.deletedAt), ...collections.map((c) => c.deletedAt)]);
  const kind = one
    ? t.trash.panel.collectionKind(one.itemCount)
    : [items.length > 0 ? multiSummary(items) : '', collections.length > 0 ? t.trash.panel.collections(collections.length) : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
  return (
    <div className="inspector-scroll" data-testid="inspector-trash">
      <header className="item-head">
        <div className="kind" data-testid="inspector-kind">
          <Icon icon={one ? Folder : Files} size="sm" />
          <span className="num">{kind}</span>
        </div>
        <h2>{one ? one.name : t.trash.panel.selected(items.length, collections.length)}</h2>
        {!one && (
          <ul className="multi-list">
            {titles.slice(0, MULTI_TITLES).map((row) => (
              <li key={row.id} className="multi-row" data-testid="multi-row">
                <Icon icon={row.icon} size="sm" />
                <span className="ellipsis" title={row.title}>
                  {row.title}
                </span>
              </li>
            ))}
            {titles.length > MULTI_TITLES && <li className="multi-more">{t.inspector.more(titles.length - MULTI_TITLES)}</li>}
          </ul>
        )}
        <div className="actions">
          <RestoreButton target={target} />
        </div>
        <TrashNote at={times.size === 1 ? [...times][0]! : null} />
      </header>
    </div>
  );
}
```

**(m)** 메뉴 명령·팔레트:
- `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/commands/useMenuCommands.ts`:
```ts
import { useLearnEvent } from '../events';
import { closePalette } from '../palette/Palette';
import { useShell } from '../state/shell-store';
import { isEditing } from './keymap';
import { menuTarget, runCommand, yieldsToText, type CommandEnv } from './registry';

/**
 * Application-menu clicks and accelerators arrive as menuCommand; the registry decides whether they apply now. A menu
 * command while the palette is open closes it first, then runs from where the focus was (ADR-0005 §5); ⌘K itself
 * keeps it open and selects its field. An item command runs on the table's selection (menuTarget), read as it runs.
 * A submenu row's value (`args`) joins the target. ⌘⌫ and ⇧⌘⌫ that reached the menu from a focused text field are the
 * field's (delete to the line's start), never the trash's (Q-6e); a click on the item still runs it.
 */
export function useMenuCommands(env: CommandEnv): void {
  useLearnEvent('menuCommand', ({ commandId, args, byKey }) => {
    if (byKey && yieldsToText(commandId) && isEditing(document.activeElement)) return;
    const run = () => runCommand(commandId, env, { ...menuTarget(commandId, env), ...(args ? { args } : {}) });
    if (commandId !== 'app.palette' && useShell.getState().paletteOpen) closePalette(run);
    else run();
  });
}
```
