`tests/e2e/helpers.ts`:
- `KEY_CODE`: `export const KEY_CODE = { return: 36, escape: 53, delete: 51 } as const;`(51 = ⌫).
- `runMenuCommand` 다음에:
```ts
/**
 * Clicks an application-menu item as its accelerator would (`triggeredByAccelerator`): CDP keys never reach native
 * accelerators on Linux, and the page tells a key from a click (Q-6e: ⌘⌫ typed in a text field is the field's).
 */
export async function runMenuAccelerator(app: ElectronApplication, id: CommandId): Promise<void> {
  await expect.poll(() => menuItemEnabled(app, id), { timeout: 5_000, message: `menu item ${id} never became clickable` }).toBe(true);
  await app.evaluate(({ BrowserWindow, Menu, webContents }, id) => {
    const item = Menu.getApplicationMenu()?.getMenuItemById(id);
    if (!item?.enabled || !item.visible) throw new Error(`menu item ${id} is not clickable`);
    item.click({ triggeredByAccelerator: true } as Electron.KeyboardEvent, BrowserWindow.getFocusedWindow() ?? undefined, webContents.getFocusedWebContents() ?? undefined);
  }, id);
}
```

새 파일 `tests/e2e/trash.spec.ts`:
```ts
// M6 Task 6: the trash on screen (spec 4.1–4.6, 11; P-7, P-9–P-11, P-25). The data under it is trash-data.spec.ts (Task 5).
// ⌘ shortcuts go through the menu (runMenuCommand / runMenuAccelerator): CDP keys never reach native accelerators on Linux.
import { expect, test, type ElectronApplication, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import {
  addToCollection, assignTag, clickToCloseSheet, closeSheet, createCollection, createTag, distinctPdfs, expectWindow, importPaths, launch, menuSnapshot,
  organizeSnapshot, recordedPopups, rowByTitle, runMenuAccelerator, runMenuCommand, specialRow, stubContextMenu, stubOpenDialog, tagChip, trashItems, treeRow,
  type MenuNode,
} from './helpers';
import { beginDrag, dragTo, hover, marked, release } from './dnd-helpers';

const MOD = process.platform === 'darwin' ? 'Meta' : 'Control';
const flat = (nodes: MenuNode[]): MenuNode[] => nodes.flatMap((n) => [n, ...flat(n.submenu ?? [])]);
const menuLabel = async (app: ElectronApplication, id: string) => flat(await menuSnapshot(app)).find((n) => n.id === id)?.label ?? null;
const liveIds = (page: Page) => page.evaluate(async () => {
  const r = await window.learn.library.list();
  return r.ok ? r.data.map((i) => i.id).sort() : [];
});
const trashed = (page: Page) => page.evaluate(async () => {
  const r = await window.learn.library.trashView();
  return r.ok ? { items: r.data.items.map((i) => i.title).sort(), collections: r.data.collections.map((c) => c.name).sort() } : null;
});
const collectionRow = (page: Page, name: string) => page.locator(`[data-testid="trash-collection-row"][data-title=${JSON.stringify(name)}]`);
const title = (page: Page) => page.getByTestId('toolbar-title');
const toTrash = (page: Page, collectionId: string) => page.evaluate((id) => window.learn.collections.remove({ collectionId: id }), collectionId);

/**
 * Three items; 학회 준비 › 발표 holding distinct-03 (which stays in the library: the collection row says 자료 1개); the tag
 * 시험 범위 on distinct-02 and 기말 on distinct-03. The tests move distinct-01 and distinct-02 to the trash.
 */
async function seed(page: Page, dir: string) {
  const items = await importPaths(page, distinctPdfs(dir, 3));
  const conf = await createCollection(page, '학회 준비');
  const talk = await createCollection(page, '발표', conf);
  await addToCollection(page, conf, [items[2]!.id]);
  const exam = await createTag(page, '시험 범위');
  const finals = await createTag(page, '기말');
  await assignTag(page, exam, [items[1]!.id]);
  await assignTag(page, finals, [items[2]!.id]);
  return { items, conf, talk, exam, finals };
}

test('⌘⌫ moves the selection at once with 실행 취소, the trash row shows with its count, one item is named, and 파일 names the line by the view', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(testInfo.outputPath('library'), testInfo.outputPath('userdata'));
  try {
    const items = await importPaths(page, distinctPdfs(testInfo.outputPath('in'), 3));
    await expect(specialRow(page, 'trash')).toHaveCount(0); // an empty trash has no row (spec 4.3)
    await rowByTitle(page, 'distinct-01').click();
    await rowByTitle(page, 'distinct-02').click({ modifiers: [MOD] });
    expect(await menuLabel(app, 'item.trash')).toBe('휴지통으로 이동');
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'item.trash');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('trash-undo')).toContainText('자료 2개를 휴지통으로 옮겼습니다');
    await expect(rowByTitle(page, 'distinct-01')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(specialRow(page, 'trash').locator('.count')).toHaveText('2');
    expect(await liveIds(page)).toEqual([items[2]!.id]);
    // 실행 취소 brings back exactly those two, and the trash row goes with the trash.
    await page.getByTestId('trash-undo').getByTestId('undo-action').click();
    await expect(rowByTitle(page, 'distinct-02')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(specialRow(page, 'trash')).toHaveCount(0);
    expect(await liveIds(page)).toEqual(items.map((i) => i.id).sort());
    // One item is named.
    await rowByTitle(page, 'distinct-03').click();
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'item.trash');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('trash-undo')).toContainText('‘distinct-03’⁠을 휴지통으로 옮겼습니다');
    // In the trash view the same line is 영구 삭제… (P-11).
    await specialRow(page, 'trash').click();
    await expect(title(page)).toHaveText('휴지통');
    await expect.poll(() => menuLabel(app, 'item.trash')).toBe('영구 삭제…');
    await specialRow(page, 'all').click();
    await expect.poll(() => menuLabel(app, 'item.trash')).toBe('휴지통으로 이동');
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

    expect(popup.map((i) => (i.type === 'separator' ? '-' : i.label))).toEqual(['복원', '-', '영구 삭제…']);
    await expect.poll(async () => (await organizeSnapshot(page)).collections.map((c) => c.id).sort()).toEqual([conf, talk].sort());
    await expect(treeRow(page, conf)).toBeVisible();
    // The keyboard: the row's menu by ⇧F10, 복원 picked.
    await rowByTitle(page, 'distinct-01').click();
    await page.keyboard.press('Shift+F10');
    await expect.poll(async () => (await trashed(page))?.items).toEqual(['distinct-02']);
    // The panel's 복원 on the last row: the trash empties and its view goes to 내 라이브러리.
    await rowByTitle(page, 'distinct-02').click();
    await page.getByTestId('inspector-restore').click();
    await expect(title(page)).toHaveText('내 라이브러리');
    await expect(specialRow(page, 'trash')).toHaveCount(0);
    expect(await liveIds(page)).toEqual(items.map((i) => i.id).sort());
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('영구 삭제… asks in the app sheet — ↩ and esc keep, the danger button on the left deletes; 휴지통 비우기… (⇧⌘⌫) empties and the view goes to 내 라이브러리', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(testInfo.outputPath('library'), testInfo.outputPath('userdata'));
  try {
    const { items, conf } = await seed(page, testInfo.outputPath('in'));
    await trashItems(page, [items[0]!.id, items[1]!.id]);
    await toTrash(page, conf);
    await specialRow(page, 'trash').click();
    await rowByTitle(page, 'distinct-01').click();
    for (const key of ['Enter', 'Escape'] as const) {
      const sheet = await expectWindow(app, 'sheet', () => runMenuCommand(app, 'item.trash'));
      await expect(sheet.getByTestId('purge-title')).toHaveText('자료 1개를 영구히 삭제하겠습니까?');
      await expect(sheet.getByTestId('purge-text')).toHaveText('되돌릴 수 없습니다. 라이브러리 안의 사본도 지웁니다. 외부 연결 원본은 지우지 않습니다.');
      await expect(sheet.getByTestId('purge-cancel')).toBeFocused();
      const [danger, cancel] = await Promise.all([sheet.getByTestId('purge-confirm').boundingBox(), sheet.getByTestId('purge-cancel').boundingBox()]);
      expect(danger!.x).toBeLessThan(cancel!.x);
      await closeSheet(sheet, key);
      await expect(rowByTitle(page, 'distinct-01')).toBeVisible();
    }
    const sheet = await expectWindow(app, 'sheet', () => runMenuCommand(app, 'item.trash'));
    await clickToCloseSheet(sheet, sheet.getByTestId('purge-confirm'));
    await expect(page.getByTestId('purge-done')).toHaveText('자료 1개를 영구히 삭제했습니다');
    await expect(rowByTitle(page, 'distinct-01')).toHaveCount(0);
    expect(await trashed(page)).toEqual({ items: ['distinct-02'], collections: ['학회 준비'] });
    // A collection row and an item together: the mixed question (esc keeps them).
    await collectionRow(page, '학회 준비').click();
    await rowByTitle(page, 'distinct-02').click({ modifiers: [MOD] });
    const mixed = await expectWindow(app, 'sheet', () => runMenuCommand(app, 'item.trash'));
    await expect(mixed.getByTestId('purge-title')).toHaveText('자료 1개와 컬렉션 1개를 영구히 삭제하겠습니까?');
    await closeSheet(mixed, 'Escape');
    // 휴지통 비우기…: the whole trash, counted; then no trash, and 내 라이브러리.
    const empty = await expectWindow(app, 'sheet', () => runMenuCommand(app, 'trash.empty'));
    await expect(empty.getByTestId('purge-title')).toHaveText('휴지통을 비우겠습니까?');
    await expect(empty.getByTestId('purge-text')).toHaveText('자료 1개와 컬렉션 1개를 영구히 지웁니다. 되돌릴 수 없습니다. 외부 연결 원본은 지우지 않습니다.');
    await expect(empty.getByTestId('purge-confirm')).toHaveText('휴지통 비우기');
    await clickToCloseSheet(empty, empty.getByTestId('purge-confirm'));
    await expect(page.getByTestId('purge-done')).toHaveText('휴지통을 비웠습니다');
    await expect(title(page)).toHaveText('내 라이브러리');
    await expect(specialRow(page, 'trash')).toHaveCount(0);
    expect(await trashed(page)).toEqual({ items: [], collections: [] });
    expect(await liveIds(page)).toEqual([items[2]!.id]);
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('table rows and a collection row dropped on 휴지통 go to the trash, with 실행 취소', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(testInfo.outputPath('library'), testInfo.outputPath('userdata'));

    await expect(treeRow(page, conf)).toHaveCount(0);

  } finally {

  }
});

test('⌘⌫ typed in the quick search stays the field\'s; the menu item clicked still moves the selection; an import from the trash view shows 내 라이브러리', async ({}, testInfo) => {

  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});
```

`tests/e2e/visual/tour.spec.ts` — 머리 import에 `trashItems`를 더하고(`setTagColor` 다음), `organize: the tag selector …` 정거장 앞에:
```ts
// M6: the trash. Pairs for the critic: library.html?state=trash (the sidebar row, a collection row on top, 삭제한 날짜 last,
// 휴지통 비우기… in the head, a row's read-only panel), dialogs.html?scene=purge and ?scene=empty-trash (the app sheet),
// reader-pdf.html?state=trashed (the stage notice) and components.html?part=1 (the undo toast).
test('trash: the undo toast, the trash view and its read-only panel, the purge and empty-trash sheets, the reader notice', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const s = await launchTour(testInfo.outputPath());
  // The days in the table (added, trashed), the trash line's time, and what moves in the item panel.
  const dates = () => [s.page.locator('[role="row"] :is([data-col="createdAt"], [data-col="deletedAt"])'), s.page.getByTestId('trash-note'), ...panelMasks(s.page)];
  try {
    const items = await importPaths(s.page, library(testInfo.outputPath('videos')));
    const conf = await createCollection(s.page, '학회 준비');
    await createCollection(s.page, '발표', conf);
    await addToCollection(s.page, conf, [items[0]!.id]);
    const exam = await createTag(s.page, '시험 범위');
    await assignTag(s.page, exam, [items[1]!.id]);
    await setTheme(s.page, 'light');

    // ⌘⌫ on one row: the undo toast names it. Shot at once: a success toast closes 5 s after it first paints.
    await rowByTitle(s.page, items[1]!.title).click();
    await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'item.trash');
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('trash-undo')).toBeVisible();
    await shoot(s.page, 'toast-trash-undo-light', { mask: dates() });

    // The trash view: one collection row (발표 inside it), two items; the first trashed item selected, its read-only panel.
    await trashItems(s.page, [items[2]!.id]);
    await s.page.evaluate((id) => window.learn.collections.remove({ collectionId: id }), conf);
    await specialRow(s.page, 'trash').click();
    await rowByTitle(s.page, items[1]!.title).click();
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('inspector-restore')).toBeVisible();
    await panelSettled(s.page, /^PDF/);
    for (const theme of THEMES) {
      await setTheme(s.page, theme);
      await shoot(s.page, `trash-view-${theme}`, { mask: dates() });
    }

    // 영구 삭제… on that row, and 휴지통 비우기….
    for (const theme of THEMES) {
      await setTheme(s.page, theme);
      const purge = await expectWindow(s.app, 'sheet', () => runMenuCommand(s.app, 'item.trash'));
      await shoot(purge, `sheet-purge-${theme}`);
      await closeSheet(purge, 'Escape');
      await expect.poll(() => menuItemEnabled(s.app, 'trash.empty')).toBe(true);
      const empty = await expectWindow(s.app, 'sheet', () => runMenuCommand(s.app, 'trash.empty'));
      await shoot(empty, `sheet-empty-trash-${theme}`);
      await closeSheet(empty, 'Escape');
      await expect.poll(() => menuItemEnabled(s.app, 'item.trash')).toBe(true);
    }

    // The reader: its item moved to the trash.
    await setTheme(s.page, 'light');
    await specialRow(s.page, 'all').click();
    await openItem(s.page, items[0]!.title);
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('viewer-title')).toBeVisible();
    await trashItems(s.page, [items[0]!.id]);
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('reader-trashed')).toBeVisible();
    for (const theme of THEMES) {
      await setTheme(s.page, theme);
      await shoot(s.page, `reader-trashed-${theme}`);
    }
  } finally {
    await s.app.close();
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 14: Mac suite `p1` — 휴지통 시험 둘(판정 시험 앞)**

`tests/evidence/p1.evidence.ts`(Task 4 파일): `../e2e/helpers` import에 없는 것을 더한다 — `KEY_CODE, distinctPdfs, menuSnapshot, nativeKeyCode, rowByTitle, runMenuCommand, type MenuNode`. `test('M6 P1: verdict of every check above …'` 앞에:
```ts
test('M6 trash: ⌘⌫ (a real key on macOS) moves the selection with 실행 취소; typed in the quick search it is the field\'s', TAG, async () => {
  const [a, b] = await importPaths(s.page, distinctPdfs(path.join(tmp, 'trash'), 2));
  await s.page.getByTestId('nav-scope-all').click();
  await rowByTitle(s.page, a!.title).click();
  if (!IS_MAC) {
    // Linux: the menu item, so the next test has a trash; the real keys are macOS's.
    await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'item.trash');
    check('⌘⌫ (a real key): the selected row goes to the trash, with 실행 취소', null, 'macOS only');
    check('⌘⌫ typed in the quick search deletes its text and moves nothing (Q-6e)', null, 'macOS only');
    save();
    return;
  }
  await guard('⌘⌫ (a real key): the selected row goes to the trash, with 실행 취소', async () => {
    await nativeKeyCode(s.app, KEY_CODE.delete, ['command']);
    const toast = s.page.getByTestId('trash-undo');
    await expect(toast).toBeVisible();
    const v = { toast: await toast.textContent(), gone: (await rowByTitle(s.page, a!.title).count()) === 0 };
    results['trashKey'] = v;
    check('⌘⌫ (a real key): the selected row goes to the trash, with 실행 취소', v.gone && (v.toast ?? '').includes('휴지통으로 옮겼습니다'), v);
  });
  await guard('⌘⌫ typed in the quick search deletes its text and moves nothing (Q-6e)', async () => {
    await rowByTitle(s.page, b!.title).click();
    const field = s.page.getByTestId('search-field').getByRole('searchbox');
    await field.fill('distinct');
    await nativeKeyCode(s.app, KEY_CODE.delete, ['command']);
    await s.page.waitForTimeout(500);
    const live = await s.page.evaluate(async () => {
      const r = await window.learn.library.list();
      return r.ok ? r.data.map((i) => i.id) : [];
    });
    // `value` says whether AppKit gave the key to the field before the menu (empty) or the menu took it (the guard kept the items).
    const v = { value: await field.inputValue(), kept: live.includes(b!.id) };
    results['trashKeyInField'] = v;
    check('⌘⌫ typed in the quick search deletes its text and moves nothing (Q-6e)', v.kept && v.value === '', v);
    await field.fill('');
  });
  save();
});

test('M6 trash: the trash view and its read-only panel, ⌘⌫ named 영구 삭제… there, and the purge sheet (macOS: the real sheet) — light and dark', TAG, async () => {
  await s.page.getByTestId('nav-scope-trash').click();
  await expect(s.page.getByTestId('toolbar-title')).toHaveText('휴지통');
  await s.page.locator('[data-testid="item-row"]').first().click();
  await expect(s.page.getByTestId('inspector-restore')).toBeVisible();
  await guard('파일 › ⌘⌫ reads 영구 삭제… in the trash view (P-11)', async () => {
    const flat = (nodes: MenuNode[]): MenuNode[] => nodes.flatMap((n) => [n, ...flat(n.submenu ?? [])]);
    const label = async () => flat(await menuSnapshot(s.app)).find((n) => n.id === 'item.trash')?.label ?? null;
    await expect.poll(label).toBe('영구 삭제…');
    check('파일 › ⌘⌫ reads 영구 삭제… in the trash view (P-11)', true, { label: await label() });
  });
  for (const theme of ['light', 'dark'] as const) {
    await setTheme(theme);
    if (IS_MAC) await focusApp(s.app);
    await shots(s.page, `m6-10-trash-view-${theme}`, `the trash view, a row's read-only panel (${theme})`);
    const sheet = await expectWindow(s.app, 'sheet', () => runMenuCommand(s.app, 'item.trash'));
    await guard(`purge sheet (${theme}): 취소 has the focus, the danger verb on its left`, async () => {
      const [danger, cancel] = await Promise.all([sheet.getByTestId('purge-confirm').boundingBox(), sheet.getByTestId('purge-cancel').boundingBox()]);
      const v = { focused: await sheet.getByTestId('purge-cancel').evaluate((e) => e === document.activeElement), dangerLeft: (danger?.x ?? 0) < (cancel?.x ?? 0), title: await sheet.getByTestId('purge-title').textContent() };
      results[`purgeSheet-${theme}`] = v;
      check(`purge sheet (${theme}): 취소 has the focus, the danger verb on its left`, v.focused && v.dangerLeft, v);
    });
    await s.page.waitForTimeout(600);
    if (IS_MAC) await fullScreenShot(`m6-11-purge-sheet-${theme}`, `the purge sheet over the trash view (${theme})`);
    await closeSheet(sheet, 'Escape');
  }
  await setTheme('light');
  save();
});
```

---

## 작성자 제안 (Q-6x)

- **Q-6a `TrashView += members, tagged`(휴지통 자료의 자리와 태그).** 승인된 목업은 휴지통 항목 패널에 태그 칩·컬렉션 경로를, 태그 선택기에 "휴지통 안의 자료로 계산한 현재 보기"를 그린다. 그런데 정리 스냅샷(`members`·`tagged`)은 휴지통 자료를 빼므로(M5 규칙, 다른 보기에는 맞다) 화면이 그 사실을 알 길이 없다. `trashView()`가 같은 트랜잭션에서 두 표를 더 읽고(`trashPlaces`, 질의 둘), 렌더러가 그것으로 휴지통 보기의 모델(`trashModelFor`)을 만든다 — 패널·표의 색 점·태그 선택기·필터·검색의 태그 이름이 다른 보기와 같은 코드로 돈다. 받지 않으면: 휴지통에서 태그 선택기를 숨기고(목업과 다름), 패널은 `library.detail`의 `tags`·`collections`로 따로 그린다(태그 필터·색 점·검색은 휴지통에서 꺼짐).
- **Q-6b `library:detail`이 휴지통 자료도 읽는다.** 읽기 전용 패널의 정보·파일 절(메타데이터, SHA-256, 원래 이름)은 상세가 있어야 그린다. 지금 `getItemDetail`은 살아 있는 자료만 읽어 `NOT_FOUND`다. 고치기(`updateMetadata`)는 그대로 거부한다. 받지 않으면: 새 채널 `library:trashedDetail`(같은 몸, 휴지통만)을 더한다.
- **Q-6c 새 채널 `ui:confirmPurge`(`{ variant, items, collections }` → `boolean`).** P-25는 시트 종류만 정하고 렌더러가 그 시트를 여는 길을 정하지 않았다. 시트 창은 main만 연다. `library:purge`가 직접 묻게 하면 Task 5의 채널·시험(묻지 않고 지운다)이 바뀐다. 받지 않으면: `library:purge`·`emptyTrash`에 `ask: true`를 더해 main이 시트 뒤에 지운다(Task 5의 처리기와 시험을 고친다).
- **Q-6d "삭제한 날짜"는 열 목록의 열(`deletedAt`, `trashOnly`)이고, 휴지통 보기의 정렬은 따로 저장한다(`library.sort.trash`).** 표의 너비·정렬·열 메뉴·보기 › 정렬 기준이 모두 열 목록에서 나오므로 목록 밖의 열은 그 기계를 모두 둘로 만든다. `trashOnly` 열은 휴지통이 강제할 때만 그려지고(맨 끝, 옮길 수 없음), 다른 보기의 열 메뉴에는 없다. 정렬은 최근 연 자료처럼 보기마다(명세 "기본 정렬은 그 열의 최근순"). 받지 않으면: 열 목록 밖에 휴지통 전용 열 하나를 표가 따로 그리고(너비 고정, 정렬은 세션에만), 보기 › 정렬 기준에는 그 열이 없다.
- **Q-6e ⌘⌫·⇧⌘⌫는 텍스트 필드에 포커스가 있으면 메뉴가 키로 받아도 실행하지 않는다(`menuCommand.byKey`).** ⌘⌫는 텍스트 필드에서 "줄 앞까지 지우기"다. 메뉴 단축키가 필드보다 먼저 키를 받는 플랫폼에서는 빠른 검색에 글자를 지우다 선택한 자료가 휴지통으로 간다. main이 메뉴 클릭이 키에서 왔는지(Electron `triggeredByAccelerator`)를 알리고, 렌더러는 필드에 포커스가 있을 때 그 둘을 무시한다. 메뉴 항목을 직접 누른 것은 그대로 실행한다. Mac에서 AppKit이 키를 필드에 먼저 주는지는 `p1`이 잰다. 받지 않으면: 이 가드를 빼고(한 줄), Mac `p1`의 그 판정도 뺀다 — 검색 중 ⌘⌫가 자료를 옮길 수 있다(실행 취소로 되돌릴 수는 있다).
- **Q-6f 결과 토스트 문구(명세에 없는 것).** 영구 삭제 뒤 "자료 N개를 영구히 삭제했습니다" / "컬렉션 N개를 …" / "자료 N개와 컬렉션 M개를 …", 비우기 뒤 "휴지통을 비웠습니다"(명세 4.5 "영구 삭제 자체는 성공으로 알린다"의 문장). 복원은 명세 그대로 "N개를 복원했습니다"(하나여도 제목을 부르지 않는다), 리더에서의 복원은 토스트 없이 그 자리에서 다시 연다. 받지 않으면: 영구 삭제·비우기 뒤에는 토스트 없이 행이 사라지는 것으로 알린다(문구 둘을 지운다).
- **Q-6g 컬렉션 행과 여러 행의 항목 패널(목업에 없는 상태).** 컬렉션 행 하나: 머리 "컬렉션 · 자료 N개", 제목 = 이름, [복원], 휴지통 줄. 여러 행: "자료 N개와 컬렉션 M개 선택"과 제목 목록, [복원], 휴지통 줄(시각이 다르면 "휴지통에 있습니다"만). 목업의 다중 선택 패널(영구 삭제 장면 뒤)과 같은 문법이다. 받지 않으면: 컬렉션 행이 섞인 선택에서는 "선택한 자료 없음" 패널을 보인다.
- **Q-6h `collection.delete`의 팔레트 이름 "컬렉션을 휴지통으로 이동".** 자료의 ⌘⌫와 같은 "휴지통으로 이동"이 팔레트에 둘 나오지 않게(M5 `collection.rename`의 "컬렉션 이름 바꾸기"와 같은 규칙). 받지 않으면: 팔레트에 같은 이름 둘.
- **Q-6i 휴지통 보기에서 가져오기를 부르면 그 자리에서 내 라이브러리로 간다(⌘O·메뉴·드롭).** 목업 문장 "가져오면 보기는 내 라이브러리로 간다"를 요청 때로 읽었다 — 가져오기가 끝날 때 바꾸면 휴지통을 보던 사용자의 화면이 늦게 바뀐다. 열기 패널을 취소해도 내 라이브러리에 남는다. 받지 않으면: `import:finished`에서 가져온 것이 있을 때만 옮긴다(한 훅).
- **Q-6j 리더의 [복원]은 레지스트리 명령이 아니라 안내의 동작이다.** `item.restore`의 가용성은 "휴지통 보기에서 선택이 있을 때"(명세 11.1)라 리더에서는 꺼져 있다. 안내 단추는 `trashActions.restore`를 직접 부른다(창이 잡혀 있으면 꺼짐). `trash.empty`도 라이브러리 보기 명령(`contexts: ['library']`)이라 리더에서는 꺼진다. 받지 않으면: `item.restore`의 맥락에 리더의 자료를 넣는 규칙을 더한다.
- **Q-6k 리더 목업의 쪽 사이드바 한 줄 "복원하면 쪽이 보입니다"는 그리지 않는다.** 그 사이드바(썸네일·목차)는 M7이고 지금 리더에는 없다(원본 없음 안내도 무대에만 있다). 받지 않으면: 없음 — M7이 쪽 사이드바를 만들 때 그 줄을 넣는다.
- **Q-6l 5,000개를 넘는 선택의 ⌘⌫는 5,000개씩 나눠 옮긴다.** `itemIdsInput`의 상한이 5,000이라 1만 행 ⌘A ⌘⌫는 두 번 부른다 — 묶음마다 지우기 표시가 하나라 휴지통 보기에서 두 시각으로 보인다(명세 4.1 "한 번에 옮긴 자료는 같은 `deleted_at`"이 그 경우만 어긋난다). 실행 취소는 모두를 되살린다. 받지 않으면: `library:trash`의 상한을 `purgeInput`처럼 1,000,000으로 올린다(Task 5와 같은 zod 한 줄 + 한 트랜잭션).
- **Q-6m 빈 휴지통에는 끌어 놓을 수 없다.** 명세 4.3이 "휴지통이 비어 있지 않을 때만 나타난다"고 하므로 휴지통이 비면 드롭 대상인 그 행이 없다. 명세대로 두었다. 받지 않으면: 끌기 동안만 빈 휴지통 행을 보인다(행 하나, 끌기 상태 하나).
- **Q-6n 휴지통 안의 빠른 검색.** 자료 행은 다른 보기와 같은 색인(태그 이름은 휴지통 모델의 것)으로, 컬렉션 행은 이름을 팔레트의 한국어 일치(초성 포함)로 거른다. 태그 필터가 켜지면 컬렉션 행은 숨는다(컬렉션에는 태그가 없다). 초록·메모(`library:searchTexts`)는 살아 있는 자료만 실어 휴지통 자료는 그 둘로는 찾히지 않는다. 받지 않으면: `searchTexts`가 휴지통 자료도 싣는다(main 한 줄, 색인 크기 증가).
- **(P-9 기록)** 첫 선택대로 표의 행 모델에 종류를 더했다: `LibraryTable`이 `collectionRows`를 `rows` 앞에 두고 같은 가상 목록·선택(id)·키·포커스(`data-row-id`)로 돈다. 명세 18절의 대안은 쓰지 않았다. 컬렉션 행의 "자료 N개"는 승인된 목업대로 저자 칸에 있어, 사용자가 저자 열을 숨기면 보이지 않는다.

### Task 7: 중복 정리 화면과 외부 수정본 — `duplicates.keepOne`·`keepOneAll` 명령·머리 단추·남김 표시·실행 취소, 수정본 목록(main: `derived/open` 읽기), 항목 패널 줄, 새 자료로 가져오기(큐) 뒤 수정본 지우기

#### 이 작업이 하는 일

명세 5·6, 11.1의 두 명령, P-14(화면 쪽)·P-15. 소유자가 승인한 목업(f4eaaac) `library.html?state=duplicates`·`?state=edited`(Task 1 보고서)를 앱에 그린다.

- **중복 정리 명령**: `duplicates.keepOne` "하나만 남기고 휴지통으로"(중복 항목 보기의 자료 컨텍스트 메뉴 — 마지막 묶음에서 "휴지통으로 이동" 바로 앞, 팔레트), `duplicates.keepOneAll` "중복 N묶음 모두 정리"(중복 항목 보기 머리 단추 — 가져오기 왼쪽, 보조 단추, 묶음이 둘 이상일 때만; 팔레트). 둘 다 Task 5의 `library:keepOneOfDuplicates`·`keepOneOfAllDuplicates`를 부르고 토스트 "중복 N개를 휴지통으로 옮겼습니다" + 실행 취소(`library:undoKeepOne`에 받은 토큰을 그대로 — 휴지통 이동과 이번에 더한 소속·태그를 함께 되돌린다). 정리 뒤 묶음이 남지 않으면(그리고 중복 항목 보기였으면) 목록을 다시 읽은 뒤 내 라이브러리로 간다. 실행 취소는 보기를 되돌리지 않는다(M5 컬렉션 삭제와 같음).
- **표**: 중복 항목 보기는 정렬과 상관없이 같은 묶음의 행을 붙여 둔다(묶음은 첫 행이 온 자리에, 묶음 안은 지금 정렬대로). 묶음 사이 1px `--separator` 선(위아래 4px — 가상 표의 행 높이에 9px를 더해 그 틈에 그린다). 남을 자료(묶음에서 `createdAt`이 가장 이른 것, 같으면 id — Task 5의 DB 규칙과 같다)의 제목 칸 끝에 2차색 12px "남김"(포커스 있는 선택 행에서는 흰색), 툴팁 "모두 정리하면 이 자료가 남습니다(가장 먼저 가져온 자료)". 표시는 정리 모델 위의 순수 함수다(`organize/duplicates.ts` + `OrganizeModel.duplicateGroups`·`duplicateGroupOf`·`duplicateKept`).
- **외부 수정본(P-15)**: L `listEditedCopies`·`orphanEditedCopies`(+ Task 8이 쓸 `editedCopyFile`·`removeImportedEditedCopy`), IPC `library:editedCopies`·`library:importEditedCopy`·`library:revealEditedCopy`(모두 MAIN, 수정본은 이름으로만 가리킨다 — R4). 새 자료로 가져오기는 큐에 사본 가져오기로 넣는다(제목 = 수정본 파일 이름에서 확장자 뺌, 컬렉션 없음). 큐 묶음의 `afterCommit`이 그 자산의 관리 사본이 제 크기로 있고 수정본의 해시를 **다시** 읽어 자산 sha256과 같을 때만 수정본을 지운다(가져오는 동안 다른 앱이 또 저장했으면 남긴다). 결과 토스트는 Task 4의 것이 그대로 알린다.
- **항목 패널 줄**: 파일 절 끝의 카드 "다른 앱에서 고친 수정본 N개"(있을 때만) — 수정본마다 이름(넘치면 말줄임 + 툴팁), 저장한 시각("2026. 10. 30. 오후 2:12"), 작은 단추 [새 자료로 가져오기] [Finder에서 보기](macOS 밖에서는 "폴더에서 보기").
- **패널이 새 수정본을 언제 아나(결정)**: 수정본은 다른 앱이 쓰고(다음 "기본 앱으로 열기" 때 옆으로 비켜 둔다) main은 그 일을 알리지 않는다. 그래서 패널이 **(1) 그 자료를 보일 때마다**(쿼리 `staleTime: 0`, `refetchOnMount: 'always'` — 다른 행을 골랐다 돌아오면 다시 읽는다), **(2) 메인 창이 포커스를 되찾을 때**(`windowState` 푸시가 `focused: false → true` — 사용자가 수정한 앱에서 돌아오는 순간), **(3) 가져오기 실행이 끝날 때**(`import:finished` — 새 자료로 가져오기가 지운 수정본이 사라진다), **(4) 그 자료의 상세를 다시 읽게 하는 모든 알림 때**(쿼리 키가 `['library','detail',id]` 아래) 다시 읽는다. main은 새 알림을 보내지 않는다(Q-7e).

이 작업이 바꾸지 않는 것: Task 5의 DB·IPC(`keepOneOf`·`undoKeepOne`·알림 `trash`/`restore`), Task 6의 휴지통 보기·`item.trash`·실행 취소 토스트 기계(이 작업은 M5의 `showUndoToast`를 그대로 쓴다), Task 4의 진행·결과 토스트, Task 8의 점검 시트(이 작업의 `orphanEditedCopies`를 쓴다), `openable.ts`의 비켜 두기 규칙, 문서(디자인 명세 7.3·10.1의 새 줄은 Task 12 — Q-7c·Q-7g).

```ts
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { AssetRow } from '@learn/db';
import { editedCopyFile, listEditedCopies, openFolder, orphanEditedCopies, removeImportedEditedCopy } from '../src/edited-copies';
import { sha256File } from '../src/hash';
import { libraryLayout, managedRelativePath, type LibraryLayout } from '../src/layout';
import { cleanupTemp, tempDir } from './helpers';

afterEach(cleanupTemp);

const A = '5a0b8c1d-3e4f-4a5b-8c6d-7e8f9a0b1c2d';
const B = '0f1e2d3c-4b5a-4968-8776-a5b4c3d2e1f0';
const ASIDE = '강의 3 (수정본 2026-10-30 1412).pdf';

function setup() {
  const layout = libraryLayout(tempDir('edited'));
  const folder = (assetId: string) => {
    const dir = openFolder(layout, assetId);
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    return dir;
  };
  const write = (file: string, body: string | Buffer, at?: Date) => {
    fs.writeFileSync(file, body);
    if (at) fs.utimesSync(file, at, at);
    return file;
  };
  return { layout, folder, write };
}

describe('listEditedCopies (M6 spec 6)', () => {
  it('lists the copies kept aside in the asset folder, newest first, with when they were saved and their size', async () => {
    const { layout, folder, write } = setup();
    const dir = folder(A);
    write(path.join(dir, '강의 3.pdf'), 'named copy');
    write(path.join(dir, ASIDE), 'edited once', new Date('2026-10-30T05:12:00Z'));
    write(path.join(dir, '강의 3 (수정본 2026-10-31 0905).pdf'), 'edited again!', new Date('2026-10-31T00:05:00Z'));
    write(path.join(dir, '.0d1c2b3a-0000-4000-8000-000000000000.part'), 'a copy in flight');
    write(path.join(dir, '.DS_Store'), 'finder');
    fs.mkdirSync(path.join(dir, '폴더 (수정본 2026-10-30 1412)'));
    fs.symlinkSync(path.join(dir, ASIDE), path.join(dir, '링크 (수정본 2026-10-30 1412).pdf'));
    expect(await listEditedCopies(layout, A)).toEqual([
      { name: '강의 3 (수정본 2026-10-31 0905).pdf', modifiedAt: '2026-10-31T00:05:00.000Z', size: 13 },
      { name: ASIDE, modifiedAt: '2026-10-30T05:12:00.000Z', size: 11 },
    ]);
  });

  it('names a copy in NFC whatever the disk spells, and has none for an asset without a folder or an id that is not one', async () => {
    const { layout, folder, write } = setup();
    write(path.join(folder(A), ASIDE.normalize('NFD')), 'x');
    expect((await listEditedCopies(layout, A)).map((c) => c.name)).toEqual([ASIDE]);
    expect(await listEditedCopies(layout, B)).toEqual([]);
    expect(await listEditedCopies(layout, '../open')).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('editedCopyFile (the panel names a copy, main finds it)', () => {
  it('finds the copy by the name the panel was given, as the disk spells it', async () => {
    const { layout, folder, write } = setup();
    const onDisk = write(path.join(folder(A), ASIDE.normalize('NFD')), 'x');
    expect(await editedCopyFile(layout, A, ASIDE)).toBe(onDisk);
  });

  it('answers nothing for the named copy, a dot name, a path, another asset copy, one that is gone, or a bad asset id', async () => {
    const { layout, folder, write } = setup();
    write(path.join(folder(A), '강의 3.pdf'), 'named');
    write(path.join(folder(B), ASIDE), 'another asset');
    for (const name of ['강의 3.pdf', `../${B}/${ASIDE}`, '..', '.', `.${ASIDE}`, ASIDE]) expect(await editedCopyFile(layout, A, name), name).toBeNull();
    expect(await editedCopyFile(layout, '../derived', ASIDE)).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('orphanEditedCopies (the library check, Task 8)', () => {
  it('lists the copies in folders whose asset has no row, folder by folder; uuid folders only', async () => {
    const { layout, folder, write } = setup();
    write(path.join(folder(A), ASIDE), 'its asset is there');
    write(path.join(folder(B), ASIDE), 'its asset is gone');
    write(path.join(folder(B), '강의 3.pdf'), 'its named copy');
    const stray = path.join(layout.derivedDir, 'open', 'not-an-asset');
    fs.mkdirSync(stray, { recursive: true });
    write(path.join(stray, ASIDE), 'stray');
    expect(await orphanEditedCopies(layout, new Set([A]))).toEqual([{ assetId: B, name: ASIDE }]);
    expect(await orphanEditedCopies(layout, new Set([A, B]))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('has none before any copy was made (no derived/open/)', async () => {
    expect(await orphanEditedCopies(setup().layout, new Set())).toEqual([]);
  });
});

/** The library's copy of `body` where the importer leaves it, and its asset row. */
async function stored(layout: LibraryLayout, body: Buffer): Promise<{ asset: AssetRow; file: string }> {
  fs.mkdirSync(layout.root, { recursive: true });
  const incoming = path.join(layout.root, 'incoming.pdf');
  fs.writeFileSync(incoming, body);
  const sha256 = await sha256File(incoming);
  const relativePath = managedRelativePath(sha256);
  const file = path.join(layout.root, ...relativePath.split('/'));
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
  fs.renameSync(incoming, file);
  const asset: AssetRow = {
    id: B, sha256, storageMode: 'managed', relativePath, externalPath: null, originalName: ASIDE, mime: 'application/pdf',
    size: body.length, availability: 'available', createdAt: '2026-10-31T00:00:00.000Z', checkedAt: null,
  };
  return { asset, file };
}

describe('removeImportedEditedCopy (after 새 자료로 가져오기 committed)', () => {
  const EDITED = Buffer.from('%PDF-1.4\n% edited in another app\n%%EOF\n');

  it('removes the copy once the library holds exactly its bytes', async () => {
    const { layout, folder, write } = setup();
    const copy = write(path.join(folder(A), ASIDE), EDITED);
    const { asset } = await stored(layout, EDITED);
    expect(await removeImportedEditedCopy(layout, copy, asset)).toBe(true);
    expect(fs.existsSync(copy)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('keeps a copy saved over while it was imported', async () => {
    const { layout, folder, write } = setup();
    const copy = write(path.join(folder(A), ASIDE), Buffer.concat([EDITED, Buffer.from('% saved again\n')]));
    const { asset } = await stored(layout, EDITED);
    expect(await removeImportedEditedCopy(layout, copy, asset)).toBe(false);
    expect(fs.existsSync(copy)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('keeps it when the library copy is gone or not its size, the asset is linked, or there is no asset', async () => {
    const { layout, folder, write } = setup();
    const copy = write(path.join(folder(A), ASIDE), EDITED);
    const { asset, file } = await stored(layout, EDITED);
    expect(await removeImportedEditedCopy(layout, copy, { ...asset, size: asset.size + 1 })).toBe(false);
    expect(await removeImportedEditedCopy(layout, copy, { ...asset, storageMode: 'linked', relativePath: null, externalPath: copy })).toBe(false);
    expect(await removeImportedEditedCopy(layout, copy, undefined)).toBe(false);
    fs.rmSync(file);
    expect(await removeImportedEditedCopy(layout, copy, asset)).toBe(false);
    expect(fs.existsSync(copy)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('never removes a file outside an asset folder in derived/open/, or one that is not a copy kept aside', async () => {
    const { layout, folder, write } = setup();
    const { asset } = await stored(layout, EDITED);
    const named = write(path.join(folder(A), '강의 3.pdf'), EDITED);
    const outside = write(path.join(layout.root, ASIDE), EDITED);
    const deeper = path.join(folder(A), 'sub');
    fs.mkdirSync(deeper);
    const nested = write(path.join(deeper, ASIDE), EDITED);
    for (const file of [named, outside, nested]) {
      expect(await removeImportedEditedCopy(layout, file, asset), file).toBe(false);
      expect(fs.existsSync(file)).toBe(true);
    }
  });
});
```

**(a)** `packages/domain/src/library.ts` 끝에:
```ts
/**
 * A copy another app saved beside an item's read-only copy (M6 spec 6): `<제목> (수정본 YYYY-MM-DD HHmm).<확장자>` in
 * derived/open/<assetId>/. The item panel names it back to main by `name` alone (R4: no path reaches the page).
 */
export interface EditedCopy {
  /** The file name, NFC. */
  name: string;
  /** When the other app last wrote it (the file's modification time, ISO). */
  modifiedAt: string;
  size: number;
}
```

**(b)** 새 파일 `packages/library/src/edited-copies.ts`:
```ts
import fs from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
import type { EditedCopy } from '@learn/domain';
import type { AssetRow } from '@learn/db';
import { sha256File } from './hash';
import type { LibraryLayout } from './layout';
import { isAside } from './openable';
import { resolveAssetPath } from './resolve';

/** Asset ids are uuids: a folder name that is not one was not made by Learn, and a name that is not one never becomes a path. */
const ASSET_ID = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
const nfc = (name: string) => name.normalize('NFC');
const code = (e: unknown) => (e as NodeJS.ErrnoException)?.code;

/** derived/open/<assetId>/: an asset's named copy (기본 앱으로 열기) and the copies kept aside beside it. */
export const openFolder = (layout: LibraryLayout, assetId: string): string => path.join(layout.derivedDir, 'open', assetId);

async function namesIn(dir: string): Promise<string[]> {
  try {
    return await fs.readdir(dir);
  } catch (e) {
    if (code(e) === 'ENOENT' || code(e) === 'ENOTDIR') return [];
    throw e;
  }
}

/** A copy kept aside, by its name alone: what asideName writes, never a dot file (scratch, .DS_Store). */
const keptAside = (name: string): boolean => !name.startsWith('.') && isAside(name);

/**
 * The copies another app saved that the next 기본 앱으로 열기 kept aside (openable.ts): regular files of that shape in
 * the asset's folder, newest first (then by name). Links and folders are not copies. The named copy itself is not one —
 * an edit saved into it shows once the next open has set it aside.
 */
export async function listEditedCopies(layout: LibraryLayout, assetId: string): Promise<EditedCopy[]> {
  if (!ASSET_ID.test(assetId)) return [];
  const dir = openFolder(layout, assetId);
  const out: EditedCopy[] = [];
  for (const name of await namesIn(dir)) {
    if (!keptAside(name)) continue;
    const st = await fs.lstat(path.join(dir, name)).catch(() => null);
    if (!st?.isFile()) continue;
    out.push({ name: nfc(name), modifiedAt: st.mtime.toISOString(), size: st.size });
  }
  return out.sort((a, b) => (a.modifiedAt !== b.modifiedAt ? (a.modifiedAt < b.modifiedAt ? 1 : -1) : a.name < b.name ? -1 : a.name > b.name ? 1 : 0));
}

/**
 * The file of the copy the panel named, as the disk spells it (HFS+ lists names decomposed), or null: a name that is a
 * path, a dot name or not a copy kept aside, or no such file in this asset's folder. Never a path outside that folder.
 */
export async function editedCopyFile(layout: LibraryLayout, assetId: string, name: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const want = nfc(name);
  if (!ASSET_ID.test(assetId) || want !== path.basename(want) || !keptAside(want)) return null;
  const dir = openFolder(layout, assetId);
  const found = (await namesIn(dir)).find((n) => nfc(n) === want);
  if (found === undefined) return null;
  const file = path.join(dir, found);
  const st = await fs.lstat(file).catch(() => null);
  return st?.isFile() ? file : null;
}

/**
 * Copies kept aside in folders whose asset has no row any more (주인 없는 수정본, the library check): `liveAssetIds` is
 * every asset with a row, the trash's included. Folders in name order, copies by name.
 */
export async function orphanEditedCopies(layout: LibraryLayout, liveAssetIds: ReadonlySet<string>): Promise<Array<{ assetId: string; name: string }>> {
  const root = path.join(layout.derivedDir, 'open');
  const out: Array<{ assetId: string; name: string }> = [];
  for (const assetId of (await namesIn(root)).sort()) {
    if (!ASSET_ID.test(assetId) || liveAssetIds.has(assetId)) continue;
    const dir = path.join(root, assetId);
    if (!(await fs.lstat(dir).catch(() => null))?.isDirectory()) continue;
    for (const name of (await namesIn(dir)).sort()) {
      if (!keptAside(name)) continue;
      if ((await fs.lstat(path.join(dir, name)).catch(() => null))?.isFile()) out.push({ assetId, name: nfc(name) });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * After 새 자료로 가져오기 committed (spec 6, the only edited copy Learn ever removes): the copy goes when the library
 * now holds exactly its bytes — the new item's asset is a managed copy, that file is there at its size, and the copy
 * hashes to its sha256 again (another app may have saved over it while it was imported). Anything else keeps it. Only a
 * copy kept aside directly in an asset's folder of derived/open/ qualifies. Returns whether it went.
 */
export async function removeImportedEditedCopy(layout: LibraryLayout, file: string, asset: AssetRow | undefined): Promise<boolean> {
  const parts = path.relative(path.join(layout.derivedDir, 'open'), file).split(path.sep);
  if (parts.length !== 2 || !ASSET_ID.test(parts[0]!) || !keptAside(parts[1]!)) return false;
  if (!asset || asset.storageMode !== 'managed') return false;
  const stored = await fs.stat(resolveAssetPath(layout, asset)).catch(() => null);
  if (!stored?.isFile() || stored.size !== asset.size) return false;
  if ((await sha256File(file).catch(() => null)) !== asset.sha256) return false;
  await fs.unlink(file);
  return true;
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, expectTypeOf, it } from 'vitest';
import { commandContextInput, editedCopyInput, type EditedCopyInput, type ItemIdInput, type LearnApi } from '../src/ipc';
import { Channels } from '../src/ipc-channels';
import type { EditedCopy } from '../src/library';
import type { Result } from '../src/result';

const ITEM = '5a0b8c1d-3e4f-4a5b-8c6d-7e8f9a0b1c2d';
const NAME = '세포생물학 3장 (수정본 2026-10-30 1412).pdf';

describe('edited copies over IPC (M6 spec 6, P-15)', () => {
  it('names three channels in the library namespace', () => {
    expect([Channels.library.editedCopies, Channels.library.importEditedCopy, Channels.library.revealEditedCopy]).toEqual([
      'library:editedCopies', 'library:importEditedCopy', 'library:revealEditedCopy',
    ]);
  });

  it('takes a copy by its bare file name in NFC, never a path or a dot name, and nothing more', () => {
    expect(editedCopyInput.parse({ itemId: ITEM, name: NAME.normalize('NFD') })).toEqual({ itemId: ITEM, name: NAME });
    for (const name of ['', '.', '..', 'a/b.pdf', '..\\x.pdf', 'x\u0000.pdf', `${'가'.repeat(256)}.pdf`]) {
      expect(editedCopyInput.safeParse({ itemId: ITEM, name }).success, JSON.stringify(name)).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(editedCopyInput.safeParse({ itemId: 'not-a-uuid', name: NAME }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(editedCopyInput.safeParse({ itemId: ITEM, name: NAME, path: '/tmp/x.pdf' }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('types the three verbs', () => {
    type In<F> = F extends (input: infer I) => unknown ? I : never;
    expectTypeOf<In<LearnApi['library']['editedCopies']>>().toEqualTypeOf<ItemIdInput>();
    expectTypeOf<In<LearnApi['library']['importEditedCopy']>>().toEqualTypeOf<EditedCopyInput>();
    expectTypeOf<In<LearnApi['library']['revealEditedCopy']>>().toEqualTypeOf<EditedCopyInput>();
    expectTypeOf<ReturnType<LearnApi['library']['editedCopies']>>().toEqualTypeOf<Promise<Result<EditedCopy[]>>>();
    expectTypeOf<ReturnType<LearnApi['library']['importEditedCopy']>>().toEqualTypeOf<Promise<Result<{ queued: number }>>>();
    expectTypeOf<ReturnType<LearnApi['library']['revealEditedCopy']>>().toEqualTypeOf<Promise<Result<void>>>();
  });
});

describe('the reported context carries the duplicate groups (spec 11.1: 중복 N묶음 모두 정리)', () => {
  it('a count of groups, or none; never negative or fractional', () => {
    const field = commandContextInput.shape.duplicateGroups;
    expect(field.safeParse(2).success).toBe(true);
    expect(field.safeParse(undefined).success).toBe(true);
    for (const n of [-1, 1.5]) expect(field.safeParse(n).success, String(n)).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

```ts
  ipcMain: { handle: (channel: string, fn: Listener) => handlers.set(channel, fn) },
  shell: { showItemInFolder: (p: string) => void revealed.push(p) },
  BrowserWindow: { getAllWindows: () => [] },
}));

const { createHandle } = await import('./register');
const { registerEditedCopiesIpc } = await import('./edited-copies');

let ctx: LibraryContext;
let dir: string;
const batches: ImportBatch[] = [];
const imports = {
  enqueue: vi.fn((batch: ImportBatch) => batches.push(batch)),
  cancel: vi.fn(), state: vi.fn(), onProgress: vi.fn(), onFinished: vi.fn(),
};
registerEditedCopiesIpc(createHandle(null), stubDeps({ getContext: () => ctx, imports: imports as never }));
const PAGE = fakeSender(41, 'main');
const SETTINGS_PAGE = fakeSender(42, 'settings');
const as = (sender: unknown, url: string) => (channel: string, input?: unknown) => handlers.get(channel)!({ sender, senderFrame: { url } }, input);
const raw = as(PAGE, 'learn://app/index.html?window=main');
async function call<T>(channel: string, input?: unknown): Promise<T> {
  const r = await raw(channel, input);
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`${channel}: ${r.code}`);
  return r.data as T;
}

const ASIDE = '강의 3 (수정본 2026-10-30 1412).pdf';
const EDITED = '%PDF-1.4\n% edited in another app\n%%EOF\n';
/** An imported item whose folder holds its named copy and one copy another app saved. */
async function itemWithCopy() {
  const src = path.join(dir, '강의 3.pdf');
  fs.writeFileSync(src, '%PDF-1.4\n% the original\n%%EOF\n');
  const out = await ctx.importer.importOne(src, { mode: 'managed' });
  if (out.status !== 'imported') throw new Error(out.status);
  const folder = path.join(ctx.layout.derivedDir, 'open', out.item.assetId);
  fs.mkdirSync(folder, { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(folder, '강의 3.pdf'), 'the named copy');
  const copy = path.join(folder, ASIDE);
  fs.writeFileSync(copy, EDITED);
  return { item: out.item, folder, copy };
}

beforeEach(async () => {
  dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'learn-edited-ipc-'));
  ctx = await openLibraryContext(path.join(dir, 'Library'));
  batches.length = 0;
  revealed.length = 0;
  vi.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => {});
});
afterEach(() => {
  vi.restoreAllMocks();
  if (ctx.db.open) ctx.db.close();
  fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
});

describe('library:editedCopies', () => {
  it('lists the item copies kept aside, not its named copy; none for an item without any', async () => {
    const { item } = await itemWithCopy();
    const copies = await call<EditedCopy[]>('library:editedCopies', { itemId: item.id });
    expect(copies).toEqual([{ name: ASIDE, modifiedAt: expect.stringMatching(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T/), size: EDITED.length }]);
    const other = path.join(dir, 'other.pdf');
    fs.writeFileSync(other, '%PDF-1.4\n% another\n%%EOF\n');
    const plain = await ctx.importer.importOne(other, { mode: 'managed' });
    if (plain.status !== 'imported') throw new Error(plain.status);
    expect(await call('library:editedCopies', { itemId: plain.item.id })).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('answers NOT_FOUND for a trashed or unknown item, and refuses the settings window', async () => {
    const { item } = await itemWithCopy();
    ctx.repo.trash([item.id]);
    expect(await raw('library:editedCopies', { itemId: item.id })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'NOT_FOUND' });
    expect(await raw('library:editedCopies', { itemId: '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000' })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'NOT_FOUND' });
    expect(await as(SETTINGS_PAGE, 'learn://app/index.html?window=settings')('library:editedCopies', { itemId: item.id })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'PERMISSION_DENIED' });
  });
});

describe('library:importEditedCopy', () => {
  it('puts the copy in the queue as a new managed item, titled after it, in no collection, owned by the asking window', async () => {
    const { item, copy } = await itemWithCopy();
    expect(await call('library:importEditedCopy', { itemId: item.id, name: ASIDE })).toEqual({ queued: 1 });
    expect(batches).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(batches[0]).toMatchObject({ paths: [copy], mode: 'managed', collectionId: null, owner: 41, titles: { [copy]: '강의 3 (수정본 2026-10-30 1412)' } });
    expect(batches[0]!.afterCommit).toBeTypeOf('function');
  });

  it('after the commit removes the copy whose bytes the library now holds, and keeps one saved over meanwhile', async () => {
    const { item, folder, copy } = await itemWithCopy();
    await call('library:importEditedCopy', { itemId: item.id, name: ASIDE });
    const batch = batches[0]!;
    const out = await ctx.importer.importOne(copy, { mode: batch.mode, title: batch.titles![copy]! });
    if (out.status !== 'imported') throw new Error(out.status);
    expect(out.item.title).toBe('강의 3 (수정본 2026-10-30 1412)');
    await batch.afterCommit!(out);
    expect(fs.existsSync(copy)).toBe(false);

    const second = path.join(folder, '강의 3 (수정본 2026-10-31 0905).pdf');
    fs.writeFileSync(second, '%PDF-1.4\n% edited twice\n%%EOF\n');
    await call('library:importEditedCopy', { itemId: item.id, name: path.basename(second) });
    const again = batches[1]!;
    const out2 = await ctx.importer.importOne(second, { mode: again.mode, title: again.titles![second]! });
    if (out2.status !== 'imported') throw new Error(out2.status);
    fs.appendFileSync(second, '% saved again while it was imported\n');
    await again.afterCommit!(out2);
    expect(fs.existsSync(second)).toBe(true);
    expect(console.warn).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.stringMatching(/^\[library\] an edited copy stays/));
  });

  it('refuses what is not a copy of this item: its named copy, another item copy, a gone one (NOT_FOUND); a path (VALIDATION_FAILED)', async () => {
    const { item, copy } = await itemWithCopy();
    expect(await raw('library:importEditedCopy', { itemId: item.id, name: '강의 3.pdf' })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'NOT_FOUND' });
    const other = path.join(dir, 'other.pdf');
    fs.writeFileSync(other, '%PDF-1.4\n% another\n%%EOF\n');
    const plain = await ctx.importer.importOne(other, { mode: 'managed' });
    if (plain.status !== 'imported') throw new Error(plain.status);
    expect(await raw('library:importEditedCopy', { itemId: plain.item.id, name: ASIDE })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'NOT_FOUND' });
    expect(await raw('library:importEditedCopy', { itemId: item.id, name: `../${item.assetId}/${ASIDE}` })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED' });
    fs.rmSync(copy);
    const gone = await raw('library:importEditedCopy', { itemId: item.id, name: ASIDE });
    expect(gone).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'NOT_FOUND' });
    expect(gone.ok ? null : gone.message).toBe('이 수정본을 찾을 수 없습니다. 이미 가져왔거나 다른 곳으로 옮겼는지 확인하세요.');
    expect(batches).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('library:revealEditedCopy', () => {
  it('shows that file selected in the file manager; a gone one is NOT_FOUND', async () => {
    const { item, copy } = await itemWithCopy();
    await call('library:revealEditedCopy', { itemId: item.id, name: ASIDE });

    expect(revealed).toHaveLength(1);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { shell } from 'electron';
import { Channels, LearnError, editedCopyInput, itemIdInput } from '@learn/domain';
import { editedCopyFile, fileTitle, listEditedCopies, removeImportedEditedCopy } from '@learn/library';
import { mainStrings } from '../strings';
import type { Handle, IpcDeps } from './register';

/**
 * 다른 앱에서 고친 수정본 (M6 spec 6): the item panel's list of an item's edited copies, 새 자료로 가져오기 through the
 * import queue, and Finder에서 보기. The page names a copy by its file name; main finds it in the item's own folder.
 */
export function registerEditedCopiesIpc(handle: Handle, deps: IpcDeps): void {
  /** A live item's asset (its copies live in derived/open/<assetId>/): a trashed or unknown item is NOT_FOUND. */
  function assetOf(itemId: string) {
    const ctx = deps.getContext();
    const item = ctx.repo.getItem(itemId);
    if (!item) throw new LearnError('NOT_FOUND', mainStrings.itemFile.noItem);
    return { ctx, assetId: item.assetId };
  }
  async function copyOf(itemId: string, name: string) {
    const { ctx, assetId } = assetOf(itemId);
    const file = await editedCopyFile(ctx.layout, assetId, name);
    if (file === null) throw new LearnError('NOT_FOUND', mainStrings.editedCopy.gone);
    return { ctx, file };
  }

  handle(Channels.library.editedCopies, itemIdInput, ({ itemId }) => {
    const { ctx, assetId } = assetOf(itemId);
    return listEditedCopies(ctx.layout, assetId);
  });

  // A copy in the queue like any import (its progress and result toasts, its duplicate question): a managed copy, so the
  // library keeps its own bytes; no collection (spec 6: not the original item's). The copy goes only after the commit.
  handle(Channels.library.importEditedCopy, editedCopyInput, async ({ itemId, name }, event) => {
    const { ctx, file } = await copyOf(itemId, name);
    const queued = deps.imports.enqueue({
      paths: [file],
      mode: 'managed',
      collectionId: null,
      owner: event.sender.id,
      titles: { [file]: fileTitle(file) },
      afterCommit: async (outcome) => {
        const removed = await removeImportedEditedCopy(ctx.layout, file, ctx.repo.getAsset(outcome.item.assetId));
        if (!removed) console.warn('[library] an edited copy stays: it changed while it was imported, or its import is not a managed copy');
      },
    });
    return { queued };
  });

  handle(Channels.library.revealEditedCopy, editedCopyInput, async ({ itemId, name }) => {
    shell.showItemInFolder((await copyOf(itemId, name)).file);
  });
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { duplicateMarks, groupRows, groupStarts, groupsLeftAfter, keptOf } from './duplicates';
import { item } from './testing';

const GROUP: Record<string, number> = { p1: 0, p2: 0, p3: 0, q1: 1, q2: 1 };
const groupOf = (id: string) => GROUP[id];
const rows = (...ids: string[]) => ids.map((id) => item(id));
const ids = (list: readonly { id: string }[]) => list.map((r) => r.id);

describe('the row that stays (M6 spec 5)', () => {
  it('is the earliest import, the smaller id between two of the same moment (the database rule)', () => {
    expect(keptOf([item('b', { createdAt: '2026-10-02T00:00:00.000Z' }), item('c', { createdAt: '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z' }), item('a', { createdAt: '2026-10-03T00:00:00.000Z' })])).toBe('c');
    expect(keptOf([item('y', { createdAt: '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z' }), item('x', { createdAt: '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z' })])).toBe('x');
    expect(keptOf([])).toBeUndefined();
  });
});

describe('rows grouped whatever the sort (the approved mockup)', () => {
  it('puts each group where its first row came, its rows in the order given', () => {
    expect(ids(groupRows(rows('p3', 'q2', 'p2', 'q1', 'p1'), groupOf))).toEqual(['p3', 'p2', 'p1', 'q2', 'q1']);
    expect(ids(groupRows(rows('q1', 'p1', 'q2', 'p2'), groupOf))).toEqual(['q1', 'q2', 'p1', 'p2']);
  });
  it('keeps a row of no group in its place, and hands back the same array when nothing moves', () => {
    expect(ids(groupRows(rows('x', 'p1', 'y', 'p2'), groupOf))).toEqual(['x', 'p1', 'p2', 'y']);
    const already = rows('p1', 'p2', 'q1');
    expect(groupRows(already, groupOf)).toBe(already);
  });
});

describe('the line between groups', () => {
  it('goes above the first row of every group but the table first', () => {
    expect([...groupStarts(rows('p3', 'p2', 'q2', 'q1'), groupOf)]).toEqual(['q2']);
    expect([...groupStarts(rows('q1', 'q2'), groupOf)]).toEqual([]);
    expect([...groupStarts([], groupOf)]).toEqual([]);
  });
  it('the marks of a view: the kept rows from the model, the lines from the rows shown', () => {
    const kept = new Set(['p1', 'q1']);
    const marks = duplicateMarks(rows('p2', 'p1', 'q1'), { duplicateKept: kept, duplicateGroupOf: groupOf });
    expect(marks.kept).toBe(kept);
    expect([...marks.starts]).toEqual(['q1']);
  });
});

describe('groups left after a clean-up', () => {
  it('counts the groups none of the chosen items is in', () => {
    const groups = [['p1', 'p2', 'p3'], ['q1', 'q2']];
    expect(groupsLeftAfter(groups, ['p2'])).toBe(1);
    expect(groupsLeftAfter(groups, ['p2', 'q1'])).toBe(0);
    expect(groupsLeftAfter(groups, ['x'])).toBe(2);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import type { KeepOneResult, LibraryScope, OrganizeSnapshot } from '@learn/domain';
import { createDuplicateActions, type DuplicateActionDeps } from './duplicateActions';
import { buildOrganizeModel } from './model';
import { item } from './testing';

const SNAPSHOT: OrganizeSnapshot = { collections: [], tags: [], members: {}, tagged: {}, duplicates: [['p1', 'p2', 'p3'], ['q1', 'q2']], trashCount: 0 };
const model = buildOrganizeModel(SNAPSHOT, ['p1', 'p2', 'p3', 'q1', 'q2'].map((id) => item(id)));
const answer = (trashed: string[], kept: string[]): KeepOneResult => ({ kept, trashed, undo: { trashed, stamp: '2026-10-31T02:00:00.000Z', memberships: [], tags: [] } });

function harness(start: LibraryScope, over: Partial<DuplicateActionDeps> = {}) {
  const log: string[] = [];
  const toasts: Array<{ title: string; undo: () => Promise<void> }> = [];
  let scope = start;
  const deps: DuplicateActionDeps = {
    keepOne: vi.fn(async (itemIds: readonly string[]) => {
      log.push(`keepOne ${itemIds.join(' ')}`);
      return answer(['p2', 'p3'], ['p1']);
    }),
    keepAll: vi.fn(async () => {
      log.push('keepAll');
      return answer(['p2', 'p3', 'q2'], ['p1', 'q1']);
    }),
    undo: vi.fn(async () => {
      log.push('undo');
      return 3;
    }),
    model: () => model,
    scope: () => scope,
    setScope: (next) => {
      log.push(`view ${next.kind}`);
      scope = next;
    },
    settled: async () => void log.push('list read'),
    undoToast: (title, undo) => void toasts.push({ title, undo }),
    failed: vi.fn(),
    ...over,
  };
  return { deps, actions: createDuplicateActions(deps), log, toasts };
}

describe('하나만 남기고 휴지통으로 (M6 spec 5)', () => {
  it('cleans the groups of the rows handed over; the view stays while a group is left; 실행 취소 hands main its token', async () => {
    const h = harness({ kind: 'duplicates' });
    await h.actions.keepOne(['p2']);
    expect(h.log).toEqual(['keepOne p2']);
    expect(h.toasts.map((t) => t.title)).toEqual(['중복 2개를 휴지통으로 옮겼습니다']);
    await h.toasts[0]!.undo();
    expect(h.deps.undo).toHaveBeenCalledWith(answer(['p2', 'p3'], ['p1']).undo);
    expect(h.log).toEqual(['keepOne p2', 'undo']);
  });
```

**(a)** 새 파일 `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/organize/duplicates.ts`:
```ts
import type { LibraryItem } from '@learn/domain';
import type { OrganizeModel } from './model';

/** What the table draws in 중복 항목 (M6 spec 5): the rows that stay (남김), and the rows that start a group after another (the line above). */
export interface DuplicateMarks {
  kept: ReadonlySet<string>;
  starts: ReadonlySet<string>;
}

/**
 * The item that stays when its group is cleaned up: the earliest import, then the smaller id — the order the database
 * keeps it by (created_at, then id), so 남김 marks the item that really stays.
 */
export function keptOf(group: readonly Pick<LibraryItem, 'id' | 'createdAt'>[]): string | undefined {
  let best: Pick<LibraryItem, 'id' | 'createdAt'> | undefined;
  for (const i of group) if (best === undefined || i.createdAt < best.createdAt || (i.createdAt === best.createdAt && i.id < best.id)) best = i;
  return best?.id;
}

/**
 * The rows with each duplicate group's rows together, whatever the sort: a group comes where its first row came, its
 * rows in the order given; a row of no group keeps its place. The same array when nothing moves (memos downstream).
 */
export function groupRows<T extends { id: string }>(rows: readonly T[], groupOf: (id: string) => number | undefined): readonly T[] {
  const members = new Map<number, T[]>();
  const order: Array<T | number> = [];
  for (const row of rows) {
    const g = groupOf(row.id);
    if (g === undefined) {
      order.push(row);
      continue;
    }
    const list = members.get(g);
    if (list) list.push(row);
    else {
      members.set(g, [row]);
      order.push(g);
    }
  }
  const out = order.flatMap((o) => (typeof o === 'number' ? members.get(o)! : [o]));
  return out.every((row, k) => row === rows[k]) ? rows : out;
}

/** The rows that start a group after another group: each gets the line above it (none above the table's first row). */
export function groupStarts(rows: readonly { id: string }[], groupOf: (id: string) => number | undefined): ReadonlySet<string> {
  const out = new Set<string>();
  let last: number | undefined;
  rows.forEach((row, k) => {
    const g = groupOf(row.id);
    if (k > 0 && g !== undefined && g !== last) out.add(row.id);
    last = g;
  });
  return out;
}

export const duplicateMarks = (rows: readonly { id: string }[], model: Pick<OrganizeModel, 'duplicateKept' | 'duplicateGroupOf'>): DuplicateMarks => ({
  kept: model.duplicateKept,
  starts: groupStarts(rows, model.duplicateGroupOf),
});

/** How many groups a clean-up of these items' groups leaves: the groups none of them is in. */
export function groupsLeftAfter(groups: readonly (readonly string[])[], chosen: readonly string[]): number {
  const picked = new Set(chosen);
  return groups.filter((g) => !g.some((id) => picked.has(id))).length;
}
```

**(d)** 새 파일 `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/organize/duplicateActions.ts`:
```ts
import type { KeepOneResult, KeepOneUndo, LibraryScope } from '@learn/domain';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { groupsLeftAfter } from './duplicates';
import type { OrganizeModel } from './model';
import { SCOPE_ALL } from './scope';

export interface DuplicateActionDeps {
  keepOne(itemIds: readonly string[]): Promise<KeepOneResult>;
  keepAll(): Promise<KeepOneResult>;
  undo(token: KeepOneUndo): Promise<number>;
  model(): OrganizeModel | undefined;
  scope(): LibraryScope;
  setScope(scope: LibraryScope): void;
  /** The list read again (waited for a while at most): the view moves once the trashed rows have left it. */
  settled(): Promise<void>;
  undoToast(title: string, undo: () => Promise<void>): void;
  failed(e: unknown): void;
}

export interface DuplicateActions {
  /** 하나만 남기고 휴지통으로: each group of these items keeps its earliest import (spec 5). */
  keepOne(itemIds: readonly string[]): Promise<void>;
  /** 중복 N묶음 모두 정리. */
  keepAll(): Promise<void>;
}

/**
 * The clean-up's screen side: main merges and trashes in one transaction (library.keepOneOf…) and hands back the undo
 * token, which 실행 취소 gives back unchanged. With no group left the 중복 항목 view has nothing to show: it gives way to
 * 내 라이브러리 (spec 5), and the undo does not bring it back (as a deleted collection's).
 */
export function createDuplicateActions(deps: DuplicateActionDeps): DuplicateActions {
  async function clean(run: () => Promise<KeepOneResult>, left: number): Promise<void> {
    let result: KeepOneResult;
    try {
      result = await run();
    } catch (e) {
      deps.failed(e);
      return;
    }
    if (result.trashed.length === 0) return;
    if (left === 0 && deps.scope().kind === 'duplicates') {
      await deps.settled();
      deps.setScope(SCOPE_ALL);
    }
    deps.undoToast(t.organize.duplicates.done(result.trashed.length), async () => {
      await deps.undo(result.undo);
    });
  }
  return {
    keepOne: (itemIds) => clean(() => deps.keepOne(itemIds), groupsLeftAfter(deps.model()?.duplicateGroups ?? [], itemIds)),
    keepAll: () => clean(() => deps.keepAll(), 0),
  };
}
```

```ts
/** 하나만 남기고 휴지통으로 and 중복 N묶음 모두 정리 (the registry env runs them). */
export const duplicateActions = createDuplicateActions({
  keepOne: (itemIds) => unwrap(api().library.keepOneOfDuplicates({ itemIds: [...itemIds] })),
  keepAll: () => unwrap(api().library.keepOneOfAllDuplicates()),
  undo: (token) => unwrap(api().library.undoKeepOne(token)),
  model: currentModel,
  scope: () => useLibrary.getState().scope,
  setScope: (scope) => useLibrary.getState().setScope(scope),
  settled: () => settledWithin(queryClient.refetchQueries({ queryKey: keys.items, type: 'active' }, { cancelRefetch: false }), LIST_REFRESH_WAIT_MS),
  undoToast: (title, undo) => void showUndoToast(title, undo),
  failed: showActionFailed,
});
```

```bash
feat(organize): duplicate groups in the model with the item each keeps, rows grouped and marked, and the clean-up actions

earliest import, then the id — the database's rule). Pure helpers group a sorted view's rows by group, find the rows
```

새 파일 `tests/e2e/duplicates.spec.ts`:
```ts
// M6 중복 정리 (spec 5): 하나만 남기고 휴지통으로 (the 중복 항목 row menu, the palette) and 중복 N묶음 모두 정리 (the view's
// button, the palette); the 남김 mark, the rows grouped whatever the sort with a line between groups, and 실행 취소 that
// undoes the trash and the merge together.
import path from 'node:path';
import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import type { LibraryItem } from '../../packages/domain/src/library';
import { expectNoSeriousA11y } from './a11y';
import {
  FIXTURES, addToCollection, assignTag, createCollection, createTag, distinctPdfs, importPaths, launch, organizeSnapshot, recordedPopups, runMenuCommand,
  runPalette, specialRow, stubContextMenu,
} from './helpers';

const PDF = path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf');
const row = (page: Page, id: string) => page.locator(`[data-testid="item-row"][data-item-id="${id}"]`);
/** The rows' ids in table order (data-index: a virtual body may hold its rows in any DOM order). */
const rowIds = (page: Page) =>
  page.getByTestId('item-row').evaluateAll((rows) =>
    rows
      .map((r) => [Number((r as HTMLElement).dataset['index']), (r as HTMLElement).dataset['itemId']!] as const)
      .sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0])
      .map(([, id]) => id));
async function liveIds(page: Page): Promise<string[]> {
  const r = await page.evaluate(() => window.learn.library.list());
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`library.list failed: ${r.code}`);
  return r.data.map((i) => i.id).sort();
}
/** The item that stays (spec 5): the earliest import, then the id. */
const earliest = (items: readonly LibraryItem[]): string =>
  [...items].sort((a, b) => (a.createdAt < b.createdAt ? -1 : a.createdAt > b.createdAt ? 1 : a.id < b.id ? -1 : 1))[0]!.id;
/** The table's default sort: 추가일, newest first. */
const newestFirst = (items: readonly LibraryItem[]): string[] => [...items].sort((a, b) => (a.createdAt < b.createdAt ? 1 : -1)).map((i) => i.id);

/** Two duplicate groups the default sort interleaves (imported p, q, p, q, p): sample.pdf three times, another PDF twice. */
async function twoGroups(page: Page, dir: string): Promise<{ p: LibraryItem[]; q: LibraryItem[] }> {
  const [other] = distinctPdfs(dir, 1);
  const p = [...(await importPaths(page, [PDF]))];
  const q = [...(await importPaths(page, [other!]))];
  p.push(...(await importPaths(page, [PDF], { allowDuplicate: true })));
  q.push(...(await importPaths(page, [other!], { allowDuplicate: true })));
  p.push(...(await importPaths(page, [PDF], { allowDuplicate: true })));
  return { p, q };
}

test('하나만 남기고 휴지통으로 from a row menu of 중복 항목: the group keeps its earliest import with the collections and tags of the rest, the rows stay grouped with 남김, and 실행 취소 undoes both', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(testInfo.outputPath('library'), testInfo.outputPath('userdata'));
  try {
    const { p, q } = await twoGroups(page, testInfo.outputPath('in'));
    const keepP = earliest(p);
    const keepQ = earliest(q);
    const [goes1, goes2] = p.map((i) => i.id).filter((id) => id !== keepP) as [string, string];
    const coll = await createCollection(page, '강의');
    await addToCollection(page, coll, [goes1]);
    const tag = await createTag(page, '복습');
    await assignTag(page, tag, [goes2]);

    // Outside 중복 항목 the row menu has no such line (absent, not greyed).
    await stubContextMenu(app, null);
    await row(page, goes1).click({ button: 'right' });
    await expect.poll(async () => (await recordedPopups(app)).length).toBe(1);
    expect((await recordedPopups(app))[0]!.map((i) => i.label)).not.toContain('하나만 남기고 휴지통으로');

    await specialRow(page, 'duplicates').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(5);
    // Grouped whatever the sort: the group of the newest row first, each group newest first; one line, above q's first row.
    await expect.poll(() => rowIds(page)).toEqual([...newestFirst(p), ...newestFirst(q)]);
    await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="item-row"][data-group-start]')).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(row(page, newestFirst(q)[0]!)).toHaveAttribute('data-group-start', 'true');
    const top = async (id: string) => Math.round((await row(page, id).boundingBox())!.y);
    const [p3, p2, p1] = newestFirst(p) as [string, string, string];
    const step = (await top(p2)) - (await top(p3));
    expect((await top(newestFirst(q)[0]!)) - (await top(p1))).toBe(step + 9); // the 4 + 1 + 4 px gap of the line
    // 남김 on the earliest of each group, nowhere else; two groups: the view's button.
    await expect(page.getByTestId('kept-mark')).toHaveCount(2);
    for (const id of [keepP, keepQ]) await expect(row(page, id).getByTestId('kept-mark')).toHaveText('남김');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('keep-all-duplicates')).toHaveText('중복 2묶음 모두 정리');
    await expectNoSeriousA11y(page, 'the duplicates view with 남김, the group line and 모두 정리');

    await stubContextMenu(app, '하나만 남기고 휴지통으로');
    await row(page, goes1).click({ button: 'right' });
    await expect(page.getByTestId('undo-toast')).toContainText('중복 2개를 휴지통으로 옮겼습니다');
    // The line sits in the menu's last group, right before 휴지통으로 이동 (design-spec 7.3: what moves to the trash is last).
    const menu = (await recordedPopups(app)).at(-1)!;
    const at = menu.findIndex((i) => i.label === '하나만 남기고 휴지통으로');
    expect(menu[at - 1]!.type).toBe('separator');
    expect(menu[at + 1]!.label).toBe('휴지통으로 이동');
    // The other group is left: the view stays with its two rows, and one group needs no button.
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(2);
    await expect(specialRow(page, 'duplicates')).toHaveAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('keep-all-duplicates')).toHaveCount(0);
    expect(await liveIds(page)).toEqual([keepP, ...q.map((i) => i.id)].sort());
    let snapshot = await organizeSnapshot(page);
    expect(snapshot.members[coll]).toEqual([keepP]);
    expect(snapshot.tagged[tag]).toEqual([keepP]);

    // 실행 취소: both back, and the kept one loses what the clean-up gave it (it had neither before).
    await page.getByTestId('undo-action').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('undo-toast')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(5);
    snapshot = await organizeSnapshot(page);
    expect(snapshot.members[coll]).toEqual([goes1]);
    expect(snapshot.tagged[tag]).toEqual([goes2]);
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('중복 N묶음 모두 정리 from the view button and the palette: every group keeps its earliest, the view goes to 내 라이브러리 once none is left, and 실행 취소 brings the rows back', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(testInfo.outputPath('library'), testInfo.outputPath('userdata'));
  try {
    const { p, q } = await twoGroups(page, testInfo.outputPath('in'));
    const kept = [earliest(p), earliest(q)].sort();

    await specialRow(page, 'duplicates').click();
    await page.getByTestId('keep-all-duplicates').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('undo-toast')).toContainText('중복 3개를 휴지통으로 옮겼습니다');
    await expect(specialRow(page, 'all')).toHaveAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
    await expect(specialRow(page, 'duplicates')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(2);
    expect(await liveIds(page)).toEqual(kept);
    await page.getByTestId('undo-action').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('undo-toast')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(5);
    await expect(specialRow(page, 'duplicates')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(specialRow(page, 'all')).toHaveAttribute('aria-selected', 'true'); // the undo does not move the view back

    // From 내 라이브러리, the palette: named with the count; the row command is not offered outside 중복 항목.
    await page.getByTestId('item-row').first().click();
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'app.palette');
    await page.getByTestId('palette-input').fill('중복');
    await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="palette-item"][data-command-id="duplicates.keepOneAll"]')).toContainText('중복 2묶음 모두 정리');
    await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="palette-item"][data-command-id="duplicates.keepOne"]')).toHaveCount(0);
    await page.locator('[data-testid="palette-item"][data-command-id="duplicates.keepOneAll"]').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('undo-toast')).toContainText('중복 3개를 휴지통으로 옮겼습니다');
    await expect(specialRow(page, 'all')).toHaveAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
    expect(await liveIds(page)).toEqual(kept);
    await page.getByTestId('undo-action').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(5);

    // In 중복 항목 with a row of q selected, the palette cleans q's group only: p's group is left, so the view stays.
    await specialRow(page, 'duplicates').click();
    await row(page, newestFirst(q)[0]!).click();
    await runPalette(page, app, '하나만', 'duplicates.keepOne');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('undo-toast')).toContainText('중복 1개를 휴지통으로 옮겼습니다');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(3);
    await expect(specialRow(page, 'duplicates')).toHaveAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});
```

**(f)** 새 파일 `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/library/KeepAllDuplicatesButton.tsx`:
```tsx
import { commandById, commandLabel } from '@learn/domain';
import { useCommands } from '../commands/CommandProvider';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { currentPlatform } from '../ui/platform';

/**
 * 중복 N묶음 모두 정리 (M6 spec 5, 11.1): the 중복 항목 view's own button, left of 가져오기 (design-spec 2.4: the pane
 * header's actions are secondary buttons), while two groups or more are left — one group is the row menu's. It runs the
 * registry command, as the palette does.
 */
export function KeepAllDuplicatesButton() {
  const { env, run, isEnabled } = useCommands();
  const groups = env.duplicateGroups ?? 0;
  if (env.view !== 'library' || env.scope !== 'duplicates' || groups < 2) return null;
  return (
    <Button testId="keep-all-duplicates" isDisabled={!isEnabled('duplicates.keepOneAll')} disabledReason={t.common.busy} onPress={() => run('duplicates.keepOneAll')}>
      {commandLabel(commandById('duplicates.keepOneAll'), currentPlatform(), { duplicateGroups: groups })}
    </Button>
  );
}
```

새 파일 `tests/e2e/edited-copy.spec.ts`:
```ts
// M6 외부 수정본 (spec 6): copies another app saved beside the read-only copy, in the item panel's 파일 section —
// 새 자료로 가져오기 through the import queue (the copy goes after its commit, only with its bytes unchanged) and
// Finder에서 보기 with it selected. The panel reads them when it shows the item and when the window gets the focus back.
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { expect, test, type ElectronApplication, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import type { LibraryItem } from '../../packages/domain/src/library';
import { expectNoSeriousA11y } from './a11y';
import {
  FIXTURES, addToCollection, createCollection, distinctPdfs, importPause, importPaths, importResume, importWaiting, launch, organizeSnapshot, runMenuCommand,
  shellCalls, stubShell,
} from './helpers';

const PDF = path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf');
const row = (page: Page, id: string) => page.locator(`[data-testid="item-row"][data-item-id="${id}"]`);
const ASIDE = /^세포생물학 3장 \(수정본 \d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{4}\)\.pdf$/;
const sha256 = (bytes: Buffer) => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');
async function listed(page: Page): Promise<LibraryItem[]> {
  const r = await page.evaluate(() => window.learn.library.list());
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`library.list failed: ${r.code}`);
  return r.data;
}
/** 세포생물학 3장.pdf: the sample's bytes and a line of its own. */
function lecture(dir: string): string {
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  const file = path.join(dir, '세포생물학 3장.pdf');
  fs.writeFileSync(file, Buffer.concat([fs.readFileSync(PDF), Buffer.from('\n% 세포생물학 3장\n')]));
  return file;
}
/** The main window losing the focus and getting it back, as main pushes it (a window manager-less Xvfb sends no focus change). */
async function focusBounce(app: ElectronApplication): Promise<void> {
  await app.evaluate(({ BrowserWindow }) => {
    const w = BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().find((x) => x.webContents.getURL().includes('window=main'))!;
    for (const focused of [false, true]) w.webContents.send('evt:window-state', { fullscreen: w.isFullScreen(), focused, sheetOpen: false, main: focused });
  });
}

test('an edited copy kept aside shows in the item panel when the item is shown again; 새 자료로 가져오기 imports it as a new item titled after it, in no collection, and removes it; Finder에서 보기 selects it', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const lib = testInfo.outputPath('library');
  const { app, page } = await launch(lib, testInfo.outputPath('userdata'));
  try {
    const [item] = await importPaths(page, [lecture(testInfo.outputPath('in'))]);
    const [other] = await importPaths(page, distinctPdfs(testInfo.outputPath('other'), 1));
    const coll = await createCollection(page, '강의');
    await addToCollection(page, coll, [item!.id]);
    await stubShell(app);
    await row(page, item!.id).click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('file-section')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('edited-copies')).toHaveCount(0);

    // 기본 앱으로 열기 makes the read-only named copy; another app unlocks it and saves an edit into it.
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'item.openExternally');
    await expect.poll(async () => (await shellCalls(app)).length).toBe(1);
    const named = (await shellCalls(app))[0]![1];
    const folder = path.join(lib, 'derived', 'open', item!.assetId);
    expect(named).toBe(path.join(folder, '세포생물학 3장.pdf'));
    fs.chmodSync(named, 0o644);
    fs.appendFileSync(named, '% edited in another app\n');
    const edited = fs.readFileSync(named);
    // The next 기본 앱으로 열기 keeps the edited one aside (openable.ts) and opens a fresh copy.
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'item.openExternally');
    await expect.poll(async () => (await shellCalls(app)).length).toBe(2);
    const aside = fs.readdirSync(folder).find((n) => ASIDE.test(n.normalize('NFC')))!;
    expect(aside).toBeDefined();

    // The panel learns of it when it shows the item again.
    await row(page, other!.id).click();
    await row(page, item!.id).click();
    const card = page.getByTestId('edited-copies');
    await expect(card.getByTestId('edited-copies-head')).toHaveText('다른 앱에서 고친 수정본 1개');
    await expect(card.getByTestId('edited-copy')).toHaveAttribute('data-name', aside.normalize('NFC'));
    await expectNoSeriousA11y(page, 'the item panel with an edited copy');

    await card.getByTestId('edited-copy-reveal').click();
    await expect.poll(async () => (await shellCalls(app)).at(-1)).toEqual(['reveal', path.join(folder, aside)]);

    await card.getByTestId('edited-copy-import').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('import-done')).toHaveText('자료 1개를 가져왔습니다');
    await expect(card).toHaveCount(0);
    expect(fs.existsSync(path.join(folder, aside))).toBe(false);
    const added = (await listed(page)).find((i) => i.id !== item!.id && i.id !== other!.id)!;
    expect(added).toMatchObject({ title: path.parse(aside).name.normalize('NFC'), storageMode: 'managed' });
    const detail = await page.evaluate((itemId) => window.learn.library.detail({ itemId }), added.id);
    expect(detail.ok && detail.data.file.sha256).toBe(sha256(edited));
    expect((await organizeSnapshot(page)).members[coll]).toEqual([item!.id]); // not filed with the original
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('a copy saved over while it is imported stays, its bytes checked again after the commit; the panel reads the copies again when the window gets the focus back', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const lib = testInfo.outputPath('library');
  const { app, page } = await launch(lib, testInfo.outputPath('userdata'));
  try {
    const [item] = await importPaths(page, [lecture(testInfo.outputPath('in'))]);
    await row(page, item!.id).click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('file-section')).toBeVisible();
    // A copy appears while the item is shown: nothing reads it until the window gets the focus back.
    const folder = path.join(lib, 'derived', 'open', item!.assetId);
    fs.mkdirSync(folder, { recursive: true });
    const copy = path.join(folder, '세포생물학 3장 (수정본 2026-10-30 1412).pdf');
    fs.writeFileSync(copy, Buffer.concat([fs.readFileSync(PDF), Buffer.from('\n% edited in another app\n')]));
    await page.waitForTimeout(300);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('edited-copies')).toHaveCount(0);
    await focusBounce(app);
    const card = page.getByTestId('edited-copies');
    await expect(card.getByTestId('edited-copy')).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(card.locator('.ec-meta')).toHaveText(/^\d{4}\. \d{1,2}\. \d{1,2}\. 오[전후] \d{1,2}:\d{2}$/);

    // Held right before its commit, the copy is saved over: the library keeps the bytes it read, the copy stays.
    await importPause(app, 'beforeCommit');
    await card.getByTestId('edited-copy-import').click();
    await expect.poll(() => importWaiting(app)).toBe('beforeCommit');
    await expect(card.getByTestId('edited-copy-import')).toHaveAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
    fs.appendFileSync(copy, '% saved again\n');
    await importResume(app);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('import-done')).toHaveText('자료 1개를 가져왔습니다');
    expect(fs.existsSync(copy)).toBe(true);
    await expect(card.getByTestId('edited-copy')).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(card.getByTestId('edited-copy-import')).not.toHaveAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
    const added = (await listed(page)).find((i) => i.id !== item!.id)!;
    expect(added.title).toBe('세포생물학 3장 (수정본 2026-10-30 1412)');
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});
```

```ts
/**
 * A moment as an absolute date and time ("2026. 10. 30. 오후 2:12"): when a file another app saved was written (the item
 * panel's edited copies, mockup library.html?state=edited), where 오늘/어제 would hide the day it matches in the name.
 */
export function formatDateTime(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return t.common.noValue;
  return `${d.getFullYear()}. ${d.getMonth() + 1}. ${d.getDate()}. ${formatTimeOfDay(d)}`;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Whether a windowState push is this window getting the focus back (it was away at the push before): the moment the user
 * returns from the app that edited a copy. The first state a panel hears is not one (it knew no state before).
 */
export const focusRegained = (before: boolean | null, now: boolean): boolean => now && before === false;
```
