**(d)** 새 파일 `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/inspector/useEditedCopies.ts`:
```ts
import { useRef } from 'react';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { api, unwrap } from '../api';
import { keys } from '../data/queries';
import { useLearnEvent } from '../events';
import { focusRegained } from './editedCopies';

/**
 * An item's edited copies (M6 spec 6). Another app writes them and main announces nothing for that, so the panel reads
 * them whenever it shows the item (fresh, not from the cache), when this window gets the focus back (the user returns
 * from the app that edited it), after an import run ends (새 자료로 가져오기 removes the copy after its commit), and with
 * every notice that reads the item's detail again (the key is under it).
 */
export function useEditedCopies(itemId: string) {
  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: keys.editedCopies(itemId),
    queryFn: () => unwrap(api().library.editedCopies({ itemId })),
    staleTime: 0,
    refetchOnMount: 'always',
  });
  const focused = useRef<boolean | null>(null);
  useLearnEvent('windowState', ({ focused: now }) => {
    if (focusRegained(focused.current, now)) void query.refetch();
    focused.current = now;
  });
  useLearnEvent('import:finished', () => void query.refetch());
  return query;
}
```

**(e)** 새 파일 `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/inspector/EditedCopies.tsx`:
```tsx
import { useId, useState } from 'react';
import { FolderSearch } from 'lucide-react';
import { commandById, commandLabel } from '@learn/domain';
import { api, unwrap } from '../api';
import { useCommands } from '../commands/CommandProvider';
import { useLearnEvent } from '../events';
import { formatDateTime } from '../format';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { currentPlatform } from '../ui/platform';
import { showActionFailed } from '../ui/toasts';
import { useEditedCopies } from './useEditedCopies';

/**
 * 다른 앱에서 고친 수정본 N개 (M6 spec 6, mockup library.html?state=edited): the 파일 section's last part, drawn only while
 * the item has one. Each copy: its name (whole as the tooltip), when it was saved, 새 자료로 가져오기 (the import queue;
 * the copy goes once its import committed with its bytes unchanged) and Finder에서 보기 with it selected. The page names a
 * copy by its file name only; main finds it.
 */
export function EditedCopies({ itemId }: { itemId: string }) {
  const copies = useEditedCopies(itemId);
  const { env } = useCommands();
  const headId = useId();
  /** Copies put in the queue from here, until the run's report: their import is under way. */
  const [sent, setSent] = useState<ReadonlySet<string>>(() => new Set());
  useLearnEvent('import:finished', () => setSent(new Set()));
  const list = copies.data ?? [];
  if (list.length === 0) return null;
  const failed = (e: unknown) => {
    showActionFailed(e);
    void copies.refetch();
  };
  const importCopy = (name: string) => {
    setSent((s) => new Set(s).add(name));
    unwrap(api().library.importEditedCopy({ itemId, name })).catch((e: unknown) => {
      setSent((s) => new Set([...s].filter((n) => n !== name)));
      failed(e);
    });
  };
  const reveal = (name: string) => void unwrap(api().library.revealEditedCopy({ itemId, name })).catch(failed);
  const revealLabel = commandLabel(commandById('item.showInFolder'), currentPlatform());
  return (
    <div className="edited-copies" role="group" aria-labelledby={headId} data-testid="edited-copies">
      <div className="ec-head" id={headId} data-testid="edited-copies-head">
        {t.inspector.editedCopies.head(list.length)}
      </div>
      {list.map((c) => (
        <div key={c.name} className="ec-item" data-testid="edited-copy" data-name={c.name}>
          <div className="ec-name ellipsis" title={c.name}>
            {c.name}
          </div>
          <div className="ec-meta num">{formatDateTime(c.modifiedAt)}</div>
          <div className="ec-actions">
            <Button
              size="small"
              testId="edited-copy-import"
              isDisabled={env.blocked || sent.has(c.name)}
              disabledReason={env.blocked ? t.common.busy : t.inspector.editedCopies.importing}
              onPress={() => importCopy(c.name)}
            >
              {t.inspector.editedCopies.importNew}
            </Button>
            <Button size="small" icon={FolderSearch} testId="edited-copy-reveal" isDisabled={env.blocked} disabledReason={t.common.busy} onPress={() => reveal(c.name)}>
              {revealLabel}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```ts
// M6: 중복 항목 with two groups — 남김 on the kept rows (white on the selected one), the line between the groups, 중복 N묶음
// 모두 정리 — and the item panel's edited copy. Pairs for the critic: library.html?state=duplicates and ?state=edited.
test('M6 duplicates and edited copies: 중복 항목 with 남김, the group line and 모두 정리; the item panel edited copy', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const s = await launchTour(testInfo.outputPath());
  const masks = () => [s.page.locator('[data-testid="item-row"] [data-col="createdAt"]'), ...panelMasks(s.page)];
  try {
    const dir = testInfo.outputPath('in');
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    const named = (name: string) => {
      const file = path.join(dir, name);
      fs.writeFileSync(file, Buffer.concat([fs.readFileSync(path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf')), Buffer.from(`\n% ${name}\n`)]));
      return file;
    };
    const kinase = named('Kinase Cascades A Primer.pdf');
    const molbio = named('분자생물학 6장 · 신호 전달.pdf');
    const cell = named('세포생물학 3장.pdf');
    // Imported K, M, K, K, M: newest first the M group (2 rows) comes before the K group (3), as the mockup draws them.
    await importPaths(s.page, [kinase]);
    const [m1] = await importPaths(s.page, [molbio]);
    await importPaths(s.page, [kinase], { allowDuplicate: true });
    await importPaths(s.page, [kinase], { allowDuplicate: true });
    await importPaths(s.page, [molbio], { allowDuplicate: true });
    const [c1] = await importPaths(s.page, [cell]);

    await specialRow(s.page, 'duplicates').click();
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(5);
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('keep-all-duplicates')).toBeVisible();
    // The M group's kept row selected with the table focused (the mockup selects it): its 남김 in white.
    await s.page.locator(`[data-testid="item-row"][data-item-id="${m1!.id}"]`).click();
    await panelSettled(s.page, 'PDF · 3쪽');
    for (const theme of THEMES) {
      await setTheme(s.page, theme);
      await shoot(s.page, `duplicates-view-${theme}`, { mask: masks() });
    }

    // A copy kept aside under the mockup's name and time (as the next 기본 앱으로 열기 would), so it reads the same every run.
    await setTheme(s.page, 'light');
    const folder = path.join(testInfo.outputPath(), 'library', 'derived', 'open', c1!.assetId);
    fs.mkdirSync(folder, { recursive: true });
    const aside = path.join(folder, '세포생물학 3장 (수정본 2026-10-30 1412).pdf');
    fs.writeFileSync(aside, Buffer.concat([fs.readFileSync(cell), Buffer.from('% edited\n')]));
    const at = new Date('2026-10-30T05:12:00Z'); // 오후 2:12 in Seoul (launchTour's TZ)
    fs.utimesSync(aside, at, at);
    await specialRow(s.page, 'all').click();
    await s.page.locator(`[data-testid="item-row"][data-item-id="${c1!.id}"]`).click();
    await panelSettled(s.page, 'PDF · 3쪽');
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('edited-copy')).toHaveCount(1);
    await s.page.getByTestId('edited-copies').scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
    for (const theme of THEMES) {
      await setTheme(s.page, theme);
      await shoot(s.page, `edited-copy-${theme}`, { mask: masks() });
    }
  } finally {
    await s.app.close();
  }
});
```

## 작성자 제안 (Q-7x)

- **Q-7a `CommandContextState.duplicateGroups?: number`(선택 필드) + `commandContextInput`의 같은 필드.** 계약에 없는 맥락 필드다. "묶음이 둘 이상"(명세 11.1)과 이름의 N을 판정하려면 렌더러가 알려야 한다. Q-4c(`importRunning?`)처럼 선택으로 두어 시험 고정값을 건드리지 않는다. 받지 않으면: 필수 필드로 하고 고정값 스크립트(Task 5 Step 4와 같은 방식)를 돌린다.
- **Q-7b `CommandSpec.countLabel` + 레이블 state에 `duplicateGroups`(`CommandLabelState`).** 명세 11.1의 이름 "중복 N묶음 모두 정리"를 팔레트·머리 단추가 같은 레지스트리에서 만든다. 레지스트리 `label`은 수 없는 "중복 묶음 모두 정리"(메뉴에는 나오지 않는다). 받지 않으면: 팔레트는 수 없는 이름, 단추만 렌더러 문구로 수를 말한다(두 곳의 이름이 갈린다).
- **Q-7c 자료 메뉴의 자리.** "하나만 남기고 휴지통으로"를 Task 6의 "휴지통으로 이동"과 같은 마지막 묶음, 그 바로 앞에 둔다(휴지통으로 옮기는 동작은 맨 아래 구분선 뒤 — 디자인 명세 7.3 표기 규칙). 명세 17절에 이 줄이 없어 Task 12가 디자인 명세 7.3 자료 메뉴에 "(중복 항목 보기에서) 하나만 남기고 휴지통으로"를 적어야 한다. 받지 않으면: 별도 묶음(group 3과 휴지통 사이)으로 옮기는 한 줄.
- **Q-7d 정리 뒤 보기 이동.** 명세 5("묶음이 없어지면 중복 항목 보기가 사라지고 내 라이브러리로")가 M5 3.2("보던 특수 보기는 비어도 떠날 때까지 남는다")와 부딪힌다. 이 계획은 정리 동작이 끝에 `setScope(all)`을 하고(목록을 다시 읽은 뒤 — 휴지통으로 간 행이 내 라이브러리에 잠깐 보이지 않게), 실행 취소는 보기를 되돌리지 않는다(M5 컬렉션 삭제와 같음). 다른 길(컬렉션 추가 등)로 비면 M5 규칙 그대로. Task 12가 명세 5에 "실행 취소는 보기를 되돌리지 않는다"를 더한다.
- **Q-7e 패널이 수정본을 다시 읽는 때**(브리프의 결정): 그 자료를 보일 때마다, 창이 포커스를 되찾을 때, 가져오기 실행이 끝날 때, 그 자료의 상세를 다시 읽게 하는 알림 때. main은 수정본을 비켜 둘 때 알리지 않는다(`openableFile`의 반환을 바꾸지 않는다). 받지 않으면: `openableFile`이 `keptAside`를 돌려주고 `library:showInFolder`·`openExternally`가 `libraryChanged`(새 이유 또는 `availability`)를 보낸다 — 포커스 규칙은 그래도 필요하다(다른 앱이 저장만 하고 다시 열지 않으면 비켜 두기가 없다).
- **Q-7f 카드의 시각은 절대 표기 "2026. 10. 30. 오후 2:12"**(`formatDateTime`, 목업 그대로)이고 파일의 수정 시각(mtime — 다른 앱이 저장한 때)이다. 이름 속 시각은 비켜 둔 때라 몇 분 다를 수 있다. 정보 절의 "오늘/어제" 표기를 쓰지 않는 이유: 이름 속 날짜와 나란히 읽혀야 한다.
- **Q-7g 묶음 선과 행 묶기.** 승인된 목업(비평 1-6 → 2차 N1)의 "정렬과 상관없이 묶음을 붙여 두고 사이에 1px 선"을 구현한다: 가상 표에서 묶음 첫 행의 크기에 9px(4 + 1 + 4)를 더하고 그 틈에 `::before` 선. 명세 5의 문장(task-1-report "명세에 옮길 것")은 Task 12. 받지 않으면: 선을 행 위 테두리 안쪽 1px로(높이 변화 없음, 목업과 9px 다름).
- **Q-7h 휴지통 자료의 수정본.** `library:editedCopies`는 살아 있는 자료만 답한다(휴지통·없는 자료는 `NOT_FOUND`) — Task 6의 읽기 전용 패널은 카드를 그리지 않는다. 영구 삭제 뒤 남은 수정본은 Task 8의 "주인 없는 수정본"이 보인다.
- **Q-7i L 계약 넓히기.** P-15의 둘에 더해 `editedCopyFile`(이름 → 그 폴더 안의 파일, 경로 탈출 없음)과 `removeImportedEditedCopy`(커밋 뒤 확인하고 지우기)를 내보낸다. Task 8의 주인 없는 수정본 "새 자료로 가져오기"·"Finder에서 보기"가 같은 함수를 쓴다(앱이 수정본을 지우는 코드 경로가 하나로 남는다 — 명세 16). `orphanEditedCopies`의 항목은 계약대로 `{ assetId, name }`이다 — 목업의 "파일 이름 · 크기"가 필요하면 Task 8이 `size`를 더할 수 있다.
- **Q-7j 같은 내용의 수정본.** 다른 앱이 잠금만 풀고 내용을 바꾸지 않았으면 그 "수정본"은 원래 자료와 같은 파일이라 큐가 끝에 중복으로 묻는다. "건너뛰기"·"기존 자료 열기"면 가져오지 않았으므로 수정본은 남는다(명세 6 "실패하면 그대로"). "새 자료로 추가"면 가져온 뒤 지운다.

### Task 8: 라이브러리 점검 — 시작 검사를 창 뒤 백그라운드로(외부 연결 stat 포함), 검사 넓히기(`.DS_Store` 제외·크기·손상 사본·주인 없는 수정본), 지문 `recovery.lastShown`, 자동 시트 규칙, 동작(임시 파일 정리·되살리기 → 큐·정리…·다시 연결…·Finder), 시트 화면, `file.checkLibrary`

#### 이 작업이 하는 일
- **검사(L, P-16)**: `scanRecovery`·`RecoveryReport`를 `checkLibrary`·`LibraryCheck`로 바꾼다. 부수 효과(시작할 때 실행 중 작업 → interrupted, 사라진 관리 사본 → missing)는 그대로, 더해서 돌아온 사본은 available. `staging/`에서는 `*.part`만 세고(점 이름·`.DS_Store`·폴더 제외, 가져오기가 지금 쓰는 `.part`도 제외), `corrupt-*`는 따로 센다. 쓰이지 않는 사본·크기, 사본이 사라진 자료·찾을 수 없는 외부 연결(살아 있는 자료만), 주인 없는 수정본(Task 7의 `orphanEditedCopies`), 지문·`actionable`.
- **시작 순서(P-18)**: `openLibraryContext`는 열기·마이그레이션만 한다(`ctx.check = null`). 창을 만든 뒤 `startLibraryCheck`가 백그라운드에서 외부 연결 가용성 → 검사를 돌리고 바뀐 자료를 `libraryChanged{availability}`로 알린다. 자동 시트 규칙(정리할 것이 있고, 지문이 지난번 보인 것과 다르고, 첫 화면 뒤, 메인 창에 시트 없음, 작업 줄·큐가 빔)이 맞으면 main이 메인 창에 `recovery:show`를 보내고, 창이 `library:check({ auto: true })`로 시트를 연다(Q-8d — 그래서 창이 다른 시트처럼 잡힌다).
- **시트(P-17, P-26)**: 시트 창 종류 `'libraryCheck'`(넓은 560). 높이 상한 = 부모 창 높이 − 120, 내용 높이를 따라간다(행이 ok로 바뀌면 창이 줄어든다). 머리·발 고정, 목록 카드만 스크롤. 할 일 줄이 표 순서대로 먼저, "자료 기록" 확인 줄이 맨 뒤. 이름 목록은 2개 + "외 N개". `sheet:act`로 동작하고 줄은 그 자리에서 ok가 된다(다시 검사).
- **동작**: 임시 파일 정리(`staging/*.part`만), 자료로 되살리기(큐 — 제목 "이름 없는 자료"), 정리…(줄 안에서 묻고 지움), 다시 연결…(자료마다 — 외부 연결은 Task 2의 `relinkAsset`, 관리 사본은 같은 내용의 파일로 되돌림), Finder에서 보기(손상된 사본·주인 없는 수정본), 새 자료로 가져오기(주인 없는 수정본 → 큐, 커밋 뒤 수정본 지움).
- **명령**: `file.checkLibrary` "라이브러리 점검…"(파일 메뉴 group 3, 팔레트, 늘 — 그 자리에서 다시 검사하고 시트를 연다. 문제가 없으면 "문제가 없습니다."). `library:recoveryReport` 없앰.

`packages/library/test/check.test.ts` 전체를 아래로 바꾼다(끝의 "linked availability and relink" 묶음은 옛 파일의 것을 그대로 옮겼다 — `refreshLinkedAvailability`가 바뀐 id를 돌려주는 한 줄만 더함):
```ts
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { LibraryRepository, migrate, openDatabase, type Db } from '@learn/db';
import {
  Importer, assetKeyFile, checkLibrary, cleanStaging, cleanUnreferenced, corruptCopies, ensureLayout, libraryLayout, managedRelativePath,
  refreshAvailability, refreshLinkedAvailability, relinkAsset, resolveAssetPath, type ImportHooks,
} from '../src/index';
import { cleanupTemp, tempDir, writePdf } from './helpers';

const dbs: Db[] = [];
afterEach(() => {
  for (const db of dbs.splice(0)) db.close();
  cleanupTemp();
});

function setup(hooks?: ImportHooks) {
  const layout = libraryLayout(path.join(tempDir(), 'Library'));
  ensureLayout(layout);
  const db = openDatabase(layout.dbFile);
  dbs.push(db);
  migrate(db, { dbFile: layout.dbFile });
  const repo = new LibraryRepository(db);
  return { layout, db, repo, importer: new Importer({ layout, repo, hooks }) };
}
async function imported(importer: Importer, src: string, mode: 'managed' | 'linked' = 'managed') {
  const out = await importer.importOne(src, { mode });
  if (out.status !== 'imported') throw new Error(out.status);
  return out.item;
}
/** A file of `bytes` (a size: zero-filled) at `file`, its folders made. */
function put(file: string, bytes: number | string | Buffer): string {
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(file, typeof bytes === 'number' ? Buffer.alloc(bytes, 7) : bytes);
  return file;
}
const sha256 = (bytes: Buffer) => createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');
const SHA = 'c'.repeat(64);
const ORPHAN_ID = '0a1b2c3d-4e5f-4061-8172-8394a5b6c7d8';
const EDIT = '단백질 접힘 정리 (수정본 2026-10-18 2210).pdf';

describe('checkLibrary (M6 spec 7, P-16)', () => {
  it('finds nothing in a clean library: its items counted, nothing to act on, the same fingerprint every time', async () => {
    const { layout, repo, importer } = setup();
    await imported(importer, writePdf(tempDir('src'), 'a.pdf', 'a'));
    const first = await checkLibrary(layout, repo);
    expect(first).toMatchObject({
      items: 1, staging: { count: 0, bytes: 0 }, unreferenced: { keys: [], bytes: 0 }, missingManaged: { itemIds: [] }, missingLinked: { itemIds: [] },
      corrupt: { count: 0, bytes: 0, files: [] }, orphanEdits: { count: 0, bytes: 0, copies: [] }, actionable: false,
    });
    expect(first.fingerprint).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/);
    expect((await checkLibrary(layout, repo)).fingerprint).toBe(first.fingerprint);
  });

  it('counts a stopped import\'s .part files and their size — never .DS_Store, a dot file, a folder or another name — and corrupt copies apart; deletes nothing', async () => {
    const { layout, repo } = setup();
    put(path.join(layout.stagingDir, '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111.part'), 300);
    put(path.join(layout.stagingDir, '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222.part'), 200);
    put(path.join(layout.stagingDir, '.DS_Store'), 6148);
    put(path.join(layout.stagingDir, '._33333333.part'), 4096);
    put(path.join(layout.stagingDir, 'notes.txt'), 10);
    fs.mkdirSync(path.join(layout.stagingDir, 'folder.part'));
    const corrupt = `corrupt-${SHA}-44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444`;
    put(path.join(layout.stagingDir, corrupt), 42);
    const check = await checkLibrary(layout, repo);
    expect(check.staging).toEqual({ count: 2, bytes: 500 });
    expect(check.corrupt).toEqual({ count: 1, bytes: 42, files: [corrupt] });
    expect(check.actionable).toBe(true);
    expect(fs.readdirSync(layout.stagingDir)).toHaveLength(7);
  });

  it('leaves out the .part an import is writing now (Importer.stagingInUse)', async () => {
    const { layout, repo } = setup();
    put(path.join(layout.stagingDir, 'live.part'), 10);
    put(path.join(layout.stagingDir, 'dead.part'), 20);
    expect((await checkLibrary(layout, repo, { stagingInUse: new Set(['live.part']) })).staging).toEqual({ count: 1, bytes: 20 });
  });

  it('lists the files under assets/ that no asset holds, by key and size, past dot files and folders; deletes nothing', async () => {
    const { layout, repo, importer } = setup();
    const item = await imported(importer, writePdf(tempDir('src'), 'a.pdf', 'a'));
    const key = `assets/cc/${SHA}`;
    put(path.join(layout.root, key), 96);
    put(path.join(layout.assetsDir, 'cc', '.DS_Store'), 6148);
    put(path.join(layout.assetsDir, '.DS_Store'), 6148);
    fs.mkdirSync(path.join(layout.assetsDir, 'dd', 'nested'), { recursive: true });
    const check = await checkLibrary(layout, repo);
    expect(check.unreferenced).toEqual({ keys: [key], bytes: 96 });
    expect(fs.existsSync(path.join(layout.root, key))).toBe(true);
    expect(repo.getItem(item.id)!.availability).toBe('available');
  });

  it('flags live items whose managed copy vanished and marks the asset missing (a trashed item\'s asset too, but no row for it); a copy put back is available again', async () => {
    const { layout, repo, importer } = setup();
    const live = await imported(importer, writePdf(tempDir('src'), 'a.pdf', 'a'));
    const trashed = await imported(importer, writePdf(tempDir('src'), 'b.pdf', 'b'));
    repo.trash([trashed.id]);
    const copyOf = (assetId: string) => resolveAssetPath(layout, repo.getAsset(assetId)!);
    const kept = path.join(tempDir('kept'), 'a.bin');
    fs.copyFileSync(copyOf(live.assetId), kept);
    fs.rmSync(copyOf(live.assetId));
    fs.rmSync(copyOf(trashed.assetId));
    const check = await checkLibrary(layout, repo);
    expect(check.missingManaged.itemIds).toEqual([live.id]);
    expect(check.actionable).toBe(true);
    expect(repo.getAsset(live.assetId)!.availability).toBe('missing');
    expect(repo.getAsset(trashed.assetId)!.availability).toBe('missing');
    fs.copyFileSync(kept, copyOf(live.assetId));
    expect((await checkLibrary(layout, repo)).missingManaged.itemIds).toEqual([]);
    expect(repo.getAsset(live.assetId)!.availability).toBe('available');
  });

  it('lists the live linked items found missing (their availability), which alone is nothing to act on (spec 7.1)', async () => {
    const { layout, repo, importer } = setup();
    const dir = tempDir('src');
    const src = writePdf(dir, 'paper.pdf', 'paper');
    const item = await imported(importer, src, 'linked');
    fs.renameSync(src, path.join(dir, 'moved.pdf'));
    expect(await refreshLinkedAvailability(layout, repo)).toEqual([item.assetId]);
    expect(await refreshLinkedAvailability(layout, repo)).toEqual([]); // nothing changed the second time
    const check = await checkLibrary(layout, repo);
    expect(check.missingLinked.itemIds).toEqual([item.id]);
    expect(check.actionable).toBe(false);
  });

  it('counts edited copies whose asset has no row (주인 없는 수정본), with their size — not those of a trashed item, not a named copy or a dot file', async () => {
    const { layout, repo, importer } = setup();
    const trashed = await imported(importer, writePdf(tempDir('src'), 'b.pdf', 'b'));
    repo.trash([trashed.id]);
    put(path.join(layout.derivedDir, 'open', trashed.assetId, EDIT), 30);
    put(path.join(layout.derivedDir, 'open', ORPHAN_ID, EDIT), 31);
    put(path.join(layout.derivedDir, 'open', ORPHAN_ID, '.DS_Store'), 6148);
    put(path.join(layout.derivedDir, 'open', ORPHAN_ID, 'named copy.pdf'), 99);
    const check = await checkLibrary(layout, repo);
    expect(check.orphanEdits).toEqual({ count: 1, bytes: 31, copies: [{ assetId: ORPHAN_ID, name: EDIT }] });
    expect(check.actionable).toBe(true);
  });

  it('interrupts the jobs left running only when asked to (at startup)', async () => {
    const { layout, db, repo, importer } = setup();
    await imported(importer, writePdf(tempDir('src'), 'a.pdf', 'a'));
    db.prepare(`UPDATE jobs SET state = 'running'`).run();
    await checkLibrary(layout, repo);
    expect(db.prepare(`SELECT state FROM jobs`).pluck().get()).toBe('running');
    await checkLibrary(layout, repo, { interruptJobs: true });
    expect(db.prepare(`SELECT state FROM jobs`).pluck().get()).toBe('interrupted');
  });

  it('fingerprints what may open the sheet by itself: a new leftover changes it; a linked file gone or one more item does not', async () => {
    const { layout, repo, importer } = setup();
    put(path.join(layout.stagingDir, 'a.part'), 1);
    const before = (await checkLibrary(layout, repo)).fingerprint;
    const dir = tempDir('src');
    const src = writePdf(dir, 'paper.pdf', 'paper');
    await imported(importer, src, 'linked');
    await imported(importer, writePdf(dir, 'more.pdf', 'more'));
    fs.rmSync(src);
    await refreshLinkedAvailability(layout, repo);
    expect((await checkLibrary(layout, repo)).fingerprint).toBe(before);
    put(path.join(layout.stagingDir, 'b.part'), 1);
    expect((await checkLibrary(layout, repo)).fingerprint).not.toBe(before);
  });
});

describe('the check sheet\'s cleanups (spec 7.2)', () => {
  it('임시 파일 정리 removes staging .part files only — never one in use, .DS_Store, a dot file, a corrupt copy or another name', async () => {
    const { layout } = setup();
    for (const n of ['dead.part', 'live.part', '.DS_Store', '._x.part', `corrupt-${SHA}-1`, 'notes.txt']) put(path.join(layout.stagingDir, n), 5);
    expect(await cleanStaging(layout, new Set(['live.part']))).toEqual({ removed: 1, failed: 0 });
    expect(fs.readdirSync(layout.stagingDir).sort()).toEqual(['._x.part', '.DS_Store', `corrupt-${SHA}-1`, 'live.part', 'notes.txt'].sort());
  });

  it('정리 removes the unreferenced copies it is given, keeps one an asset holds again, and refuses a key that is not under assets/', async () => {
    const { layout, repo, importer } = setup();
    const orphan = `assets/cc/${SHA}`;
    put(path.join(layout.root, orphan), 9);
    const item = await imported(importer, writePdf(tempDir('src'), 'a.pdf', 'a'));
    const held = repo.getAsset(item.assetId)!.relativePath!;
    const outside = put(path.join(layout.root, 'library-notes.txt'), 3);
    const r = await cleanUnreferenced(layout, (key) => repo.managedPathInUse(key), [orphan, held, '../library-notes.txt', 'assets/cc/.DS_Store', 'assets/../library.sqlite']);
    expect(r).toEqual({ removed: 1, failed: 3 });
    expect(fs.existsSync(path.join(layout.root, orphan))).toBe(false);
    expect(fs.existsSync(path.join(layout.root, held))).toBe(true);
    expect(fs.existsSync(outside)).toBe(true);
    expect(fs.existsSync(layout.dbFile)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('names the corrupt copies set aside as files in name order, and maps a key to its file only under assets/', async () => {
    const { layout } = setup();
    const b = put(path.join(layout.stagingDir, `corrupt-${SHA}-b`), 1);
    const a = put(path.join(layout.stagingDir, `corrupt-${SHA}-a`), 1);
    put(path.join(layout.stagingDir, 'x.part'), 1);
    expect(await corruptCopies(layout)).toEqual([a, b]);
    expect(assetKeyFile(layout, `assets/cc/${SHA}`)).toBe(path.join(layout.assetsDir, 'cc', SHA));
    for (const bad of ['assets/cc', 'assets/../x', 'assets/.x/y', 'staging/a.part', '/etc/passwd', `assets/cc/${SHA}/more`]) expect(assetKeyFile(layout, bad), bad).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('Importer: the staging names it writes, and a vanished copy put back (다시 연결…, spec 7.2)', () => {
  it('names the .part it is writing while it writes it, and none after', async () => {
    let inUse: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set();
    const seen: boolean[] = [];
    const { importer } = setup({ afterStage: (staging) => void seen.push(inUse.has(path.basename(staging))) });
    inUse = importer.stagingInUse();
    await imported(importer, writePdf(tempDir('src'), 'a.pdf', 'a'));
    expect(seen).toEqual([true]);
    expect([...importer.stagingInUse()]).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('puts a vanished managed copy back from a file with the same bytes; the asset is available again and staging is empty', async () => {
    const { layout, repo, importer } = setup();
    const src = writePdf(tempDir('src'), 'a.pdf', 'a');
    const item = await imported(importer, src);
    const asset = repo.getAsset(item.assetId)!;
    fs.rmSync(resolveAssetPath(layout, asset));
    await checkLibrary(layout, repo);
    expect(repo.getAsset(asset.id)!.availability).toBe('missing');
    await importer.restoreCopy(src, asset.id);
    expect(fs.readFileSync(resolveAssetPath(layout, asset)).equals(fs.readFileSync(src))).toBe(true);
    expect(asset.relativePath).toBe(managedRelativePath(sha256(fs.readFileSync(src))));
    expect(repo.getAsset(asset.id)!.availability).toBe('available');
    expect(fs.readdirSync(layout.stagingDir)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('refuses other bytes, a linked asset and a file that is not there, and places nothing', async () => {
    const { layout, repo, importer } = setup();
    const dir = tempDir('src');
    const src = writePdf(dir, 'a.pdf', 'a');
    const item = await imported(importer, src);
    const asset = repo.getAsset(item.assetId)!;
    fs.rmSync(resolveAssetPath(layout, asset));
    await expect(importer.restoreCopy(writePdf(dir, 'other.pdf', 'other'), asset.id)).rejects.toMatchObject({
      code: 'HASH_MISMATCH', message: '선택한 파일의 내용이 원래 자료와 다릅니다. 같은 파일을 선택하세요.',
    });
    await expect(importer.restoreCopy(path.join(dir, 'gone.pdf'), asset.id)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'NOT_FOUND' });
    const linked = await imported(importer, writePdf(dir, 'paper.pdf', 'paper'), 'linked');
    await expect(importer.restoreCopy(src, linked.assetId)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED' });
    expect(fs.existsSync(resolveAssetPath(layout, asset))).toBe(false);
    expect(fs.readdirSync(layout.stagingDir)).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('linked availability and relink', () => {
  it('marks a moved linked file missing, then relinks only to identical content', async () => {
    const { layout, repo, importer } = setup();
    const dir = tempDir('src');
    const src = writePdf(dir, 'paper.pdf', 'paper');
    const out = await importer.importOne(src, { mode: 'linked' });
    if (out.status !== 'imported') throw new Error(out.status);
    const moved = path.join(dir, 'paper (moved).pdf');
    fs.renameSync(src, moved);

    expect(await refreshLinkedAvailability(layout, repo)).toEqual([out.item.assetId]);
    expect(repo.getItem(out.item.id)!.availability).toBe('missing');

    const other = writePdf(dir, 'other.pdf', 'different');
    await expect(relinkAsset(repo, out.item.assetId, other)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'HASH_MISMATCH' });

    await relinkAsset(repo, out.item.assetId, moved);
    expect(repo.getAsset(out.item.assetId)).toMatchObject({ externalPath: moved, availability: 'available' });
    expect(await refreshAvailability(layout, repo, repo.getAsset(out.item.assetId)!)).toBe('available');
  });

  it('refuses to relink managed assets', async () => {
    const { repo, importer } = setup();
    const src = writePdf(tempDir('src'), 'a.pdf', 'a');
    const out = await importer.importOne(src, { mode: 'managed' });
    if (out.status !== 'imported') throw new Error(out.status);
    await expect(relinkAsset(repo, out.item.assetId, src)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED' });
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 2: library — 구현, 커밋**

**(a)** `packages/domain/src/library.ts` — `RecoveryReport`(L95–104)는 **아직 그대로 두고**(Step 8이 지운다) 그 바로 뒤에:
```ts
/**
 * 라이브러리 점검 (M6 spec 7, P-16): what the library folder holds that the app left behind or lost. Keys inside the
 * library and ids only — no path outside it.
 */
export interface LibraryCheck {
  checkedAt: string;
  /** Live items: the 자료 기록 row's count. */
  items: number;
  /** Stopped imports' staging copies (`staging/*.part`); dot files, folders and corrupt copies are not counted. */
  staging: { count: number; bytes: number };
  /** Files under assets/ that no asset row holds, as `assets/<xx>/<name>` keys in order. */
  unreferenced: { keys: string[]; bytes: number };
  /** Live items whose managed copy is gone. */
  missingManaged: { itemIds: string[] };
  /** Live items whose linked original was not found: shown, never a reason to open the sheet by itself (spec 7.1). */
  missingLinked: { itemIds: string[] };
  /** Damaged copies the importer set aside in staging/ (`corrupt-<sha256>-<id>`), by name. The app never removes them. */
  corrupt: { count: number; bytes: number; files: string[] };
  /** Edited copies kept aside in derived/open/<assetId>/ whose asset has no row any more. */
  orphanEdits: { count: number; bytes: number; copies: Array<{ assetId: string; name: string }> };
  /** A hash of what may open the sheet by itself (not the linked row, not the item count). */
  fingerprint: string;
  /** Something the app left or lost is there: the sheet may open by itself. */
  actionable: boolean;
}
```

**(b)** 새 파일 `packages/library/src/check.ts`:
```ts
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import fs from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
import { nowIso, type LibraryCheck } from '@learn/domain';
import type { LibraryRepository } from '@learn/db';
import { withManagedPath } from './asset-lock';
import { editedCopyFile, orphanEditedCopies } from './edited-copies';
import type { LibraryLayout } from './layout';

/** A stopped import's staging copy: Importer.place writes `<uuid>.part`. */
const PART = /\.part$/;
/** A damaged copy the importer set aside instead of overwriting it: `corrupt-<sha256>-<uuid>`. */
const CORRUPT = /^corrupt-[0-9a-f]{64}-/;
/** `assets/<shard>/<name>` with no part a dot name: the only keys a cleanup or a revival acts on. */
const ASSET_KEY = /^assets\/[^/\\.][^/\\]*\/[^/\\.][^/\\]*$/;

export interface CheckOptions {
  /** At startup only: the jobs the last run left `running` are `interrupted` now. A check while the app runs leaves them. */
  interruptJobs?: boolean;
  /** Staging names an import is writing right now (Importer.stagingInUse): no leftovers. */
  stagingInUse?: ReadonlySet<string>;
  now?: () => string;
}

const code = (e: unknown) => (e as NodeJS.ErrnoException)?.code;
const sum = (xs: readonly number[]) => xs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);

/** Regular files (or folders) of `dir` in name order, dot names left out (.DS_Store, ._*, our scratch files); [] when it is not there. */
async function namesIn(dir: string, kind: 'file' | 'dir'): Promise<string[]> {
  let entries;
  try {
    entries = await fs.readdir(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
  } catch (e) {
    if (code(e) === 'ENOENT' || code(e) === 'ENOTDIR') return [];
    throw e;
  }
  return entries
    .filter((d) => !d.name.startsWith('.') && (kind === 'file' ? d.isFile() : d.isDirectory()))
    .map((d) => d.name)
    .sort();
}

async function sizeOf(file: string): Promise<number> {
  return (await fs.lstat(file).catch(() => null))?.size ?? 0;
}

/** The file of an `assets/<shard>/<name>` key, or null for any other key: never a path out of assets/. */
export function assetKeyFile(layout: LibraryLayout, key: string): string | null {
  if (!ASSET_KEY.test(key)) return null;
  const file = path.join(layout.root, ...key.split('/'));
  return file.startsWith(layout.assetsDir + path.sep) ? file : null;
}

/** The damaged copies set aside in staging/, as files in name order (Finder에서 보기 shows the first). */
export async function corruptCopies(layout: LibraryLayout): Promise<string[]> {
  return (await namesIn(layout.stagingDir, 'file')).filter((n) => CORRUPT.test(n)).map((n) => path.join(layout.stagingDir, n));
}

/**
 * 라이브러리 점검 (M6 spec 7): reads staging/, assets/ and derived/open/ against the database. It removes nothing. Side
 * effects: with `interruptJobs`, running jobs → interrupted; a managed asset whose copy is gone → missing, one whose copy
 * is there again → available (the disk is the truth; opening an item re-checks it the same way).
 */
export async function checkLibrary(layout: LibraryLayout, repo: LibraryRepository, opts: CheckOptions = {}): Promise<LibraryCheck> {
  const now = (opts.now ?? nowIso)();
  if (opts.interruptJobs) repo.markRunningJobsInterrupted(now);

  const parts: string[] = [];
  const corrupt: string[] = [];
  for (const name of await namesIn(layout.stagingDir, 'file')) {
    if (CORRUPT.test(name)) corrupt.push(name);
    else if (PART.test(name) && !opts.stagingInUse?.has(name)) parts.push(name);
  }
  const inStaging = (names: readonly string[]) => Promise.all(names.map((n) => sizeOf(path.join(layout.stagingDir, n))));
  const partBytes = sum(await inStaging(parts));
  const corruptBytes = sum(await inStaging(corrupt));

  const onDisk = new Set<string>();
  for (const shard of await namesIn(layout.assetsDir, 'dir')) {
    for (const name of await namesIn(path.join(layout.assetsDir, shard), 'file')) onDisk.add(`assets/${shard}/${name}`);
  }
  const managed = repo.assetsByMode('managed');
  const held = new Set(managed.flatMap((a) => (a.relativePath === null ? [] : [a.relativePath])));
  const unreferenced = [...onDisk].filter((key) => !held.has(key)).sort();
  const unreferencedBytes = sum(await Promise.all(unreferenced.map((key) => sizeOf(path.join(layout.root, ...key.split('/'))))));

  const missingAssets: string[] = [];
  for (const a of managed) {
    if (a.relativePath === null) continue;
    const there = onDisk.has(a.relativePath);
    if (!there) missingAssets.push(a.id);
    if (!there && a.availability !== 'missing') repo.setAvailability(a.id, 'missing', now);
    if (there && a.availability === 'missing') repo.setAvailability(a.id, 'available', now);
  }
  const missingManaged = missingAssets.flatMap((id) => repo.itemIdsForAsset(id)).sort();
  const missingLinked = repo
    .assetsByMode('linked')
    .filter((a) => a.availability === 'missing')
    .flatMap((a) => repo.itemIdsForAsset(a.id))
    .sort();

  const copies = await orphanEditedCopies(layout, new Set(repo.allAssets().map((a) => a.id)));
  const copyBytes = sum(
    await Promise.all(
      copies.map(async (c) => {
        const file = await editedCopyFile(layout, c.assetId, c.name);
        return file === null ? 0 : sizeOf(file);
      }),
    ),
  );

  const fingerprint = createHash('sha256')
    .update(JSON.stringify({ staging: parts, unreferenced, missingManaged, corrupt, orphanEdits: copies.map((c) => `${c.assetId}/${c.name}`).sort() }))
    .digest('hex');
  return {
    checkedAt: now,
    items: repo.counts().items,
    staging: { count: parts.length, bytes: partBytes },
    unreferenced: { keys: unreferenced, bytes: unreferencedBytes },
    missingManaged: { itemIds: missingManaged },
    missingLinked: { itemIds: missingLinked },
    corrupt: { count: corrupt.length, bytes: corruptBytes, files: corrupt },
    orphanEdits: { count: copies.length, bytes: copyBytes, copies },
    fingerprint,
    actionable: parts.length + unreferenced.length + missingManaged.length + corrupt.length + copies.length > 0,
  };
}

/**
 * 임시 파일 정리 (spec 7.2): the stopped imports' `staging/*.part` files, and nothing else there — not a name an import
 * is writing now (`inUse` is read again for each file: a live view), not .DS_Store or another dot file, not a corrupt
 * copy. A file already gone counts as neither.
 */
export async function cleanStaging(layout: LibraryLayout, inUse: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set()): Promise<{ removed: number; failed: number }> {
  let removed = 0;
  let failed = 0;
  for (const name of await namesIn(layout.stagingDir, 'file')) {
    if (!PART.test(name) || CORRUPT.test(name) || inUse.has(name)) continue;
    try {
      await fs.rm(path.join(layout.stagingDir, name));
      removed += 1;
    } catch (e) {
      if (code(e) !== 'ENOENT') failed += 1;
    }
  }
  return { removed, failed };
}

/**
 * 정리… of 쓰이지 않는 사본, after the user said yes in the sheet (spec 7.2, 16): each copy under its path's lock, and only
 * while no asset row holds that path — an import of the same bytes may have placed and committed it since the check.
 * A key that is not an `assets/<shard>/<name>` key counts as failed and nothing is touched for it.
 */
export async function cleanUnreferenced(layout: LibraryLayout, inUse: (key: string) => boolean, keys: readonly string[]): Promise<{ removed: number; failed: number }> {
  let removed = 0;
  let failed = 0;
  for (const key of keys) {
    const file = assetKeyFile(layout, key);
    if (file === null) {
      failed += 1;
      continue;
    }
    const outcome = await withManagedPath(key, async () => {
      if (inUse(key)) return 'kept' as const;
      const st = await fs.lstat(file).catch(() => null);
      if (!st?.isFile()) return 'kept' as const;
      await fs.rm(file);
      return 'removed' as const;
    }).catch(() => 'failed' as const);
    if (outcome === 'removed') removed += 1;
    if (outcome === 'failed') failed += 1;
  }
  return { removed, failed };
}
```

  ```ts
    /** Staging names an import is writing now (a live view, read again by each check and cleanup). */
    stagingInUse(): ReadonlySet<string> {
      return this.staged;
    }

    /**
     * 다시 연결… of a managed copy that went missing (the library check, spec 7.2): the picked file must hold the asset's
     * exact bytes. It is placed at the asset's path the way an import places a copy (staging, check, flush, rename) and the
     * asset is available again. Nothing else about the item changes.
     */
    async restoreCopy(src: string, assetId: string, opts: { signal?: AbortSignal } = {}): Promise<void> {
      const { repo } = this.deps;
      const asset = repo.getAsset(assetId);
      if (!asset) throw new LearnError('NOT_FOUND', '자료를 찾을 수 없습니다.');
      if (asset.storageMode !== 'managed') throw new LearnError('VALIDATION_FAILED', '외부 연결 자료는 원본 위치를 다시 지정하세요.');
      const abs = path.resolve(src);
      const st = await fs.stat(abs).catch(() => null);
      if (!st?.isFile()) throw new LearnError('NOT_FOUND', '선택한 파일을 찾을 수 없습니다.');
      if ((await sha256File(abs, { signal: opts.signal })) !== asset.sha256) {
        throw new LearnError('HASH_MISMATCH', '선택한 파일의 내용이 원래 자료와 다릅니다. 같은 파일을 선택하세요.');
      }
      await withManagedPath(managedRelativePath(asset.sha256), async () => {
        await this.place(abs, asset.sha256, opts.signal);
        repo.setAvailability(asset.id, 'available', nowIso());
      });
    }
  ```

```ts
/** Looks for every linked original; answers the assets whose availability changed (main announces their items). */
export async function refreshLinkedAvailability(layout: LibraryLayout, repo: LibraryRepository): Promise<string[]> {
  const changed: string[] = [];
  for (const asset of repo.assetsByMode('linked')) {
    if ((await refreshAvailability(layout, repo, asset)) !== asset.availability) changed.push(asset.id);
  }
  return changed;
}
```

```ts
  const CHECK: LibraryCheckPayload = { kind: 'libraryCheck', mode: 'manual', items: 3, rows: [], homeDir: '/home/u', failed: null };
  const host = () => createSheetHost({ preload: '/p.cjs', url: () => 'learn://app/index.html?window=sheet', platform: 'linux' });

  it('is wide, measured within the parent\'s height − 120, and tells the page that cap before it is sized', async () => {

    void host().open(parent(1, 900), CHECK);
    await tick();
    const w = FakeWindow.all[0]!;
    expect(w.options).toMatchObject({ width: 560, height: 780 });
    await ready(w);
    expect(w.contentSize).toEqual([560, 600]);
    const cap = FakeWindow.scripts.findIndex((s) => s.includes("'--sheet-max-height', '780px'"));
    const sized = FakeWindow.scripts.findIndex((s) => s.includes('dataset.sized'));
    expect(cap).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
    expect(cap).toBeLessThan(sized);
  });

  it('follows its content down and up while open, never past the cap', async () => {
    FakeWindow.pageHeight = 600;
    void host().open(parent(1, 900), CHECK);
    await tick();
    const w = FakeWindow.all[0]!;
    await ready(w);
    await tick();
    FakeWindow.followers.shift()!(420);
    await tick();
    expect(w.contentSize).toEqual([560, 420]);
    await tick();
    FakeWindow.followers.shift()!(1200);
    await tick();
    expect(w.contentSize).toEqual([560, 780]);
  });

  it('the other sheets keep their own cap and do not follow', async () => {
    void host().open(parent(1, 900), { kind: 'shortcuts' });
    await tick();
    const w = FakeWindow.all[0]!;
    expect(w.options.height).toBe(900 - SHEET_TOP - 16);
    await ready(w);
    await tick();
    expect(FakeWindow.followers).toEqual([]);
    expect(FakeWindow.scripts.some((s) => s.includes('--sheet-max-height'))).toBe(false);
  });

  it('runs an action through its kind\'s handler, one at a time; the page reads the newest payload back', async () => {
    const h = host();
    const p = parent();
    const order: string[] = [];
    let release = (): void => {};
    h.onAct('libraryCheck', async (action, sheet) => {
      order.push(`start ${action.act}`);
      expect(sheet.parent).toBe(p);
      expect(sheet.window).toBe(FakeWindow.all[0]);
      expect(sheet.payload.kind).toBe('libraryCheck');
      if (order.length === 1) await new Promise<void>((resolve) => (release = resolve));
      order.push('end');
      return { ...CHECK, items: 3 + order.length };
    });
    void h.open(p, CHECK);
    await tick();
    const w = FakeWindow.all[0]!;
    await ready(w);
    const first = h.act(contentsOf(w), { kind: 'libraryCheck', act: 'cleanStaging' });
    const second = h.act(contentsOf(w), { kind: 'libraryCheck', act: 'revive' });
    await tick();
    expect(order).toEqual(['start cleanStaging']);
    release();
    expect(await first).toMatchObject({ items: 5 });
    expect(await second).toMatchObject({ items: 7 });
    expect(order).toEqual(['start cleanStaging', 'end', 'start revive', 'end']);
    expect(h.payloadFor(contentsOf(w))).toMatchObject({ items: 7 });
  });

  it('refuses an action for another kind, a kind with no handler, and a window that is not an open sheet', async () => {
    const h = host();
    void h.open(parent(1), { kind: 'shortcuts' });
    void h.open(parent(2), CHECK);
    await tick();
    const [keys, check] = FakeWindow.all as [FakeWindow, FakeWindow];
    await expect(h.act(contentsOf(keys), { kind: 'libraryCheck', act: 'cleanStaging' })).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED' });
    await expect(h.act(contentsOf(check), { kind: 'libraryCheck', act: 'cleanStaging' })).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED' });
    await expect(h.act({ id: 999 } as unknown as WebContents, { kind: 'libraryCheck', act: 'cleanStaging' })).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'PERMISSION_DENIED' });
  });
});
```

```ts
// ---- 라이브러리 점검 (M6 spec 7, P-16/P-17/P-26) ----

/** The check sheet's rows in the spec's table order (7.2); the 자료 기록 row is not one of them (it is always last). */
export const CHECK_ROW_KINDS = ['staging', 'unreferenced', 'missingManaged', 'missingLinked', 'corrupt', 'orphanEdits'] as const;
export type CheckRowKind = (typeof CHECK_ROW_KINDS)[number];
/** How a row was fixed in the sheet — its ok sentence; `none` when it went by itself. */
export type CheckFix = 'cleaned' | 'revived' | 'relinked' | 'imported' | 'none';
/** `auto`: opened by itself after the startup check; `manual`: 파일 › 라이브러리 점검…. */
export type CheckMode = 'auto' | 'manual';
/** A name the row shows: an item to relink (its title, a linked one's original location), or the first copy's name. */
export interface CheckEntry {
  itemId: string | null;
  label: string;
  /** A linked item's original location, as recorded; the sheet shows it home-relative with the whole path as its tooltip. */
  path: string | null;
}
export interface CheckRow {
  kind: CheckRowKind;
  /** `todo`: something left to do; `done`: fixed (or gone) since the sheet opened — it keeps its place as an ok row. */
  state: 'todo' | 'done';
  count: number;
  /** What its files take (staging, unused, corrupt and orphan copies); 0 for the item rows. */
  bytes: number;
  /** Two names at most (P-26); the sheet adds 외 N개 for the rest of `count`. */
  entries: CheckEntry[];
  /** Set on a done row. */
  fix: CheckFix | null;
}
/** What the last action could not finish, in main's words, under its row. */
export interface CheckFailure {
  kind: CheckRowKind;
  message: string;
}
export interface LibraryCheckPayload {
  kind: 'libraryCheck';
  mode: CheckMode;
  /** Live items (the 자료 기록 row). */
  items: number;
  /** The rows there are or were since the sheet opened, in table order. */
  rows: CheckRow[];
  homeDir: string;
  failed: CheckFailure | null;
}
/** The check sheet's row actions; 다시 연결… names an item, never a path (R4). */
export const CHECK_ACTS = ['cleanStaging', 'revive', 'cleanUnreferenced', 'revealCorrupt', 'importOrphanEdits', 'revealOrphanEdit'] as const;
export type CheckAction = { kind: 'libraryCheck'; act: (typeof CHECK_ACTS)[number] } | { kind: 'libraryCheck'; act: 'relink'; itemId: string };
/** What an open sheet asks main to do (sheet:act). The backup and restore result sheets add theirs. */
export type SheetAction = CheckAction;
```
같은 파일의 `SheetPayload` 합집합 끝(Task 6의 `| { kind: 'purge'; … }` 다음)에 `| LibraryCheckPayload`, `SheetResult` 끝에 `| { kind: 'libraryCheck' }`를 더한다(타입 선언 순서상 위의 블록을 두 합집합보다 앞에 두어도 된다 — TS는 순서를 가리지 않는다).

```ts
/** A sheet that follows its content (sheets.ts FOLLOWING_SHEETS): the tallest its root may grow, as `--sheet-max-height`. */
export async function capHeight(contents: WebContents, px: number): Promise<void> {
  await contents.executeJavaScript(`document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--sheet-max-height', '${Math.round(px)}px')`, false);
}
```

  ```ts
  /** Room the library check keeps below its parent's height (P-26: at most the parent's height − 120, the list scrolls). */
  export const CHECK_SHEET_ROOM = 120;
  /** Sheets whose content changes while they are open (sheet:act): the window follows its content up to the cap. */
  export const FOLLOWING_SHEETS: ReadonlySet<SheetPayload['kind']> = new Set<SheetPayload['kind']>(['libraryCheck']);

  /** The tallest a sheet of `kind` may be over a parent `roomHeight` tall. */
  export function sheetHeightCap(kind: SheetPayload['kind'], roomHeight: number, platform: NodeJS.Platform): number {
    return kind === 'libraryCheck' ? Math.max(160, roomHeight - CHECK_SHEET_ROOM) : sheetMaxHeight(roomHeight, platform);
  }

  /** The sheet an action runs for: its window (where its own open panel hangs), its parent, and what it shows now. */
  export interface ActingSheet {
    window: BrowserWindow;
    parent: BrowserWindow;
    payload: SheetPayload;
  }
  export type SheetActHandler = (action: SheetAction, sheet: ActingSheet) => Promise<SheetPayload>;
  ```
- `SheetHost` 인터페이스의 `resolve(…)` 다음에:
  ```ts
    /**
     * sheet:act (P-17): the open sheet's own action, run by its kind's handler; the sheet shows the payload answered, and a
     * reload of its page reads that one. One action at a time per sheet: a second waits for the first.
     */
    act(contents: WebContents, action: SheetAction): Promise<SheetPayload>;
    /** The handler of a kind's actions; a kind with none refuses every action. */
    onAct(kind: SheetPayload['kind'], handler: SheetActHandler): void;
  ```
- `interface Pending`를:
  ```ts
  interface Pending {
    payload: SheetPayload;
    settle(result: SheetResult | null): void;
    window: BrowserWindow;
    parent: BrowserWindow;
    /** The action under way (sheet:act), which the next one waits for. */
    acting: Promise<void>;
  }
  ```
- `createSheetHost` 몸의 `const heights = …` 다음 줄에 `const handlers = new Map<SheetPayload['kind'], SheetActHandler>();`.
- `show()`에서 `const maxHeight = sheetMaxHeight(room.height, opts.platform);`를

  ```ts
        const maxHeight = sheetHeightCap(payload.kind, room.height, opts.platform);
  ```
  로, `pending.set(id, { payload, settle });`를 `pending.set(id, { payload, settle, window: win, parent, acting: Promise.resolve() });`로.
- 크기를 맞추는 `try` 블록의 `await markSized(win.webContents);` 앞 줄에 `if (follows) await capHeight(win.webContents, maxHeight);`.

  ```ts
      async act(contents, action) {
        const p = find(contents);
        const handler = handlers.get(p.payload.kind);
        if (action.kind !== p.payload.kind || !handler) throw new LearnError('VALIDATION_FAILED', mainStrings.badRequest);
        const run = p.acting.then(() => handler(action, { window: p.window, parent: p.parent, payload: p.payload }));
        p.acting = run.then(
          () => undefined,
          () => undefined,
        );
        const next = await run;
        if (pending.get(contents.id) === p) p.payload = next;
        return next;
      },
      onAct(kind, handler) {
        handlers.set(kind, handler);
  ```

**(f)** `apps/desktop/src/main/ipc/sheet.ts`:
```ts
import { Channels, emptyInput, sheetActInput, sheetResultInput } from '@learn/domain';
import type { Handle, IpcDeps } from './register';

/** Sheet windows only: the host rejects any other sender (PERMISSION_DENIED). */
export function registerSheetIpc(handle: Handle, deps: IpcDeps): void {
  handle(Channels.sheet.payload, emptyInput, (_input, event) => deps.sheets.payloadFor(event.sender));
  handle(Channels.sheet.resolve, sheetResultInput, (result, event) => deps.sheets.resolve(event.sender, result));
  // An open sheet's own action (the library check's rows, P-17): main does it, the sheet shows the answer.
  handle(Channels.sheet.act, sheetActInput, ({ action }, event) => deps.sheets.act(event.sender, action));
}
```

```ts
  records: { title: '자료 기록', text: (n: number) => `자료 ${n}개의 정보⁠·컬렉션⁠·태그가 그대로입니다.` },
  rows: {
    staging: { title: (n: number) => `가져오다 멈춘 임시 파일 ${n}개`, name: '가져오다 멈춘 임시 파일', text: '라이브러리에는 추가되지 않았습니다. 정리하면 디스크 공간을 돌려받습니다.' },
    unreferenced: { title: (n: number) => `쓰이지 않는 사본 ${n}개`, name: '쓰이지 않는 사본', text: '어느 자료도 쓰지 않는 라이브러리 폴더의 파일입니다.' },
    missingManaged: { title: (n: number) => `사본이 사라진 자료 ${n}개`, name: '사본이 사라진 자료', text: '라이브러리 폴더에서 사본 파일이 없어졌습니다.' },
    missingLinked: { title: (n: number) => `원본을 찾을 수 없는 외부 연결 ${n}개`, name: '원본을 찾을 수 없는 외부 연결', text: '파일을 옮겼다면 새 위치를 지정하세요.' },
    corrupt: {
      title: (n: number) => `따로 보관한 손상된 사본 ${n}개`, name: '따로 보관한 손상된 사본',
      text: '내용이 손상되어 라이브러리에서 뺀 사본입니다. 확인한 뒤 직접 지울 수 있습니다.',
    },
    orphanEdits: { title: (n: number) => `주인 없는 수정본 ${n}개`, name: '주인 없는 수정본', text: '다른 앱에서 고쳤지만 원래 자료가 없는 파일입니다.' },

  /** A fixed row's sentence (it keeps its place, its name without a count). */
  fixed: { cleaned: '정리했습니다.', revived: '자료로 되살렸습니다.', relinked: '다시 연결했습니다.', imported: '새 자료로 가져왔습니다.', none: '남은 것이 없습니다.' },
  actions: {
    cleanStaging: '임시 파일 정리',

    relinkFor: (title: string) => `${title} 다시 연결…`,
    reveal: { darwin: 'Finder에서 보기', other: '폴더에서 보기' },

  more: (n: number) => `외 ${n}개`,

  /** The status icon's name for a screen reader. */
  status: { warning: '주의', info: '참고', success: '이상 없음', working: '처리하는 중' },
```

**(b)** 새 파일 `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/sheets/checkView.ts`:
```ts
import type { CheckRow, CheckRowKind, LibraryCheckPayload } from '@learn/domain';
import { formatSize, homeRelative } from '../format';
import { t } from '../strings';

export type CheckTone = 'warning' | 'info' | 'success';
/** A row button: an action main runs (sheet:act), or `askClean`, which asks in the row first. */
export type CheckActKey = 'cleanStaging' | 'revive' | 'askClean' | 'revealCorrupt' | 'importOrphanEdits' | 'revealOrphanEdit';
export interface CheckButtonView {
  key: CheckActKey;
  label: string;
}
export interface CheckEntryView {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  /** A linked original's location on screen (home-relative, mono) and in full as its tooltip. */
  path: string | null;
  pathTitle: string | null;
  /** The item this line's 다시 연결… acts on; null for a line with no button. */
  relinkItemId: string | null;
}
export interface CheckRowView {
  kind: CheckRowKind;
  /** What is left (0 on a done row): the 정리… question names it. */
  count: number;
  state: CheckRow['state'];
  tone: CheckTone;
  title: string;
  text: string;
  /** The footnote line: a size, or the first copy's name and the size. */
  meta: string | null;
  buttons: CheckButtonView[];
  entries: CheckEntryView[];
  /** 외 N개 after the names. */
  more: number;
}

/** Rows that tell, with nothing for the app to fix (the user removes a corrupt copy; an edited copy is theirs). */
const INFO: ReadonlySet<CheckRowKind> = new Set<CheckRowKind>(['corrupt', 'orphanEdits']);

const reveal = (platform: string) => (platform === 'darwin' ? t.check.actions.reveal.darwin : t.check.actions.reveal.other);

function buttonsOf(kind: CheckRowKind, platform: string): CheckButtonView[] {
  const a = t.check.actions;
  if (kind === 'staging') return [{ key: 'cleanStaging', label: a.cleanStaging }];
  if (kind === 'unreferenced') return [{ key: 'revive', label: a.revive }, { key: 'askClean', label: a.clean }];
  if (kind === 'corrupt') return [{ key: 'revealCorrupt', label: reveal(platform) }];
  if (kind === 'orphanEdits') return [{ key: 'importOrphanEdits', label: a.importNew }, { key: 'revealOrphanEdit', label: reveal(platform) }];
  return []; // the item rows: one 다시 연결… per name
}

function metaOf(row: CheckRow): string | null {
  if (row.kind === 'staging' || row.kind === 'unreferenced') return formatSize(row.bytes);
  if (row.kind !== 'corrupt' && row.kind !== 'orphanEdits') return null;
  const first = row.entries[0];
  if (!first) return formatSize(row.bytes);
  const name = row.count > 1 ? t.check.withMore(first.label, row.count - 1) : first.label;
  return `${name} · ${formatSize(row.bytes)}`;
}

/** One row as the sheet draws it (mockup recoverySheet `ci`): status, title, sentence, footnote, buttons, names. */
export function checkRowView(row: CheckRow, homeDir: string, platform: string): CheckRowView {
  const copy = t.check.rows[row.kind];
  if (row.state === 'done') {
    return { kind: row.kind, count: 0, state: 'done', tone: 'success', title: copy.name, text: t.check.fixed[row.fix ?? 'none'], meta: null, buttons: [], entries: [], more: 0 };
  }
  const items = row.kind === 'missingManaged' || row.kind === 'missingLinked';
  const entries: CheckEntryView[] = items
    ? row.entries.map((e) => ({
        key: e.itemId ?? e.label,
        label: e.label,
        path: e.path === null ? null : homeRelative(e.path, homeDir),
        pathTitle: e.path,
        relinkItemId: e.itemId,
      }))
    : [];
  return {
    kind: row.kind,
    count: row.count,
    state: 'todo',
    tone: INFO.has(row.kind) ? 'info' : 'warning',
    title: copy.title(row.count),
    text: copy.text,
    meta: metaOf(row),
    buttons: buttonsOf(row.kind, platform),
    entries,
    more: items ? Math.max(0, row.count - entries.length) : 0,
  };
}

/** The sentence under the title: what was found, never a cause the app did not record (spec 7.2, Task 1 ruling 3). */
export function checkIntro(p: LibraryCheckPayload): string {
  if (p.rows.length === 0) return t.check.intro.fine;
  return p.mode === 'auto' ? t.check.intro.auto : t.check.intro.manual;
}
/** The badge: warning while something is left to do, success when nothing was found or all of it is fixed. */
export const checkBadge = (p: LibraryCheckPayload): 'warning' | 'success' => (p.rows.some((r) => r.state === 'todo') ? 'warning' : 'success');
/** The pointer to 파일 › 라이브러리 점검: on the sheet that opened by itself only (from the menu it was just used). */
export const checkHintShown = (p: LibraryCheckPayload): boolean => p.mode === 'auto' && p.rows.length > 0;
```

**(c)** 새 파일 `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/sheets/LibraryCheckSheet.tsx`:
```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { CircleCheck, Info, Stethoscope, TriangleAlert } from 'lucide-react';
import type { CheckAction, CheckRowKind, LibraryCheckPayload, SheetPayload } from '@learn/domain';
import { api } from '../api';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { cx } from '../ui/cx';
import { Icon } from '../ui/Icon';
import { currentPlatform } from '../ui/platform';
import { Spinner } from '../ui/Spinner';
import { checkBadge, checkHintShown, checkIntro, checkRowView, type CheckActKey, type CheckRowView, type CheckTone } from './checkView';
import { resolveSheet } from './SheetApp';
import { useScrollRegion } from './scrollRegion';
import { useSheetKeys } from './sheetKeys';

const TONE_ICON = { warning: TriangleAlert, info: Info, success: CircleCheck } as const;
const TONE_CLASS: Record<CheckTone, string> = { warning: 'c-warning', info: 'c-secondary', success: 'c-success' };
const ACTIONS: Record<Exclude<CheckActKey, 'askClean'>, CheckAction> = {
  cleanStaging: { kind: 'libraryCheck', act: 'cleanStaging' },
  revive: { kind: 'libraryCheck', act: 'revive' },
  revealCorrupt: { kind: 'libraryCheck', act: 'revealCorrupt' },
  importOrphanEdits: { kind: 'libraryCheck', act: 'importOrphanEdits' },
  revealOrphanEdit: { kind: 'libraryCheck', act: 'revealOrphanEdit' },
};
const focusDone = () => document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-testid="check-done"]')?.focus();

/**
 * 라이브러리 점검 (dialogs.html?scene=recovery, recovery-full, recovery-ok; M6 spec 7.2, P-17, P-26). Rows to act on first, in
 * the table's order, the 자료 기록 row last; a row's action runs in main (sheet:act) and the row turns ok in place. Only
 * the list scrolls. ↩ and esc are 완료 — or, while 정리… asks in its row, they keep the copies.
 */
export function LibraryCheckSheet({ payload }: { payload: LibraryCheckPayload }) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [working, setWorking] = useState<CheckRowKind | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<{ kind: CheckRowKind; message: string } | null>(null);
  const [asking, setAsking] = useState(false);
  const [heard, setHeard] = useState('');
  const done = () => resolveSheet({ kind: 'libraryCheck' });
  const keepCopies = () => {
    setAsking(false);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-testid="check-askClean"]')?.focus());
  };
  const keys = useSheetKeys(() => (asking ? keepCopies() : done()), () => (asking ? keepCopies() : done()));
  const list = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const region = useScrollRegion(list, 'sheet-title');
  const platform = currentPlatform();
  const rows = payload.rows.map((r) => checkRowView(r, payload.homeDir, platform));
  const badge = checkBadge(payload);

  // A button that went with its row (the row turned ok) leaves the focus nowhere: it goes to 완료.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (document.activeElement === null || document.activeElement === document.body) focusDone();
  }, [payload]);

  async function act(kind: CheckRowKind, action: CheckAction): Promise<void> {
    if (working !== null) return; // one action at a time; the buttons keep their focus meanwhile
    setWorking(kind);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const r = await api().sheet.act({ action });
      if (!r.ok) {
        setError({ kind, message: r.message });
        return;
      }
      const next = r.data as LibraryCheckPayload;
      queryClient.setQueryData<SheetPayload>(['sheet', 'payload'], next);
      const row = next.rows.find((x) => x.kind === kind);
      if (row?.state === 'done') setHeard(`${t.check.rows[kind].name}: ${t.check.fixed[row.fix ?? 'none']}`);
    } finally {
      setWorking(null);
      setAsking(false);
    }
  }
  const failure = (kind: CheckRowKind): string | null => (error?.kind === kind ? error.message : payload.failed?.kind === kind ? payload.failed.message : null);

  return (
    <div
      className="sheet wide check-sheet"
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="sheet-title"
      aria-describedby="sheet-text"
      data-sheet-root=""
      data-kind="libraryCheck"
      data-mode={payload.mode}
      data-follows=""
      data-testid="sheet-root"
      {...keys}
    >
      <div className="d-title check-head">
        <span className={cx('badge-icon', badge)} data-testid="check-badge" data-tone={badge}>
          <Icon icon={Stethoscope} />
        </span>
        <div className="check-head-text">
          <h2 id="sheet-title" className="ui-balance">
            {t.check.title}
          </h2>
          <p className="d-text ui-prose" id="sheet-text" data-testid="check-intro">
            {checkIntro(payload)}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="d-body check-body">
        <div className="card checklist" ref={list} {...region} data-testid="check-list" aria-busy={working !== null ? true : undefined}>
          <div role="list" aria-labelledby="sheet-title">
            {rows.map((view) => (
              <CheckRowItem
                key={view.kind}
                view={view}
                working={working === view.kind}
                asking={asking && view.kind === 'unreferenced' && view.state === 'todo'}
                failure={failure(view.kind)}
                onAct={(key) => (key === 'askClean' ? setAsking(true) : void act(view.kind, ACTIONS[key]))}
                onRelink={(itemId) => void act(view.kind, { kind: 'libraryCheck', act: 'relink', itemId })}
                onConfirm={() => void act('unreferenced', { kind: 'libraryCheck', act: 'cleanUnreferenced' })}
                onKeep={keepCopies}
              />
            ))}
            <div className="check-row" role="listitem" data-testid="check-row" data-kind="records" data-state="done" data-tone="success">
              <span className="ci-status c-success">
                <Icon icon={CircleCheck} label={t.check.status.success} />
              </span>
              <div className="ci-main">
                <div className="ci-title">{t.check.records.title}</div>
                <div className="ci-text">{t.check.records.text(payload.items)}</div>
              </div>
              <div className="ci-action" />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="d-foot">
        {checkHintShown(payload) && (
          <span className="t-footnote c-secondary" data-testid="check-hint">
            {t.check.hint}
          </span>
        )}
        <span className="spacer" />
        <Button variant="primary" autoFocus testId="check-done" onPress={done}>
          {t.common.done}
        </Button>
      </div>
      <div className="visually-hidden" role="status">
        {heard}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

interface RowProps {
  view: CheckRowView;
  working: boolean;
  asking: boolean;
  failure: string | null;
  onAct(key: CheckActKey): void;
  onRelink(itemId: string): void;
  onConfirm(): void;
  onKeep(): void;
}

function CheckRowItem({ view, working, asking, failure, onAct, onRelink, onConfirm, onKeep }: RowProps) {
  return (
    <div className="check-row" role="listitem" data-testid="check-row" data-kind={view.kind} data-state={view.state} data-tone={view.tone} data-asking={asking ? '' : undefined}>
      <span className={cx('ci-status', TONE_CLASS[view.tone])}>
        {working ? <Spinner label={t.check.status.working} /> : <Icon icon={TONE_ICON[view.tone]} label={t.check.status[view.tone]} />}
      </span>
      <div className="ci-main">
        <div className="ci-title">{asking ? t.check.confirm.title(view.count) : view.title}</div>
        <div className="ci-text">{asking ? t.check.confirm.text : view.text}</div>
        {view.meta !== null && !asking && (
          <div className="ci-meta ellipsis" title={view.meta}>
            {view.meta}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className={cx('ci-action', (asking || view.buttons.length > 1) && 'stack')}>
        {asking ? (
          <>
            <Button size="small" variant="plain-danger" testId="check-confirm" onPress={onConfirm}>
              {t.check.confirm.remove}
            </Button>
            <Button size="small" autoFocus testId="check-confirm-cancel" onPress={onKeep}>
              {t.check.confirm.cancel}
            </Button>
          </>
        ) : (
          view.buttons.map((b) => (
            <Button key={b.key} size="small" testId={`check-${b.key}`} onPress={() => onAct(b.key)}>
              {b.label}
            </Button>
          ))
        )}
      </div>
      {(view.entries.length > 0 || view.more > 0) && (
        <div className="ci-entries">
          {view.entries.map((e) => (
            <div className="ci-entry" key={e.key} data-testid="check-entry" data-item-id={e.relinkItemId ?? undefined}>
              {e.path !== null ? (
                <span className="ce-text">
                  <span className="ce-title ellipsis" title={e.label}>
                    {e.label}
                  </span>
                  <span className="ce-path ellipsis" title={e.pathTitle ?? undefined}>
                    {e.path}
                  </span>
                </span>
              ) : (
                <span className="ellipsis" title={e.label}>
                  {e.label}
                </span>
              )}
              {e.relinkItemId !== null && (
                <Button size="small" testId="check-relink" aria-label={t.check.actions.relinkFor(e.label)} onPress={() => onRelink(e.relinkItemId!)}>
                  {t.check.actions.relink}
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
          ))}
          {view.more > 0 && (
            <div className="ci-entry more" data-testid="check-more">
              <span>{t.check.more(view.more)}</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
      {failure !== null && (
        <div className="ci-error" role="alert" data-testid="check-error">
          {failure}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

**(e)** 새 파일 `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/styles/screens/check.css`:
```css
@layer screens {
  /* 라이브러리 점검 (dialogs.html?scene=recovery, recovery-full, recovery-ok; P-26). Main caps the sheet at the parent window's
     height − 120 (--sheet-max-height) and follows its content as rows change; the head and the foot stay, and the list
     scrolls inside its card, whose ring is the list's top and bottom edge. */
  :root[data-sized] .sheet[data-follows] {
    max-height: var(--sheet-max-height, 100vh);
  }
  /* Nothing to fix (recovery-ok), or all of it fixed. */
  .sheet .badge-icon.success {
    background: var(--success-soft);
    color: var(--success-text);
  }
  .check-sheet .check-head {
    align-items: flex-start;
  }
  .check-sheet .check-head-text {
    min-width: 0;
  }
  .check-sheet .check-head h2 {
    margin-top: 5px; /* local: the title's first line level with the 32 px badge's middle (mockup recoverySheet) */
  }
  .check-sheet .check-head .d-text {
    margin-top: var(--space-4);
  }
  .check-sheet .check-body {
    padding-bottom: 0;
  }
  .check-sheet .d-foot {
    padding-top: calc(var(--space-16) - 1px);
  }
  .check-sheet .checklist {
    flex: 0 1 auto;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow-y: auto;
  }
  .check-sheet .checklist[data-scrolls]:focus-visible {
    outline-offset: calc(-1 * var(--focus-ring-width));
  }
  .check-sheet .check-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0, 1fr) 128px; /* local: one action column, so every text column is as wide (mockup .check-item) */
    column-gap: var(--space-16);
    align-items: start;
    padding: var(--space-12) var(--space-16);
  }
  .check-sheet .check-row + .check-row {
    border-top: 1px solid var(--separator-on-surface);
  }
  .check-sheet .ci-status {
    display: flex;
    margin-top: 1px; /* local: the 16 px icon on the headline's first line (mockup .status-dot) */
  }
  .check-sheet .ci-main {
    min-width: 0;
  }
  .check-sheet .ci-title {
    font: var(--type-headline);
    text-wrap: balance;
  }
  .check-sheet .ci-text {
    margin-top: 2px; /* local: mockup .ci-text */
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    font: var(--type-footnote);
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }
  .check-sheet .ci-meta {
    margin-top: var(--space-4);
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    font: var(--type-footnote);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  .check-sheet .ci-action {
    align-self: center;
    justify-self: end;
  }
  /* Two actions on one row stand stacked, as wide as the wider one. */
  .check-sheet .ci-action.stack {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
    gap: var(--space-4);
  }
  /* A line per name or path, each with its own button, across the text and action columns. */
  .check-sheet .ci-entries {
    grid-column: 2 / 4;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--space-4);
    margin-top: var(--space-8);
  }
  .check-sheet .ci-entry {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: var(--space-16);
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: var(--control-height-small);
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    font: var(--type-footnote);
  }
  .check-sheet .ci-entry > .ellipsis {
    min-width: 0;
  }
  /* 외 N개 has no button: relinking one checks again and the next name shows. */
  .check-sheet .ci-entry.more {
    color: var(--text-tertiary);
  }
  .check-sheet .ce-text {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-width: 0;
  }
  .check-sheet .ce-title {
    font: var(--type-body);
  }
  .check-sheet .ce-path {
    font: var(--type-mono);
  }
  /* What an action could not finish, in main's words (cause + next step). */
  .check-sheet .ci-error {
    grid-column: 2 / 4;
    margin-top: var(--space-8);
    color: var(--danger-text);
```

```ts
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import type { CheckAction, ImportReport, LibraryCheck, LibraryCheckPayload, SheetPayload } from '@learn/domain';
import { managedRelativePath, resolveAssetPath } from '@learn/library';
import type { ImportBatch } from './jobs/import-queue';
import { AUTO_POLL_MS, LAST_SHOWN, autoShowDue, checkPayload, clearToShow, createCheckSheets, runCheck, startLibraryCheck, type AutoGate, type CheckSheetsDeps } from './library-check';
import { openLibraryContext, type LibraryContext } from './library-context';

const dirs: string[] = [];
const contexts: LibraryContext[] = [];
afterEach(() => {
  vi.restoreAllMocks();
  for (const c of contexts.splice(0)) c.db.close();
  for (const d of dirs.splice(0)) fs.rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true });
});
function temp(name: string): string {
  const d = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), `learn-check-${name}-`));
  dirs.push(d);
  return d;
}
async function library(): Promise<LibraryContext> {
  const ctx = await openLibraryContext(path.join(temp('lib'), 'Library'));
  contexts.push(ctx);
  return ctx;
}
function pdf(dir: string, name: string, text: string): string {
  const p = path.join(dir, name);
  fs.writeFileSync(p, `%PDF-1.4\n% ${text}\n%%EOF\n`);
  return p;
}
async function add(ctx: LibraryContext, src: string, mode: 'managed' | 'linked' = 'managed') {
  const o = await ctx.importer.importOne(src, { mode });
  if (o.status !== 'imported') throw new Error(o.status);
  return o.item;
}
function put(file: string, bytes: number | Buffer): string {
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(file, typeof bytes === 'number' ? Buffer.alloc(bytes, 5) : bytes);
  return file;
}
const ORPHAN_ID = '0a1b2c3d-4e5f-4061-8172-8394a5b6c7d8';
const EDIT = '단백질 접힘 정리 (수정본 2026-10-18 2210).pdf';
const PARENT = { webContents: { id: 7 } } as never;
const SHEET_WINDOW = { webContents: { id: 9 } } as never;
const gate = (over: Partial<AutoGate> = {}): AutoGate => ({ firstScreen: Promise.resolve(), busy: () => false, stopped: () => false, sleep: async () => {}, ...over });

/** The import queue as the sheet uses it: each batch through the real importer, then the run's end. */
function queueOf(ctx: LibraryContext) {
  const batches: ImportBatch[] = [];
  const finished = new Set<(report: ImportReport, openIn: number | null) => void>();
  return {
    batches,
    enqueue(batch: ImportBatch): number {
      batches.push(batch);
      void (async () => {
        let imported = 0;
        for (const p of batch.paths) {
          const title = batch.titles?.[p];
          const o = await ctx.importer.importOne(p, { mode: batch.mode, ...(title !== undefined ? { title } : {}), ...(batch.allowDuplicate ? { allowDuplicate: true } : {}) });
          if (o.status === 'imported') {
            imported += 1;
            await batch.afterCommit?.(o);
          }
        }
        const report: ImportReport = { imported, filed: 0, filedExisting: 0, failed: [], openItemId: null, requested: batch.paths.length, cancelled: false, mode: batch.mode, collectionId: null };
        for (const cb of [...finished]) cb(report, null);
      })();
      return batch.paths.length;
    },
    onFinished(cb: (report: ImportReport, openIn: number | null) => void): () => void {
      finished.add(cb);
      return () => void finished.delete(cb);
    },
  };
}
function sheets(ctx: LibraryContext, over: Partial<CheckSheetsDeps> = {}) {
  const opened: SheetPayload[] = [];
  const relinked: string[][] = [];
  const revealed: string[] = [];
  const queue = queueOf(ctx);
  const deps: CheckSheetsDeps = {
    context: () => ctx,
    sheets: {
      open: async (_parent, payload) => {
        opened.push(payload);
        return { kind: 'libraryCheck' };
      },
    },
    imports: queue,
    announce: () => {},
    relinked: (ids) => void relinked.push(ids),
    homeDir: '/home/u',
    pickFile: async () => null,
    reveal: (file) => void revealed.push(file),
    stopAuto: vi.fn(),
    ...over,
  };
  return { deps, opened, relinked, revealed, queue, checks: createCheckSheets(deps) };
}
async function shown(h: ReturnType<typeof sheets>, mode: 'auto' | 'manual' = 'manual'): Promise<LibraryCheckPayload> {
  await h.checks.open(PARENT, mode);
  return h.opened.at(-1) as LibraryCheckPayload;
}
const acting = (payload: LibraryCheckPayload) => ({ window: SHEET_WINDOW, parent: PARENT, payload });
const act = (h: ReturnType<typeof sheets>, p: LibraryCheckPayload, action: CheckAction) => h.checks.act(action, acting(p));
const rowOf = (p: LibraryCheckPayload, kind: string) => p.rows.find((r) => r.kind === kind);

describe('the automatic sheet\'s rules (spec 7.1)', () => {
  const check = (over: Partial<LibraryCheck>): LibraryCheck => ({
    checkedAt: '2026-10-31T00:00:00.000Z', items: 1, staging: { count: 0, bytes: 0 }, unreferenced: { keys: [], bytes: 0 }, missingManaged: { itemIds: [] },
    missingLinked: { itemIds: [] }, corrupt: { count: 0, bytes: 0, files: [] }, orphanEdits: { count: 0, bytes: 0, copies: [] }, fingerprint: 'f'.repeat(64), actionable: false, ...over,
  });
  it('is due for something to act on whose list was not the last one shown', () => {
    expect(autoShowDue(null, undefined)).toBe(false);
    expect(autoShowDue(check({}), undefined)).toBe(false);
    expect(autoShowDue(check({ actionable: true }), undefined)).toBe(true);
    expect(autoShowDue(check({ actionable: true }), 'f'.repeat(64))).toBe(false);
    expect(autoShowDue(check({ actionable: true }), 'e'.repeat(64))).toBe(true);
  });
  it('waits for the first screen, then looks again every poll while a sheet or a job holds the window', async () => {
    let drawn = (): void => {};
    const firstScreen = new Promise<void>((resolve) => (drawn = resolve));
    let busy = 3;
    const sleeps: number[] = [];
    const result = clearToShow(gate({ firstScreen, busy: () => busy-- > 0, sleep: async (ms) => void sleeps.push(ms) }));
    await Promise.resolve();
    expect(sleeps).toEqual([]);
    drawn();
    expect(await result).toEqual({ go: true, waited: true });
    expect(sleeps).toEqual([AUTO_POLL_MS, AUTO_POLL_MS, AUTO_POLL_MS]);
  });
  it('goes at once when nothing holds the window, and not at all once stopped', async () => {
    expect(await clearToShow(gate())).toEqual({ go: true, waited: false });
    let n = 0;
    expect(await clearToShow(gate({ busy: () => true, stopped: () => n++ > 1 }))).toEqual({ go: false, waited: true });
  });
});

describe('startLibraryCheck (P-18: once the window exists, in the background)', () => {
  it('interrupts the jobs left running, checks, and asks for the automatic sheet when something is left', async () => {
    const ctx = await library();
    await add(ctx, pdf(temp('src'), 'a.pdf', 'a'));
    ctx.db.prepare(`UPDATE jobs SET state = 'running'`).run();
    put(path.join(ctx.layout.stagingDir, 'dead.part'), 10);
    expect(ctx.check).toBeNull();
    const requestAuto = vi.fn();
    expect(await startLibraryCheck(ctx, { announce: () => {}, requestAuto, gate: gate() })).toBe('requested');
    expect(requestAuto).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(ctx.check).toMatchObject({ staging: { count: 1 }, actionable: true });
    expect(ctx.db.prepare(`SELECT state FROM jobs`).pluck().get()).toBe('interrupted');
  });
  it('does not ask for the list the user was shown last, nor for a missing linked original alone — which it announces', async () => {
    const ctx = await library();

    await startLibraryCheck(ctx, { announce: () => {}, requestAuto, gate: gate() });
    ctx.settings.set(LAST_SHOWN, ctx.check!.fingerprint);
    expect(await startLibraryCheck(ctx, { announce: () => {}, requestAuto, gate: gate() })).toBe('not-due');
    fs.rmSync(path.join(ctx.layout.stagingDir, 'dead.part'));

    const announced: string[][] = [];
    expect(await startLibraryCheck(ctx, { announce: (ids) => void announced.push(ids), requestAuto, gate: gate() })).toBe('not-due');
    expect(announced).toEqual([[linked.id]]);
    expect(requestAuto).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
  it('checks again before asking when it had to wait (an import ran meanwhile); a stop calls it off', async () => {
    const ctx = await library();
    put(path.join(ctx.layout.stagingDir, 'a.part'), 1);
    let busy = 1;
    const busyOnce = () => {
      if (busy-- <= 0) return false;
      put(path.join(ctx.layout.stagingDir, 'b.part'), 1);
      return true;
    };
    expect(await startLibraryCheck(ctx, { announce: () => {}, requestAuto: () => {}, gate: gate({ busy: busyOnce }) })).toBe('requested');
    expect(ctx.check!.staging.count).toBe(2);
    const requestAuto = vi.fn();
    expect(await startLibraryCheck(ctx, { announce: () => {}, requestAuto, gate: gate({ stopped: () => true }) })).toBe('stopped');
    expect(requestAuto).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('announces the items whose managed copy it found gone, once', async () => {

    fs.rmSync(resolveAssetPath(ctx.layout, ctx.repo.getAsset(item.assetId)!));
    const announced: string[][] = [];
    await runCheck(ctx, (ids) => void announced.push(ids));
    await runCheck(ctx, (ids) => void announced.push(ids));
    expect(announced).toEqual([[item.id]]);
  });
});

  it('새 자료로 가져오기 imports the orphan edited copies through the queue under their names, and each goes after its commit', async () => {

    const h = sheets(ctx);

    expect(h.queue.batches[0]).toMatchObject({ paths: [edit], mode: 'managed', collectionId: null, owner: 7, allowDuplicate: true, titles: { [edit]: '단백질 접힘 정리 (수정본 2026-10-18 2210)' } });
    expect(ctx.repo.listItems().map((i) => i.title)).toEqual(['단백질 접힘 정리 (수정본 2026-10-18 2210)']);

    const p3 = checkPayload(await runCheck(ctx, () => {}), ctx.repo, { ...input, prev: p2, acted: null });
```
