```ts
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { IDLE_BACKUP_PROGRESS, LearnError, type BackupDoneSheet, type JobProgress } from '@learn/domain';
import { LibraryRepository, SettingsRepository, migrate, openDatabase, type Db } from '@learn/db';
import { Importer, ensureLayout, libraryLayout } from '@learn/library';
import { mainStrings } from '../strings';
import { createBackupJob, type BackupJobDeps, type BackupLibrary } from './backup-job';
import { createJobLane } from './lane';
import { quitQuestion } from './quit-guard';

const made: string[] = [];
const dbs: Db[] = [];
afterEach(() => {
  vi.restoreAllMocks();
  for (const db of dbs.splice(0)) if (db.open) db.close();
  for (const d of made.splice(0)) fs.rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true });
});
const temp = (name: string): string => {
  const d = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), `learn-bj-${name}-`));
  made.push(d);
  return d;
};
const pdf = (dir: string, name: string): string => {
  const p = path.join(dir, name);
  fs.writeFileSync(p, `%PDF-1.4\n% ${name}\n%%EOF\n`);
  return p;
};

/** Two copies and one linked file, in a library of its own. */
async function library(): Promise<BackupLibrary> {
  const layout = libraryLayout(path.join(temp('lib'), 'Library'));
  ensureLayout(layout);
  const db = openDatabase(layout.dbFile);
  dbs.push(db);
  migrate(db, { dbFile: layout.dbFile });
  const repo = new LibraryRepository(db);
  const importer = new Importer({ layout, repo });
  const src = temp('src');
  await importer.importOne(pdf(src, 'a.pdf'), { mode: 'managed' });
  await importer.importOne(pdf(src, 'b.pdf'), { mode: 'managed' });
  await importer.importOne(pdf(src, 'c.pdf'), { mode: 'linked' });
  return { layout, db, repo, settings: new SettingsRepository(db) };
}

type Win = { id: number };
const WHEN = new Date(2026, 9, 30, 21, 41, 5);
function harness(lib: BackupLibrary, over: Partial<BackupJobDeps<Win>> = {}) {
  const lane = createJobLane();
  const parent = temp('dest');
  const notices: JobProgress[] = [];
  const results: Array<{ owner: Win | null; payload: BackupDoneSheet }> = [];
  const picks: Array<{ owner: Win | null; defaultPath: string }> = [];
  const remembered: string[] = [];
  const stored = vi.fn();
  let dir: string | null = null;
  const job = createBackupJob<Win>({
    lane,
    library: () => lib,
    pickFolder: async (owner, opts) => {
      picks.push({ owner, ...opts });
      return parent;
    },
    backupDir: () => dir,
    rememberDir: (d) => {
      dir = d;
      remembered.push(d);
    },
    documentsDir: () => '/home/u/Documents',
    homeDir: () => '/home/u',
    progress: (p) => notices.push(p),
    stored,
    showResult: (owner, payload) => results.push({ owner, payload }),
    now: () => WHEN,
    progressMs: 0,
    ...over,
  });
  const ended = (outcome: JobProgress['outcome']) => vi.waitFor(() => expect(notices.at(-1)?.outcome).toBe(outcome));
  return { job, lane, parent, notices, results, picks, remembered, stored, ended };
}
/** A hook that holds the first copy written until `release` (the copies after it pass). */
function holdFirst() {
  let release: () => void = () => {};
  let held = false;
  const hooks = {
    afterCopy: (): Promise<void> | undefined => {
      if (held) return undefined;
      held = true;
      return new Promise<void>((resolve) => (release = resolve));
    },
  };
  return { hooks, held: () => held, release: () => release() };
}

describe('the backup on the work line (spec 8.1, P-20)', () => {
  it('asks where (the documents folder the first time, then the folder chosen last), names the folder by the minute, and ends with the result sheet', async () => {
    const lib = await library();
    const h = harness(lib);
    const owner = { id: 7 };
    expect(await h.job.start(owner)).toEqual({ started: true });
    await h.ended('done');
    const name = 'Learn 백업 2026-10-30 2141';
    const folder = path.join(h.parent, name);
    expect(h.picks).toEqual([{ owner, defaultPath: '/home/u/Documents' }]);
    expect(h.remembered).toEqual([h.parent]);
    expect(fs.readdirSync(h.parent)).toEqual([name]);
    expect(fs.readdirSync(folder).sort()).toEqual(['assets', 'library.sqlite', 'manifest.json']);
    // Running from the start (nothing ran before it), named, counted; then idle, done.
    expect(h.notices[0]).toEqual({ ...IDLE_BACKUP_PROGRESS, state: 'running' });
    expect(h.notices.some((n) => n.state === 'waiting-job')).toBe(false);
    expect(h.notices.filter((n) => n.state === 'running').at(-1)).toMatchObject({ name, done: 2, total: 2 });
    expect(h.notices.at(-1)).toEqual({ ...IDLE_BACKUP_PROGRESS, outcome: 'done' });
    expect(lib.settings.get('backup.last')).toEqual({ at: WHEN.toISOString(), folder });
    expect(h.stored).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    const bytes = lib.repo.assetsByMode('managed').reduce((n, a) => n + a.size, 0);
    expect(h.results).toEqual([
      { owner, payload: { kind: 'backupDone', at: WHEN.toISOString(), tookMs: 0, items: 3, trashed: 0, files: 2, bytes, linked: 1, missing: 0, location: folder, homeDir: '/home/u' } },
    ]);

    // The next one opens on that folder, and takes a name of its own in the same minute.
    expect(await h.job.start(owner)).toEqual({ started: true });
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(h.results).toHaveLength(2));
    expect(h.picks[1]!.defaultPath).toBe(h.parent);
    expect(fs.readdirSync(h.parent).sort()).toEqual([name, `${name} 2`]);
  });

  it('a cancelled panel starts nothing; with a backup on the line a second is refused unasked', async () => {
    const lib = await library();
    const cancelled = harness(lib, { pickFolder: async () => null });
    expect(await cancelled.job.start(null)).toEqual({ started: false });
    expect([cancelled.notices, cancelled.remembered]).toEqual([[], []]);

    const h = harness(lib);
    const first = holdFirst();
    h.job.setHooks(first.hooks);
    expect(await h.job.start(null)).toEqual({ started: true });
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(first.held()).toBe(true));
    expect(await h.job.start(null)).toEqual({ started: false });
    expect(h.picks).toHaveLength(1);
    first.release();
    await h.ended('done');
  });

  it('refuses a folder inside the library, or one that is gone, before anything runs; with no library it asks nothing', async () => {
    const lib = await library();
    for (const chosen of [lib.layout.root, path.join(lib.layout.root, 'assets')]) {
      const h = harness(lib, { pickFolder: async () => chosen });
      await expect(h.job.start(null)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED', message: mainStrings.backup.inLibrary });
      expect([h.notices, h.remembered]).toEqual([[], []]);
    }
    const gone = harness(lib, { pickFolder: async () => path.join(temp('x'), 'gone') });
    await expect(gone.job.start(null)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED', message: mainStrings.libraryFolder.missing });
    const closed = harness(lib, {
      library: () => {
        throw new LearnError('LIBRARY_UNAVAILABLE', mainStrings.library.unavailable);
      },
    });
    await expect(closed.job.start(null)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'LIBRARY_UNAVAILABLE' });
    expect(closed.picks).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('waits behind a running import as waiting-job and runs after it; 취소 while it waits ends it at once, and it never runs', async () => {
    const lib = await library();
    const h = harness(lib);
    let letGo: () => void = () => {};
    void h.lane.run('import', () => new Promise<void>((resolve) => (letGo = resolve)));
    expect(await h.job.start(null)).toEqual({ started: true });
    expect(h.notices).toEqual([{ ...IDLE_BACKUP_PROGRESS, state: 'waiting-job' }]);
    h.job.cancel();
    expect(h.notices.at(-1)).toEqual({ ...IDLE_BACKUP_PROGRESS, outcome: 'cancelled' });
    letGo();
    await h.lane.idle();
    expect(fs.readdirSync(h.parent)).toEqual([]);
    expect(h.notices.filter((n) => n.outcome !== undefined)).toHaveLength(1); // ended once
    expect(h.results).toEqual([]);

    const after = harness(lib);
    let go: () => void = () => {};
    void after.lane.run('import', () => new Promise<void>((resolve) => (go = resolve)));
    await after.job.start(null);
    go();
    await after.ended('done');
    expect(after.notices.slice(0, 2).map((n) => n.state)).toEqual(['waiting-job', 'running']);
  });

  it('취소 while copying, or the line stopped for a quit, leaves no folder and ends cancelled; 마지막 백업 is not touched', async () => {
    const lib = await library();
    const h = harness(lib);
    const first = holdFirst();
    h.job.setHooks(first.hooks);
    await h.job.start(null);
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(first.held()).toBe(true));
    h.job.cancel();
    first.release();
    await h.ended('cancelled');
    expect(fs.readdirSync(h.parent)).toEqual([]);
    expect(lib.settings.get('backup.last')).toBeUndefined();

    const quit = harness(lib);
    const held = holdFirst();
    quit.job.setHooks(held.hooks);
    await quit.job.start(null);
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(held.held()).toBe(true));
    quit.lane.cancelAll();
    held.release();
    await quit.ended('cancelled');
    expect(fs.readdirSync(quit.parent)).toEqual([]);
    // What the quit question says meanwhile (spec 3.6; Task 3 asks it).
    expect(quitQuestion('backup', 0)).toMatchObject({ message: '백업을 만드는 중입니다', detail: '끝내면 만들던 백업은 남지 않습니다.' });
  });

  it('a copy that reads back different ends failed with its own sentence and the code alone in the log; no folder, no 마지막 백업, no sheet', async () => {
    const lib = await library();
    const logged = vi.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => {});
    const h = harness(lib);
    h.job.setHooks({ afterCopy: (file) => fs.appendFileSync(file, 'changed on the way') });
    await h.job.start(null);
    await h.ended('failed');
    expect(h.notices.at(-1)).toEqual({ ...IDLE_BACKUP_PROGRESS, outcome: 'failed', error: { code: 'HASH_MISMATCH', message: mainStrings.backup.copyMismatch } });
    expect(logged.mock.calls).toEqual([['[backup] failed: HASH_MISMATCH']]);
    expect(fs.readdirSync(h.parent)).toEqual([]);
    expect(lib.settings.get('backup.last')).toBeUndefined();
    expect(h.results).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

```ts
describe('the backup channels (P-20)', () => {
```

**(c)** 새 파일 `apps/desktop/src/main/jobs/backup-job.ts`:
```ts
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { IDLE_BACKUP_PROGRESS, LearnError, toLearnError, type BackupDoneSheet, type ErrorCode, type JobProgress } from '@learn/domain';
import type { Db, LibraryRepository, SettingsRepository } from '@learn/db';
import { createBackup, datedFolderName, type BackupHooks, type LibraryLayout } from '@learn/library';
import { checkLibraryFolder } from '../library-folder';
import { mainStrings } from '../strings';
import { PROGRESS_MS } from './import-queue';
import type { JobLane } from './lane';
import { createThrottle } from './throttle';

export interface BackupLibrary {
  layout: LibraryLayout;
  db: Db;
  repo: LibraryRepository;
  settings: SettingsRepository;
}

export interface BackupJobDeps<W> {
  lane: Pick<JobLane, 'run' | 'busy'>;
  /** The open library (LIBRARY_UNAVAILABLE when there is none). */
  library(): BackupLibrary;
  /** The folder panel over `owner` (a sheet on macOS), opened on `defaultPath`: the folder chosen, or null. */
  pickFolder(owner: W | null, opts: { defaultPath: string }): Promise<string | null>;
  /** prefs.backupDir: the folder chosen last (spec 8.1), and keeping a new one (every window hears of it). */
  backupDir(): string | null;
  rememberDir(dir: string): void;
  documentsDir(): string;
  homeDir(): string;
  /** job:progress to every window. */
  progress(p: JobProgress): void;
  /** backup.last was written: settingsChanged, so a settings window shows it. */
  stored(): void;
  /** The result sheet over the window that asked (or another main window). */
  showResult(owner: W | null, payload: BackupDoneSheet): void;
  now?(): Date;
  progressMs?: number;
}

export interface BackupJob<W> {
  /**
   * 파일 › 백업 만들기…: asks for the folder, checks it, remembers it and puts the backup on the work line; answers once
   * it is there (started), not when it ends. false: the panel was cancelled, or a backup is on the line already.
   */
  start(owner: W | null): Promise<{ started: boolean }>;
  /** The toast's 취소 (spec 8.1): the backup stops at its next checkpoint, or never starts. */
  cancel(): void;
  state(): JobProgress;
  /** E2E only (test-hooks.ts): createBackup's fault points. */
  setHooks(hooks: BackupHooks | undefined): void;
}

interface Run {
  abort: AbortController;
  ended: boolean;
}

/** Inside the library folder: a backup there would travel with the library it is a copy of. */
function within(dir: string, root: string): boolean {
  const rel = path.relative(path.resolve(root), dir);
  return rel === '' || (!rel.startsWith('..') && !path.isAbsolute(rel));
}

/** What a failed run says: its own cause and next step; a copy that read back different has a sentence of its own. */
function failure(e: unknown): { code: ErrorCode; message: string } {
  const le = toLearnError(e, mainStrings.backup.failed);
  return { code: le.code, message: le.code === 'HASH_MISMATCH' ? mainStrings.backup.copyMismatch : le.message };
}

/** A stop, not a failure: 취소, the line stopped for a quit, or a run the quit dropped before it began. */
function stopped(e: unknown, run: Run): boolean {
  return run.abort.signal.aborted || (e as { name?: unknown } | null)?.name === 'AbortError' || toLearnError(e).code === 'CANCELLED';
}

/**
 * 백업 만들기… on main's work line (spec 8.1, P-20): one backup at a time, behind whatever runs first; its state goes to
 * every window as job:progress, its end as a result sheet (done) or the toast's own end (cancelled, failed).
 */
export function createBackupJob<W>(deps: BackupJobDeps<W>): BackupJob<W> {
  const now = deps.now ?? (() => new Date());
  let current: JobProgress = { ...IDLE_BACKUP_PROGRESS };
  let pending: Run | null = null;
  let asking = false;
  let hooks: BackupHooks | undefined;
  const notice = createThrottle(() => deps.progress({ ...current }), deps.progressMs ?? PROGRESS_MS);
  const show = (next: JobProgress, flush = false): void => {
    current = next;
    notice.request();
    if (flush) notice.flush();
  };

  function end(run: Run, outcome: NonNullable<JobProgress['outcome']>, error?: JobProgress['error']): void {
    if (run.ended) return;
    run.ended = true;
    if (pending === run) pending = null;
    show({ ...IDLE_BACKUP_PROGRESS, outcome, ...(error ? { error } : {}) }, true);
  }

  async function work(run: Run, parent: string, owner: W | null, laneSignal: AbortSignal): Promise<void> {
    const signal = AbortSignal.any([laneSignal, run.abort.signal]);
    signal.throwIfAborted();
    const lib = deps.library();
    const when = now();
    const name = datedFolderName(mainStrings.backup.folderPrefix, when, (n) => fs.existsSync(path.join(parent, n)));
    show({ ...IDLE_BACKUP_PROGRESS, state: 'running', name });
    const { summary } = await createBackup({
      layout: lib.layout,
      db: lib.db,
      repo: lib.repo,
      destDir: path.join(parent, name),
      includeAssets: true,
      signal,
      hooks,
      createdAt: when,
      onProgress: (p) => show({ ...current, bytesDone: p.bytesDone, bytesTotal: p.bytesTotal, done: p.filesDone, total: p.filesTotal }),
    });
    try {
      lib.settings.set('backup.last', { at: summary.createdAt, folder: summary.folder });
      deps.stored();
    } catch (e) {
      // The backup is whole; only 마지막 백업 will not say so.
      console.warn(`[backup] backup.last not saved: ${toLearnError(e).code}`);
    }
    end(run, 'done');
    deps.showResult(owner, {
      kind: 'backupDone',
      at: summary.createdAt,
      tookMs: Math.max(0, now().getTime() - when.getTime()),
      items: summary.items,
      trashed: summary.trashedItems,
      files: summary.files,
      bytes: summary.bytes,
      linked: summary.linkedItems,
      missing: summary.missingItems,
      location: summary.folder,
      homeDir: deps.homeDir(),
    });
  }

  return {
    async start(owner) {
      if (pending !== null || asking) return { started: false };
      const lib = deps.library();
      asking = true;
      let chosen: string | null;
      try {
        chosen = await deps.pickFolder(owner, { defaultPath: deps.backupDir() ?? deps.documentsDir() });
      } finally {
        asking = false;
      }
      if (chosen === null) return { started: false };
      const parent = path.resolve(chosen);
      const check = checkLibraryFolder(parent);
      if (!check.ok) throw new LearnError('VALIDATION_FAILED', check.message);
      if (within(parent, lib.layout.root)) throw new LearnError('VALIDATION_FAILED', mainStrings.backup.inLibrary);
      try {
        deps.rememberDir(parent);
      } catch (e) {
        // A device that cannot save its prefs still backs up; the panel just opens elsewhere next time.
        console.warn(`[backup] backupDir not saved: ${toLearnError(e).code}`);
      }
      const run: Run = { abort: new AbortController(), ended: false };
      pending = run;
      // Behind an import or a restore the backup waits its turn (spec 3.1); its toast says so.
      show({ ...IDLE_BACKUP_PROGRESS, state: deps.lane.busy() === null ? 'running' : 'waiting-job' });
      void deps.lane.run('backup', (signal) => work(run, parent, owner, signal)).catch((e: unknown) => {
        if (stopped(e, run)) {
          end(run, 'cancelled');
          return;
        }
        const f = failure(e);
        console.error(`[backup] failed: ${f.code}`);
        end(run, 'failed', f);
      });
      return { started: true };
    },
    cancel() {
      const run = pending;
      if (run === null) return;
      run.abort.abort();
      // Not begun yet: it ends now (its turn on the line finds it stopped and does nothing).
      if (current.state === 'waiting-job') end(run, 'cancelled');
    },
    state: () => ({ ...current }),
    setHooks(next) {
      hooks = next;
    },
  };
}
```

**(d)** 새 파일 `apps/desktop/src/main/ipc/backup.ts`:
```ts
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { BrowserWindow, shell, type WebContents } from 'electron';
import { Channels, LearnError, emptyInput, type BackupInfo } from '@learn/domain';
import type { SettingsRepository } from '@learn/db';
import { mainStrings } from '../strings';
import type { Handle, IpcDeps } from './register';

/** backup.last (spec 8.2) as main wrote it; null when this library has none. */
export function lastBackup(settings: Pick<SettingsRepository, 'get'>): { at: string; folder: string } | null {
  return (settings.get('backup.last') as { at: string; folder: string } | undefined) ?? null;
}

/** Finder에서 보기 on a backup folder: shown selected in its parent; a folder that is gone says so (R4: main opens it). */
export function revealBackupFolder(folder: string): void {
  if (!fs.existsSync(folder)) throw new LearnError('NOT_FOUND', mainStrings.backup.revealMissing);
  shell.showItemInFolder(folder);
}

/** 백업 만들기… and its 취소 (the main window), 마지막 백업 (the settings window). Restore is Task 10's. */
export function registerBackupIpc(handle: Handle, deps: IpcDeps): void {
  // Defence in depth, as app.ts does for the library location: CHANNEL_KINDS already admits the settings window only.
  const fromSettings = (sender: WebContents): void => {
    if (!deps.isSettingsWindow(sender)) throw new LearnError('PERMISSION_DENIED', mainStrings.callerRefused);
  };
  // R4: the page sends no path — main asks for the folder, over the window that asked.
  handle(Channels.backup.create, emptyInput, (_input, event) => deps.backup.start(BrowserWindow.fromWebContents(event.sender)));
  handle(Channels.backup.cancel, emptyInput, () => deps.backup.cancel());
  handle(Channels.app.backupInfo, emptyInput, (_input, event): BackupInfo | null => {
    fromSettings(event.sender);
    let last: { at: string; folder: string } | null;
    try {
      last = lastBackup(deps.getContext().settings);
    } catch {
      return null; // no library open: the settings window shows no 마지막 백업
    }
    return last === null ? null : { at: last.at, folderName: path.basename(last.folder) };
  });
  handle(Channels.app.revealBackup, emptyInput, (_input, event) => {
    fromSettings(event.sender);
    const last = lastBackup(deps.getContext().settings);
    if (last === null) throw new LearnError('NOT_FOUND', mainStrings.backup.revealMissing);
    revealBackupFolder(last.folder);
  });
}
```

  ```ts
    // 백업 만들기… on the same work line (spec 8.1): the folder panel hangs on the window that asked; the result sheet too.
    const backup = createBackupJob<BrowserWindow>({
      lane: jobs,
      library: () => {
        const c = getContext();
        return { layout: c.layout, db: c.db, repo: c.repo, settings: c.settings };
      },
      pickFolder: async (owner, { defaultPath }) => {
        const copy = mainStrings.backup;
        const options: OpenDialogOptions = { title: copy.pickTitle, message: copy.pickMessage, buttonLabel: copy.pickButton, defaultPath, properties: ['openDirectory', 'createDirectory'] };
        const res = owner && !owner.isDestroyed() ? await asSheet(owner, () => dialog.showOpenDialog(owner, options)) : await dialog.showOpenDialog(options);
        return res.canceled ? null : (res.filePaths[0] ?? null);
      },
      backupDir: () => prefs.get().backupDir,
      rememberDir: (dir) => {
        if (prefs.get().backupDir !== dir) broadcast('prefsChanged', { prefs: prefs.set({ backupDir: dir }) });
      },
      documentsDir: () => app.getPath('documents'),
      homeDir: () => app.getPath('home'),
      progress: (p) => broadcast('job:progress', p),
      stored: () => broadcast('settingsChanged', { keys: ['backup.last'] }),
      showResult: (owner, payload) => {
        const parent = owner && !owner.isDestroyed() ? owner : liveMainWindow();
  ```

**(b)** 새 파일 `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/jobs/backupJob.test.ts`:
```ts
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { IDLE_BACKUP_PROGRESS, type JobProgress } from '@learn/domain';
import { backupResult, followBackup } from './backupJob';

const p = (over: Partial<JobProgress>): JobProgress => ({ ...IDLE_BACKUP_PROGRESS, ...over });
function harness() {
  let stored = p({});
  const toast = { begin: vi.fn(), end: vi.fn((): string | null => 'k1'), settle: vi.fn() };
  const follow = followBackup(toast, () => stored, (next) => (stored = next));
  return { toast, follow, stored: () => stored };
}

describe('the backup in this window (spec 8.1, P-3)', () => {
  it('a run begins its toast once; its end freezes the toast at its last state and settles it — done closes it (the sheet says it)', () => {
    const h = harness();
    const named = p({ state: 'running', name: 'Learn 백업 2026-10-30 2141', done: 1, total: 2 });
    h.follow(p({ state: 'waiting-job' }));
    h.follow(p({ state: 'running', name: 'Learn 백업 2026-10-30 2141' }));
    h.follow(named);
    expect(h.toast.begin.mock.calls).toEqual([[false]]);
    h.follow(p({ outcome: 'done' }));
    expect(h.toast.end.mock.calls).toEqual([[named]]);
    expect(h.toast.settle.mock.calls).toEqual([['k1', null]]);
    expect(h.stored()).toEqual(p({ outcome: 'done' }));
  });
  it('cancelled is an info toast; failed an error toast with the cause and the next step; done has none', () => {
    expect(backupResult(p({ outcome: 'cancelled' }))).toEqual({ kind: 'info', title: '백업을 취소했습니다', body: '만들던 백업 폴더는 남기지 않았습니다.', testId: 'backup-cancelled' });
    expect(backupResult(p({ outcome: 'failed', error: { code: 'DISK_FULL', message: '원인. 다음 행동.' } }))).toEqual({ kind: 'error', title: '백업을 만들지 못했습니다', body: '원인. 다음 행동.', testId: 'backup-failed' });
    expect(backupResult(p({ outcome: 'done' }))).toBeNull();
  });
  it('a restore\'s notice, or an idle one with nothing running, changes nothing here', () => {
    const h = harness();
    h.follow({ ...p({ state: 'running' }), kind: 'restore' });
    h.follow(p({}));
    expect([h.toast.begin, h.toast.end, h.toast.settle].map((f) => f.mock.calls.length)).toEqual([0, 0, 0]);
    expect(h.stored()).toEqual(p({}));
  });
});
```

**(b)** `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/format.ts` 끝에:
```ts

/** How long work took, in words (design-spec 9; the backup sheet's "38초 걸림"): at least a second; hours drop the seconds. */
export function formatElapsed(ms: number): string {
  const total = Math.max(1, Math.round(ms / 1000));
  const h = Math.floor(total / 3600);
  const m = Math.floor((total % 3600) / 60);
  const s = total % 60;
  if (h > 0) return t.common.elapsed.hours(h, m);
  if (m > 0) return t.common.elapsed.minutes(m, s);
  return t.common.elapsed.seconds(s);
}
```

**(d)** `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/jobs/jobProgress.ts`(Task 4):
- 2행 가져오기를 `import { IDLE_BACKUP_PROGRESS, IDLE_IMPORT_STATE, type ImportQueueState, type JobProgress } from '@learn/domain';`로, `progressToast` 가져오기를 `import type { JobState, JobToastView, ProgressJob } from './progressToast';`로.
- `JobProgressState`의 `import: ImportQueueState;` 다음에:
  ```ts

  backup: JobProgress;
  ```
  그리고 `setImport(state: ImportQueueState): void;` 다음에 `setBackup(progress: JobProgress): void;`.
- `create` 몸의 `import: { ...IDLE_IMPORT_STATE },` 다음에 `backup: { ...IDLE_BACKUP_PROGRESS },`, `setImport: …,` 다음에 `setBackup: (backup) => set({ backup }),`.
- `JobToastText`의 `note: string | null;` 다음에:
  ```ts
  /** The bar and its percent: not while waiting behind another job (nothing is measured yet, mockup jobToasts). */
  bar: boolean;
  ```
- `export function describeJob(…)` 함수 전체를 바꾼다:
  ```ts
  /** The job ahead of a waiting one, when this window knows which (Q-4e): the backup's notices say it runs. */
  export type AheadJob = 'import' | 'backup' | null;

  /** What a job's toast draws live (Task 10 adds the restore's). */
  export function liveState(s: JobProgressState, job: ProgressJob): JobState {
    return job === 'import' ? s.import : s.backup;
  }

  /** The job running ahead of `job` on main's work line, as this window knows it. */
  export function jobAhead(s: JobProgressState, job: ProgressJob): AheadJob {
    if (job === 'import') return s.backup.state === 'running' ? 'backup' : null;
    return s.import.state !== 'idle' ? 'import' : null;
  }

  /** Floored, so the bar never reads 100 before the work has ended; 0 before the sizes are known. */
  const percentOf = (done: number, total: number): number => (total > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.floor((done * 100) / total)) : 0);

  export function describeJob(job: ProgressJob, s: JobState, ahead: AheadJob = null): JobToastText {
    // Each job's toast is handed its own job's state (liveState, or the view its controller froze).
    return job === 'import' ? describeImport(s as ImportQueueState, ahead) : describeBackup(s as JobProgress, ahead);
  }

  function describeImport(s: ImportQueueState, ahead: AheadJob): JobToastText {
    const percent = percentOf(s.bytesDone, s.bytesTotal);
    const waitingJob = s.state === 'waiting-job';
    return {
      state: s.state,
      waiting: s.state === 'waiting-choice' || waitingJob,
      title: s.state === 'waiting-choice' ? t.jobs.waitingChoice : waitingJob ? t.jobs.waitingJob : t.jobs.importing,
      count: waitingJob ? t.jobs.waitingCount(s.total) : t.jobs.count(s.done, s.total),
      file: waitingJob ? null : s.current,
      note: waitingJob ? (ahead === 'backup' ? t.jobs.importAfter.backup : t.jobs.waitingJobNote) : null,
      bar: !waitingJob,
      percent,
      valueText: t.jobs.progressValue(s.done, s.total, percent),
      testId: 'import-progress',
      cancelTestId: 'import-cancel',
    };
  }

  function describeBackup(s: JobProgress, ahead: AheadJob): JobToastText {
    const percent = percentOf(s.bytesDone, s.bytesTotal);
    const waitingJob = s.state === 'waiting-job';
    return {
      state: s.state,
      waiting: waitingJob,
      title: waitingJob ? t.jobs.waitingJob : t.jobs.backingUp,
      count: !waitingJob && s.total > 0 ? t.jobs.count(s.done, s.total) : '',
      file: waitingJob ? null : s.name,
      note: waitingJob ? (ahead === 'import' ? t.jobs.backupAfter.import : t.jobs.backupAfter.other) : null,
      bar: !waitingJob,
      percent,
      valueText: t.jobs.progressValue(s.done, s.total, percent),
      testId: 'backup-progress',
      cancelTestId: 'backup-cancel',
    };
  }
  ```
- `cancelJob`을 바꾼다:
  ```ts
  /** The toast's 취소: the job stops (spec 3.5, 8.1). A refused call changes nothing the user could act on, so it says nothing. */
  export function cancelJob(job: ProgressJob): void {
    void (job === 'import' ? api().library.cancelImport() : api().backup.cancel());
  }
  ```

```ts
import type { JobProgress } from '@learn/domain';
import { useLearnEvent } from '../events';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { closeToast, showJobToast, showToast, type ToastData } from '../ui/toasts';
import { useJobProgress } from './jobProgress';
import { createProgressToast, type ProgressToast } from './progressToast';

/** How a backup run ends in its toast (spec 8.1); the result sheet speaks for a done one, so it has none here. */
export function backupResult(p: JobProgress): ToastData | null {
  if (p.outcome === 'cancelled') return { kind: 'info', title: t.jobs.backupCancelled, body: t.jobs.backupCancelledBody, testId: 'backup-cancelled' };
  if (p.outcome === 'failed') return { kind: 'error', title: t.jobs.backupFailed, ...(p.error ? { body: p.error.message } : {}), testId: 'backup-failed' };
  return null;
}

/**
 * The backup's notices into the store and its one toast (P-3): a run's first busy notice begins the toast, its end
 * freezes the toast at the last state it showed and settles it — the same <Toast> becomes the cancelled or failed one.
 */
export function followBackup(toast: Pick<ProgressToast, 'begin' | 'end' | 'settle'>, get: () => JobProgress, set: (p: JobProgress) => void): (p: JobProgress) => void {
  return (p) => {
    if (p.kind !== 'backup') return;
    const before = get();
    set(p);
    if (before.state === 'idle' && p.state !== 'idle') toast.begin(false);
    else if (before.state !== 'idle' && p.state === 'idle') toast.settle(toast.end(before), backupResult(p));
  };
}

/** The backup's progress toast in this window: one controller, as there is one toast queue (as the import's). */
const backupToast = createProgressToast('backup', {
  add: (job) => showJobToast(job),
  close: closeToast,
  show: (data) => void showToast(data),
  setView: (key, view) => useJobProgress.getState().setView(key, view),
});
const follow = followBackup(backupToast, () => useJobProgress.getState().backup, (p) => useJobProgress.getState().setBackup(p));

/** main's backup on the work line (job:progress), followed into the store and the toast. */
export function useBackupJob(): void {
  useLearnEvent('job:progress', follow);
}
```

```ts
import type { BackupDoneSheet } from '@learn/domain';
import { formatDateTime, formatElapsed, formatSize, homeRelative } from '../format';
import { t } from '../strings';

export interface BackupSheetText {
  title: string;
  when: string;
  items: string;
  files: string;
  location: string;
  linkedNote: string | null;
  missingNote: string | null;
  reveal: string;
  done: string;
}

/** The result sheet's words (spec 8.2, dialogs.html?scene=backup): the notes only when there is something to say. */
export function backupSheetText(p: BackupDoneSheet, platform: string): BackupSheetText {
  return {
    title: t.backup.doneTitle,
    when: t.backup.when(formatDateTime(p.at), formatElapsed(p.tookMs)),
    items: t.backup.items(p.items, p.trashed),
    files: p.files > 0 ? t.backup.files(p.files, formatSize(p.bytes)) : t.backup.noFiles,
    location: homeRelative(p.location, p.homeDir),
    linkedNote: p.linked > 0 ? t.backup.linkedNote(p.linked) : null,
    missingNote: p.missing > 0 ? t.backup.missingNote(p.missing) : null,
    reveal: platform === 'darwin' ? t.settings.reveal.darwin : t.settings.reveal.other,
    done: t.common.done,
  };
}
```

```tsx
import { useRef, useState } from 'react';

import type { BackupDoneSheet as BackupDonePayload } from '@learn/domain';
import { api, unwrap } from '../api';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { Icon } from '../ui/Icon';
import { currentPlatform } from '../ui/platform';
import { backupSheetText } from './backupText';
import { resolveSheet } from './SheetApp';
import { useScrollRegion } from './scrollRegion';
import { useSheetKeys } from './sheetKeys';

/**
 * 백업을 만들었습니다 (spec 8.2, dialogs.html?scene=backup): when, what the backup holds, where, and what it kept as a
 * location only. Finder에서 보기 asks main to show the folder (sheet:act — this page has no path to send); ↩ and esc are 완료.
 */
export function BackupDoneSheet({ payload }: { payload: BackupDonePayload }) {
  const done = () => resolveSheet({ kind: 'backupDone' });
  const keys = useSheetKeys(done, done);
  const body = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const region = useScrollRegion(body, 'sheet-title');
  const [revealError, setRevealError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const text = backupSheetText(payload, currentPlatform());
  const reveal = () => {
    setRevealError(null);
    void unwrap(api().sheet.act({ action: { kind: 'backupDone', act: 'reveal' } })).catch((e: unknown) => setRevealError((e as Error).message));
  };
  return (
    <div className="sheet" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="sheet-title" aria-describedby="sheet-when" data-sheet-root="" data-kind="backupDone" data-testid="sheet-root" {...keys}>
      <div className="d-title">
        <span className="badge-icon success">
          <Icon icon={CircleCheck} />
        </span>
        <div className="d-heading">
          <h2 id="sheet-title" className="ui-balance" data-testid="backup-title">
            {text.title}
          </h2>
          <div className="t-footnote c-secondary num" id="sheet-when" data-testid="backup-when">
            {text.when}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="d-body" ref={body} {...region}>
        <div className="card kv-card">
          <dl className="kv">
            <dt>{t.backup.labels.items}</dt>
            <dd className="num" data-testid="backup-items">
              {text.items}
            </dd>
            <dt>{t.backup.labels.files}</dt>
            <dd className="num" data-testid="backup-files">
              {text.files}
            </dd>
            <dt>{t.backup.labels.location}</dt>
            <dd className="mono-val ellipsis" title={payload.location} data-testid="backup-location">
              {text.location}
            </dd>
          </dl>
        </div>
        {text.linkedNote !== null && (
          <p className="sheet-note" data-testid="backup-linked-note">
            <Icon icon={Info} size="sm" />
            <span className="ui-prose">{text.linkedNote}</span>
          </p>
        )}
        {text.missingNote !== null && (
          <p className="sheet-note" data-testid="backup-missing-note">
            <Icon icon={Info} size="sm" />
            <span className="ui-prose">{text.missingNote}</span>
          </p>
        )}
        {revealError !== null && (
          <p className="field-error" role="alert" data-testid="backup-reveal-error">
            {revealError}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="d-foot">
        <Button icon={FolderSearch} testId="backup-reveal" onPress={reveal}>
          {text.reveal}
        </Button>
        <span className="spacer" />
        <Button variant="primary" autoFocus testId="backup-done" onPress={done}>
          {text.done}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

**(b)** `tests/e2e/helpers.ts` — 머리 가져오기 곁에 `import type { JobProgress } from '../../packages/domain/src/backup';`. 파일 끝에:
```ts

// ---- M6 backup -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/** One call of the stubbed folder panel (백업 만들기…): whether it hung on a window (a sheet), and what it said. */
export interface FolderPickCall {
  parent: boolean;
  title: string | null;
  message: string | null;
  buttonLabel: string | null;
  defaultPath: string | null;
  properties: string[];
}

/**
 * Replace the native open panel in main with a folder picker that answers `folder` (null: cancelled), recording every
 * call from none (folderPicks). The real panel is kept the first time, as stubOpenDialog keeps it.
 */
export async function stubFolderPicker(app: ElectronApplication, folder: string | null): Promise<void> {
  await app.evaluate(({ dialog }, answer) => {
    const g = globalThis as { __learnFolderPicks?: unknown[]; __learnRealOpenDialog?: typeof dialog.showOpenDialog };
    g.__learnRealOpenDialog ??= dialog.showOpenDialog;
    g.__learnFolderPicks = [];
    dialog.showOpenDialog = (async (...args: unknown[]) => {
      const o = (args.length > 1 ? args[1] : args[0]) as { title?: string; message?: string; buttonLabel?: string; defaultPath?: string; properties?: string[] };
      g.__learnFolderPicks!.push({
        parent: args.length > 1,
        title: o.title ?? null,
        message: o.message ?? null,
        buttonLabel: o.buttonLabel ?? null,
        defaultPath: o.defaultPath ?? null,
        properties: o.properties ?? [],
      });
      return answer === null ? { canceled: true, filePaths: [] } : { canceled: false, filePaths: [answer] };
    }) as typeof dialog.showOpenDialog;
  }, folder);
}
export const folderPicks = (app: ElectronApplication): Promise<FolderPickCall[]> =>
  app.evaluate(() => ((globalThis as { __learnFolderPicks?: FolderPickCall[] }).__learnFolderPicks ?? []));
/** Where main opens the folder panel the first time (spec 8.1: the documents folder). */
export const documentsDir = (app: ElectronApplication): Promise<string> => app.evaluate(({ app }) => app.getPath('documents'));

type WithBackupHooks = {
  __learnTest: {
    backupPause(input: { at: 'afterCopy' | null }): void;
    backupResume(): void;
    backupWaiting(): string | null;
    backupState(): JobProgress;
  };
};
/** The next backup holds its first copy once written, before it is read back, until backupResume (null lifts it). */
export const backupPause = (app: ElectronApplication, at: 'afterCopy' | null = 'afterCopy') =>
  app.evaluate((_e, at) => (globalThis as unknown as WithBackupHooks).__learnTest.backupPause({ at }), at);
export const backupResume = (app: ElectronApplication) => app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as unknown as WithBackupHooks).__learnTest.backupResume());
/** The held copy's path inside the backup being made, or null. */
export const backupWaiting = (app: ElectronApplication) => app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as unknown as WithBackupHooks).__learnTest.backupWaiting());
export const backupState = (app: ElectronApplication) => app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as unknown as WithBackupHooks).__learnTest.backupState());
/** Until main's backup has ended (its last notice sent). */
export const waitBackupIdle = (app: ElectronApplication) =>
  expect.poll(async () => (await backupState(app)).state, { message: 'the backup ended' }).toBe('idle');
```

**(c)** 새 파일 `tests/e2e/backup.spec.ts`:
```ts
// 백업 (spec 8, P-20): the folder it makes and what is in it, the result sheet and 마지막 백업, its toast and 취소, a copy
// that reads back different, the work line it shares with imports, and quitting while it runs.
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import {
  addToCollection, assignTag, backupPause, backupResume, backupWaiting, clickToCloseSheet, closeSheet, confirmCalls, createCollection, createTag, distinctPdfs,
  documentsDir, enabledMenuCommands, expectWindow, folderPicks, importFiles, importPause, importPaths, importResume, launch, runMenuCommand, runPalette,
  shellCalls, stubConfirm, stubFolderPicker, stubShell, trashItems, waitBackupIdle, waitImportIdle,
} from './helpers';

/** manifest.json as the backup writes it (packages/library/src/backup.ts BackupManifest). */
interface Manifest {
  format: string;
  formatVersion: number;
  createdAt: string;
  counts: Record<string, number>;
  assets: Array<{ assetId: string; sha256: string; storageMode: 'managed' | 'linked'; relativePath: string | null; externalPath: string | null; size: number; included: boolean }>;
}
const NAME = /^Learn 백업 \d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{4}$/;
const sha256 = (file: string) => createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(file)).digest('hex');
const readManifest = (folder: string) => JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(folder, 'manifest.json'), 'utf8')) as Manifest;
const kvLast = (page: Page) => page.evaluate(() => window.learn.settings.get({ key: 'backup.last' }));
/** The name a backup made in `when`'s minute takes first (spec 8.1), in local time as main writes it. */
function nameAt(when: Date): string {
  const two = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
  return `Learn 백업 ${when.getFullYear()}-${two(when.getMonth() + 1)}-${two(when.getDate())} ${two(when.getHours())}${two(when.getMinutes())}`;
}
const folderFor = (dir: string) => {
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  return dir;
};

test('a backup holds the database, every managed copy — the trash\'s too — and the manifest; the sheet says what it holds; 마지막 백업 shows it (spec 8.1–8.3)', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const ud = testInfo.outputPath('userdata');
  const parent = folderFor(testInfo.outputPath('backups'));
  const s = await launch(testInfo.outputPath('library'), ud);
  try {
    expect(await enabledMenuCommands(s.app)).not.toContain('file.backup'); // nothing to back up yet
    const [a, b, c] = distinctPdfs(testInfo.outputPath('src'), 3);
    const [kept, trashed] = await importPaths(s.page, [a!, b!]);
    await importPaths(s.page, [c!], { mode: 'linked' });
    const collectionId = await createCollection(s.page, '세포생물학');
    await addToCollection(s.page, collectionId, [kept!.id]);
    await assignTag(s.page, await createTag(s.page, '시험 범위'), [trashed!.id]);
    await trashItems(s.page, [trashed!.id]);
    await expect.poll(() => enabledMenuCommands(s.app)).toContain('file.backup');

    await stubFolderPicker(s.app, parent);
    await stubShell(s.app);
    const sheet = await expectWindow(s.app, 'sheet', () => runMenuCommand(s.app, 'file.backup'));
    // The panel: over the main window, on the documents folder the first time, saying what a backup leaves out.
    expect(await folderPicks(s.app)).toEqual([
      { parent: true, title: '백업 만들기', message: '외부 연결 자료는 파일 없이 위치만 기록합니다.', buttonLabel: '여기에 만들기', defaultPath: await documentsDir(s.app), properties: ['openDirectory', 'createDirectory'] },
    ]);

    // One folder, named by the minute, nothing left beside it: the database, the copies and the manifest only.
    const [name] = fs.readdirSync(parent);
    expect(fs.readdirSync(parent)).toEqual([name]);
    expect(name).toMatch(NAME);
    const folder = path.join(parent, name!);
    expect(fs.readdirSync(folder).sort()).toEqual(['assets', 'library.sqlite', 'manifest.json']);
    const manifest = readManifest(folder);
    expect(manifest).toMatchObject({ format: 'learn-backup', formatVersion: 1, counts: { items: 2, trashedItems: 1, collections: 1, collectionItems: 1, tags: 1, itemTags: 1, assets: 3 } });
    const managed = manifest.assets.filter((x) => x.storageMode === 'managed');
    expect(managed.map((x) => x.included)).toEqual([true, true]); // the trashed item's copy too (spec 8.1)
    for (const x of managed) expect(sha256(path.join(folder, ...x.relativePath!.split('/'))), x.assetId).toBe(x.sha256);
    expect(manifest.assets.find((x) => x.storageMode === 'linked')).toMatchObject({ included: false, externalPath: c });

    // The sheet (dialogs.html?scene=backup).
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('backup-title')).toHaveText('백업을 만들었습니다');
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('backup-when')).toHaveText(/^\d{4}\. \d{1,2}\. \d{1,2}\. 오[전후] \d{1,2}:\d{2} · \d+초 걸림$/);
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('backup-items')).toHaveText('2개 · 휴지통 1개 · 컬렉션⁠·태그 포함');
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('backup-files')).toHaveText(/^2개 · \d+(\.\d)? [KMG]?B · 손상 없음$/);
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('backup-location')).toHaveAttribute('title', folder);
    expect((await sheet.getByTestId('backup-location').textContent())!.endsWith(`/${name}`)).toBe(true);
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('backup-linked-note')).toHaveText('외부 연결 자료 1개는 파일 없이 위치만 기록했습니다. 다른 Mac에서 복원하면 다시 연결해야 합니다.');
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('backup-missing-note')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('backup-done')).toBeFocused();
    await sheet.getByTestId('backup-reveal').click();
    await expect.poll(() => shellCalls(s.app)).toEqual([['reveal', folder]]);
    await clickToCloseSheet(sheet, sheet.getByTestId('backup-done'));

    // Remembered: the folder chosen (this device), when and where (this library) — neither of which a page can write.
    expect(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ud, 'preferences.json'), 'utf8'))).toMatchObject({ backupDir: parent });
    expect(await kvLast(s.page)).toEqual({ ok: true, data: { at: manifest.createdAt, folder } });
    expect(await s.page.evaluate(() => window.learn.settings.set({ key: 'backup.last', value: { at: '2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z', folder: '/tmp' } }))).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'PERMISSION_DENIED' });
    expect(await s.page.evaluate(() => window.learn.prefs.set({ backupDir: '/tmp' } as never))).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED' });

    // 마지막 백업 in the settings window (settings.html).
    const settings = await expectWindow(s.app, 'settings', () => runMenuCommand(s.app, 'app.settings'));
    const date = settings.getByTestId('last-backup-date');
    await expect(date).toHaveText(/^\d{4}\. \d{1,2}\. \d{1,2}\. 오[전후] \d{1,2}:\d{2}$/);
    await expect(date).toHaveAttribute('title', name!);
    await settings.getByTestId('last-backup-reveal').click();
    await expect.poll(async () => (await shellCalls(s.app)).at(-1)).toEqual(['reveal', folder]);
  } finally {

});

test('the palette runs it too; a name used this minute is never taken; a copy gone from the library is said, not copied; the next opens where the last was made', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const lib = testInfo.outputPath('library');
  const parent = folderFor(testInfo.outputPath('backups'));
  const s = await launch(lib, testInfo.outputPath('userdata'));
  try {
    await importPaths(s.page, distinctPdfs(testInfo.outputPath('src'), 2));
    // The names this minute and the next could take are used: it takes " 2" of whichever minute it runs in.
    const now = new Date();
    const used = [nameAt(now), nameAt(new Date(now.getTime() + 60_000))];
    for (const n of used) fs.mkdirSync(path.join(parent, n));
    // A managed copy lost from the library (its row stays).
    const assets = path.join(lib, 'assets');
    const shard = fs.readdirSync(assets).sort()[0]!;
    const lost = fs.readdirSync(path.join(assets, shard))[0]!;
    fs.rmSync(path.join(assets, shard, lost));

    await stubFolderPicker(s.app, parent);
    const sheet = await expectWindow(s.app, 'sheet', () => runPalette(s.page, s.app, '백업', 'file.backup'));
    expect((await folderPicks(s.app))[0]!.defaultPath).toBe(await documentsDir(s.app));
    const made = fs.readdirSync(parent).filter((n) => !used.includes(n));
    expect(made).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(used.map((n) => `${n} 2`)).toContain(made[0]);
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('backup-files')).toHaveText(/^1개 · /);
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('backup-missing-note')).toHaveText('사본이 사라진 자료 1개는 파일 없이 기록했습니다.');
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('backup-linked-note')).toHaveCount(0);
    expect(readManifest(path.join(parent, made[0]!)).assets.filter((x) => !x.included).map((x) => x.sha256)).toEqual([lost]);
    await closeSheet(sheet, 'Enter');

    await stubFolderPicker(s.app, parent);
    const second = await expectWindow(s.app, 'sheet', () => runMenuCommand(s.app, 'file.backup'));
    expect((await folderPicks(s.app))[0]!.defaultPath).toBe(parent);
    await closeSheet(second, 'Escape');
    expect(fs.readdirSync(parent).filter((n) => n.includes('.partial-'))).toEqual([]);
  } finally {
    await s.app.close();
  }
});

test('its toast: 백업을 만드는 중 · files, the folder\'s name, the bar; one backup at a time; 취소 stops it and leaves no folder (spec 8.1, P-3)', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const parent = folderFor(testInfo.outputPath('backups'));
  const s = await launch(testInfo.outputPath('library'), testInfo.outputPath('userdata'));
  try {
    await importPaths(s.page, distinctPdfs(testInfo.outputPath('src'), 3));
    await backupPause(s.app);
    await stubFolderPicker(s.app, parent);
    await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'file.backup');
    await expect.poll(() => backupWaiting(s.app)).not.toBeNull();
    const toast = s.page.getByTestId('backup-progress');
    await expect(toast).toHaveAttribute('data-state', 'running'); // up once the run passed its first second
    await expect(toast).toContainText('백업을 만드는 중 · 0 / 3');
    await expect(toast.locator('.t-file')).toHaveAttribute('title', NAME);
    await expect(toast.getByRole('progressbar')).toHaveAttribute('aria-valuetext', /^파일 3개 중 0개, \d+%$/);
    await expect.poll(() => enabledMenuCommands(s.app)).not.toContain('file.backup');
    const node = await toast.elementHandle();
    await toast.getByTestId('backup-cancel').click();
    await backupResume(s.app);
    const done = s.page.getByTestId('backup-cancelled');
    await expect(done).toContainText('백업을 취소했습니다');
    await expect(done).toContainText('만들던 백업 폴더는 남기지 않았습니다.');
    await expect(done).toHaveAttribute('data-kind', 'info');
    expect(await node!.evaluate((e) => e.isConnected)).toBe(true); // the same toast, now its end (P-3)
    await waitBackupIdle(s.app);
    expect(fs.readdirSync(parent)).toEqual([]);
    expect(await kvLast(s.page)).toEqual({ ok: true, data: null });
    await expect.poll(() => enabledMenuCommands(s.app)).toContain('file.backup');
  } finally {
    await s.app.close();
  }
});

    await closeSheet(sheet, 'Enter');

    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(4);

    // An import holds the line: the backup asked for meanwhile waits, then holds what the import brought in.

    await expect(importing).toHaveAttribute('data-state', 'running');
    await stubFolderPicker(s.app, parent);

    await expect(waiting).toHaveAttribute('data-state', 'waiting-job');
    await expect(waiting).toContainText('앞의 작업을 기다리는 중');
    await expect(waiting).toContainText('가져오기가 끝나면 백업을 시작합니다.');
    await expect(waiting.getByRole('progressbar')).toHaveCount(0);
    sheet = await expectWindow(s.app, 'sheet', () => importResume(s.app));
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('backup-items')).toHaveText('6개 · 컬렉션⁠·태그 포함');
    await closeSheet(sheet, 'Escape');
    await waitImportIdle(s.page);
  } finally {

});

test('quitting during a backup asks with its own words; 취소 keeps it going, 끝내기 stops it and leaves no folder (spec 3.6, P-19)', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const parent = folderFor(testInfo.outputPath('backups'));
  const s = await launch(testInfo.outputPath('library'), testInfo.outputPath('userdata'));
  let quit = false;
  try {
    await importPaths(s.page, distinctPdfs(testInfo.outputPath('src'), 2));
    await backupPause(s.app);
    await stubFolderPicker(s.app, parent);
    await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'file.backup');
    await expect.poll(() => backupWaiting(s.app)).not.toBeNull();

    await stubConfirm(s.app, 'cancel');
    await s.app.evaluate(({ app }) => app.quit());
    await expect.poll(() => confirmCalls(s.app)).toEqual([
      { type: 'warning', message: '백업을 만드는 중입니다', detail: '끝내면 만들던 백업은 남지 않습니다.', buttons: ['끝내기', '취소'], defaultId: 0, cancelId: 1 },
    ]);
    expect(await backupWaiting(s.app)).not.toBeNull(); // 취소: it goes on

    await stubConfirm(s.app, 'confirm');
    const exited = new Promise((resolve) => s.app.process().once('exit', resolve));
    await s.app.evaluate(({ app }) => app.quit());
    await expect.poll(async () => (await confirmCalls(s.app)).length).toBe(1);
    await backupResume(s.app).catch(() => {}); // let go, the copy meets the stop at its read-back; then the app quits
    await exited;
    quit = true;
    expect(fs.readdirSync(parent)).toEqual([]);
  } finally {
    if (!quit) await s.app.close().catch(() => {});
  }
});
```

Run(백그라운드, 끝날 때까지 직접 기다린다): `pnpm build && pnpm fixtures && xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 1920x1200x24" pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/backup.spec.ts --output=/tmp/m6-t9-backup`; 단위: `pnpm exec vitest run apps/desktop/src/main/test-hooks.test.ts`
Expected: 단위 FAIL 1건(`t.backupPause is not a function`). E2E: 셋째·넷째·다섯째·여섯째 FAIL(`__learnTest.backupPause is not a function`), 첫째·둘째는 PASS — 둘은 Step 10의 연결만 쓰므로 여기서 통과하면 채널·작업·시트·설정 줄이 맞게 이어졌다는 뜻이다(실패하면 Step 12 전에 고친다).

- [ ] **Step 12: 시험 훅 구현, E2E 실행, 바뀐 전제의 기존 시험, 커밋**

**(a)** `apps/desktop/src/main/test-hooks.ts`:
- 가져오기 곁에 `import type { JobProgress } from '@learn/domain';`(domain 가져오기 줄에 더해도 된다), `import type { BackupJob } from './jobs/backup-job';`.
- `LearnTestHooks`의 Task 4 `releaseJob(): void;` 다음에:
  ```ts
  /**
   * The next backup holds its first copy once it is written, before it is read back (spec 8.1), until backupResume — so a
   * test sees its toast, presses its 취소, or changes the copy under it. `null` lifts it.
   */
  backupPause(input: { at: 'afterCopy' | null }): void;
  backupResume(): void;
  /** The held copy's path inside the backup being made, or null. */
  backupWaiting(): string | null;
  backupState(): JobProgress;
  ```
- `installTestHooks`의 의존 묶음 끝(Task 4의 `imports?: { … };` 다음)에:
  ```ts
    /** The backup job (backupPause and its kin; tests that do not use them leave it out). */
    backup?: Pick<BackupJob<unknown>, 'setHooks' | 'state'>;
  ```
- 몸에서 Task 4의 `let heldJob: (() => void) | null = null;` 다음에:
  ```ts
    let backupHeld: { file: string; go: () => void } | null = null;
    const backupJob = (): NonNullable<typeof deps.backup> => {
      if (!deps.backup) throw new Error('backup hooks: no backup job');
      return deps.backup;
    };
  ```
- `__learnTest` 객체의 Task 4 `releaseJob() { … },` 다음에:
  ```ts
    backupPause({ at }) {
      if (at === null) {
        backupJob().setHooks(undefined);
        return;
      }
      let armed = true;
      backupJob().setHooks({
        afterCopy: (file) => {
          if (!armed) return undefined;
          armed = false; // once: the copies after it pass
          return new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
            backupHeld = { file, go: resolve };
          });
        },
      });
    },
    backupResume() {
      const held = backupHeld;
      backupHeld = null;
      held?.go();
    },
    backupWaiting: () => backupHeld?.file ?? null,
    backupState: () => backupJob().state(),
  ```
  (`installTestHooks`의 매개변수 이름이 `deps`가 아니면 그 이름을 쓴다.)

**(b)** 바뀐 전제의 기존 시험:
- `tests/e2e/import-queue.spec.ts`(Task 4) `waiting behind the work before it …` 시험 — 기다리는 토스트는 막대 없이 파일 수만(승인 목업 `jobToasts`, Q-9f). `holdJob`은 `job:progress`를 보내지 않으므로 아래 줄은 일반 문장 그대로다:
  ```ts
      await expect(toast(s.page)).toContainText('앞의 작업을 기다리는 중 · 2개');
      await expect(toast(s.page)).toContainText('앞의 작업이 끝나면 가져오기를 시작합니다.');
      await expect(toast(s.page).getByRole('progressbar')).toHaveCount(0);
  ```

`tests/e2e/visual/tour.spec.ts`:

- `settings window (…)` 정거장 다음에(같은 파일의 `tourHome`을 쓴다):
```ts
// 백업 (spec 8; dialogs.html?scene=jobs, ?scene=backup, ?scene=backup-missing, settings.html): the backup's toast with an
// import waiting behind it, the result sheet, 마지막 백업. Files of fixed sizes, so the bar and the sizes read the same
// everywhere; the minute (the folder's name, the sheet's first line, the settings date) is masked.
test('backup: its toast with an import waiting behind it, the result sheet (and with a lost copy), 마지막 백업 in settings', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const home = tourHome(testInfo.outputPath());
  const dir = path.join(home, 'Library', 'Application Support', 'Learn');
  const s = await launchTour(dir, { HOME: home });
  const documents = path.join(home, 'Documents');
  fs.mkdirSync(documents, { recursive: true });
  const dates = () => [s.page.locator('[data-testid="item-row"] [data-col="createdAt"]')];
  const sheetMasks = (sheet: Page) => [sheet.getByTestId('backup-when'), sheet.getByTestId('backup-location')];
  try {
    const src = testInfo.outputPath('src');
    await importPaths(s.page, [fixedSizeCopy(path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf'), src, 1_500_000), h264(src)]);
    const more = distinctPdfs(testInfo.outputPath('more'), 4);
    for (const p of more) fs.truncateSync(p, 1_000_000);
    for (const [i, theme] of THEMES.entries()) {
      await setTheme(s.page, theme);
      await backupPause(s.app);
      await stubFolderPicker(s.app, documents);
      await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'file.backup');
      await expect.poll(() => backupWaiting(s.app)).not.toBeNull();
      await importFiles(s, more.slice(2 * i, 2 * i + 2));
      await expect(s.page.getByTestId('import-progress')).toHaveAttribute('data-state', 'waiting-job');
      await expect(s.page.getByTestId('backup-progress')).toHaveAttribute('data-state', 'running');
      await shoot(s.page, `toast-backup-jobs-${theme}`, { mask: [...dates(), s.page.getByTestId('backup-progress').locator('.t-file')] });
      const sheet = await expectWindow(s.app, 'sheet', () => backupResume(s.app));
      await expect(sheet.getByTestId('backup-files')).toContainText('손상 없음');
      await shoot(sheet, `sheet-backup-${theme}`, { mask: sheetMasks(sheet) });
      await closeSheet(sheet, 'Enter');
      await waitImportIdle(s.page);
      const settings = await expectWindow(s.app, 'settings', () => runMenuCommand(s.app, 'app.settings'));
      await expect(settings.getByTestId('last-backup-date')).toBeVisible();
      await shoot(settings, `settings-backup-${theme}`, { mask: [settings.getByTestId('last-backup-date')] });
      await settings.close();
      await (await mainWindow(s.app)).evaluate((w) => w.focus());
    }
    // A managed copy gone from the library: the sheet says it was kept without its file (?scene=backup-missing).
    await setTheme(s.page, 'light');
    const assets = path.join(dir, 'library', 'assets');
    const shard = fs.readdirSync(assets).sort()[0]!;
    fs.rmSync(path.join(assets, shard, fs.readdirSync(path.join(assets, shard))[0]!));
    await stubFolderPicker(s.app, documents);
    const sheet = await expectWindow(s.app, 'sheet', () => runMenuCommand(s.app, 'file.backup'));
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('backup-missing-note')).toBeVisible();
    await shoot(sheet, 'sheet-backup-missing-light', { mask: sheetMasks(sheet) });
    await closeSheet(sheet, 'Enter');
  } finally {
    await s.app.close();
  }
});
```

```ts
test('M6 backup: its toast with an import waiting behind it, the result sheet (macOS: a real sheet), 마지막 백업; throughput reported', TAG, async () => {
  const parent = path.join(tmp, 'backups');
  fs.mkdirSync(parent, { recursive: true });
  await setTheme('light');
  await backupPause(s.app);
  await stubFolderPicker(s.app, parent);
  await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'file.backup');
  await expect.poll(() => backupWaiting(s.app)).not.toBeNull();
  await importFiles(s, [sized(PDF, 'molbio_ch14_immunity.pdf', 1_000_000), sized(PDF, 'molbio_ch15_neurons.pdf', 1_000_000)]);
  const backupToast = s.page.getByTestId('backup-progress');
  const importToast = s.page.getByTestId('import-progress');
  await expect(backupToast).toHaveAttribute('data-state', 'running');
  await expect(importToast).toHaveAttribute('data-state', 'waiting-job');
  await guard('backup toast: 백업을 만드는 중 with its files and folder, a bar; the import behind it waits with no bar and names the backup; both 360 wide', async () => {
    const v = {
      backup: (await backupToast.textContent()) ?? '',
      importing: (await importToast.textContent()) ?? '',
      bars: [await backupToast.locator('.progress').count(), await importToast.locator('.progress').count()],
      widths: [await backupToast.evaluate((t) => Math.round(t.getBoundingClientRect().width)), await importToast.evaluate((t) => Math.round(t.getBoundingClientRect().width))],
    };
    results['backupToasts'] = v;
    check(
      'backup toast: 백업을 만드는 중 with its files and folder, a bar; the import behind it waits with no bar and names the backup; both 360 wide',
      v.backup.includes('백업을 만드는 중 · 0 / ') && v.backup.includes('Learn 백업 ') && v.importing.includes('백업이 끝나면 가져오기를 시작합니다.') && v.bars[0] === 1 && v.bars[1] === 0 && v.widths.every((w) => w === 360),
      v,
    );
  });
  for (const theme of ['light', 'dark'] as const) {
    await setTheme(theme);
    if (IS_MAC) await focusApp(s.app);
    await shots(s.page, `m6-05-backup-jobs-${theme}`, `the backup's toast and an import waiting behind it (dialogs.html?scene=jobs, ${theme})`);
  }
  await setTheme('light');
  const sheet = await expectWindow(s.app, 'sheet', () => backupResume(s.app));
  await guard('backup sheet: 440 wide, the success badge, the location in mono, 완료 focused', async () => {
    const v = await sheet.evaluate(() => ({
      width: innerWidth,
      badge: getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.badge-icon')!).backgroundColor,
      mono: getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('[data-testid="backup-location"]')!).fontFamily,
      focused: document.activeElement?.getAttribute('data-testid') ?? null,
    }));
    const soft = await tokenColor(sheet, '--success-soft');
    results['backupSheet'] = { ...v, soft };
    check('backup sheet: 440 wide, the success badge, the location in mono, 완료 focused', v.width === 440 && v.badge === soft && /mono/i.test(v.mono) && v.focused === 'backup-done', results['backupSheet']);
  });
  if (IS_MAC) await fullScreenShot('m6-06-backup-sheet', 'the backup result sheet hanging on the main window (a macOS sheet)');
  await shots(sheet, 'm6-06-backup-sheet-light', 'the backup result sheet (dialogs.html?scene=backup)');
  await closeSheet(sheet, 'Enter');
  await waitImportIdle(s.page);
  const settings = await expectWindow(s.app, 'settings', () => runMenuCommand(s.app, 'app.settings'));
  await guard('settings: 마지막 백업 with its date and the reveal button', async () => {
    const v = { date: (await settings.getByTestId('last-backup-date').textContent()) ?? null, reveal: (await settings.getByTestId('last-backup-reveal').textContent())?.trim() ?? null };
    results['lastBackup'] = v;
    check('settings: 마지막 백업 with its date and the reveal button', v.date !== null && /^\d{4}\. /.test(v.date) && v.reveal === (IS_MAC ? 'Finder에서 보기' : '폴더에서 보기'), v);
  });
  await shots(settings, 'm6-07-settings-last-backup-light', 'the settings window with 마지막 백업 (settings.html)');
  await settings.close();
  // Throughput (spec 14: reported only — it depends on the disk): a 64 MB copy written, flushed and read back with the rest.
  await importPaths(s.page, [sized(MP4, 'lecture-64mb.mp4', 64_000_000)]);
  await stubFolderPicker(s.app, parent);
  const started = Date.now();
  const timed = await expectWindow(s.app, 'sheet', () => runMenuCommand(s.app, 'file.backup'));
  const ms = Date.now() - started;
  const newest = fs.readdirSync(parent).sort().at(-1)!;
  const manifest = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(parent, newest, 'manifest.json'), 'utf8')) as { assets: Array<{ size: number; included: boolean }> };
  const bytes = manifest.assets.filter((a) => a.included).reduce((n, a) => n + a.size, 0);
  results['backupThroughput'] = { ms, bytes, mbPerSecond: Math.round((bytes / 1e6 / (ms / 1000)) * 10) / 10 };
  await closeSheet(timed, 'Enter');
  save();
});
```

   | 투어 | 목업 |
   |---|---|
   | `toast-backup-jobs-{light,dark}` | `dialogs--jobs-*-B`의 토스트 둘(위 "백업을 만드는 중 · N / M" + 폴더 이름 + 막대, 아래 "앞의 작업을 기다리는 중 · 2개" + "백업이 끝나면 가져오기를 시작합니다.", 막대 없음) |
   | `sheet-backup-{light,dark}` | `dialogs--backup-*-B`의 시트(성공 배지, 제목 아래 시각 · 걸린 시간, 카드 자료·파일·위치, 정보 줄, [Finder에서 보기] [완료]) |
   | `sheet-backup-missing-light` | `dialogs--backup-missing-light-B`(둘째 정보 줄) |
   | `settings-backup-{light,dark}` | `settings-*-B`의 라이브러리 묶음 "마지막 백업 — 날짜 [Finder에서 보기](28)" |
   | `settings-{light,dark}`(갱신) | `settings--nobackup-*-B`(아직 없음 + 이름 아래 힌트) |
   | `toast-import-waiting-{light,dark}`(갱신) | `dialogs--jobs-*-B`의 아래 토스트(막대 없음 · "N개"; 이 정거장은 `holdJob`이라 아래 줄이 일반 문장) |
4. 루브릭: 디자인 명세 6 "시트"(폭 440, 머리 배지 32, 기본 단추 오른쪽 끝 ↩, 보조 정보 footnote 12/16 `--text-secondary`, 경로 mono), 6 "토스트"·"진행 막대"(폭 360, 막대와 % 아래 줄, 기다릴 때 일시정지 아이콘), 10.6 설정(행 높이 44, 이름 아래 힌트, 값 2차색 + 작은 단추), 10.7(백업 결과 시트), 9 문장(합니다체, "컬렉션·태그 포함", U+00A0), `mockup.css` `.dialog`·`.kv`·`.toast`·`.progress`·`.form-row`. 비평 범위: 이 작업이 그린 것(백업 토스트·기다리는 토스트·결과 시트·설정 줄)과 그 주변의 회귀(설정 창 높이, 토스트 영역의 쌓임). 플랫폼 차이(지적 대상 아님)는 Global Constraints 그대로.

- [ ] **Step 18: Mac — 컨트롤러가 suite `p1`을 돌린다(구현자는 돌리지 않는다)**

CI 녹색 뒤 컨트롤러: `scripts/evidence.sh m6-p1-gate p1 m6-t9`. 받은 `m6-p1.json`의 `tally.failed` 0, `backupThroughput`(Mac의 `F_FULLFSYNC` 비용이 백업 처리량에 드러난다 — Q-2c의 Mac 측정과 나란히 `docs/mac-verification.md`에 적는다), `m6-05-backup-jobs-*`·`m6-06-backup-sheet.screen.png`(네이티브 시트로 걸린 결과 시트)·`m6-06-backup-sheet-light`·`m6-07-settings-last-backup-light`로 Step 15의 비평을 한 번 더 한다. 실기에서만 볼 것(next-session에 넘긴다): macOS 폴더 패널에 메시지 줄이 보이는지, 외장 디스크로 백업할 때의 처리량과 취소 대기.

## 작성자 제안 (Q-9x)

- **Q-9a `job:progress` 필드 더하기** — P-20의 `{ kind; state; bytesDone; bytesTotal }`에 `done`·`total`(파일 수), `name`(만드는 폴더의 이름), 끝 알림의 `outcome`·`error`를 더했다. 이유: 승인 목업 `scene=jobs`의 백업 토스트가 "백업을 만드는 중 · 56 / 128"과 폴더 이름을 보이고, 진행 토스트가 결과(취소·실패)로 바뀌려면(P-3) 렌더러가 끝난 방식과 오류 문장을 알아야 한다. 안 받으면: 토스트에 수와 이름이 없고(목업과 다름), 실패는 따로 푸시나 채널이 필요하다. Task 10이 같은 모양을 쓴다.
- **Q-9b `CommandContextState.backupRunning?`** — 백업이 줄에 있으면 `file.backup`을 끈다(Q-4c `importRunning`과 같은 모양). main도 두 번째 시작을 `{ started: false }`로 거절한다. 안 받으면: 두 번째 클릭이 아무 말 없이 무시된다.
- **Q-9c `createBackup`이 `{ manifest, summary }`를 돌려줌, `LibraryCounts += trashedItems, trashedCollections`, `LibraryRepository.itemCountsByAsset()`** — 결과 시트의 "외부 연결 자료 N개"·"사본이 사라진 자료 N개"는 자산이 아니라 자료 수이고 스냅샷과 같은 순간에 세야 한다. 명세 8.3 "자료(휴지통 포함/제외 둘 다)"는 `items` + `trashedItems`로 둔다(포함 = 합). 안 받으면: 자산 수로 세어 같은 파일을 쓰는 자료가 있을 때 숫자가 틀린다.
- **Q-9e main이 연 결과 시트도 창을 잡는다(`blocked ||= sheetShown`)** — P-20대로 결과 시트는 main이 연다(렌더러가 부르지 않았다). 창이 그 시트를 알도록 이미 있는 `windowState.sheetOpen`을 쓴다: 시트가 보이는 동안 메뉴 막대·명령·드롭이 꺼진다(렌더러가 연 시트·패널은 이미 잡고 있어 변화 없음). 남는 틈: 시트 창이 뜨기까지(수백 ms) 명령이 돈다. Task 8의 Q-8d처럼 하려면 main이 결과를 들고 있다가 `job:progress`의 `outcome: 'done'`으로 알리고, 창이 `askInSheet(() => api().backup.showResult())`(새 채널, MAIN)로 열게 한다 — 그러면 요청부터 닫힐 때까지 잡힌다. 비용: 채널 하나, P-20 문장 정정. 안 받으면(둘 다): 결과 시트 아래에서 ⌘O 등이 패널을 하나 더 띄우려 한다.
- **Q-9f 기다리는 토스트를 승인 목업대로** — 막대 없음, "앞의 작업을 기다리는 중 · N개", 아래 줄이 앞의 작업을 부른다(Q-4e). Task 4의 `describeJob`·`import-queue.spec.ts` 세 줄·`toast-import-waiting-*` 기준 PNG가 바뀐다(목업 비평 1-27, 소유자 승인 f4eaaac). 안 받으면: 기다리는 동안 0% 막대가 남는다(목업과 다름).
- **Q-9g 백업 사본은 스트림으로 진짜 복사(복제 금지)** — APFS 같은 디스크의 `COPYFILE_FICLONE`는 블록을 공유해 라이브러리와 함께 손상된다. 청크 단위라 진행과 취소가 큰 파일 안에서도 움직인다. 비용: 같은 디스크 백업이 공간과 시간을 쓴다(처리량은 `p1`이 보고).
- **Q-9h 라이브러리 폴더 안에는 백업하지 않음** — 명세에 없다. 라이브러리 안의 백업은 라이브러리와 함께 옮겨지고 지워진다(백업의 뜻이 없다). 문구 `mainStrings.backup.inLibrary`.
- **Q-9i 새 문구** — 폴더 패널 단추 "여기에 만들기", 취소 결과 "백업을 취소했습니다" / "만들던 백업 폴더는 남기지 않았습니다.", 실패 "백업을 만들지 못했습니다" + 원인 문장(다시 읽기 실패는 "복사한 파일의 내용이 원래 자료와 달라 백업을 남기지 않았습니다. 다른 디스크나 폴더에 다시 만들어 보세요."), 복사할 파일이 없을 때 파일 줄 "없음", 걸린 시간 "38초 / 2분 5초 / 1시간 4분", 기다리는 백업의 아래 줄 "가져오기가 끝나면 백업을 시작합니다."(앞의 작업을 모르면 "앞의 작업이 끝나면 백업을 시작합니다."). Task 12가 명세 8.1·8.2에 옮길 문장들이다.
- **Q-9j `app:backupInfo`의 툴팁** — 계약대로 `{ at, folderName }`이라 설정 줄의 날짜 툴팁은 폴더 이름이다(목업은 `~/Documents/Learn 백업 …`). 원하면 `location`(홈 상대 경로)을 더한다 — 비용 없음, 정보 노출은 시트와 같은 수준.
- **Q-9k 결과 시트도 내용 높이를 따라간다(`FOLLOWING_SHEETS += 'backupDone'`)** — Finder에서 보기가 실패하면(백업 폴더를 옮겼거나 지웠다) 시트 안에 오류 줄이 생긴다. 높이가 고정이면 그 줄이 몸통 스크롤 아래로 숨는다. Task 8의 기계를 그대로 쓰고 높이 상한은 기본값이다. 안 받으면: 오류 줄을 시트 발 위에 고정하거나 오류 토스트로 바꾼다.
- **Q-9l E2E 훅 `backupPause`·`backupResume`·`backupWaiting`·`backupState`와 `createBackup`의 `hooks.afterCopy`** — 1초 규칙 때문에 작은 시험 파일로는 토스트·취소·다시 읽기 실패를 볼 수 없다. 멈춤은 한 번만(다음 사본은 지나간다), 다시 읽기 전 자리라 시험이 사본을 바꿀 수 있다. E2E에서만 설치된다.
- **Q-9m 설정 창이 `settingsChanged`를 듣는다** — 설정 창은 미리 숨겨 준비되므로 백업 뒤에 다시 읽어야 "마지막 백업"이 맞다. main이 `backup.last`를 쓰고 `settingsChanged { keys: ['backup.last'] }`를 보낸다(새 푸시 없이 있는 것을 씀). 안 받으면: 백업 뒤 설정 창이 "아직 없음"을 계속 보인다(다시 열 때까지).

### Task 10: 복원 — `backup:restore`(백업 고르기·manifest 검사·상위 폴더·`Learn 복원 …`), 작업 줄의 복원(진행·취소·다시 읽기 확인·fsync), 교차 확인 결과, 결과 시트 `'restoreDone'`(Finder에서 보기 · 전환하고 다시 시작 · 나중에), 치명 화면 Finder에서 보기, `file.restore`

#### 이 작업이 하는 일

명세 9, 3.6, 11, 12와 P-17·P-19·P-20·Q-2d. 소유자가 승인한 목업(f4eaaac): `dialogs.html?scene=restore`·`?scene=restore-issues`(결과 시트), `?scene=fatal`(치명 화면의 Finder에서 보기). 문구는 Task 1 보고서의 "명세에 옮길 것"(9.3)과 판정("해시" 대신 "손상 없음"·"내용이 손상된 파일 N개")을 따른다.

- **라이브러리(L)**: `readBackupManifest(dir)`(형식·지원 버전·더 새 스키마·옆의 `library.sqlite` — 두 번째 패널 전에 부른다). `restoreBackup`이 관리 사본을 Task 9의 `copyCounting`으로 **진짜 복사**하며 바이트를 세고, fsync한 뒤 **다시 읽어** 해시를 확인한다. 다르면 그 사본을 `staging/corrupt-<sha>-<id>`로 비켜 둔다(그 자리에 두면 Task 8의 점검이 "돌아온 사본"으로 보고 available로 되돌린다). 백업이 적었지만 더는 가진 적 없는 파일은 실패가 아니라 `missingAssets`(명세 9.2 "없거나 다른 자산은 missing"). 취소 지점: 시작 전·사본 사이·복사 중(청크)·다시 읽기 중·DB 열기 전·이름 붙이기 직전. 폴더 fsync(Q-2d): DB → 사본 → 샤드 폴더 → `assets/` → (손상 사본이 있으면 `staging/`) → 표시를 끝낸 DB → 임시 폴더 → rename → 상위 폴더. 결과에 백업 시각·manifest의 관리 사본 수·문제가 닿은 자료(`problemItems` — 휴지통 자료 포함, 살아 있는 것 먼저). manifest 오류 문장은 `D/backup.ts` `RESTORE_COPY`(원인 + 다음 행동, `strings.test.ts`가 검사).
- **DB**: `LibraryRepository.originalItemsOf(assetIds)` — 그 자산을 원본으로 쓰는 자료(휴지통 포함)의 제목.
- **main**: `M/jobs/restore-job.ts` — 백업 폴더 고르기(마지막 백업 위치 `prefs.backupDir`, 없으면 문서 폴더) → manifest 검사 → 복원할 곳 고르기(기본: 지금 라이브러리의 상위 폴더) → 폴더 검사(없음·폴더 아님·쓰기 불가·**라이브러리 안**·**백업 폴더 안**) → 작업 줄(`jobs.run('restore', …)`)에서 `Learn 복원 YYYY-MM-DD HHmm`(`datedFolderName`)에 복원, `job:progress`(`kind: 'restore'`) → 결과 시트 `'restoreDone'`(작업 줄 밖에서 답을 기다린다). 시트의 Finder에서 보기는 `sheet:act`(`onAct('restoreDone')`), 전환·나중에는 `sheet:resolve({ kind: 'restoreDone', switch })`. 전환 = `app.chooseLibraryFolder`의 저장 후 재시작 경로를 `switchLibrary(target, …)`로 꺼내 둘이 같이 쓴다(`prefs.libraryRoot` 저장 → `prefsChanged` → `deps.relaunch()`; E2E는 요청만 기록). 전환이 실패하면(환경설정을 쓸 수 없음 등) 결과 시트가 닫힌 뒤라 메인 창에 네이티브 경고 상자. 채널 `backup:restore`(MAIN), `backup:cancel`이 `{ job: 'restore' }`로 복원도 멈춘다, `app:revealUpdateBackup`(MAIN — 치명 화면). 종료 확인 문구는 Task 3의 `quitGuard.restore` 그대로(E2E로 확인).
- **렌더러**: 진행 토스트에 복원(P-3의 같은 기계, `ProgressJob += 'restore'`, 앞의 작업 이름 문장 셋), 결과 토스트(취소·실패 — 시작 전에 거절된 것도 같은 실패 토스트), 결과 시트 `RestoreDoneSheet`(넓은 560, 성공/주의 배지, 카드 자료·파일·위치 + 작은 Finder에서 보기, 문제 줄과 자료 이름 2개 + "외 N개", 파일 없음 문장, "지금 라이브러리는 그대로 남습니다…", [나중에] [이 라이브러리로 전환하고 다시 시작]), 치명 화면 [Finder에서 보기] [설정 열기], 명령 `file.restore`(파일 메뉴 group 3 order 3, 팔레트), 폴더 패널 동안 창을 잡는다.
- **E2E** `tests/e2e/restore.spec.ts` 6건(AC15 흐름 — 컬렉션·태그·휴지통이 있는 라이브러리를 백업 → 빈 폴더에 복원 → 시트 문구 → 전환 요청 기록 → `LEARN_LIBRARY_DIR` = 복원 폴더로 띄운 두 번째 앱에서 자료·sha256·개수·컬렉션·태그·소속·휴지통이 같다; 문제가 있는 백업; 거절; 토스트·취소; 작업 줄·종료 확인; 치명 화면), 시험 훅 `__learnTest.restorePause/restoreResume/restoreWaiting/restoreState`, 투어 정거장 하나(새 기준 PNG 4장 + 바뀐 치명 화면 4장), Mac `p1` 판정.

이 작업이 하지 않는 것: `p1-gate.spec.ts`(Task 11 — 이 작업의 도우미를 쓴다), 성능 측정(명세 14 "보고만" — `p1`에 처리량 한 줄), 명세·디자인 명세 문서 고치기(Task 12, 아래 Q-10*).

#### 정한 것 (컨트롤러가 "고르고 말하라"고 한 곳)

1. **`file.restore`는 언제 켜지나**: 레지스트리 규칙은 `restoreRunning !== true` 하나(명세 11.1 "늘" + Task 9 Q-9b와 같은 이유 — 줄에 복원이 있으면 두 번째 클릭이 말없이 무시되지 않게 끈다). 라이브러리를 열지 못한 치명 화면에서는 **꺼진다**: `FatalScreen`이 `blocked: true` 맥락을 보고해 메뉴 막대의 레지스트리 명령이 모두 꺼지고(메인 소유인 설정…만 남는다), 팔레트도 없다. 명세 2절이 치명 화면의 "백업에서 복원…"을 뺐으므로 메인 소유 명령으로 만들지 않는다. 대신 복원 작업 자체는 열린 라이브러리를 쓰지 않는다(`getContext()`를 부르지 않고 `libraryRoot`만 쓴다) — 나중에 치명 화면에서 허용하려면 `MAIN_OWNED_COMMANDS` 한 줄과 `dispatchMenuCommand`의 가지 하나다(Q-10a).
2. **취소 채널**: P-20의 `backup:cancel`이 복원도 맡는다. 입력이 `{ job: 'backup' | 'restore' }`(선택, 없으면 백업 — Task 9의 호출은 그대로 통과)로 넓어진다. 백업과 복원이 줄에 함께 있을 수 있어(하나는 돌고 하나는 기다림) 토스트의 취소가 자기 작업을 가리켜야 한다(Q-10b).
3. **전환은 `sheet:resolve`**(P-17 그대로) — 명세 12의 `backup:pickRestore`·`backup:switchTo`는 P-20·P-17이 대신한다(Task 12가 명세 12를 고친다).
4. **문제 줄의 자료 이름**은 줄마다 2개 + "외 N개"(Task 1 보고서의 9.3 문장, P-26·Task 8 `ENTRY_NAMES = 2`와 같은 규칙). 컨트롤러 지시문의 "최대 3"과 다르다 — 상수 하나(`RESTORE_ISSUE_NAMES`)라 Q-10c로 올린다.

**(b)** `packages/db/src/library-repository.ts`. `LibraryCounts` 인터페이스 다음에:
```ts
/** An item whose original file is a given asset (a restore names the items its problems touch, spec 9.3). */
export interface AssetItem {
  assetId: string;
  itemId: string;
  title: string;
  /** In the trash: listed after the live ones. */
  trashed: boolean;
}
```
Task 9의 `itemCountsByAsset()` 메서드 다음에:
```ts
  /**
   * The items, the trash's too, whose original file is one of `assetIds`: live ones first, then the trash's, each in the
   * order it came in; an item once.
   */
  originalItemsOf(assetIds: readonly string[]): AssetItem[] {
    const ids = [...new Set(assetIds)];
    const rows: Array<{ assetId: string; itemId: string; title: string; trashed: number; createdAt: string; seq: number }> = [];
    for (let start = 0; start < ids.length; start += GET_ITEMS_CHUNK) {
      const chunk = ids.slice(start, start + GET_ITEMS_CHUNK);
      rows.push(
        ...(this.db
          .prepare(
            `SELECT ia.asset_id AS assetId, i.id AS itemId, i.title AS title, (i.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS trashed, i.created_at AS createdAt, i.rowid AS seq
             FROM item_assets ia JOIN items i ON i.id = ia.item_id
             WHERE ia.role = 'original' AND ia.asset_id IN (${chunk.map(() => '?').join(', ')})`,
          )
          .all(...chunk) as typeof rows),
      );
    }
    rows.sort((a, b) => a.trashed - b.trashed || a.createdAt.localeCompare(b.createdAt) || a.seq - b.seq);
    return rows.map((r) => ({ assetId: r.assetId, itemId: r.itemId, title: r.title, trashed: r.trashed === 1 }));
  }
```
