```ts

// ---- M6 restore ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * Like stubFolderPicker, but the panel answers `answers` in turn (null: cancelled; past the last, cancelled): 백업에서
 * 복원… asks twice, for the backup and for where to restore. Every call is recorded for folderPicks.
 */
export async function stubFolderPicks(app: ElectronApplication, answers: Array<string | null>): Promise<void> {
  await app.evaluate(({ dialog }, list) => {
    const g = globalThis as { __learnFolderPicks?: unknown[]; __learnRealOpenDialog?: typeof dialog.showOpenDialog };
    g.__learnRealOpenDialog ??= dialog.showOpenDialog;
    g.__learnFolderPicks = [];
    const queue = [...list];
    dialog.showOpenDialog = (async (...args: unknown[]) => {
      const o = (args.length > 1 ? args[1] : args[0]) as { title?: string; message?: string; buttonLabel?: string; defaultPath?: string; properties?: string[] };
      g.__learnFolderPicks!.push({
        parent: args.length > 1,
        title: o.title ?? null,
        message: o.message ?? null,
        buttonLabel: o.buttonLabel ?? null,
        defaultPath: o.defaultPath ?? null,
        properties: o.properties ?? [],
      });
      const answer = queue.length > 0 ? queue.shift()! : null;
      return answer === null ? { canceled: true, filePaths: [] } : { canceled: false, filePaths: [answer] };
    }) as typeof dialog.showOpenDialog;
  }, answers);
}

/** Main was asked to restart (E2E records it instead: Playwright cannot follow a new process). */
export const relaunchRequested = (app: ElectronApplication): Promise<boolean> =>
  app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as { __learnRelaunchRequested?: boolean }).__learnRelaunchRequested ?? false);

type WithRestoreHooks = {
  __learnTest: {
    restorePause(input: { at: 'afterCopy' | null }): void;
    restoreResume(): void;
    restoreWaiting(): string | null;
    restoreState(): JobProgress;
  };
};
/** The next restore holds its first copy once written, before it is read back, until restoreResume (null lifts it). */
export const restorePause = (app: ElectronApplication, at: 'afterCopy' | null = 'afterCopy') =>
  app.evaluate((_e, at) => (globalThis as unknown as WithRestoreHooks).__learnTest.restorePause({ at }), at);
export const restoreResume = (app: ElectronApplication) => app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as unknown as WithRestoreHooks).__learnTest.restoreResume());
/** The held copy's path inside the library being made, or null. */
export const restoreWaiting = (app: ElectronApplication) => app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as unknown as WithRestoreHooks).__learnTest.restoreWaiting());
export const restoreState = (app: ElectronApplication) => app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as unknown as WithRestoreHooks).__learnTest.restoreState());
/** Until main's restore has ended (its last notice sent). */
export const waitRestoreIdle = (app: ElectronApplication) =>
  expect.poll(async () => (await restoreState(app)).state, { message: 'the restore ended' }).toBe('idle');
```
(`JobProgress` 형 가져오기는 Task 9가 머리에 두었다.)

**(b)** 새 파일 `tests/e2e/restore.spec.ts`:
```ts
// 복원 (spec 9, P-20, AC15): a backup restored into a new folder beside the library, the result sheet and its answers, an
// app on the restored folder holding the same library; a backup that lost a file and changed another; what a restore
// refuses before it runs; its toast and 취소; the work line it shares; quitting while it runs; the fatal screen (9.4).
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { expect, test, type ElectronApplication, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { RESTORE_COPY } from '../../packages/domain/src/backup';
import {
  addToCollection, assignTag, clickToCloseSheet, closeSheet, confirmCalls, createCollection, createTag, distinctPdfs, enabledMenuCommands, expectWindow,
  folderPicks, importFiles, importPause, importPaths, importResume, launch, relaunchRequested, restorePause, restoreResume, restoreWaiting, runMenuCommand,
  setTagColor, shellCalls, stubConfirm, stubFolderPicker, stubFolderPicks, stubShell, trashItems, waitImportIdle, waitRestoreIdle,
} from './helpers';

const RESTORED = /^Learn 복원 \d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{4}( \d+)?$/;
const IS_MAC = process.platform === 'darwin';
const sha256 = (file: string) => createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(file)).digest('hex');
const folderFor = (dir: string) => {
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  return dir;
};
const prefsFile = (ud: string) => JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ud, 'preferences.json'), 'utf8')) as Record<string, unknown>;
/** The folders in `parent` named `prefix …`, and any a restore left half-made (`….restoring-<id>`). */
const madeIn = (parent: string, prefix: string) => fs.readdirSync(parent).filter((n) => n.startsWith(prefix) || n.includes('.restoring-'));
interface Manifest {
  createdAt: string;
  assets: Array<{ assetId: string; sha256: string; storageMode: 'managed' | 'linked'; relativePath: string | null; included: boolean }>;
}
const readManifest = (folder: string) => JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(folder, 'manifest.json'), 'utf8')) as Manifest;

/** A backup of the library the session has open, in `parent` (Task 9's flow); its folder. */
async function backUp(app: ElectronApplication, parent: string): Promise<string> {
  await stubFolderPicker(app, parent);
  await closeSheet(await expectWindow(app, 'sheet', () => runMenuCommand(app, 'file.backup')), 'Enter');
  const [name] = fs.readdirSync(parent).filter((n) => n.startsWith('Learn 백업'));
  return path.join(parent, name!);
}

/** Everything a restore must bring back, read through the page as the app shows it (spec 9.2, AC15). */
async function libraryFacts(page: Page) {
  return page.evaluate(async () => {
    const un = <T>(r: { ok: true; data: T } | { ok: false; code: string }): T => {
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.code);
      return r.data;
    };
    const byId = <T extends { id: string }>(xs: readonly T[]): T[] => [...xs].sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
    const sorted = (r: Record<string, string[]>) =>
      Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(r).map(([k, v]) => [k, [...v].sort()] as const).sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b)));
    const items = un(await window.learn.library.list());
    const trash = un(await window.learn.library.trashView());
    const organize = un(await window.learn.library.organize());
    const files: Record<string, { title: string; sha256: string; storageMode: string; availability: string; tags: string[]; collections: string[] }> = {};
    for (const it of [...items, ...trash.items]) {
      const d = un(await window.learn.library.detail({ itemId: it.id }));
      files[it.id] = {
        title: it.title, sha256: d.file.sha256, storageMode: d.file.storageMode, availability: d.file.availability,
        tags: d.tags.map((t) => t.name).sort(), collections: d.collections.map((c) => c.name).sort(),
      };
    }
    return {
      items: items.map((i) => i.id).sort(),
      trashed: byId(trash.items.map((i) => ({ id: i.id, deletedAt: i.deletedAt }))),
      trashedCollections: byId(trash.collections),
      collections: byId(organize.collections),
      tags: byId(organize.tags),
      members: sorted(organize.members),
      tagged: sorted(organize.tagged),
      trashMembers: sorted(trash.members),
      trashTagged: sorted(trash.tagged),
      trashCount: organize.trashCount,
      files,
    };
  });
}
type Facts = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof libraryFacts>>;

test('a backup restores into a new folder beside the library; the sheet says what came back; 전환 saves the folder and asks for a restart; an app on it holds the same library (spec 9, AC15)', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const lib = testInfo.outputPath('library');
  const ud = testInfo.outputPath('userdata');
  const backups = folderFor(testInfo.outputPath('backups'));
  let before: Facts | undefined;
  let restored = '';
  const s = await launch(lib, ud);
  try {
    // Copies and a linked file, a collection tree, a colour tag and a plain one, memberships, a trashed item that keeps
    // its membership and tag, a trashed collection.
    const [a, b, c, d] = distinctPdfs(testInfo.outputPath('src'), 4);
    const [one, two, three] = await importPaths(s.page, [a!, b!, c!]);
    const [linked] = await importPaths(s.page, [d!], { mode: 'linked' });
    const bio = await createCollection(s.page, '분자생물학');
    const ch6 = await createCollection(s.page, '6장 · 신호 전달', bio);
    const old = await createCollection(s.page, '지난 학기');
    await addToCollection(s.page, bio, [one!.id, linked!.id]);
    await addToCollection(s.page, ch6, [two!.id, three!.id]);
    await addToCollection(s.page, old, [one!.id]);
    const exam = await createTag(s.page, '시험 범위');
    await setTagColor(s.page, exam, 'red', 1);
    const plain = await createTag(s.page, '기말');
    await assignTag(s.page, exam, [one!.id, three!.id]);
    await assignTag(s.page, plain, [two!.id]);
    await trashItems(s.page, [three!.id]);
    expect((await s.page.evaluate((id) => window.learn.collections.remove({ collectionId: id }), old)).ok).toBe(true);
    before = await libraryFacts(s.page);
    expect(before.trashed.map((x) => x.id)).toEqual([three!.id]);
    expect(before.trashedCollections.map((x) => x.id)).toEqual([old]);
    const backup = await backUp(s.app, backups);

    // 백업에서 복원…: the backup (the panel opens where backups were made), then where (beside the library by default).
    expect(await enabledMenuCommands(s.app)).toContain('file.restore');
    await stubShell(s.app);
    await stubFolderPicks(s.app, [backup, path.dirname(lib)]);
    const sheet = await expectWindow(s.app, 'sheet', () => runMenuCommand(s.app, 'file.restore'));
    expect(await folderPicks(s.app)).toEqual([
      { parent: true, title: '백업에서 복원', message: '복원할 백업 폴더를 고르세요.', buttonLabel: '선택', defaultPath: backups, properties: ['openDirectory'] },
      {
        parent: true, title: '복원할 위치', message: '고른 폴더 안에 새 라이브러리 폴더를 만듭니다. 지금 라이브러리는 그대로 남습니다.', buttonLabel: '여기에 복원',
        defaultPath: path.dirname(lib), properties: ['openDirectory', 'createDirectory'],
      },
    ]);
    const made = madeIn(path.dirname(lib), 'Learn 복원');
    expect(made).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(made[0]).toMatch(RESTORED);
    restored = path.join(path.dirname(lib), made[0]!);
    expect(fs.readdirSync(restored).sort()).toEqual(['assets', 'derived', 'exports', 'library.sqlite', 'staging']);

    // The sheet (dialogs.html?scene=restore).
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('restore-badge')).toHaveAttribute('data-tone', 'success');
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('restore-title')).toHaveText('백업을 복원했습니다');
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('restore-when')).toHaveText(/^\d{4}\. \d{1,2}\. \d{1,2}\. 오[전후] \d{1,2}:\d{2}에 만든 백업$/);
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('restore-items')).toHaveText('3개 · 휴지통 1개 · 컬렉션 2개 · 태그 2개');
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('restore-files')).toHaveText('3개 확인 · 손상 없음');
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('restore-location')).toHaveAttribute('title', restored);
    expect((await sheet.getByTestId('restore-location').textContent())!.endsWith(`/${made[0]}`)).toBe(true);
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('restore-issues')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('restore-keep')).toHaveText('지금 라이브러리는 그대로 남습니다. 나중에 전환하려면 설정의 ‘다른 폴더 선택’⁠에서 이 폴더를 고르세요.');
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('restore-reveal')).toHaveText(IS_MAC ? 'Finder에서 보기' : '폴더에서 보기');
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('restore-switch')).toBeFocused();
    await sheet.getByTestId('restore-reveal').click();
    await expect.poll(() => shellCalls(s.app)).toEqual([['reveal', restored]]);
    // 이 라이브러리로 전환하고 다시 시작: saved as this device's library folder, then the restart (recorded under E2E).
    await clickToCloseSheet(sheet, sheet.getByTestId('restore-switch'));
    await expect.poll(() => relaunchRequested(s.app)).toBe(true);
    expect(prefsFile(ud)['libraryRoot']).toBe(restored);
    // The library in use is untouched.
    expect(await libraryFacts(s.page)).toEqual(before);
  } finally {
    await s.app.close();
  }

  // The restored folder in an app of its own: the same items and files, collections, tags, memberships and trash.
  const second = await launch(restored, testInfo.outputPath('userdata-2'));
  try {
    const after = await libraryFacts(second.page);
    expect(after).toEqual(before);
    const managed = Object.values(after.files).filter((f) => f.storageMode === 'managed');
    expect(managed).toHaveLength(3);
    for (const f of managed) expect(sha256(path.join(restored, 'assets', f.sha256.slice(0, 2), f.sha256)), f.title).toBe(f.sha256);
  } finally {
    await second.app.close();
  }
});

test('a backup that lost a file and changed another: a warning sheet names both with their items; esc is 나중에 and changes nothing; the restored library shows those items without their file (spec 9.2, 9.3)', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const lib = testInfo.outputPath('library');
  const ud = testInfo.outputPath('userdata');
  const parent = folderFor(testInfo.outputPath('restores'));
  let restored = '';
  const titles: Record<string, string> = {};
  const gone: string[] = [];
  const s = await launch(lib, ud);
  try {
    for (const i of await importPaths(s.page, distinctPdfs(testInfo.outputPath('src'), 3))) titles[i.assetId] = i.title;
    const backup = await backUp(s.app, folderFor(testInfo.outputPath('backups')));
    const [lost, changed] = readManifest(backup).assets.filter((x) => x.included);
    fs.rmSync(path.join(backup, ...lost!.relativePath!.split('/')));
    fs.appendFileSync(path.join(backup, ...changed!.relativePath!.split('/')), 'changed on the way');
    gone.push(titles[lost!.assetId]!, titles[changed!.assetId]!);

    await stubFolderPicks(s.app, [backup, parent]);
    const sheet = await expectWindow(s.app, 'sheet', () => runMenuCommand(s.app, 'file.restore'));
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('restore-badge')).toHaveAttribute('data-tone', 'warning');
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('restore-files')).toHaveText('3개 중 1개 확인');
    const issues = sheet.getByTestId('restore-issue');
    await expect(issues).toHaveCount(2);
    await expect(issues.nth(0)).toHaveAttribute('data-kind', 'missing');
    await expect(issues.nth(0).locator('.ri-line')).toHaveText('백업에 없는 파일 1개');
    await expect(issues.nth(0).getByTestId('restore-issue-item')).toHaveText([gone[0]!]);
    await expect(issues.nth(1)).toHaveAttribute('data-kind', 'damaged');
    await expect(issues.nth(1).locator('.ri-line')).toHaveText('내용이 손상된 파일 1개');
    await expect(issues.nth(1).getByTestId('restore-issue-item')).toHaveText([gone[1]!]);
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('restore-missing-note')).toHaveText('이 라이브러리로 전환해도 그 자료는 ‘파일 없음’⁠으로 보입니다. 원래 파일이 있으면 전환한 뒤 다시 연결할 수 있습니다.');
    await closeSheet(sheet, 'Escape');
    expect(await relaunchRequested(s.app)).toBe(false);
    expect(prefsFile(ud)['libraryRoot'] ?? null).toBeNull();
    const made = madeIn(parent, 'Learn 복원');
    expect(made).toHaveLength(1);
    restored = path.join(parent, made[0]!);
    // The changed copy waits in staging for the library check; nothing is where its hash says.
    expect(fs.readdirSync(path.join(restored, 'staging'))).toEqual([expect.stringMatching(new RegExp(`^corrupt-${changed!.sha256}-`))]);
    for (const x of [lost!, changed!]) expect(fs.existsSync(path.join(restored, ...x.relativePath!.split('/'))), x.assetId).toBe(false);
  } finally {
    await s.app.close();
  }

  const second = await launch(restored, testInfo.outputPath('userdata-2'));
  try {
    const shown = await second.page.evaluate(async () => {
      const r = await window.learn.library.list();
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.code);
      return Object.fromEntries(r.data.map((i) => [i.title, i.availability]));
    });
    expect(shown).toEqual(Object.fromEntries(Object.values(titles).map((t) => [t, gone.includes(t) ? 'missing' : 'available'])));
  } finally {
    await second.app.close();
  }
});

test('what a restore refuses before it runs: a cancelled panel, a folder that is not a backup, a newer backup, a place inside the library; the page sends no path (spec 9.1)', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const lib = testInfo.outputPath('library');
  const parent = folderFor(testInfo.outputPath('restores'));
  const s = await launch(lib, testInfo.outputPath('userdata'));
  const failed = s.page.getByTestId('restore-failed');
  /** The error toast says `message` under 복원하지 못했습니다 after `panels` panels; then it is closed. */
  const refusedWith = async (message: string, panels: number) => {
    await expect(failed).toContainText('복원하지 못했습니다');
    await expect(failed).toContainText(message);
    expect(await folderPicks(s.app)).toHaveLength(panels);
    await failed.getByTestId('toast-close').click();
    await expect(failed).toHaveCount(0);
  };
  try {
    await importPaths(s.page, distinctPdfs(testInfo.outputPath('src'), 1));
    const backup = await backUp(s.app, folderFor(testInfo.outputPath('backups')));

    await stubFolderPicks(s.app, [null]);
    await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'file.restore');
    await expect.poll(() => folderPicks(s.app)).toHaveLength(1);
    await expect.poll(() => enabledMenuCommands(s.app)).toContain('file.restore'); // the panel is gone; the window is free again
    await expect(failed).toHaveCount(0);

    const notBackup = folderFor(testInfo.outputPath('not-a-backup'));
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(notBackup, 'notes.txt'), 'x');
    await stubFolderPicks(s.app, [notBackup, parent]);
    await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'file.restore');
    await refusedWith(RESTORE_COPY.unknownFormat, 1);

    const newer = testInfo.outputPath('newer-backup');
    fs.cpSync(backup, newer, { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(newer, 'manifest.json'), JSON.stringify({ ...readManifest(backup), schemaVersion: 99 }));
    await stubFolderPicks(s.app, [newer, parent]);
    await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'file.restore');
    await refusedWith(RESTORE_COPY.newerVersion, 1);

    await stubFolderPicks(s.app, [backup, path.join(lib, 'assets')]);
    await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'file.restore');
    await refusedWith('라이브러리 폴더 안에는 복원할 수 없습니다. 다른 폴더를 고르세요.', 2);

    await stubFolderPicks(s.app, [backup, null]);
    await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'file.restore');
    await expect.poll(() => folderPicks(s.app)).toHaveLength(2);
    await expect(failed).toHaveCount(0);

    expect(await s.page.evaluate(() => (window.learn.backup.restore as (input: unknown) => Promise<unknown>)({ folder: '/tmp' }))).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED' });
    expect(madeIn(parent, 'Learn 복원')).toEqual([]);
    expect(fs.readdirSync(path.join(lib, 'assets')).filter((n) => n.startsWith('Learn 복원'))).toEqual([]);
  } finally {
    await s.app.close();
  }
});

test('its toast: 복원하는 중 · files, the new folder\'s name, the bar; one restore at a time; 취소 stops it and leaves no folder (spec 9.1, P-3)', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const parent = folderFor(testInfo.outputPath('restores'));
  const s = await launch(testInfo.outputPath('library'), testInfo.outputPath('userdata'));
  try {
    await importPaths(s.page, distinctPdfs(testInfo.outputPath('src'), 3));
    const backup = await backUp(s.app, folderFor(testInfo.outputPath('backups')));
    await restorePause(s.app);
    await stubFolderPicks(s.app, [backup, parent]);
    await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'file.restore');
    await expect.poll(() => restoreWaiting(s.app)).not.toBeNull();
    const toast = s.page.getByTestId('restore-progress');
    await expect(toast).toHaveAttribute('data-state', 'running'); // up once the run passed its first second
    await expect(toast).toContainText('복원하는 중 · 0 / 3');
    await expect(toast.locator('.t-file')).toHaveAttribute('title', RESTORED);
    await expect(toast.getByRole('progressbar')).toHaveAttribute('aria-valuetext', /^파일 3개 중 0개, \d+%$/);
    await expect.poll(() => enabledMenuCommands(s.app)).not.toContain('file.restore');
    const node = await toast.elementHandle();
    await toast.getByTestId('restore-cancel').click();
    await restoreResume(s.app);
    const done = s.page.getByTestId('restore-cancelled');
    await expect(done).toContainText('복원을 취소했습니다');
    await expect(done).toContainText('만들던 라이브러리 폴더는 남기지 않았습니다.');
    await expect(done).toHaveAttribute('data-kind', 'info');
    expect(await node!.evaluate((e) => e.isConnected)).toBe(true); // the same toast, now its end (P-3)
    await waitRestoreIdle(s.app);
    expect(madeIn(parent, 'Learn 복원')).toEqual([]);
    await expect.poll(() => enabledMenuCommands(s.app)).toContain('file.restore');
  } finally {
    await s.app.close();
  }
});

test('one work line: a restore waits behind an import and its toast says so; quitting during a restore asks with its own words, 끝내기 leaves no folder (spec 3.1, 3.6, P-19)', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const parent = folderFor(testInfo.outputPath('restores'));
  const quitParent = folderFor(testInfo.outputPath('quit-restores'));
  const s = await launch(testInfo.outputPath('library'), testInfo.outputPath('userdata'));
  const pdfs = distinctPdfs(testInfo.outputPath('src'), 4);
  let quit = false;
  try {
    await importPaths(s.page, pdfs.slice(0, 2));
    const backup = await backUp(s.app, folderFor(testInfo.outputPath('backups')));
    // An import holds the line: the restore asked for meanwhile waits, saying for what, with no bar.
    await importPause(s.app, 'afterStage');
    await importFiles(s, pdfs.slice(2, 4));
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('import-progress')).toHaveAttribute('data-state', 'running');
    await stubFolderPicks(s.app, [backup, parent]);
    await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'file.restore');
    const waiting = s.page.getByTestId('restore-progress');
    await expect(waiting).toHaveAttribute('data-state', 'waiting-job');
    await expect(waiting).toContainText('앞의 작업을 기다리는 중');
    await expect(waiting).toContainText('가져오기가 끝나면 복원을 시작합니다.');
    await expect(waiting.getByRole('progressbar')).toHaveCount(0);
    const sheet = await expectWindow(s.app, 'sheet', () => importResume(s.app));
    // What the backup holds — made before this import — not what the library holds now.
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('restore-items')).toHaveText('2개 · 컬렉션 0개 · 태그 0개');
    await closeSheet(sheet, 'Escape');
    await waitImportIdle(s.page);

    // A restore holds the line: quitting asks (Task 3's question, the restore's words); 취소 keeps it going.
    await restorePause(s.app);
    await stubFolderPicks(s.app, [backup, quitParent]);
    await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'file.restore');
    await expect.poll(() => restoreWaiting(s.app)).not.toBeNull();
    await stubConfirm(s.app, 'cancel');
    await s.app.evaluate(({ app }) => app.quit());
    await expect.poll(() => confirmCalls(s.app)).toEqual([
      { type: 'warning', message: '복원하는 중입니다', detail: '끝내면 만들던 라이브러리는 남지 않습니다.', buttons: ['끝내기', '취소'], defaultId: 0, cancelId: 1 },
    ]);
    expect(await restoreWaiting(s.app)).not.toBeNull();

    await stubConfirm(s.app, 'confirm');
    const exited = new Promise((resolve) => s.app.process().once('exit', resolve));
    await s.app.evaluate(({ app }) => app.quit());
    await expect.poll(async () => (await confirmCalls(s.app)).length).toBe(1);
    await restoreResume(s.app).catch(() => {}); // let go: the copy meets the stop at its read-back, then the app quits
    await exited;
    quit = true;
    expect(madeIn(quitParent, 'Learn 복원')).toEqual([]);
  } finally {
    if (!quit) await s.app.close().catch(() => {});
  }
});

test('the fatal screen: Finder에서 보기 shows the pre-update backup selected, before 설정 열기; one gone since says so; 백업에서 복원… is off there (spec 9.4)', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const lib = folderFor(testInfo.outputPath('broken'));
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(lib, 'library.sqlite'), 'not a database');
  const bak = path.join(lib, 'library.sqlite.pre-v2.bak');
  fs.writeFileSync(bak, '');
  const { app, page } = await launch(lib, testInfo.outputPath('userdata'));
  try {
    const reveal = page.getByTestId('fatal-reveal');
    await expect(reveal).toHaveText(IS_MAC ? 'Finder에서 보기' : '폴더에서 보기');
    await expect(reveal).toHaveClass(/btn-secondary/);
    expect(await page.getByTestId('fatal-notice').locator('.actions button').evaluateAll((els) => els.map((e) => e.getAttribute('data-testid')))).toEqual(['fatal-reveal', 'fatal-settings']);
    await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
    await expect(reveal).toBeFocused();
    expect(await enabledMenuCommands(app)).not.toContain('file.restore');
    await stubShell(app);
    await reveal.click();
    await expect.poll(() => shellCalls(app)).toEqual([['reveal', bak]]);
    expect(await page.evaluate(() => (window.learn.app.revealUpdateBackup as (input: unknown) => Promise<unknown>)({ path: '/tmp' }))).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED' });
    // Gone since the screen was drawn: said in a toast, nothing shown.
    fs.rmSync(bak);
    await reveal.click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('action-error')).toContainText('업데이트 전 백업 파일을 찾을 수 없습니다. 옮기거나 지웠는지 확인하세요.');
    expect(await shellCalls(app)).toHaveLength(1);
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});
```

`tests/e2e/visual/tour.spec.ts`:
- 9–12행 `../helpers` 가져오기에 `restorePause, restoreResume, restoreWaiting, stubFolderPicks`를 더한다(Task 9가 더한 `stubFolderPicker` 등은 그대로).
- Task 9의 `backup: …` 정거장 다음에(같은 파일의 `tourHome`·`h264`를 쓴다):
```ts
// 복원 (spec 9; dialogs.html?scene=restore, ?scene=restore-issues): the result sheet, the one with problems, and the restore's
// toast (as ?scene=jobs draws the backup's). Files of fixed sizes, so the bar reads the same everywhere; the backup's minute,
// the restored folder's name and the table's dates are masked.
test('restore: the result sheet (and with problems), its toast', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const home = tourHome(testInfo.outputPath());
  const dir = path.join(home, 'Library', 'Application Support', 'Learn');
  const s = await launchTour(dir, { HOME: home });
  const backups = path.join(home, 'Documents');
  fs.mkdirSync(backups, { recursive: true });
  const dates = () => [s.page.locator('[data-testid="item-row"] [data-col="createdAt"]')];
  const masks = (sheet: Page) => [sheet.getByTestId('restore-when'), sheet.getByTestId('restore-location')];
  // Restored beside the library (its parent, the second panel's default): ~/Library/Application Support/Learn/Learn 복원 ….
  const restoreFrom = async (backup: string) => {
    await stubFolderPicks(s.app, [backup, dir]);
    return expectWindow(s.app, 'sheet', () => runMenuCommand(s.app, 'file.restore'));
  };
  try {
    const src = testInfo.outputPath('src');
    const items = await importPaths(s.page, [
      fixedSizeCopy(path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf'), src, 1_500_000),
      fixedSizeCopy(path.join(FIXTURES, '한글 경로 (테스트) #1.pdf'), src, 900_000),
      h264(src),
    ]);
    const bio = await createCollection(s.page, '분자생물학');
    await addToCollection(s.page, bio, [items[0]!.id]);
    await assignTag(s.page, await createTag(s.page, '시험 범위'), [items[1]!.id]);
    await stubFolderPicker(s.app, backups);
    await closeSheet(await expectWindow(s.app, 'sheet', () => runMenuCommand(s.app, 'file.backup')), 'Enter');
    const backup = path.join(backups, fs.readdirSync(backups).find((n) => n.startsWith('Learn 백업'))!);
    for (const theme of THEMES) {
      await setTheme(s.page, theme);
      const sheet = await restoreFrom(backup);
      await expect(sheet.getByTestId('restore-files')).toHaveText('3개 확인 · 손상 없음');
      await shoot(sheet, `sheet-restore-${theme}`, { mask: masks(sheet) });
      await closeSheet(sheet, 'Escape');
    }
    // A file the backup no longer holds and one whose contents changed (?scene=restore-issues).
    await setTheme(s.page, 'light');
    const listed = (JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(backup, 'manifest.json'), 'utf8')) as { assets: Array<{ included: boolean; relativePath: string | null }> }).assets;
    const [lost, changed] = listed.filter((a) => a.included);
    fs.rmSync(path.join(backup, ...lost!.relativePath!.split('/')));
    fs.appendFileSync(path.join(backup, ...changed!.relativePath!.split('/')), 'changed on the way');
    const issues = await restoreFrom(backup);
    await expect(issues.getByTestId('restore-badge')).toHaveAttribute('data-tone', 'warning');
    await shoot(issues, 'sheet-restore-issues-light', { mask: masks(issues) });
    await closeSheet(issues, 'Escape');
    // The restore's toast while it copies (the backup's machine, P-3).
    await restorePause(s.app);
    await stubFolderPicks(s.app, [backup, dir]);
    await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'file.restore');
    await expect.poll(() => restoreWaiting(s.app)).not.toBeNull();
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('restore-progress')).toHaveAttribute('data-state', 'running');
    await shoot(s.page, 'toast-restore-light', { mask: [...dates(), s.page.getByTestId('restore-progress').locator('.t-file')] });
    await closeSheet(await expectWindow(s.app, 'sheet', () => restoreResume(s.app)), 'Escape');
  } finally {
    await s.app.close();
  }
});
```
- 치명 화면 정거장(`fatal: the library cannot be opened …`)은 코드가 그대로다 — 단추가 하나 늘어 그 기준 PNG 넷이 바뀐다.

기준 PNG(백그라운드, 끝날 때까지 직접 기다린다):

```bash
xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 1920x1200x24" pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/visual/tour.spec.ts --grep "restore:|fatal:" --update-snapshots=changed --output=/tmp/m6-t10-tour
```

`tests/evidence/p1.evidence.ts`:
- `../e2e/helpers` 가져오기에 `restorePause, restoreResume, restoreWaiting, shellCalls, stubFolderPicks, stubShell`을 더한다(있는 이름은 그대로 — Task 9가 `stubFolderPicker`·`runMenuCommand`·`closeSheet`·`expectWindow`를 더했다).
- `test('M6 P1: verdict of every check above …')` 앞에:
```ts
test('M6 restore: its toast, the result sheet (macOS: a real sheet) and the one with problems; the fatal screen\'s Finder에서 보기; throughput reported', TAG, async () => {
  const backups = path.join(tmp, 'restore-backups');
  const parent = path.join(tmp, 'restored');
  fs.mkdirSync(backups, { recursive: true });
  fs.mkdirSync(parent, { recursive: true });
  await setTheme('light');
  await stubFolderPicker(s.app, backups);
  await closeSheet(await expectWindow(s.app, 'sheet', () => runMenuCommand(s.app, 'file.backup')), 'Enter');
  const backup = path.join(backups, fs.readdirSync(backups).find((n) => n.startsWith('Learn 백업'))!);

  await restorePause(s.app);
  await stubFolderPicks(s.app, [backup, parent]);
  await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'file.restore');
  await expect.poll(() => restoreWaiting(s.app)).not.toBeNull();
  const toast = s.page.getByTestId('restore-progress');
  await expect(toast).toHaveAttribute('data-state', 'running');
  await guard('restore toast: 복원하는 중 with its files and its folder, a bar, 360 wide', async () => {
    const v = { text: (await toast.textContent()) ?? '', bars: await toast.locator('.progress').count(), width: await toast.evaluate((t) => Math.round(t.getBoundingClientRect().width)) };
    results['restoreToast'] = v;
    check('restore toast: 복원하는 중 with its files and its folder, a bar, 360 wide', v.text.includes('복원하는 중 · 0 / ') && v.text.includes('Learn 복원 ') && v.bars === 1 && v.width === 360, v);
  });
  if (IS_MAC) await focusApp(s.app);
  await shots(s.page, 'm6-restore-1-toast-light', 'the restore\'s progress toast (the backup\'s machine, dialogs.html?scene=jobs)');
  const started = Date.now();
  const sheet = await expectWindow(s.app, 'sheet', () => restoreResume(s.app));
  results['restoreThroughput'] = { ms: Date.now() - started }; // from the first copy's read-back on: reported only (spec 14)
  await guard('restore sheet: 560 wide, the success badge, the location in mono with a small Finder button, 전환 the focused default', async () => {
    const v = await sheet.evaluate(() => ({
      width: innerWidth,
      badge: getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('[data-testid="restore-badge"]')!).backgroundColor,
      mono: getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('[data-testid="restore-location"]')!).fontFamily,
      reveal: document.querySelector('[data-testid="restore-reveal"]')?.className ?? '',
      focused: document.activeElement?.getAttribute('data-testid') ?? null,
    }));
    const soft = await tokenColor(sheet, '--success-soft');
    results['restoreSheet'] = { ...v, soft };
    check(
      'restore sheet: 560 wide, the success badge, the location in mono with a small Finder button, 전환 the focused default',
      v.width === 560 && v.badge === soft && /mono/i.test(v.mono) && /btn-small/.test(v.reveal) && v.focused === 'restore-switch',
      results['restoreSheet'],
    );
  });
  if (IS_MAC) await fullScreenShot('m6-restore-2-sheet', 'the restore result sheet hanging on the main window (a macOS sheet)');
  await shots(sheet, 'm6-restore-2-sheet-light', 'the restore result sheet (dialogs.html?scene=restore)');
  await closeSheet(sheet, 'Escape'); // 나중에: the library in use stays

  // With problems (dialogs.html?scene=restore-issues): a copy gone from the backup, another changed.
  const copies = (JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(backup, 'manifest.json'), 'utf8')) as { assets: Array<{ included: boolean; relativePath: string | null }> }).assets.filter((a) => a.included);
  fs.rmSync(path.join(backup, ...copies[0]!.relativePath!.split('/')));
  fs.appendFileSync(path.join(backup, ...copies[1]!.relativePath!.split('/')), 'changed on the way');
  await stubFolderPicks(s.app, [backup, parent]);
  const issues = await expectWindow(s.app, 'sheet', () => runMenuCommand(s.app, 'file.restore'));
  await guard('restore sheet with problems: the warning badge, a line for the missing file and one for the damaged, the 파일 없음 sentence', async () => {
    const v = {
      tone: await issues.getByTestId('restore-badge').getAttribute('data-tone'),
      kinds: await issues.getByTestId('restore-issue').evaluateAll((els) => els.map((e) => e.getAttribute('data-kind'))),
      note: (await issues.getByTestId('restore-missing-note').textContent()) ?? '',
    };
    results['restoreIssues'] = v;
    check('restore sheet with problems: the warning badge, a line for the missing file and one for the damaged, the 파일 없음 sentence', v.tone === 'warning' && JSON.stringify(v.kinds) === '["missing","damaged"]' && v.note.includes('파일'), v);
  });
  await shots(issues, 'm6-restore-3-issues-light', 'the restore result sheet with problems (dialogs.html?scene=restore-issues)');
  await closeSheet(issues, 'Escape');

  // The fatal screen in a profile of its own: an unreadable library and one pre-update backup (dialogs.html?scene=fatal).
  const broken = path.join(tmp, 'broken-library');
  fs.mkdirSync(broken, { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(broken, 'library.sqlite'), 'not a database');
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(broken, 'library.sqlite.pre-v2.bak'), '');
  const fatal = await launch(broken, path.join(tmp, 'broken-userdata'), { colorScheme: null });
  try {
    await guard('fatal screen: Finder에서 보기 before 설정 열기, both secondary; it shows the backup file selected', async () => {
      await stubShell(fatal.app);
      const labels = (await fatal.page.getByTestId('fatal-notice').locator('.actions button').allTextContents()).map((l) => l.trim());
      await fatal.page.getByTestId('fatal-reveal').click();
      await expect.poll(() => shellCalls(fatal.app)).toHaveLength(1);
      const v = { labels, shell: await shellCalls(fatal.app) };
      results['fatalReveal'] = v;
      check(
        'fatal screen: Finder에서 보기 before 설정 열기, both secondary; it shows the backup file selected',
        JSON.stringify(v.labels) === JSON.stringify([IS_MAC ? 'Finder에서 보기' : '폴더에서 보기', '설정 열기']) && v.shell[0]?.[1] === path.join(broken, 'library.sqlite.pre-v2.bak'),
        v,
      );
    });
    for (const theme of ['light', 'dark'] as const) {
      await fatal.page.evaluate((t) => window.learn.prefs.set({ theme: t }), theme);
      await expect(fatal.page.locator('html')).toHaveAttribute('data-theme', theme);
      if (IS_MAC) await focusApp(fatal.app);
      for (const e of await allShots(fatal.app, fatal.page, `m6-restore-4-fatal-${theme}`, `the fatal screen with Finder에서 보기 (dialogs.html?scene=fatal, ${theme})`)) {
        if (e.file === null && e.error) shotFailures.push({ name: `m6-restore-4-fatal-${theme}`, kind: e.kind, description: e.description, error: e.error });
      }
    }
  } finally {
    await fatal.app.close();
  }
  save();
});
```

## 작성자 제안 (Q-10x)

- **Q-10a 치명 화면에서 `file.restore`는 꺼진 채(메인 소유 명령 아님)** — 컨트롤러가 정하라 한 곳. `FatalScreen`이 막힌 맥락을 보고해 메뉴 막대가 모두 꺼지고, 명세 2절이 치명 화면의 "백업에서 복원…"을 뺐다. 복원 작업은 열린 라이브러리 없이도 돈다(`libraryRoot`만 쓴다). 받지 않으면(치명 화면에서도 메뉴로 복원): `MAIN_OWNED_COMMANDS`에 `'file.restore'`, `dispatchMenuCommand`에 `restore.start(mainWindow)` 가지 하나, 결과 시트의 부모는 치명 화면의 창 — 한 시간 남짓.
- **Q-10b `backup:cancel`이 `{ job?: 'backup' | 'restore' }`를 받는다** — P-20은 인자 없는 `backup:cancel()`이다. 백업과 복원이 줄에 함께 있을 수 있어(하나는 돌고 하나는 기다림) 토스트의 취소가 자기 작업을 가리켜야 한다. 인자가 없으면 백업(Task 9의 호출·시험 그대로). 받지 않으면: 형제 채널 `backup:cancelRestore`를 더한다(등록 다섯 곳, 같은 시간).
- **Q-10c 문제 줄의 자료 이름은 2개 + "외 N개"** — 컨트롤러 지시문은 "최대 3"이라 했지만 Task 1 보고서의 9.3 명세 문장("줄마다 자료 이름(2개 + ‘외 N개’)")과 P-26·Task 8의 `ENTRY_NAMES = 2`가 2다. `RESTORE_ISSUE_NAMES` 한 줄과 시험 하나로 바꿀 수 있다.
- **Q-10d 백업이 적었지만 더는 가진 적 없는 파일은 실패가 아니라 "백업에 없는 파일"** — 명세 9.2 "없거나 다른 자산은 missing"과 목업의 "백업에 없는 파일 N개". 지금 코드는 그 경우 복원 전체가 실패했고, 기존 시험 `cleans up temp dir on restore failure`가 그것을 실패 원인으로 썼다 — 이 계획은 그 시험의 실패 원인을 "DB가 모르는 자산을 적은 manifest"로 바꾼다. 받지 않으면: 사본 하나가 빠진 백업으로는 복원할 수 없다.
- **Q-10e 다시 읽어 다른 사본은 `staging/corrupt-<sha>-<id>`로 비켜 둔다** — 지금 코드는 그 자리에 두고 `missing`으로만 표시했다. Task 8의 점검은 "돌아온 사본"을 `available`로 되돌리므로(Q-8k), 그대로 두면 다음 실행에서 손상된 바이트가 정상 자료로 보인다. 비켜 두면 점검이 "따로 보관한 손상된 사본"과 "사본이 사라진 자료"(다시 연결…, Q-8b)로 보인다.
- **Q-10f 새 문구와 문구의 자리** — `RESTORE_COPY`(D/backup.ts, `strings.test.ts`가 검사): 지금 L의 문장("알 수 없는 백업 형식입니다.", "백업 목록(manifest)이 손상되었습니다." — 내부 용어)이 다음 행동 없이 오류 토스트에 나가므로 원인 + 다음 행동으로 고쳤다("백업 폴더가 아니거나 형식을 알 수 없습니다. 백업 만들기로 만든 폴더를 고르세요." 등 다섯, Task 2의 "…선택하세요."는 "…고르세요."로 맞춤). 명세 9.3의 넷째·다섯째 문제 줄은 목업에 없어 새로 썼다: "일치하지 않는 기록 N개"(명세 문구 그대로), "개수가 백업에 적힌 것과 다릅니다"(명세의 "개수 불일치"를 문장으로). 폴더 패널("백업에서 복원" / "복원할 백업 폴더를 고르세요." / [선택], "복원할 위치" / "고른 폴더 안에 새 라이브러리 폴더를 만듭니다. 지금 라이브러리는 그대로 남습니다." / [여기에 복원]), 토스트("복원하는 중", "가져오기가 끝나면 복원을 시작합니다." 등 앞의 작업 문장 다섯, "복원을 취소했습니다" / "만들던 라이브러리 폴더는 남기지 않았습니다.", "복원하지 못했습니다"), 거절("라이브러리 폴더 안에는 복원할 수 없습니다. …", "백업 폴더 안에는 …"), 치명 화면("업데이트 전 백업 파일을 찾을 수 없습니다. 옮기거나 지웠는지 확인하세요."). Task 12가 명세 9·디자인 명세 10.7·6 "안내"에 옮긴다.
- **Q-10g 백업 폴더 안에는 복원하지 않는다** — 명세에 없다. 그 안에 만든 라이브러리는 그 백업을 다음에 읽을 때 함께 있고, 백업은 만든 그대로여야 한다. Task 9의 Q-9h(라이브러리 안에는 백업하지 않음)와 짝. 문구 `mainStrings.restore.inBackup`.
- **Q-10h 전환이 실패하면 결과 시트가 닫힌 뒤 메인 창에 네이티브 경고 상자** — 전환은 P-17대로 `sheet:resolve`라 시트가 먼저 닫힌다. 실패(환경설정 파일을 쓸 수 없음 `PREFS_UNAVAILABLE`, 그사이 폴더가 사라짐)는 드물고, 그때 말할 자리가 메인 창뿐이다("라이브러리를 전환하지 못했습니다" + 원인 문장, [확인]). 받지 않으면: 전환을 `sheet:act`로 바꿔 시트 안에 오류 줄을 둔다(P-17을 바꾼다).
- **Q-10i `CommandContextState.restoreRunning?`** — 명세 11.1은 `file.restore`가 "늘" 켜진다고 하지만, 줄에 복원이 있으면 main이 두 번째를 `{ started: false }`로 거절하므로 메뉴를 끈다(Q-9b와 같은 모양). 받지 않으면: 두 번째 클릭이 말없이 무시된다.
- **Q-10j 백업 폴더 패널의 첫 위치는 `prefs.backupDir`(마지막으로 백업을 만든 곳), 없으면 문서 폴더** — 명세 9.1은 복원할 곳의 기본(지금 라이브러리의 상위 폴더)만 정한다. 백업 만들기와 같은 위치에서 여는 것이 "Learn 백업 …" 폴더를 바로 보이게 한다.
- **Q-10k `LibraryRepository.originalItemsOf`와 `RestoreResult.problemItems`** — 문제 줄의 자료 이름(명세 9.3, 목업)을 위해 복원한 DB를 닫기 전에 읽는다. 휴지통 자료도 이름에 들지만 살아 있는 자료가 먼저다(전환해도 휴지통 자료는 보이지 않는다). 새 표·마이그레이션 없음.
- **Q-10l 명세 12의 `backup:pickRestore`·`backup:switchTo`는 P-20의 `backup:restore`와 P-17의 `sheet:resolve({ kind: 'restoreDone', switch })`가 대신한다** — Task 12가 명세 12 줄을 고친다. 결과 시트의 ↩는 목업대로 기본 단추 [이 라이브러리로 전환하고 다시 시작], esc는 [나중에].

명세 1절 완료 조건 1(P1 게이트)과 5(명세 14의 성능 예산)를 닫는다. 새 기능은 없다 — Task 2–10이 만든 것을 끝에서 끝까지 한 번에 지나가는 E2E 하나와, 명세 14의 표를 한 줄씩 재는 `@perf` 증거 하나다. 둘이 필요로 하는 작은 기계만 더한다.

- **`tests/e2e/p1-gate.spec.ts`**(명세 1 조건 1, 15, AC15). 서로 다른 fixture 넷(사본)과 외부 연결 하나를 넣은 라이브러리에서
  1. `afterStage`에서 멈춘 가져오기를 SIGKILL → 다시 켜면 점검 시트가 저절로 뜨고 "가져오다 멈춘 임시 파일 1개" → **임시 파일 정리**,

- [ ] **Step 2: E2E 도우미 — `library-facts.ts`, `hardKill`을 helpers로, 세 spec이 가져다 씀, 실행, 커밋**

**(a)** 새 파일 `tests/e2e/library-facts.ts`. `libraryFacts`의 몸은 `tests/e2e/restore.spec.ts`(Task 10)의 것을 **그대로** 옮긴다(Task 10 구현자가 고친 것이 있으면 저장소에 있는 그 판을 옮긴다 — 아래는 Task 10 계획의 판이다):
```ts
// What a restore must bring back (M6 spec 9.2, AC15), read through the page as the app shows it, and the counts the P1 gate
// compares. Playwright is a type here only, so the counts are unit-tested (library-facts.unit.ts).
import type { Page } from '@playwright/test';

/** Everything a restore must bring back, read through the page as the app shows it (spec 9.2, AC15). */
export async function libraryFacts(page: Page) {
  return page.evaluate(async () => {
    const un = <T>(r: { ok: true; data: T } | { ok: false; code: string }): T => {
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.code);
      return r.data;
    };
    const byId = <T extends { id: string }>(xs: readonly T[]): T[] => [...xs].sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
    const sorted = (r: Record<string, string[]>) =>
      Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(r).map(([k, v]) => [k, [...v].sort()] as const).sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b)));
    const items = un(await window.learn.library.list());
    const trash = un(await window.learn.library.trashView());
    const organize = un(await window.learn.library.organize());
    const files: Record<string, { title: string; sha256: string; storageMode: string; availability: string; tags: string[]; collections: string[] }> = {};
    for (const it of [...items, ...trash.items]) {
      const d = un(await window.learn.library.detail({ itemId: it.id }));
      files[it.id] = {
        title: it.title, sha256: d.file.sha256, storageMode: d.file.storageMode, availability: d.file.availability,
        tags: d.tags.map((t) => t.name).sort(), collections: d.collections.map((c) => c.name).sort(),
      };
    }
    return {
      items: items.map((i) => i.id).sort(),
      trashed: byId(trash.items.map((i) => ({ id: i.id, deletedAt: i.deletedAt }))),
      trashedCollections: byId(trash.collections),
      collections: byId(organize.collections),
      tags: byId(organize.tags),
      members: sorted(organize.members),
      tagged: sorted(organize.tagged),
      trashMembers: sorted(trash.members),
      trashTagged: sorted(trash.tagged),
      trashCount: organize.trashCount,
      files,
    };
  });
}
export type LibraryFacts = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof libraryFacts>>;

export interface FactCounts {
  items: number;
  trashed: number;
  collections: number;
  trashedCollections: number;
  tags: number;
  memberships: number;
  assignments: number;
}

/** What a count reads of the facts: lists of anything and id maps (the unit test passes plain ones). */
export interface CountedFacts {
  items: readonly unknown[];
  trashed: readonly unknown[];
  collections: readonly unknown[];
  trashedCollections: readonly unknown[];
  tags: readonly unknown[];
  members: Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>;
  trashMembers: Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>;
  tagged: Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>;
  trashTagged: Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>;
}

/**
 * AC15's counts: live and trashed items, live and trashed collection rows, tags, and the memberships and tag assignments of
 * live and trashed items together — a trashed item keeps its own (spec 4.1), so a restore must bring those back too.
 */
export function factCounts(f: CountedFacts): FactCounts {
  const pairs = (...maps: ReadonlyArray<Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>>): number =>
    maps.reduce((n, m) => n + Object.values(m).reduce((k, ids) => k + ids.length, 0), 0);
  return {
    items: f.items.length,
    trashed: f.trashed.length,
    collections: f.collections.length,
    trashedCollections: f.trashedCollections.length,
    tags: f.tags.length,
    memberships: pairs(f.members, f.trashMembers),
    assignments: pairs(f.tagged, f.trashTagged),
  };
}
```
(`window.learn`의 형은 같은 형 검사 프로그램(`tests/tsconfig.json`의 `e2e`)에 든 `helpers.ts`의 `declare global`이 준다.)

**(b)** `tests/e2e/helpers.ts` 끝(Task 10의 `// ---- M6 restore ---` 묶음 뒤)에:
```ts

// ---- M6 P1 gate and @perf ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

export { factCounts, libraryFacts, type FactCounts, type LibraryFacts } from './library-facts';

/**
 * SIGKILL of the Electron main process, as a crash or a power cut ends the app: no quit handler and no beforeunload run.
 * Waits at most `timeoutMs` for the exit.
 */
export async function hardKill(app: ElectronApplication, timeoutMs = 10_000): Promise<void> {
  const proc = app.process();
  const pid = proc.pid!;
  const exited = new Promise<void>((resolve) => proc.once('exit', () => resolve()));
  process.kill(pid, 'SIGKILL');
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
  const timedOut = new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
    timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error(`Electron main process ${pid} did not exit within ${timeoutMs} ms of SIGKILL`)), timeoutMs);
  });
  try {
    await Promise.race([exited, timedOut]);
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}
```

**(c)** 지역 정의를 지우고 도우미를 쓴다:
- `tests/e2e/position.spec.ts`: 26–42행(`/** Hard kill of the Electron main process (no quit handlers, no beforeunload); waits at most \`timeoutMs\` for the exit. */`부터 `hardKill` 함수의 닫는 `}`까지)을 지운다. 5행을 `import { FIXTURES, hardKill, importPaths, launch, openItem } from './helpers';`로. 3행의 `type ElectronApplication, `는 지운 함수에서만 쓰였으므로 뺀다(`grep -n "ElectronApplication" tests/e2e/position.spec.ts`가 아무것도 보이지 않아야 한다).
- `tests/e2e/recovery.spec.ts`(Task 8): `/** SIGKILL, as a crash or a power cut ends the app: no quit handler runs (position.spec.ts does the same). */`와 그 아래 `async function hardKill(…) { … }`를 지우고, `./helpers` 가져오기 목록에 `hardKill,`을 더한다(`FIXTURES, clickToCloseSheet, …` 줄, 알파벳 순서로 `expectWindow,` 다음). `type ElectronApplication`은 `visibleSheets`가 계속 쓴다 — 그대로 둔다.
- `tests/e2e/restore.spec.ts`(Task 10): `/** Everything a restore must bring back, read through the page as the app shows it (spec 9.2, AC15). */`부터 `async function libraryFacts(page: Page) { … }`의 닫는 `}`까지 지운다. 그 바로 아래 `type Facts = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof libraryFacts>>;`는 그대로 둔다(이제 가져온 함수를 가리킨다). `./helpers` 가져오기 목록에 `libraryFacts,`를 더한다(`launch,` 다음). 지운 함수 말고 `Page`를 쓰는 곳이 없으면(`grep -n "Page\b" tests/e2e/restore.spec.ts`) `@playwright/test` 가져오기의 `type Page`를 뺀다.

- [ ] **Step 3: `p1-gate.spec.ts`(완료 조건 1), 실행, 커밋**

이 시험은 Task 3–10이 만든 것을 실제 앱에서 끝에서 끝까지 본다. 그래서 처음 돌릴 때도 **통과가 기대값**이다 — 실패는 그 작업들의 버그이니 그 자리를 고친다(이 시험의 기대를 낮추지 않는다). 문구는 Task 8·9·10 계획의 문자열 그대로다(`⁠`은 낱말 이음, 그 작업들의 문구와 같은 글자).

새 파일 `tests/e2e/p1-gate.spec.ts`:
```ts
// P1 게이트 (M6 spec 1 condition 1, spec 15; AC15): an import killed once its temp copy is written, then one killed once its
// copy is placed but before its row; after each relaunch the library check opens by itself — 임시 파일 정리 removes the
// one, 자료로 되살리기 brings the other back as an item; the library, with collections, tags, memberships and an item in
// the trash, is backed up and restored into an empty folder; an app on that folder with a profile of its own holds the
// same items, files, counts and trash. The switch's restart is recorded, not followed (Playwright cannot follow a new process).
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import {
  FIXTURES, addToCollection, assignTag, clickToCloseSheet, createCollection, createTag, distinctPdfs, expectWindow, factCounts, hardKill,
  importFiles, importPause, importPaths, importWaiting, launch, libraryCheckState, libraryFacts, relaunchRequested, rowByTitle, runMenuCommand,
  setTagColor, specialRow, stubFolderPicker, stubFolderPicks, trashItems, waitForSheet, waitImportIdle, type LibraryFacts, type Session,
} from './helpers';

/** Four distinct files of the fixture set: two documents (one with a Korean path) and two videos. */
const SOURCES = [
  path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf'),
  path.join(FIXTURES, '한글 경로 (테스트) #1.pdf'),
  path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample-h264-aac.mp4'),
  path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample-mpeg4part2.mp4'),
];
const BACKUP = /^Learn 백업 \d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{4}( \d+)?$/;
const RESTORED = /^Learn 복원 \d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{4}( \d+)?$/;
/** The library at its backup: 5 items and 1 in the trash, 3 collections, 2 tags, 7 memberships and 5 assignments (the trashed item's included). */
const COUNTS = { items: 5, trashed: 1, collections: 3, trashedCollections: 0, tags: 2, memberships: 7, assignments: 5 };

const sha256 = (file: string) => createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(file)).digest('hex');
/** Where a library keeps the managed copy of these bytes (layout.ts managedRelativePath). */
const copyOf = (lib: string, sha: string) => path.join(lib, 'assets', sha.slice(0, 2), sha);
const tempFiles = (lib: string) => fs.readdirSync(path.join(lib, 'staging')).filter((n) => n.endsWith('.part'));
const checkRow = (sheet: Page, kind: string) => sheet.locator(`[data-testid="check-row"][data-kind="${kind}"]`);
const emptyFolder = (dir: string) => {
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  return dir;
};
const prefsOf = (ud: string) => JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ud, 'preferences.json'), 'utf8')) as Record<string, unknown>;
interface Manifest {
  counts: Record<string, number>;
  assets: Array<{ storageMode: 'managed' | 'linked'; included: boolean }>;
}

/** The live items by title (titles are unique here). */
async function idsByTitle(page: Page): Promise<Record<string, string>> {
  const r = await page.evaluate(() => window.learn.library.list());
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`library.list failed: ${r.code}`);
  return Object.fromEntries(r.data.map((i) => [i.title, i.id]));
}

/** 파일 가져오기… of one file, held at `at` (Task 3's pause) until the test kills the app. */
async function holdImport(s: Session, file: string, at: 'afterStage' | 'afterPlace'): Promise<void> {
  await importPause(s.app, at);
  await importFiles(s, [file]);
  await expect.poll(() => importWaiting(s.app), { message: `the import is held at ${at}`, timeout: 15_000 }).toBe(at);
}

test.beforeAll(() => {
  for (const f of SOURCES) if (!fs.existsSync(f)) throw new Error(`fixture missing: ${f} — run \`pnpm fixtures\``);
});

test('P1 gate: killed imports → the library check after each relaunch → 임시 파일 정리 · 자료로 되살리기 → a backup → a restore into an empty folder → an app on it holds the same library (spec 1, 15; AC15)', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  test.setTimeout(300_000);
  const lib = testInfo.outputPath('library');
  const ud = testInfo.outputPath('userdata');
  const [held, placed, outside] = distinctPdfs(testInfo.outputPath('src'), 3) as [string, string, string];
  // Each item's file by its title (the file's name; the revived copy is 이름 없는 자료): the hashes AC15 compares.
  const shaByTitle: Record<string, string> = {
    sample: sha256(SOURCES[0]!),
    '한글 경로 (테스트) #1': sha256(SOURCES[1]!),
    'sample-h264-aac': sha256(SOURCES[2]!),
    'sample-mpeg4part2': sha256(SOURCES[3]!),
    'distinct-03': sha256(outside),
    '이름 없는 자료': sha256(placed),
  };
  const placedSha = shaByTitle['이름 없는 자료']!;

  // 1. Four distinct files copied in, one linked; then an import killed once its temp copy is written (staging/*.part).
  let s = await launch(lib, ud);
  let killed = false;
  try {
    expect(await importPaths(s.page, SOURCES)).toHaveLength(4);
    expect(await importPaths(s.page, [outside], { mode: 'linked' })).toHaveLength(1);
    await holdImport(s, held, 'afterStage');
    expect(tempFiles(lib)).toHaveLength(1);
    await hardKill(s.app);
    killed = true;
  } finally {
    if (!killed) await s.app.close();
  }
  expect(tempFiles(lib), 'the killed import left its temp copy').toHaveLength(1);
  expect(fs.existsSync(copyOf(lib, sha256(held))), 'and placed nothing').toBe(false);

  // 2. The relaunch: the check sheet opens by itself with the temp file; 임시 파일 정리 removes it. Then the variant — an
  //    import killed once its copy is in assets/ and before its row is written.
  s = await launch(lib, ud);
  killed = false;
  try {
    const sheet = await waitForSheet(s.app);
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('sheet-root')).toHaveAttribute('data-mode', 'auto');
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('check-intro')).toHaveText('라이브러리를 열 때 정리할 것을 찾았습니다. 자동으로 지운 것은 없습니다.');
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('check-row')).toHaveCount(2);
    const temp = checkRow(sheet, 'staging');
    await expect(temp.locator('.ci-title')).toHaveText('가져오다 멈춘 임시 파일 1개');
    await expect(checkRow(sheet, 'records').locator('.ci-text')).toHaveText('자료 5개의 정보⁠·컬렉션⁠·태그가 그대로입니다.');
    await sheet.getByTestId('check-cleanStaging').click();
    await expect(temp).toHaveAttribute('data-state', 'done');
    await expect(temp.locator('.ci-text')).toHaveText('정리했습니다.');
    expect(tempFiles(lib)).toEqual([]);
    await clickToCloseSheet(sheet, sheet.getByTestId('check-done'));

    await holdImport(s, placed, 'afterPlace');
    expect(sha256(copyOf(lib, placedSha)), 'the copy was placed whole').toBe(placedSha);
    expect(Object.keys(await idsByTitle(s.page)), 'and no row was written').toHaveLength(5);
    await hardKill(s.app);
    killed = true;
  } finally {
    if (!killed) await s.app.close();
  }
  expect(tempFiles(lib), 'a placed copy leaves no temp file').toEqual([]);

  let before: LibraryFacts | undefined;
  let trashedId = '';
  let restored = '';
  s = await launch(lib, ud);
  try {
    const { app, page } = s;
    // 3. The list differs from the one last shown: the sheet opens by itself again, with the unused copy only.
    const sheet = await waitForSheet(app);
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('sheet-root')).toHaveAttribute('data-mode', 'auto');
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('check-row')).toHaveCount(2);
    const unused = checkRow(sheet, 'unreferenced');
```

```ts
import { limitFailures } from './budget';
```

```ts
// V/budget.ts
/** One measured value against its spec budget. */
export interface Limit {
  what: string;
  value: number;
  budget: number;
  /** The value's unit in the failure line; 'ms' when absent (a rate says '/s'). */
  unit?: string;
}

/**
 * The Linux CI rule (spec 1 condition 2, spec 12; M6 spec 1 condition 5): a value fails beyond `factor` times its budget.
 * Every failure is returned, not the first, so one run shows which measurements went over.
 */
export function limitFailures(limits: readonly Limit[], factor = 2): string[] {
  return limits
    .filter((l) => l.value > factor * l.budget)
    .map((l) => {
      const unit = l.unit ?? 'ms';
      return `${l.what}: ${l.value} ${unit} against the Linux CI limit ${factor * l.budget} ${unit} (budget ${l.budget} ${unit})`;
    });
}
```

**(b)** 새 파일 `tests/evidence/p1-perf-math.ts`:
```ts
// V/p1-perf-math.ts — the arithmetic of p1-perf.json (M6 spec 14), apart from the app so it is unit-tested.
import type { Limit } from './budget';
import { median, percentile } from './percentile';

/** M6 spec 14; ms unless the name says otherwise. Linux CI fails beyond twice each (budget.ts). */
export const P1_BUDGET = {
  importAnswerMs: 50,
  progressPerSecond: 10,
  toastPaintP95Ms: 16.7,
  trashRedrawMs: 300,
  trashViewOpenMs: 300,
  purgeTransactionMs: 500,
  startupCheckMs: 2000,
} as const;

/**
 * Cold start → app-ready of an empty library, the median of five launches, at the end of M5 (spec 14 "M5 값 이하"): the
 * Linux CI run 41130036868 on main 7e3ce2b (M6's base; its evidence perf.json) and the Mac VM run 41024983289
 * (docs/mac-verification.md). A platform without a value is reported, not checked.
 */
export const M5_APP_READY_MS: Readonly<Record<string, number>> = { linux: 675, darwin: 867 };

export const tenth = (x: number): number => Math.round(x * 10) / 10;

export interface Summary {
  runs: number[];
  median: number;
  max: number;
}
/** Every run and its median and maximum, to a tenth of a millisecond. At least one run. */
export function summary(xs: readonly number[]): Summary {
  return { runs: xs.map(tenth), median: tenth(median(xs)), max: tenth(Math.max(...xs)) };
}

export interface Spread {
  samples: number;
  median: number;
  p95: number;
  max: number;
}
/** Many samples: their count, median, p95 and maximum (zeros when there are none). */
export function spread(xs: readonly number[]): Spread {
  if (xs.length === 0) return { samples: 0, median: 0, p95: 0, max: 0 };
  return { samples: xs.length, median: tenth(median(xs)), p95: tenth(percentile(xs, 95)), max: tenth(Math.max(...xs)) };
}

/** The most of `times` (ms) inside any window [t, t + windowMs): a rate cap is broken by any one second, not by the average. */
export function maxInWindow(times: readonly number[], windowMs = 1000): number {
  const t = [...times].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  let best = 0;
  for (let i = 0, j = 0; i < t.length; i++) {
    while (j < t.length && t[j]! < t[i]! + windowMs) j++;
    best = Math.max(best, j - i);
  }
  return best;
}

/** Notices per second over their span (n − 1 gaps from the first to the last), a tenth; 0 with fewer than two or no span. */
export function meanRate(times: readonly number[]): number {
  if (times.length < 2) return 0;
  const t = [...times].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const span = t.at(-1)! - t[0]!;
  return span <= 0 ? 0 : tenth(((t.length - 1) * 1000) / span);
}

/** MB (10^6 bytes) per second, a tenth; 0 when no time passed. */
export function mbPerSecond(bytes: number, ms: number): number {
  return ms <= 0 ? 0 : tenth(bytes / 1e6 / (ms / 1000));
}

/** One job:progress notice as the page logged it (performance.now()). */
export interface JobNotice {
  t: number;
  kind: string;
  state: string;
  outcome: string | null;
}
/** A job's run: its first running notice to the idle notice after it that says done; null when it never ran or did not finish. */
export function jobSpan(log: readonly JobNotice[], kind: string): number | null {
  const start = log.find((n) => n.kind === kind && n.state === 'running');
  if (!start) return null;
  const end = log.find((n) => n.kind === kind && n.t >= start.t && n.state === 'idle' && n.outcome === 'done');
  return end ? end.t - start.t : null;
}

/** What a test hands to the Linux CI rule; lines it does not measure are left out. */
export interface P1Values {
  importPickMs?: number;
  importDropMs?: number;
  progressPerSecond?: number;
  toastPaintP95Ms?: number;
  trashRedrawMs?: number;
  trashViewOpenMs?: number;
  purgeTransactionMs?: number;
  startupCheckMs?: number;
  coldStartMs?: number;
}
/** spec 14's lines for the values given, in the table's order; cold start against the M5 value of `platform` (none: unchecked). */
export function p1Limits(v: P1Values, platform: string = process.platform): Limit[] {
  const out: Limit[] = [];
  const add = (value: number | undefined, what: string, budget: number, unit?: string): void => {
    if (value === undefined) return;
    out.push(unit === undefined ? { what, value, budget } : { what, value, budget, unit });
  };
  add(v.importPickMs, '파일 가져오기… of 1,000 files → the queue answered, median', P1_BUDGET.importAnswerMs);
  add(v.importDropMs, 'a drop of 1,000 files → the queue answered, median', P1_BUDGET.importAnswerMs);
  add(v.progressPerSecond, 'import:progress notices in any one second', P1_BUDGET.progressPerSecond, '/s');
  add(v.toastPaintP95Ms, 'progress notice → the toast painted, p95', P1_BUDGET.toastPaintP95Ms);
  add(v.trashRedrawMs, '1,000 to the trash (⌘⌫) → the table redrawn, median', P1_BUDGET.trashRedrawMs);
  add(v.trashViewOpenMs, 'the trash view of 1,000 items → painted, median', P1_BUDGET.trashViewOpenMs);
  add(v.purgeTransactionMs, 'purge of 1,000: the database transaction, median', P1_BUDGET.purgeTransactionMs);
  add(v.startupCheckMs, 'the startup check of 10,000 assets, median', P1_BUDGET.startupCheckMs);
  const m5 = M5_APP_READY_MS[platform];
  if (m5 !== undefined) add(v.coldStartMs, 'cold start → app-ready of an empty library, median (budget: the M5 value)', m5);
  return out;
}
```

```ts
// V/settle.ts — waits the @perf suites share: a timing starts only once what came before it has finished.
import type { ElectronApplication, Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { ipcCalls } from '../e2e/helpers';

const sleep = (ms: number) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

/** Call counts once none has changed for `quietMs`: what an action started has finished. */
export async function settleCalls(app: ElectronApplication, quietMs = 300): Promise<Record<string, number>> {
  let last = JSON.stringify(await ipcCalls(app));
  let since = Date.now();
  while (Date.now() - since < quietMs) {
    await sleep(60);
    const now = JSON.stringify(await ipcCalls(app));
    if (now !== last) {
      last = now;
      since = Date.now();
    }
  }
  return JSON.parse(last) as Record<string, number>;
}
export const grew = (before: Record<string, number>, after: Record<string, number>, channel: string) => (after[channel] ?? 0) - (before[channel] ?? 0);

/** The search index is built at an idle moment after each list (useSearch): wait until no new build starts, so that long task lands in no timing. */
export async function settleIndex(page: Page, app: ElectronApplication): Promise<void> {
  let last = -1;
  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
    const n = await page.evaluate(() => performance.getEntriesByName('learn:search:index', 'measure').length);
    if (n > 0 && n === last) break;
    last = n;
    await sleep(700);
  }
  await settleCalls(app, 500);
}

/**
 * After a change that reads the list again (a restore, a purge): the index is built again at the next idle moment, and the
 * timeline keeps only the newest build (timed()). Waits for a build that began after `since` (the page's clock), at most
 * `timeoutMs` — a change the index does not follow builds nothing — then for the calls to stop.
 */
export async function settleIndexSince(page: Page, app: ElectronApplication, since: number, timeoutMs = 5000): Promise<void> {
  const until = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
  while (Date.now() < until) {
    const at = await page.evaluate(() => performance.getEntriesByName('learn:search:index', 'measure').at(-1)?.startTime ?? -1);
    if (at > since) break;
    await sleep(100);
  }
  await settleCalls(app, 300);
}
```

**(a)** `apps/desktop/src/main/perf.ts` — Task 8 판의 `markPerf` 함수 다음(파일 끝)에:
```ts

/** Main-side steps p1-perf.evidence.ts times (M6 spec 14): a purge's transaction, an emptied trash's, and the files after either. */
export type TimedStep = 'purge' | 'emptyTrash' | 'purgeFiles';

/**
 * The newest duration of each timed step, in ms (performance.now, fractional), read through app.evaluate
 * (globalThis.__learnLastMs). A step not run yet has no key. Kept in every build: two numbers, no names or paths.
 */
export const lastMs: Partial<Record<TimedStep, number>> = {};
(globalThis as { __learnLastMs?: typeof lastMs }).__learnLastMs = lastMs;

/** Runs `run` and keeps how long it took as `step`'s newest time, whether it returned or threw. */
export function timeLast<T>(step: TimedStep, run: () => T): T {
  const start = performance.now();
  try {
    return run();
  } finally {
    lastMs[step] = performance.now() - start;
  }
}

export async function timeLastAsync<T>(step: TimedStep, run: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  const start = performance.now();
  try {
    return await run();
  } finally {
    lastMs[step] = performance.now() - start;
  }
}
```

**(c)** `apps/desktop/src/main/test-hooks.ts`.

- `seedItems`의 `metadataJson: JSON.stringify({ … }),` 다섯 줄(`creators: r.creators.map(…)`부터 `...(r.extra ? { extra: r.extra } : {}),`와 닫는 `}),`)을 `metadataJson: seedMetadataJson(r),` 한 줄로 바꾸고, `seedItems` 함수 **앞**에:

  ```ts
  const seedMetadataJson = (r: SeedRow): string =>
    JSON.stringify({
      creators: r.creators.map((name) => ({ name, role: 'author' })),
      ...(r.year === null ? {} : { date: String(r.year) }),
  ```

- `seedOrganize` 함수 다음(`export interface LearnTestHooks` 앞)에:
  ```ts
  export interface SeedAssetsInput {
    /** One item each, in this order (seedRows: newest first). */
    rows: SeedRow[];
    /** Rows from this index on are linked to a file of their own in `linkedDir`; the rows before it are managed copies. Default: none linked. */
    linkedFrom?: number;
    /** Absolute; made when missing. */
    linkedDir?: string;
  }
  export interface SeedAssetsResult {
    /** In the rows' order. */
    itemIds: string[];
    /** Each item's file hash, in the rows' order. */
    sha256: string[];
  }
  export interface SeedAssetsDeps {
    db: Db;
    repo: Pick<LibraryRepository, 'insertItemsForAsset'>;
    layout: Pick<LibraryLayout, 'root'>;
  }

  /**
   * Items that each have a file of their own — what a library of many imports is to the library check, a purge and a
   * backup — without importing them one by one: a small PDF per row (bytes unique to this call), written where an import
   * puts it (assets/<xx>/<sha256>, or `linkedDir` for a linked row), then every row in one transaction. E2E only.
   */
  export function seedAssets(deps: SeedAssetsDeps, input: SeedAssetsInput, makeId: () => string = newId): SeedAssetsResult {
    const linkedFrom = input.linkedFrom ?? input.rows.length;
    if (!Number.isInteger(linkedFrom) || linkedFrom < 0) throw new Error('seedAssets: linkedFrom must be a row index');
    const linkedDir = input.linkedDir;
    if (linkedFrom < input.rows.length && (linkedDir === undefined || !path.isAbsolute(linkedDir))) throw new Error('seedAssets: linked rows need an absolute linkedDir');
    const batch = makeId();
    const now = nowIso();
    const files = input.rows.map((row, i) => {
      const bytes = Buffer.from(`%PDF-1.4\n% learn seed ${batch} ${i + 1}\n%%EOF\n`);
      const sha256 = createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');
      const linked = i >= linkedFrom;
      const relativePath = linked ? null : managedRelativePath(sha256);
      const target = relativePath === null ? path.join(linkedDir!, `seed-${i + 1}.pdf`) : path.join(deps.layout.root, ...relativePath.split('/'));
      return { row, i, bytes, sha256, linked, relativePath, target, assetId: makeId(), revisionId: makeId(), itemId: makeId() };
    });
    // The files first: a row is written only for a file that is there.
    const folders = new Set<string>();
    for (const f of files) {
      const folder = path.dirname(f.target);
      if (!folders.has(folder)) {
        fs.mkdirSync(folder, { recursive: true });
        folders.add(folder);
      }
      fs.writeFileSync(f.target, f.bytes);
    }
    const insertAsset = deps.db.prepare(
      `INSERT INTO assets (id, sha256, storage_mode, relative_path, external_path, original_name, mime, size, availability, created_at, checked_at)
       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'application/pdf', ?, 'available', ?, ?)`,
    );
    const insertRevision = deps.db.prepare('INSERT INTO source_revisions (id, asset_id, hash, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)');
    deps.db.transaction(() => {
      for (const f of files) {
        insertAsset.run(f.assetId, f.sha256, f.linked ? 'linked' : 'managed', f.relativePath, f.linked ? f.target : null, `seed-${f.i + 1}.pdf`, f.bytes.length, f.row.createdAt, now);
        insertRevision.run(f.revisionId, f.assetId, f.sha256, f.row.createdAt);
      }
      deps.repo.insertItemsForAsset(
        files.map((f) => ({ id: f.itemId, type: 'pdf' as const, title: f.row.title, createdAt: f.row.createdAt, metadataJson: seedMetadataJson(f.row), assetId: f.assetId, revisionId: f.revisionId })),
      );
    })();
    return { itemIds: files.map((f) => f.itemId), sha256: files.map((f) => f.sha256) };
  }

  export interface FsyncProbeInput {
    /** Absolute, and new: the probe makes staging/ and assets/<xx>/ in it. */
    dir: string;
    /** 1–256: one new shard each. */
    files: number;
    bytes: number;
  }
  export interface FsyncProbeResult {
    /** fsyncDir of assets/ after a new shard was made in it. */
    parentMs: number[];
    /** fsyncFile of the staging copy before its rename. */
    fileMs: number[];
    /** fsyncDir of the shard after the rename. */
    shardMs: number[];
    /** This process's libuv (macOS: F_FULLFSYNC since 1.25.0, Q-2c). */
    uv: string;
  }
  export interface FsyncIo {
    fsyncFile(file: string): Promise<void>;
    fsyncDir(dir: string): Promise<void>;
  }

  /**
   * One import's flushes as Importer.place makes them on a new shard — its parent, the staging copy before the rename,
   * the shard after it — `files` times on random files of `bytes` in `dir` (the test's folder, on the library's disk), with
   * the importer's own fsyncFile and fsyncDir: a Mac run measures F_FULLFSYNC as the app pays it. E2E evidence only.
   */
  export async function fsyncProbe(input: FsyncProbeInput, io: FsyncIo = { fsyncFile, fsyncDir }): Promise<FsyncProbeResult> {
    if (!path.isAbsolute(input.dir)) throw new Error('fsyncProbe: dir must be absolute');
    if (!Number.isInteger(input.files) || input.files < 1 || input.files > 256) throw new Error('fsyncProbe: 1 to 256 files (one new shard each)');
    if (!Number.isInteger(input.bytes) || input.bytes < 1) throw new Error('fsyncProbe: bytes must be a positive integer');
    const staging = path.join(input.dir, 'staging');
    const assets = path.join(input.dir, 'assets');
    await fsp.mkdir(staging, { recursive: true });
    await fsp.mkdir(assets, { recursive: true });
    const out: FsyncProbeResult = { parentMs: [], fileMs: [], shardMs: [], uv: process.versions.uv };
    const timed = async (list: number[], run: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void> => {
      const start = performance.now();
      await run();
      list.push(performance.now() - start);
    };
    for (let i = 0; i < input.files; i++) {
      const name = i.toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
      const staged = path.join(staging, `${name}.part`);
      await fsp.writeFile(staged, randomBytes(input.bytes));
      const shard = path.join(assets, name);
      await fsp.mkdir(shard);
      await timed(out.parentMs, () => io.fsyncDir(assets));
      await timed(out.fileMs, () => io.fsyncFile(staged));
      await fsp.rename(staged, path.join(shard, name));
      await timed(out.shardMs, () => io.fsyncDir(shard));
    }
    return out;
  }
  ```

```ts
/**
 * Clicks an application-menu item as its accelerator would (`triggeredByAccelerator`): CDP keys never reach native
 * accelerators on Linux, and the page tells a key from a click (Q-6e: ⌘⌫ typed in a text field is the field's).
 * Resolves to main's clock at the click (epoch ms, performance.timeOrigin + now): where a key's timing starts (p1-perf).
 */
export async function runMenuAccelerator(app: ElectronApplication, id: CommandId): Promise<number> {
  await expect.poll(() => menuItemEnabled(app, id), { timeout: 5_000, message: `menu item ${id} never became clickable` }).toBe(true);
  return app.evaluate(({ BrowserWindow, Menu, webContents }, id) => {
    const item = Menu.getApplicationMenu()?.getMenuItemById(id);
    if (!item?.enabled || !item.visible) throw new Error(`menu item ${id} is not clickable`);
    const at = performance.timeOrigin + performance.now();
    item.click({ triggeredByAccelerator: true } as Electron.KeyboardEvent, BrowserWindow.getFocusedWindow() ?? undefined, webContents.getFocusedWebContents() ?? undefined);
    return at;
  }, id);
}
```

```ts
// @perf — M6 spec 14 (p1-perf.json): the import queue's answer for 1,000 files and the progress it reports; cold start of
// an empty library against the M5 value; a library of 10,000 items that each have a file — its startup check after the
// window, 1,000 to the trash → the table, the trash view, 1,000 purged; backup and restore throughput; and what one
// import's fsync costs (Q-2c). Linux CI fails beyond twice each budget (budget.ts); throughputs and fsync are reported only.
//
// "Painted" is a state of the page, as in organize-perf.evidence.ts: a timing ends at the first animation frame whose
// callback finds the DOM in the state the action leads to. A start is the event's own timeStamp in the page, or — for a
// menu key, which main turns into the command — main's clock at the menu item's click; both are epoch-based, as the
// context menu's timing in organize-perf compares them.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { expect, test, type ElectronApplication, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import type { ImportReport, LibraryCheck } from '../../packages/domain/src/library';
import type { BackupDoneSheet } from '../../packages/domain/src/sheets';

  FIXTURES, clickToCloseSheet, closeSheet, drag, dropSource, expectWindow, fsyncProbe, importFiles, importPause, importPaths, importQueueState,
  importResume, importWaiting, launch, libraryCheckState, rowAt, runMenuAccelerator, runMenuCommand, seedAssets, seedRows, specialRow,
  stubFolderPicker, stubFolderPicks, trashItems, waitImportIdle, type Session,
} from '../e2e/helpers';
import { limitFailures } from './budget';
import { EVIDENCE_ROOT, writeJson } from './capture';
import { M5_APP_READY_MS, P1_BUDGET, jobSpan, maxInWindow, mbPerSecond, meanRate, p1Limits, spread, summary, tenth, type JobNotice } from './p1-perf-math';
import { settleCalls, settleIndex, settleIndexSince } from './settle';

const linuxCi = process.platform === 'linux' && Boolean(process.env['CI']);
/** Every single-shot timing at least five times (M5 spec 12's rule, kept). */
const RUNS = 5;
const LAUNCHES = 5;
/** spec 14 "1,000 경로". */
const PATHS = 1_000;
/** Dropped while the 1,000 import: the run's total grows (spec 3.1, 7 / 12 → 7 / 15). */
const JOINED = 500;
const SMALL_BYTES = 64 * 1024;
const ITEMS = 10_000;
/** Of ITEMS, the oldest are linked to files outside: the startup check stats each of them. */
const LINKED = 1_000;
const TRASHED = 1_000;
const PURGES = 3;
const BIG_FILES = 16;
const BIG_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
const FSYNC_FILES = 20;
const FSYNC_BYTES = 1024 * 1024;
/** Fewer timed toast updates than this say nothing about a p95 (checked on Linux CI). */
const MIN_PAINTS = 10;
const RESULT = 'p1-perf.json';

// ---- p1-perf.json ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/** The sections written so far in this run (the runner's pid tells a file of this run from one left by an earlier run). */
function readP1Perf(): Record<string, unknown> {
  try {
    const old = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(EVIDENCE_ROOT, RESULT), 'utf8')) as Record<string, unknown>;
    return old['run'] === process.ppid ? old : {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}
/** Merged into p1-perf.json after each test: a worker restarted after a failure keeps the sections before it. */
function saveP1Perf(patch: Record<string, unknown>): void {
  writeJson(
    RESULT,
    {
      ...readP1Perf(), ...patch, run: process.ppid, budget: P1_BUDGET, linuxCiFactor: 2, m5AppReadyMs: M5_APP_READY_MS,
      platform: `${process.platform}-${process.arch}`, ci: process.env['CI'] ?? null, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    },
    'M6 spec 14: the import queue answer and progress, cold start vs M5, the startup check and the trash over 10,000 assets, backup and restore throughput, fsync cost',
  );
}

// ---- fixtures and small reads ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/** `count` distinct PDFs of `bytes` each: the sample's bytes, a line naming the file, then spaces after %%EOF. */
function paddedPdfs(dir: string, count: number, bytes: number, tag: string): string[] {
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  const head = fs.readFileSync(path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf'));
  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => {
    const file = path.join(dir, `${tag}-${String(i + 1).padStart(4, '0')}.pdf`);
    const mark = Buffer.from(`\n% ${tag} ${i + 1}\n`);
    fs.writeFileSync(file, Buffer.concat([head, mark, Buffer.alloc(Math.max(0, bytes - head.length - mark.length), 0x20)]));
    return file;
  });
}
const folder = (dir: string) => {
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  return dir;
};
const shownTotal = async (page: Page): Promise<number> =>
  Number(/^[\d,]+/.exec((await page.getByTestId('toolbar-count').textContent()) ?? '')?.[0]?.replace(/,/g, '') ?? 0);
type WithReports = { __learnTest: { importReports(): ImportReport[] } };
const importReports = (app: ElectronApplication): Promise<ImportReport[]> => app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as unknown as WithReports).__learnTest.importReports());
type LastMs = Partial<Record<'purge' | 'emptyTrash' | 'purgeFiles', number>>;
const lastMs = (app: ElectronApplication): Promise<LastMs> => app.evaluate(() => ({ ...((globalThis as { __learnLastMs?: LastMs }).__learnLastMs ?? {}) }));
const forgetPurgeTimes = (app: ElectronApplication) =>
  app.evaluate(() => {
    const l = (globalThis as { __learnLastMs?: LastMs }).__learnLastMs;
    if (l) {
      delete l.purge;
      delete l.purgeFiles;
    }
```
